Aru Peter tai laga dyna hath dhori kene khara kori bole dise, aru etu homoi te theng laga hardi khan te takot ahi jaise.
Titia etu manu khara hoi kene bera bole shuru hoise; aru taikhan logote mondoli bhitor te jaise, kudi kene aru berai kene Isor ke dhanyavad dise.
Aru sob manu taike berai kene Isor ke dhanyavad kora dikhise.
Aru manu khan taike dikhi kene jani loise tai kun ase, tai jun mondoli laga Sundur dorjate bhik mangi thake; aru tai logot ki hoise etu dikhi kene taikhan bisi asurit hoi jaise. Peter Pora Kotha Kowa
Aru tai Peter aru John logote jai thaka karone, sob manu polai ahi kene Solomon laga veranda kowa jagate joma hoise aru taikhan bisi asurit pora sai thakise.

Jitia Peter etu dikhise, tai manu khan ke koise, “Israel laga manu khan, etu dikhi kene kele iman asurit lagi ase? Aru kele amikhan ke eneka sai ase, amikhan laga hokti pora nohoile amikhan bisi bhal manu huwa pora taike berabo paribole diya nisena?

Abraham laga Isor ,Isaac aru Jacob laga Isor ,amikhan baba khan laga Isor ,Tai laga noukar Jisu ke mohima kori dise, tumikhan taike swekar kora nai aru Pilate laga hathte di Acts 3:14 xi Acts 3:22 dise, jitia Pilate pora Jisu ke chari dibo koise etu bhi tumikhan mana nai.
Tumikhan Pobitro aru dhormik ekjon ke luwa nai, aru manu morai diya ekjon ke chari dibole binti korise.
Kintu Jibon diya ke morai dise, junke Isor he mora pora aru jinda kori dise- aru amikhan utu laga sakhi ase.
Etiya, Jisu laga naam te aru biswas pora apnikhan junke dikhi ase taike takot kori dise. Jisu laga naam te aru Tai dwara thaka biswas pora etu manu ke apuni khan sob usorte pura bhal kori dise.
Etiya, bhai khan, moi jane apuni khan najani kene kori dise, aru tumikhan laga cholawta khan bhi eneka korise.
Kintu ji kotha Isor he tai laga bhabobadi khan mukh pora koi dise, Tai laga Khrista dukh pabo, aru Tai etu purah kori dise.
Mon ghura bhi, aru, titia nijor paap pora maph pabo,
Probhu laga asirbad apuni khan logote notun kori kene ahibo; aru Tai apuni khan nimite basi kene rakhi diya ekjon, Jisu Khrista ke pathai dibo.
Taike sorgote loi najabo jitia tak sob kaam pura nohoi, aru ji kotha Isor pora Tai laga pobitro bhabobadi khan laga mukh pora koi disele etu pura nohua tak.

Moses pora amikhan baba laga baba khan ke koise, ‘Probhu Isor pora tumikhan nimite bhai khan majot pora moi nisena ekjon bhabobadi ulai dibo, aru tai ki kotha kobo etu Acts 3:23 xii Acts 4:4 tumikhan sob hunibo.
Aru kun etu bhabobadi laga kotha nahunibo, etu bhabobadi pora taike manu laga majot pora khotom kori dibo.’
Aru Samuel pora loi kene jiman bhabobadi khan tai pichete ahise, taikhan sob pora etu din laga kotha he koise.
Apuni khan bhabobadi khan laga bacha khan ase, aru Isor pora apnikhan laga baba khan logote kowa nisena, Abraham ke koise, ‘Aru tumi laga bijon pora duniya te sob parivar asishit hobo*.’

Jitia Isor pora Tai laga noukar ke mora pora jinda kori dise,Tai pora Taike tumikhan usorte poila pathai dise, tumikhan laga biya kaam pora ghurai kene loi anibo aru asirbad dibo nimite.” 4 Peter Aru John Sabha Age Te
Jitia Peter aru John duijon pora manu khan logote kotha kori thakise, purohit khan aru mondoli laga henedhikari khan aru kunba sadducee khan taikhan duijon logot te ahise.
Taikhan bisi chinta hoi jaise, kelemane Peter aru John duijon to Jisu mora pora jinda uthijaise koi kene manu khan ke sikhai thakise.
Aru taikhan duijon ke dhori kene dusra din phojur tak bondhi ghor te rakhidise, kelemane saam hoija karone.
Kintu jiman manu etu kotha hunise taikhan Jisu ke biswas korise; aru biswas kora manu * 3:25 Gen. 12:3, 18:18, 22:18, 26:4. Acts 4:5 xiii Acts 4:12 khan sob milai kene panch hajar nisena hoi jaise.
Aru dusra dinte cholawta aru bura manu khan aru niyom likha khan sob Jerusalem te joma hoise.
Aru Annas moha purohit bhi ta te thakise, aru Caiaphas, John aru Alexandra aru jiman dangor purohit sob joma hoise.
Aru jitia Peter aru John ke taikhan laga majote rakhise, taikhan ke hudise, “Kun laga takot aru kun laga naam pora tumikhan etu korise?”
Titia Peter ,Pobitro Atma pora bhorta hoi kene, taikhan ke koise, “Apuni cholawta khan, aru bura manu khan,
amikhan ke ekta bemar manu ke bhal kaam kori diya nimite hudi ase koile, kineka kori kene tai bhal hoise?

Apuni khan aru Israel laga manu sob pora jani lobi, Nazareth Jisu Khrista naam pora, kunke tumikhan Cross te morai dise, kintu mora pora Taike Isor jinda kori dise, Tai laga naam pora etu manu bhal hoi kene tumikhan usorte khara ase.
Jisu Khrista etu pathor ase junke apuni khan pora phelai dise, ghor bona manu khan, kintu etu pathor he sob pora bhal aru kaam laga pathor hoi jaise*.

Aru Tai nohoile dusra kun bhi poritran dibole na paribo, kelemane sorgo laga nichete kun bhi eneka nai amikhan laga paap pora mukti dibole nimite.” * 4:11 Psa. 118:22; Dan. 2:34-35. Acts 4:13 xiv Acts 4:21
Jitia taikhan Peter aru John laga mon dangor dikhise, aru taikhan likha pora manu nohoi koi kene janise, taikhan asurit lagise, aru titia taikhan Jisu logote thakise koi kene chini bole parise.
Aru taikhan dikhise bhal hoi juwa manu tai duijon logote khara hoi thakise, aru taikhan eku bhi kobo para nai.
Aru jitia apostle khan ke sabha laga bahar te pathai dise, taikhan nijor majot te kotha patise.

Taikhan majot te eneka hudi thakise, “Amikhan etu duijon ke ki kori dile bhal hobo? Kelemane tai duijon pora asurit kaam kori diya to Jerusalem te thaka sob jani jaise, aru amikhan etu mana koribo na paribo.
Kintu etu kotha dusra jagate bisi najabo nimite, amikhan tai duijon ke koi dibo etu naam loi kene dusra ke aru nahikabole.”
Titia taikhan Peter aru John ke mati kene anise aru Jisu laga naam te nashika bole hukum dise.
Kintu Peter aru John taikhan ke koise, “Isor laga kotha huna to thik ase na apnikhan laga kotha mana to thik ase, etu apnikhan bhabi sabi.
Kelemane amikhan ki dikhise aru hunise etu nokoi kene thaki bole na paribo.”

Titia Peter aru John ke dhomki dikene jabole dise, kelemane manu khan tai duijon laga asurit kaam to dikhi kene Isor ke dhanyavad di thakise aru tai duijon ke sajai dibole eku golti taikhan dikha nai. Acts 4:22 xv Acts 4:28
Kelemane junke asurit pora changai kori dise etu manu chalis saal pora dangor thakise. Bhoi Nakoribo Karone Biswasi Khan Prathana Kora
Jitia tai duijon ke chari dise, Peter aru John nijor manu khan logote jai kene maha purohit khan aru cholawta khan pora ki koise etu taikhan ke koi dise.
Jitia taikhan etu hunise, taikhan sob awaj uthaikene eke logote Isor ke prathana korise, “Probhu, apuni sorgo aru prithibi bonaise aru samundar te ki ase sob bonai diya Probhu Isor hoi.
Apuni ekjon ase jun he Pobitro Atma pora Apuni laga noukar laga mukh pora koise, moi khan laga baba David, ‘Ki nimite Porjati manu khan khong uthise, Aru manu khan misa kotha khan kele bhabi thake?’
‘Prithibi laga raja khan uthi khara hoise, Aru cholawta khan eke logote joma hoise, Probhu laga bhirodh te aru Khrista laga bhirodh te†.’
Hosa pora, Herod aru Pontius Pilate, dusra jati aru Israel laga manu khan, sob eke logote joma hoi kene Apuni laga pobitro noukar junke Apuni asirbad korise taike manu khan pora hinsa korise‡.
Aru taikhan sob joma korise aru Apuni laga hath pora ki kori bole itcha asele etu sob poila pora hobo koi kene thakise. † 4:26 Psa. 2:1-2. ‡ 4:27 Isa. 61:1. Acts 4:29 xvi Acts 4:36
Etiya, Probhu, taikhan laga dhomki ke sabi, aru Apuni laga noukar laga mon dangor kori dibi Apuni laga kotha bhoi nakorikena kobole nimite.
Etu karone Apuni laga hath changai kori bole nimite khuli dibi, aru Apuni laga pobitro noukar Jisu laga naam te asurit kaam kori bole nimite.”

Aru jitia taikhan prathana kori khotom hoise taikhan jun jagate thakise etu hili bole shuru hoise, aru taikhan sob Pobitro Atma pora bhorta hoi jaise, aru taikhan bhoi nakori kene Isor laga kotha manu khan ke koise. Sampoti Sob Taikhan Eke Laga Hoise

Aru jiman manu biswas te joma hoi thakise taikhan sob mon aru bhabona sob eke hoi thakise, aru kun pora bhi nijor laga dhun sompoti etu moi laga ase koi kene kowa nai kintu ekjon-ekjon logote bhag korise.
Aru apostle khan dangor takot pora, Probhu Jisu jinda hoise koi kene gawahi di thakise, aru taikhan sob logote Isor laga anugrah thakise.
Aru taikhan majote kun bhi dukh nathaka hoise, kelemane kun logote kheti, ghor aru saman ase, tai etu sob bikiri kori kene etu laga daam ani di thakise.
Aru apostle khan laga theng nichete ani kene rakhi diye, aru taikhan kunke ki dorkar ase etu saikene bhag kori diye.
Titia Joseph, taike Barnabas koi kene apostle khan pora mate -Mon Dangor Kori Diya Putro bhi mate-, ekjon Levite, jonom pora Cyprus majuli laga manu, Acts 4:37 xvii Acts 5:8
tai laga ekta kheti thakise etu bikiri kori kene poisa anise aru apostle khan laga theng te rakhidise. 5 Ananias Aru Sapphira
Etiya ekjon manu Ananias, aru tai laga maiki Sapphira duijon mili kene chutu ekta mati bikiri korise,
Aru tai laga maiki logote kotha milai kene adha poisa rakhi loise, aru adha poisa jai kene apostle khan laga theng te rakhidise.
Kintu Peter koise, “Ananias, kele Saitan pora tumi laga mon to Pobitro Atma ke misa kobole bhorta kori dise aru ki bhikai se etu laga adha daam tumi kele loi rakhise?

Jitia mati tumi logote bikiri nohoi kene thakise, titia mati to tumi laga he thakise nohoi, aru jitia bikiri hoi jaise, tumi jani kene bikiri kora nohoi? Tumi laga monte kineka etu bhabise? Tumi manu ke misa kowa nai, kintu Isor ke he misa koi ase.”
Jitia Ananias etu kotha hunise, tai giri kene ta te mori jaise, aru jun etu kotha hunise sob bhoi lagi jaise.
Aru taike uthaikene jawan khan ahi kene kapra pora bandhi dise, aru loijai kene, matite hali dise.
Aru tin ghanta pichete, tai laga maiki ahise, hoilebi tai to ki hoise etu najani kene thakise.
Titia Peter taike jawab dise, “Amike kobi, tumi etu mati iman pora bikiri korise na nohoi.” Titia tai koise “Hoi, iman pora he bikiri korise.” Acts 5:9 xviii Acts 5:16

Titia Peter taike koise, “Tumi duijon mili kene Isor laga Atma ke porikha kori bole kene bhabise? Sabi, tumi laga mota ke matite hali diya manu khan dorja usorte khara kori ase, aru tumike bhi uthai loijabo.”
Titia tai etu homoi te Peter laga theng nichete giri kene mori jaise, aru jitia jawan khan bhitor te ahise, taike mora paise, aru bahar te loijai kene tai laga mota usorte dabai dise.
Aru jiman manu girja te thakise aru etu kotha hunise, taikhan sob bisi bhoi lagi jaise. Chihna Aru Chihna Kaam Bisi Kora
Aru apostle khan laga hath pora chihna kaam manu usorte bisi kori thakise, aru biswasi khan sob eke mon hoi kene Solomon laga Veranda te joma hoise.
Kintu taikhan logote abiswasi khan to kaam kori bole mon dangor thaka nai; hoilebi manu khan* pora taikhan ke bisi sonman di thakise.
Probhu laga naam te mota aru mahila khan bisi joma hoise, aru biswas khan logot mili kene ekta mon pora kaam korise,
etu karone manu khan bisna uthaikene bemar manu ke rasta te loijai kene rakhidise, jitia Peter ta te ahibo, tai laga chaya bemar manu khan uporte lagi kene changai pai jabo.

Aru Jerusalem usorte thaka nagar khan pora manu khan bemar aru biya atma pora dukh di thaka khan loi ani joma kori dise, aru sob manu jiman ahise bhal hoi jaise. * 5:13 Jersualem sheher laga manu khan. Acts 5:17 xix Acts 5:25 Apostle Khan ke Dhurikena Aru Chari Diya
Kintu maha purohit khara hoi jaise, aru jun manu tai logote thakise taikhan bhi uthijaise - Sadducee khan laga ekta dol-; aru taikhan etu saikene jolon hoise
aru apostle khan ke dhori kene bondhi ghor te rakhidise.
Kintu etu rati te Probhu laga sorgodoth ahi kene bondhi ghor laga dorja khuli dise, aru taikhan ke bahar ulai dise, aru koise,
“Jabi aru khara kori kene mondoli bhitor te jiman manu ase taikhan ke jibon laga kotha koi dibi.”

Aru jitia taikhan etu hunise, taikhan phojurte mondoli bhitor te jai kene sikhaise. Kintu maha purohit aru jiman manu tai logote thakise taikhan bhi ahise, aru Israel laga bacha khan laga dangor chokra khan ke sabha te eke logote matise, aru bondhi ghor pora apostle khan ke loi anibole nimite pathaise.
Kintu jitia daruga khan bondhi ghor te jaise, taikhan ke pa-a nai, titia taikhan wapas jai kene khobor dise.
Koise, “Amikhan jai kene saise, bondhi ghor bahar te sipahi khan bhi ta te khara kori thakise, kintu jitia amikhan Khuli Kena bhitor te jaise, ta te kunke bhi panai.”
Jitia mondoli laga cholawta aru moha purohit khan etu kotha hunise, taikhan asurit hoise, aru bhabise etu kineka hoi jaise.
Titia kunba ahi kene taikhan ke koise, “Sabi, apnikhan kunke bondhi ghor te hali dise, taikhan to mondoli te khara kori kene manu Acts 5:26 xx Acts 5:34 khan ke sikhai ase.”
Titia cholawta aru daruga khan jaise, aru taikhan ke loi anise, kintu taikhan eku kora nai, kelemane manu khan pora taikhan ke pathor maribo jodi taikhan pora apostle khan ke dukh dise koile.
Aru jitia taikhan ke anise, sabha usorte khara kori bole dise. Titia maha purohit pora taikhan ke hudise,

aru koise, “Amikhan koi dise apuni khan etu naam loi kene nasikhabi, kintu, tumikhan Jerusalem to pura tumikhan laga kotha pora bhorta kori dise, aru etu manu laga khun moi khan uporte hali bole bisari ase.”
Kintu Peter aru apostle khan koise, “Manu laga kotha huna pora to amikhan Isor laga kotha he poila manibo lage.
Amikhan laga baba khan laga Isor he Jisu ke jinda kori dise, junke apnikhan khuri te latkai kene morai dise.
Isor he Taike Probhu aru Tran-Korta bonai kene Tai laga dyna hathte rakhi loise, aru Israel manu khan ke notun jibon dibo aru paap pora mukti pabo.
Aru amikhan etu kotha laga gawahi ase, aru Isor Tai laga kotha mani thaka khan ke dibole Pobitro Atma bhi etu kotha laga sakhi ase.
Jitia sabhakhan etu kotha hunise, taikhan bisi khong uthise, aru apostle khan ke morai dibole mon hoise.”

Kintu sabha te ekjon Pharisee thakise, tai laga naam Gamaliel thakise, ekjon niyom jana manu, aru sob manu pora taike adar kore, tai Acts 5:35 xxi Acts 5:42 khara kori kene apostle khan ke olop deri nimite bahar te loi jabole koise.
Aru taikhan ke koise, “Israel laga manu, moi ki koi ase etu bhal pora huni bhi aru tumikhan etu manu khan logote ki kori bole lage.

Kelemane bisi sal age te, Theudas uthi kene tai kunba ekjon ase koise, aru charsoh nisena manu tai laga pichete jaise, taike morai dise, aru jun manu tai laga pichete jai thakise taikhan bhi sob alag-alag hoi jaise.
Etu pichete Galilee pora Judas koi kene ekjon uthise, tai bhi manu khan ke chela bonai loise le, kintu tai bhi harai jaise, aru jiman taike mani thakise taikhan sob alag-alag hoi jaise.
Etiya moi apnikhan ke koi ase, eitu khan pora dur thakibi aru taikhan ke chari dibi, kelemane jodi etu dhorom aru kaam to manu pora ase koile, taikhan bhi khotom hoi jabo.
Kintu jodi Isor pora ase koile, tumikhan taikhan ke kitia bhi hata bona paribo; aru tumikhan nijor Isor logote lorai kori thaka nisena hobo.”
Titia taikhan apostle khan ke matise aru mari kene taikhan ke Jisu laga naam aru nolobole koise, aru jabole dise.
Taikhan sabha pora ulai jaise aru Jisu laga naam nimite, dukh paise koi kene khushi pora jaise.
Aru etu pichete, mondoli te bhi aru ghor-ghor te jai kene Jisu Khrista laga susamachar manu khan ke prochar kori thakise. Acts 6:1 xxii Acts 6:7 6 Sewa Karone Sat Jon Basi Luwa

Aru etu dinte, jitia chela khan bisi hoi thakise, titia Yunani khan, Yehudi khan ke bhirodh kori thakise, kelemane mota morija maiki khan ke kha luwa bhag kora homoi te hisab nakore koi kene taikhan biya pai thakise.
Titia baroh ta chela khan pora taikhan pichete aha khan ke koise, “Etu amikhan nimite thik nohoi Isor laga kotha chari kene kha luwa laga bhag kori thaki te jabo nalage.
Etu karone bhai khan, apnikhan majote sat jon bhal manu khan ke basi lobi, Pobitro Atma aru gyaan thaka, junke amikhan etu kaam nimite basi lobo.
Kintu amikhan hodai prathana kori thakibo aru Isor laga kotha aru kaam te age jai thakibo.”

Taikhan laga kotha sob manu khan pora bhal paise. Aru taikhan Stephen ke basi loise jun dhormik aru Pobitro Atma pora bhorta thakise, aru Philip, aru Prochorus, aru Nicanor , Timon, Parmenas, aru Nicolaus, Yehudi niyom mani thaka Antioch pora aha ekjon.
Taikhan ke apostle usorte anise, aru apostle khan pora hath dikene taikhan uporte prathana kori dise.

Titia Isor laga kotha khuli prochar hoi jaise, aru biswasi khan bisi-bisi hoi thakise aru Jerusalem te purohit khan bhi bisi manu biswasi khan logot mili jaise. Stephen Ke Dhori Luwa Acts 6:8 xxiii Acts 7:1
Etiya Stephen pura takot aru anugrah te bhorta hoi kene manu usorte dangor asurit kaam kori thakise.
Kintu mondoli te Freedmen koi kene kunba uthise, aru Cyrenia aru Alexandria manu, aru Cilicia aru Asia pora kunba ahi kene Stephen logote kotha pora lagi jaise.
Kintu taikhan Stephen to gyaan aru Pobitro Atma pora kotha kowa dikhi kene tai uporte jiti bole para nai.
Titia taikhan poisa dikene manu khan ke kobole koise, “Amikhan Stephen pora Moses aru Isor laga biya kotha koi thaka hunise.”
Aru taikhan pora bura khan aru niyom likha khan laga mon ulta kori dise aru Stephen ke dhurikena taike sabha usorte tani kene loi anise.
Taikhan misa gawahi diya manu bhi loi anise, aru koise, “Etu manu to amikhan laga pobitro jaga aru niyom laga bhirodh te biya kotha kobole narukhe.
Kelemane amikhan tai pora etu kowa hunise, Nazareth laga Jisu pora etu jaga khotom kori dibo, aru Moses ki niyom amikhan ke dise etu sob bodli kori dibo.”
Aru jiman manu sabha te bohi thakise sob Stephen ke he saise, aru tai laga chehera to sorgodoth laga chehera nisena dikhise. 7 Stephen Laga Kotha
Titia maha purohit pora hudise, “Etu kotha khan hosa ase? Acts 7:2 xxiv Acts 7:9
Titia Stephen koise, “Bhai khan aru baba khan, moi laga kotha huni bhi: Isor laga mohima baba Abraham logote ahise jitia tai Mesopotamia te thakise, tai Haran te nathaka age pora;
aru taike koise, ‘Tumi laga mati aru ghor manu khan pora ulai jabi, aru moi jun jaga tumike dikha bo ta te jabi.’
Titia Abraham pora Chaldea laga desh chari kene Haran te thaki jaise; aru tai laga baba mora pichete, Isor pora taike etu jagate loi anise, jun jagate tumikhan etiya thaki ase.
Kintu Tai taike etu jaga diya nai, tai laga theng rakhibole bhi diya nai. Kintu Isor pora taike aru tai laga khandan ke, ekta jaga dibo koi kene kosom dise, tai laga bacha nathaka hoilebi.
Kintu Isor pora taike eneka koise, tai laga khandan khan dusra desh te alag manu hoi kene thakibo, aru etu jaga laga manu khan taikhan ke nokor bonai rakhibo aru charsoh saal tak bisi dukh dibo.
‘Aru,’ Isor koise, ‘jun jati taikhan ke nokor banabo, utu jati khan ke moi bisar koribo, titia taikhan ulai ahi kene moike etu jagate mohima koribo.’

Titia Isor pora Abraham ke sunnot laga kosom dise, titia Abraham, Isaac laga baba hoise aru ath-dinte Isaac ke sunnot korise; aru Isaac pora Jacob laga baba hoise, aru Jacob pora baroh ta bacha paise aru etu khandan laga baba hoise.
Kintu Joseph laga bhai khan tai uporte ke suku jolise, aru taike Egypt te bikiri kori dise; Acts 7:10 xxv Acts 7:20 kintu Isor tai logote thakise.
Aru Isor pora tai laga dukh sob pora bachai loise. Tai laga gyaan pora Egypt raja Pharaoh laga mon jiti loise, aru raja pora taike Egypt aru tai laga ghor uporte Governor bonai dise.
Titia Egypt aru Canaan desh te akaal ahise, aru bisi dukh paise, aru amikhan laga baba khan khabole panai.
Kintu jitia Jacob hunise Egypt te dhaan ase koi kene, tai amikhan laga baba khan ke ta te pathaise.
Aru dusra bar Joseph nijor bhai khan ke tai kun ase utu janibole dise, aru Pharaoh bhi Joseph laga ghor manu khan ke jani loise.
Titia Joseph tai laga kokai khan logote manu pathai kene Jacob aru tai logote pachatar jonke loi kene Egypt te anibole pothaise.
Titia Jacob Egypt te jaise, Jacob aru amikhan laga baba khan sob ta te morise.
Aru taikhan laga mora gaw to Shechem te loijai kene kote Abraham pora Hamor bacha khan logote poisa dikene mati kini rakhise ta te kobor dise.
Jitia Isor pora Abraham logote kosom khai kene rakha homoi ahise- etu kosom juntu Isor he Abraham logote korise- Egypt te manu bisi hoi jaise.
Joseph ke najana ekjon raja Egypt te ulaise.
Tai amikhan laga manu ke thogai dise, aru jiman notun jonom huwa bacha khan ase taikhan ke ulai anibole koise ta te taikhan eitu khan ke jinda thaki bole nadibo.
Etu homoi te Moses jonom hoise; tai Isor Acts 7:21 xxvi Acts 7:30 nimite bisi sundur thakise, aru taike tin mohina tak tai baba ghor te rakhise.
Kintu jitia taike bahar te rakhise, Pharaoh laga swali pora taike loi kene nijor bacha nisena palise.
Aru Moses ke Egypt laga gyaan aru niyom sob sikhai dise, aru tai kotha aru kaam te bhi bisi takot thakise.
Kintu jitia tai chalis saal hoi jaise, tai nijor Israel bhai khan ke lok kori bole mon korise.
Aru ek din, jitia Israel manu ekjon ke dukh pai thaka dikhise, Moses etu manu ke modot kori bole jaise, aru etu dikhi kene Moses pora etu Egypt manu ke morai dise.
Tai bhabisele, tai laga bhai khan bujhi bo paribo, Isor he taikhan ke bachai dibo nimite taike pathaise, kintu taikhan etu bujhi bo para nai.
Aru dusra dinte duijon Israel manu jhagara kori thaka homoi te tai ponchise, aru ekjon-ekjon logote shanti rakhibole koise, ‘Bhai khan, kele nijor bhai kokai majote jhagara kori ase?’
Kintu jun tai usorte manu logot jhagara kori thakise, Moses ke pichete dhakai kene, koise, ‘Tumike kun pora amikhan uporte hukum chola bole dise?
Juwa kali ekjon Egypt manu ke morai diya nisena, moike bhi mora bole mon ase?’
Etu kotha huni kene Moses polai jaise, aru Median laga desh te alag desh manu hoi kene thaki jaise, aru ta te tai duita chokra bacha laga baba hoi jaise.
Aru jitia chalis saal paar hoi jaise, Probhu Acts 7:31 xxvii Acts 7:37 laga sorgodoth Sinai Pahar laga jongol te jui nisena kori kene tai usorte ahise.
Jitia Moses jui dikhise, tai etu dikhi kene bisi asurit hoise, aru usor pora sabole jaise, titia Probhu laga awaj hunise.
‘Moi tumi laga baba khan laga Isor ase, Abraham, Isaac aru Jacob laga Isor .’ Titia Moses kapi kene bhoi pora ta te phale sabole para nai.
Titia Probhu* taike koise, ‘Tumi laga theng pora juta ulai rakhi dibi, kelemane kuntu jagate tumi khara ase etu jaga Pobitro ase.
Ami laga manu khan Egypt te dukh kori thaka Moi dikhise, aru taikhan kandi thaka awaj hunise, aru taikhan ke bacha bole nimite Moi ahise; etu karone ahibi, Moi tumike Egypt te pathabo.’

Etu Moses, junke Israel manu khan pora grohon kora nai, tai koise, ‘Kun he tumike moi khan uporte cholawta koribo dise?’- Tai ekjon thakise junke Isor pora cholawta bonaise aru bachai dibole nimite pathaise- aru sorgodoth hath pora Moses ke jongol te dikhai dise.

Moses pora he Egypt pora taikhan ke ulai anise, aru sob asurit kaam khan Egypt laga matite dikhai thakise aru Ghar laga Samundar te, aru jongol majot pora taikhan ke chalis saal tak cholai kene loi jaise.

Etu Moses he ase, jun Israel khan ke koise, ‘Isor pora tumikhan nimite tumikhan laga bhai kokai khan majot pora ekjon moi nisena bhabobadi ulai dibo.’ * 7:33 Yate, Probhu to Isor ke koi ase. Acts 7:38 xxviii Acts 7:45

Etu tai ase, jongol te thaka homoi te, Sinai Pahar te sorgodoth logot kotha korise, aru kun amikhan baba laga baba khan logot asele, aru utu tai ase jun pora jinda kotha paikene amikhan ke ponchai dise.
Etu manu laga kotha moi khan laga baba laga baba khan mani bole mon kora nai, kintu taike hatai dise, aru taikhan laga mon Egypt phale jai jaise.
Aru Aaron koise, ‘Amikhan nimite murti khan bonai dibi jun amikhan ke loi kene age jabo. Aru etu Moses, jun he amikhan ke Egypt pora loi anise, taike ki hoise amikhan najane.’
Titia taikhan ekta goru bacha bonaise, aru hath pora bona laga murti ke kiba ani kene boli dise, aru khushi manai thakise.

Kintu Isor taikhan ke chari kene akas aru tara khan ke puja kori bole dise, jineka bhabobadi khan laga kitab te likha ase, ‘Tumikhan moike janwar laga boli diya nai Chalis saal jongol te thaka homoi te, tumi Israel manu khan kotha manise?

Apuni khan Molech laga tambu ke mani loise, Aru tumikhan laga bhagwan Rephan laga tara bhi, aru murti bonai kene puja kori bole loi jaise karone: Moi tumikhan ke Babylon pora bisi dur te loi rakhidibo.’
Ami laga baba laga baba khan logot sakhi laga tambu ase, jineka taike dikhaise jongol te, tineka bona bole koise, aru thik tineka bonai loise.

Etu ase tombu ghor juntu amikhan baba khan pora paikene Joshua hath pora loi yate Acts 7:46 xxix Acts 7:54 anise, jitia taikhan desh khan ke gheri loi kene kabja kori loise, jun khan Isor he amikhan laga baba khan usor pora khedai dise, aru David raja laga homoi tak thakise,
jun Isor itcha te paise, tai mangise Jacob laga Isor ke thaki bole ekta jagah karone.
Kintu Solomon he Isor karone ekta ghor bonai dise.
Kintu, Mohan Isor to manu pora bonai diya ghor te nathake, bhabobadi pora kowa nisena,
‘Sorgo to Ami laga singhason, aru prithibi Ami laga theng rakha jaga. Probhu koise, tumi Moi karone ghor bonai dibo? Aru Ami laga aram kora jaga to kote hobo?
Moi he nijor hath pora etu sob bona nai naki?’
Tumikhan phutani aru mon aru kaan te sunnot nakora khan, tumikhan Pobitro Atma laga hinsa kori thake, tumikhan baba laga baba khan kori aha nisena, tineka apuni khan bhi kore.

Eneka kun bhabobadi ase junke tumikhan laga baba pora dukh diya nai? Taikhan pora ahibole thaka Dharmik Jon Jisu laga kotha kowa manu khan ke bhi morai dise, aru tumikhan bhi morai diya aru thogai diya khan hoi jaise,
Tumikhan sorgodoth khan pora diya Isor laga niyom luwa khan, hoilebi tumikhan manibo para nai.” Pathor Pora Stephen Ke Morai Diya
Jitia taikhan etu kotha hunise, sabha laga manu khan monte bisi khong hoise, aru dath kamuri kene Stephen uporte khong uthise. Acts 7:55 xxx Acts 8:2
Kintu tai Pobitro Atma te bhorta hoi kene, sorgote saise, aru Isor laga mohima aru Jisu to Isor laga dyna hath phale khara thaka dikhi paise.
Stephen pora hala kori kene koise, “Sabi, sorgo khuli thaka dikhi ase, aru Manu laga Putro Isor laga dyna hath phale khara kori ase.”
Titia taikhan untcha awaj pora hala korise, aru kaan bondh kori kene sob eke logot tai usorte polai ahise.
Aru taikhan taike sheher bahar te loijai kene taike pathor mari dise, aru gawahi khan taikhan laga kapra loise aru jawan manu ekjon naam Saul laga bhori te rakhise.
Aru taikhan jitia Stephen ke pathor mari thakise, tai Isor ke mati kene koise, “Probhu Jisu, moi laga Atma loi lobi.”
Titia tai athukarikena jor awaj pora koise, “Probhu, taikhan ke etu paap laga bisar nokoribi.” Etu koi kene tai ghumai jaise. 8 Saul Pora Girja Nosto Kora

Saul bhi Stephen ke morai dibole monjur korise, aru etu dinte Jerusalem te thaka girja te bisi dukh digdar ahise; aru sob biswasi khan Judea aru Samaria te alag-alag jai jaise, khali apostle khan he thakise.
Biswasi manu khan pora Stephen laga gaw uthai loijai kene kobor dise, aru manu khan mon dukh korise. Acts 8:3 xxxi Acts 8:12
Kintu Saul girja khan ke biya kori bole kosis kori thakise; aru ghor-ghor te jai kene, mota aru maiki sobke dhori kene bondhi ghor te hali dise. Philip Pora Samaria Te Khrista Prochar Kora
Aru jun biswasi alag phale jai jaisele taikhan ja-a jaga sob te khushi laga khobor prochar kori thakise.
Titia Philip Samaria sheher te jai kene manu khan ke Khrista laga kotha prochar kori dise.
Aru Philip ki kotha prochar korise, taikhan mon dikene hunise, aru tai kori diya asurit kaam khan dikhise.
Bisi manu bhitor te dusto atma khan thakise, aru eitu khan taikhan pora ulai jaise, jor pora hala kori kene. Bisi manu jothor aru lengra khan bhi changai paise.
Aru etu sheher manu khan bisi khushi korise. Jadu Kora Simon Biswas Kora
Kintu ta te Simon koi kene ekjon manu thakise, tai jadu montor kori kene Samaria manu khan ke asurit kori dise, aru tai nijorke ekjon dangor manu ase koi thake.
Aru sob Samaria manu chutu pora dangor tak tai laga kotha bhal pora huni thakise aru koise, “Etu manu logote Isor laga takot ase.”
Tai laga kotha manu khan hune, kelemane bisi homoi pora tai jadu montor kori kene manu khan ke asurit kaam dikhai thakise, etu karone taikhan tai laga kotha mani thakise.
Kintu jitia taikhan Philip ke biswas korise, aru tai Isor laga rajyo kotha aru Jisu Khrista Acts 8:13 xxxii Acts 8:22 laga naam ke prochar korise, bisi mota aru maiki khan baptizma loise.
Titia Simon nijor bhi biswas korise, aru tai baptizma loi kene Philip logote thaki jaise, aru jitia asurit kaam khan kora dikhise, tai bisi khushi paise.
Jitia Jerusalem te thaka apostle khan Samaria pora Isor kotha loise koi kene hunise, taikhan nimite Peter aru John ke pathaise.
Jitia Peter aru John ta te punchise, taikhan nimite prathana korise, taikhan Pobitro Atma pabo nimite.
Kelemane Pobitro Atma taikhan logote aha nai, kintu taikhan Probhu Jisu naam pora khali baptizma he loi kene thaka karone.
Titia Peter aru John taikhan uporte hath rakhi kene prathana kori dise, aru taikhan Pobitro Atma paise.
Aru jitia Simon dikhise apostle khan manu laga uporte hath rakhile Pobitro Atma pai ase, tai apostle khan ke poisa dibole bisarise.
Titia tai koise, “Moike bhi etu adhikar dibi, ta te moi jun uporte hath rakhibo tai Pobitro Atma pabo.”
Kintu Peter taike koise, tumi laga poisa tumi logote khotom hoi jabo, kelemane tumi Isor laga bordan poisa pora kini bole bhabi ase.
Tumi laga yate eku bhag aru hisa nai, kelemane Probhu usorte tumi laga mon thik nohoi.
Etu nimite mon ghura bhi aru biya bhabona pora ulabi, aru Probhu usorte prathana koribi, Acts 8:23 xxxiii Acts 8:30 titia Tai pora tumi laga letera mon aru biya bhabona pora maph kori dibo pare.
Kelemane moi dikhi ase tumi laga biya bhabona aru paap pora bandi thaka mon to.”
Titia Simon koise, “Probhu logot moi nimite prathana kori dibi, apuni pora ki koise etu moi uporte nahibole nimite.”

Jitia taikhan Isor kotha koi dise aru sakhi korise, Peter aru John wapas Jerusalem te jaise, aru Samaria manu laga bosti khan te jai kene Isor laga kotha prochar korise. Philip Aru Ethiopia Laga Hijira
Titia Probhu laga sorgodoth Philip logote kotha korise, aru koise, “Uthibi aru dakshin laga rasta jun to Jerusalem hoi kene Gaza te jai ta te jabi.”- Etu rasta balu laga jaga pora jai.

Titia tai uthi kene jaise. Aru ta te Ethiopia laga ekjon hijira manu thakise, tai ekjon dangor adhikar chola manu thakise, tai Candace, Ethiopia laga rani laga dhun sampoti sa-a manu asele, aru tai mohima kori bole Jerusalem te jai thakise.
Aru tai laga ghora gaari te bohi kene wapas ghor te jai thakise, aru Isaiah bhabobadi laga kitab porhi thakise.
Titia Atma pora Philip ke koise, “Jai kene ghora gari usorte bohibi.”
Titia Philip tai usorte polaikene jaise, aru Tai Isaiah bhabobadi laga kitab porhi thaka hunise, aru koise, “Tumi ki porhi ase etu bujhi pai ase?” Acts 8:31 xxxiv Acts 8:37
Titia tai koise, “Moi kineka janibo, jitia tak moike kunba pora nashikai?” Titia tai Philip ke ghora gari te bohi bole matise.

Etiya jun to kitab Ethiopia manu pora porhi thakise etu eneka thakise, “Taike ekta mer bolidan dibole nisena loi jaise, Aru jineka mer bacha pora chuli kata manu usorte chup-chap pora bohe, Etu nisena, aru Tai pora Tai laga mukh khula nai.
Tai laga bisar sorom khilai dikene Tai usor pora loi jaise. Kun Tai laga manu khan ase koi kene kobo pare? Kelemane Tai laga jibon to etu duniya pora uthai loise.”
Titia hijira pora Philip ke hudise, “Moi apuni ke anurodh kori ase, kun bhabobadi laga kotha koi ase, tai nijor laga koi ase, na dusra manu laga kotha koi ase?”
Titia Philip tai mukh khuli se, aru Isor kotha pora shuru kori kene, Jisu laga kotha taike prochar korise.
Taikhan rasta te jai thaka homoi te pani thaka jagah ponchise, titia hijira pora koise, “Sabi, yate pani ase, moike baptizma lobole nimite ki pora rukhai ase?’ ”
Titia Philip pora koise, “Jodi tumi mon pora biswas kore, baptizma lobo pare.” Titia tai koise, “Moi biswas kore Jisu Khrista Isor laga chokra ase koi kene.” Acts 8:38 xxxv Acts 9:5
Titia tai ghora gari ke rukhibole hukum dise. Aru Philip aru hijira duijon panite namikene jaise, aru Philip pora taike baptizma dise.
Jitia taikhan pani pora ulai ahise, Probhu laga Atma pora Philip ke loi jaise, titia hijira taike aru dikha nai, kintu tai bisi khushi pora jai jaise.
Kintu Philip to Azotus te ahise, aru pura jagate tai jaise, jitia tak tai Caesarea puncha nai, tai sob sheher khan te jai kene Isor laga kotha prochar korise. 9 Saul Mon Bodli Huwa
Kintu Saul, Probhu laga chela khan ke morai dibo koi kene kotha kori thakise aru tai moha purohit logote jaise

aru tai moha purohit logote chithi mangise Damascus sheher laga mondoli khan nimite, jodi tai rasta te jai thaka homoi te kunba manu pai, mota aru mahila hoilebi, eitu khan ke dhori kene Jerusalem te loi jabole.
Jitia tai safar te jai thakise, Damascus te punchibole usor huwa homoi te, achanak sorgo pora ujala hoi kene ekta puhor tai uporte jolise;
aru titia tai matite giri jaise, aru ekta awaj taike koi thaka hunise, “Saul, Saul, kele tumi Moike dukh di ase?”
Aru titia Saul hudise, “Apuni kun ase Probhu?” Aru Probhu jowab dise, “Moi Jisu ase junke tumi dukh di ase; pathor te theng marile nijor he jokhom pabo.” Acts 9:6 xxxvi Acts 9:15
Titia tai asurit hoise aru bhoi pora kapi kene koise, “Probhu moi ki kori bole lage?” Titia Probhu taike koise, “Uthibi aru Damascus sheher te jabi, aru tumi ki koribo lage etu sob tumike koi dibo.”
Jun manu Saul logote jai thakise taikhan chup hoi jaise, taikhan awaj hunise, kintu kunke bhi dikha nai.
Titia Saul khara hoise, aru jitia tai laga suku khuli se, tai eku bhi dikhi bole napara hoise; titia taikhan tai laga hath dhori kene Damascus te loi jaise.
Aru tai tin din suku andha hoi jaise aru eku dikhi bole para nai, aru kha luwa bhi kora nai.
Damascus te ekjon chela Ananias koi kene thakise. Probhu pora taike darshan pora koise, “Ananais!” Titia tai koise, “Sabi, moi yate ase Probhu.”
Titia Probhu taike koise, “Uthibi, aru Sidha kowa rasta te jabi, aru Judas laga ghor te jai kene ekjon manu Saul, Tarsus sheher pora aha, ase na nai hudibi, kelemane tai prathana kori ase.
Aru tai darshan te ekjon manu Ananias koi kene dikhise, aru tai uporte te hath rakhi kene thaka dikhise, etu pora tai aru dikhibo paribo.”
Kintu Ananias koise, “Probhu, moi etu manu laga kotha bisi manu pora hunise, tai Jerusalem te kiman pobitro manu ke dukh dise.
Tai moha purohit khan pora adhikar loise aru jun manu apuni laga naam lobo taike bondhi ghor te hali dibo.”

Kintu Probhu taike koise, “Jabi, kelemane tai Moi laga basi luwa kaam kora manu hobo, Acts 9:16 xxxvii Acts 9:23 tai he moi laga naam Porjati khan ke, raja khan ke aru Israel laga bacha khan ke koi dibo;
kelemane Moi taike dikhai dibo, tai moi laga naam nimite ki dukh uthabo lagibo.”

Aru Ananias etu ghor te jaise, aru tai laga hath Saul uporte rakhi kene koise, “Bhai Saul, Probhu Jisu pora tumi rasta te ahi thaka homoi te dikhai dise, Tai moike tumi usorte pathaise, tumi aru dikhibo aru Pobitro Atma pora bhorta hobo.”
Etu homoi te Saul laga suku pora kiba chamra nisena giri jaise, aru tai dikhi bole parise, aru tai uthi kene baptizma loise;
aru tai bhat khai kene takot paise. Saul Pora Jisu Ke Prochar Kora Aru tai chela khan logote Damascus te olop din thakise.
Tai joldi mondoli khan te jai kene Khrista Isor laga Putro ase koi kene prochar korise.

Aru jun manu tai laga kotha hunise sob manu asurit hoi kene koise, “Jerusalem te Khrista naam loi thaka khan ke dukh diya to etu manu nohoi? Aru yate tai yate aha to taikhan ke bandi kene moha purohit khan logot loi jabole ahise.”
Kintu Saul aru bisi mon dangor hoise, aru Damascus te thaka Yehudi khan nimite ekta chinta hoi jaise aru Jisu he Khrista ase koikena prochar kori thakise. Damascus Pora Saul Polai Juwa
Kintu bisi din ja pichete, Yehudi khan Saul ke morai dibole kotha milai loise. Acts 9:24 xxxviii Acts 9:31
Kintu taikhan laga bhabona to Saul jani loise. Taike morai dibole nimite din raat dorja usorte te rukhi thakise.
Kintu tai laga chela khan rati huwa homoi te, taike ani kene tukri pora diwar niche korise aru paar kori dise. Saul Jerusalem Te
Aru jitia Saul Jerusalem te ahise, tai chela khan logote mili bole kosis korise, kintu taikhan sob taike bhoi korise, tai bhi ekjon chela ase koi kene biswas kora nai.

Kintu Barnabas pora taike apostle khan logote loi jaise, aru Probhu pora kineka taike rasta te lok paise aru ki koise, aru tai Damascus te kineka mon dangor pora Jisu laga naam prochar korise, etu sob koi dise.
Titia tai chela khan logote Jerusalem te aha juwa korise. Aru tai mon dangor pora Probhu laga naam loise.
Tai Greece te thaka Yehudi khan logot bhi kotha korise; kintu taikhan taike morai dibole kosis korise.
Jitia biswasi bhai khan etu janise, taike Caesarea te loijai kene Tarsus te pathai dise.

Titia, Judea aru Galilee aru Samaria laga girja khan shanti te thakise; aru Probhu laga bhoi te thakise aru ekjon-ekjon ke Pobitro Atma pora mon dangor kori dise, aru girja laga ginti aru bhi bisi hoi jaise. Aeneas ke Bhal Kora Acts 9:32 xxxix Acts 9:40
Etiya eneka hoise, jitia Peter sob jagate safar korise, Lydda town te thaka Isor laga manu khan usorte bhi jaise.
Ta te tai Aeneas koi kene ekjon manu ke lok paise, tai bisna te ath saal pora ghumai thakise, aru tai jothor bemar thakise.
Peter taike koise, “Aeneas, Jisu Khrista tumike changai koridi ase, uthibi aru tumi laga bisna thik kori lobi,” aru titia tai joldi uthijaise.
Titia Lydda aru Sharon te thaka manu khan taike dikhi kene mon ghuraise aru Probhu ke biswas korise.
Joppa te Tabitha koi kene ekjon mahila chela thakise, jun laga motlob ase “Dorcas.” Etu mahila sob bhal kaam kore aru gorib manu khan uporte bisi morom thakise.
Kintu tai bemar pora mori jaise, aru taike gaw dhulai dikene upor kamra te rakhise.
Aru Lydda jaga to Joppa usorte thakise, aru Peter ta te ase koi kene chela khan hunise, aru taikhan pora duijon manu ke tai logote anurodh kori kene pathaise, “Amikhan logote deri nohoi kene ahibi.”

Titia Peter uthi kene taikhan logot jaise. Jitia tai ponchise, taikhan pora taike upor kamra te loi jaise aru ta te sob bidhowa khan tai usorte khara kori kene kandi thakise, aru Dorcas pora tai jinda thaka homoi te taikhan nimite kapra bonai diya khan dikhai dise.

Kintu Peter taikhan sobke bahar jabo dise, aru tai athukari kene prathana korise. Titia, tai laga gaw phale saikene koise, “Tabitha, uthibi.” Tai suku khuli se, aru Peter ke dikhi kene tai Acts 9:41 xl Acts 10:7 bohi jaise.
Titia Peter tai laga hath dikene taike uthai dise; aru pobitro manu aru bidhowa khan ke jinda hoi juwa to dikhai dise.
Aru Joppa te thaka sob etu kotha jani loise, aru bisi manu Probhu ke biswas korise.
Peter bisi din Joppa te Simon koi kene ekjon manu ghor te thakise. 10 Peter Aru Cornelius
Titia ekjon manu Cornelius koi kene Caesarea te thakise, aru tai Italy laga Regiment te ekjon dangor henapoti thakise.
Tai aru tai laga ghor manu khan sob Isor ke bhoi kora khan thakise; aru tai manu khan ke poisa dikena modot kora manu asele, aru hodai Isor logote prathana kori thakise.
Ek din tin baji nisena te, tai ekta sapha sapna dikhise, Isor laga ekjon sorgodoth tai logote ahi kene koise, “Cornelius!”
Kintu Cornelius sorgodoth ke bhoi pora saikene hudise, “Ki ase, malik?” Titia sorgodoth pora taike koise, “Tumi laga prathana aru dukh manu ke modot kora to Isor pora dikhise.
Etiya Joppa te kunba manu pathai kene Simon, kunke Peter bhi mate, taike anibi.
Tai Simon koi kene ekjon chamra ula kaam kora manu laga ghor te ase, tai laga ghor samundar kinar te ase.”
Jitia sorgodoth taike kotha koi kene jai jaise, Cornelius tai laga duijon noukar ke matise, aru Acts 10:8 xli Acts 10:17 bisi majote ekjon bhal sipahi jun taike sewa kore taike bhi mati anise.
Aru taikhan ke sob kotha koi diya pichete, Cornelius taikhan ke Joppa te pathaise. Peter Pora Darshan Dikha
Etiya aru alag din ekta te, taikhan jai thaka homoi te ekta sheher te ponchise, Peter ghor uporte prathana kori bole jaise.
Titia tai bisi bhuk lagise, aru kiba khabole itcha thakise, kintu jitia manu khan bhat bonai thakise, tai ekta darshan dikhise,
aru tai akas pora kiba ekta saman aha dikhise, ekta dangor kapra, charta kinar pora bandhi kene prithibi nichete ahi thaka dikhise.
Aru ta te prithibi laga sob janwar charta theng thaka aru matite rengi kene choli thaka jongli janwar ,aru akas laga chiriya khan sob thakise.
Aru titia ekta awaj taike koise: “Uthibi, Peter ,aru mari kene khabi.”
Kintu Peter koise, “Nohobo Probhu, moi kitia bhi sapha nathaka aru letera saman khanai.”
Kintu aru ekbar awaj ahi kene koise: “Ki Isor pora sapha kori dise, etu ke letera ase nokobi.”
Aru eneka ti bar hoise; titia saman pora bhorta thaka sorgote wapas loi jaise.

Titia Peter etu darshan laga ki motlob ase koi kene bisi chinta bhabona korise, etu homoi te, Cornelius pora kun manu ke pathaise taikhan ahi kene dorjate khara hoi thakise, Acts 10:18 xlii Acts 10:26 taikhan ahi kene Simon laga ghor kot te ase etu bisari kene ahise.
Aru taikhan ahi kene matise, aru Simon kunke Peter bhi koi, tai ta te thaki ase na nai etu hudise.
Etu homoi te bhi Peter to tai ki darshan paise etu bhabona kori thakise, titia Pobitro Atma pora taike koise, “Sabi, kunba manu tumike bisari ase.
Uthibi aru taikhan logote jabi, eku bhabona nokoribi, kelemane moi he taikhan ke pathaise.”
Titia Peter niche kamra te namikene taikhan ke koise, “Sabi, tumikhan kunke bisari ase etu moi ase. Ki nimite tumikhan moike bisari kene ahise?”

Aru taikhan koise, “Henapoti Cornelius jun dharmik manu ase, aru sob Yehudi desh manu khan pora tai laga bhal kotha he koi, pobitro sorgodoth pora etu ghor te apuni logote pathaise, apuni pora kowa kotha to huni bole nimite.”
Titia Peter taikhan ke tai logote thaki bole matise. Aru dusra dinte uthi kene taikhan logote jaise, aru Joppa pora kunba bhai khan bhi tai logote jaise.
Aru dusra dinte taikhan Caesarea te ponchise. Cornelius pora tai laga sathi aru ghor manu khan ke bhi mati kene rukhi thakise.
Jitia Peter ghor bhitor te ahise, Cornelius ahi kene taike lok korise, aru taike aradhana kori bole Peter laga theng nichete girise.
Kintu Peter taike uthaikene, koise, “Uthibi! Moi nijor bhi ekjon manu he ase.” Acts 10:27 xliii Acts 10:34
Aru jitia Peter tai logote kotha kori thakise, tai jai kene manu bisi joma kori thaka paise.

Titia tai taikhan ke koise, “Apnikhan bhi jani ase, Yehudi manu dusra jati khan ke lok kora aru eke logote mili kene aha juwa kora niyom nai. Kintu Isor pora moike dikhaise aru koise kunke bhi letera aru sapha nai eneka nokobi.
Etu nimite moi apuni khan logote eku nokoi kene ahise, jitia apuni pora moike mati bole pathaise. Etu karone moi hudise ki nimite moike lobole pathaise?”
Titia Cornelius koise, “Char din age te etu homoi te, moi ghor te prathana kori thakise; aru sabi ekjon manu moi usorte boga kapra lagai kene khara kori thakise.
Aru tai koise, ‘Cornelius, tumi laga prathana huni loise, aru tumi gorib manu khan ke modot kora to Isor pora Tai usorte yaad kori ase.
Etu karone kunba ke Joppa te patha bhi, aru Simon junke Peter koi. Taike mati bhi, tai samundar kinar te chamra ula kaam kora manu Simon koi kene ekjon ghor te ase.’

Etu karone moi apuni ke lobole kunba manu pathaise. Aru apuni aha karone bisi bhal paise, aru etu karone, amikhan aji Isor usorte sob manu joma hoi ase, aru Probhu pora apuni ke ki koise etu huni bole nimite joma hoise.” Porjati khan Pora Susamachar Huna
Titia Peter mukh khuli kene koise, “Hosa pora, Isor to kun logote bhi alag pora nasai kintu Tai sobke eke morom kore. Acts 10:35 xliv Acts 10:43
Kintu, jun desh te hoilebi jun he Isor ke bhoi koribo aru Tai laga itcha pora kaam koribo tai uporte hodai Isor laga khushi thakibo.
Etu kotha Israel laga bacha khan nimite di pathaise, shanti laga susamachar Jisu Khrista dwara, kun he sob laga Probhu ase-
etu kotha aha to tumikhan bhi jani ase, aru sob Judea te bhorta hoijai ase, Galilee pora shuru kori kene, aru John pora baptizma kotha koi diya pichete;

aru Nazareth Jisu laga kotha khan, kineka Pobitro Atma aru takot pora Taike Isor pora asirbad kori dise, jiman manu bhoot pora bandhi rakhise taikhan ke changai korise aru tai bhal kaam kori kene thakise, kelemane Isor tai logote asele.
Jisu ki korise moi khan sob etu laga gawahi ase, Yehudi khan laga desh sob jagah te, aru Jerusalem te ki-ki korise amikhan utu sob laga gawahi ase. Taikhan Taike Cross te latkai kene morai dise.
Kintu Isor Taike tin dinte jinda kori dise aru manu khan ke dikhai dise,
sob manu ke nohoi, kintu Isor poila pora basi luwa khan ke- moi khan pora jun Tai logote kha luwa korise Tai mori kene jinda huwa pichete.
Aru Tai moi khan ke sob manu khan logote jai kene Tai he Isor pora basi luwa ekjon ase aru mora aru jinda sob jati uporte bisar kora ekjon ase koi kene manu khan ke jonai dibi koise.
Jiman bhabobadi ase sob Tai laga gawahi he ase, jun manu Taike biswas kore Tai laga Acts 10:44 xlv Acts 11:4 naam te sob manu paap pora maph pabo.” Porjati Khan Logot Pobitro Atma Aha
Jitia Peter etu kotha khan koi thakise, jun manu tai laga kotha huni thakise taikhan uporte Pobitro Atma ahi jaise.
Aru Peter logot jiman sunnot kora biswasi khan ahise taikhan asurit hoi jaise, kelemane Pobitro Atma pora jati manu khan uporte bhi di dise.
Kelemane taikhan pora Porjati khan alag kotha kora aru Isor ke dhanyavad di thaka hunise. Titia Peter pora etu kotha koise,
“Kun pora taikhan ke baptizma lobole nadibo nimite pani pora dur rakhibo paribo naki, amikhan sob Pobitro Atma pa nisena?”
Aru tai taikhan ke Jisu Khrista naam pora baptizma lobole koise, titia taike aru olop din taikhan logote thaki bole anurodh korise. 11 Mondoli Te Peter Prochar Kora
Titia apostle khan aru Judea te thaka biswasi bhai khan hunise Porjati khan bhi Isor laga kotha ke mani loise koi kene.
Aru jitia Peter Jerusalem te wapas ahise, jun khan sunnot koribo lage koi, taikhan logote kotha te laga lagi jaise;
taikhan koise, “Apuni khan sunnot nakora manu khan logote jai kene kha luwa korise!”
Kintu Peter taikhan ke bhal pora samjai kene koise, Acts 11:5 xlvi Acts 11:14
Moi Joppa laga sheher te prathana kori thakise, titia moi upor pora saman nichete ahi thaka darshan te dikhise, ekta dangor kapra charta kinar pora bandi kene ahi thakise, etu moi logote ahise.
Moi etu ke bhal pora saikene bhabona korise. Moi duniya te charta theng thaka janwar dikhise, aru jongli janwar ,matite jai thaka janwar aru akas laga chiriya khan dikhise.
Aru moike ekta awaj pora koise, “Uthibi, Peter; mari kene khabi!”
Kintu moi koise, “Nohobo, Probhu; moi kitia bhi pobitro aru sapha nathaka saman moi laga mukh te ghusa nai.”
Kintu dusra bar aru ekta awaj pora moike koise, “Ki saman Isor pora sapha ase koise, etu ke letera nokobi.”
Aru eneka tin bar hoise, titia sob saman akas te aru uthai loi jaise.
Aru etu homoi te, moi thaka ghor te tinjon manu ahikena khara hoise; taikhan ke Caesarea pora moi logot pathaise.
Titia Pobitro Atma pora moike taikhan logote jabole koise, kintu taikhan kun ase etu moike koi diya nai, titia choi jon bhai khan moi logote jaise, aru moi khan etu manu laga ghor te jaise.
Titia tai pora amikhan ke koise kineka ekjon sorgodoth pora tai laga ghor te khara kori kene taike koise, “Joppa te manu ke pathabi aru Simon ke loi anibole kobi.
Tai tumike Isor kotha koi dibo, aru etu kotha huni kene tumi aru tumi laga ghor manu Acts 11:15 xlvii Acts 11:21 khan sob poritran pabo.”
Aru jitia moi kotha koi thakise, Pobitro Atma taikhan logote ahi jaise, jineka shuru te amikhan logote ahisele.
Titia moike Probhu laga kotha yaad ahise, kineka tai John ke koise, “John pani pora baptizma diye; kintu tumikhan Pobitro Atma pora baptizma lobo.”
Jodi Isor taikhan ke daan dise jineka amikhan ke bhi dise, juntu pora amikhan Probhu Jisu Khrista ke biswas kore, to moi kun ase, Isor laga kotha namanibole?”
Jitia taikhan etu kotha hunise, taikhan eku jowab diya nai, kintu taikhan Isor ke dhanyavad dise, aru koise, “Tinehoile Isor pora Porjati khan ke bhi notun jonom dise.” Antioch Te Khristan Mata

Stephen ke morai diya homoi te biswasi khan dukh pa-a pora alag-alag jagate jai jaise, taikhan Isor laga kotha koi kene Phoenicia, Cyprus, aru Antioch te khali Yehudi khan logote prochar kori thakise.
Kintu taikhan kunba manu khan Cyprus aru Cyrene laga manu thakise, aru taikhan Antioch te ahise aru Yunani manu khan logote bhi kotha korise, aru taikhan ke Probhu Jisu laga prochar korise.
Aru Probhu laga hath taikhan uporte thakise; aru bisi manu, biswas kori kene, Probhu logot ahise. Acts 11:22 xlviii Acts 11:30
Titia taikhan laga kotha Jerusalem te thaka girja khan pora hunise, aru taikhan Barnabas ke Antioch te pathai dise.
Jitia tai ahi kene Isor laga anugraha dikhise, tai khushi paise; aru taikhan laga mon dangor kori kene arubi pura mon pora Probhu logote thaki bole koise.
Kelemane tai ekjon biswas te thaka aru Pobitro Atma pora bhorta kori kene thaka ekjon bhal manu thakise, aru bisi manu Probhu ke grohon korise.
Titia Barnabas to Saul ke bisari bole Tarsus te jaise.

Aru jitia taike paise, taike Antioch te loi anise. Aru eneka hoise, pura saal taikhan eke logote thakise aru girja te manu khan ke sikhai thakise, aru titia Antioch te poila bar chela khan ke Khristan khan koi kene matise.
Aru etu homoi te bhabobadi khan kunba Jerusalem pora Antioch te ahise.
Aru taikhan majot, Agabus koi kene ekjon khara hoi kene jineka pura duniya te bisi dangor akaal ahibole ase, Atma pora taike dikhai diya nisena bhabobani koise. Etu sob Claudius laga dinte hoise.
Titia chela khan, jun khan jabo paribo, taikhan jai kene Judea te thaka bhai khan ke modot pathai dibo nimite kotha korise.
Aru taikhan eneka korise; Barnabas aru Saul laga hath pora ta te thaka bura khan ke poisa pathai dise. 12 Acts 12:1 xlix Acts 12:8 James Shahid Huwa Aru Peter ke Bondhi ghor Te Rakha
Etu homoi te raja Herod pora girja manu kunba khan ke dhurise aru bisi digdar dise.
Aru tai John laga bhai James ke talwar pora morai dise.
Aru jitia Yehudi cholawta khan etu karone bisi khushi pa-a janise, tai Peter ke bhi dhori bole jaise. Aru etu homoi to khomir nadhala laga roti kha laga din khan thakise.
Jitia tai Peter ke dhori loise, taike bondhi ghor te hali dise, aru charta sipahi khan ke tai uporte sabole rakhidise; tai Peter ke Nistar Purbb dinte manu khan usorte ulaikene anibole bhabi thakise.
Etu homoi te, Peter ke bondhi ghor te rakhi thakise, kintu girja manu khan mon pora tai nimite hodai Isor logot prathana kori thakise. Peter Ke Bachaise
Aru Peter ke Herod pora bisar nakora ek rati age te, Peter to duijon sipahi majote ghumai thakise, loha laga rusi duita pora bandi kene thakise, aru dorja usorte duijon sipahi taike rukhi thakise.

Titia, achanak pora Probhu laga sorgodoth tai usorte ahise, aru bondhi ghor bhitor te ujala pora bhorta hoi jaise. Tai Peter laga kona te marise, aru taike uthaikene koise, “Joldi uthibi,” aru taike bandhi kene rakha luha rusi giri jaise.
Titia sorgodoth taike koise, “Kapra lagabi aru juta to lagai lobi.” Peter eneka korise. Sorgodoth taike koise, “Bahar laga ki kapra ase etu lagabi aru moi laga piche ahibi.” Acts 12:9 l Acts 12:16
Titia Peter sorgodoth laga pichete jaise. Kintu tai jana nai etu sob to hosa pora sorgodoth he kori ase. Tai darshan he dikhi ase bhabise.

Jitia taikhan poila thaka duijon sipahi aru bahar te thaka duijon sipahi ke paar korise, taikhan loha laga ekta dorja usorte punchise juntu khuli kene taikhan sheher te jabo paribo; aru etu nijor pora khuli jaise. Titia taikhan ulaikene rasta nichete jaise, aru sorgodoth taike chari kene jai jaise.

Aru jitia Peter etu sob hosa pora hoise koi kene jani loise, tai nijorke koise, “Etiya moi hosa pora jani loise Probhu moike Herod laga hath pora bachai lobole nimite Tai laga sorgodoth ke pathai dise, aru Yehudi manu khan ki bhabona kori thakise etu pora moike ulaikene anise.”
Jitia tai etu buji jaise, tai John, kunke Mark bhi mate tai laga ama Mary laga ghor te jaise, ta te bisi manu khan joma kori kene prathana kori thakise.
Aru jitia Peter dorjate marikena awaj dise, ekjon chukri noukar Rhoda koi kene dorja khuli bole ahise.
Jitia tai Peter laga awaj janise, khushi pora dorja khuli bole pahorise; aru tai, polaikene kamra te ahise; aru taikhan ke Peter dorjate khara kori kene ase koise.
Titia taikhan pora koise, “Tumi pagli hoise.” Kintu tai Peter ahise koi kene jor pora koi dise. Titia taikhan koise, “Etu tai laga sorgodoth hobo.”
Kintu Peter to dorjate mari thakise, aru jitia Acts 12:17 li Acts 12:23 taikhan dorja khuli se, taikhan taike dikhi kene bisi asurit hoise.

Kintu tai taikhan ke hath pora chup thaki bole dikhai dise, aru kineka kori kene Probhu pora taike bondhi ghor pora ulai dise etu taikhan ke koise, “Jai kene etu kotha James aru bhai khan ke kobi.” Aru ta te pora tai dusra jagate jai jaise.
Aru jitia din hoise, sipahi khan Peter logote ki hoise eku bhi jana nai.
Aru jitia Herod Peter ke bisari kene panai, tai sipahi khan ke hudise aru taikhan ke morai dibole hukum dise. Etu pichete tai Judea pora jai kene Caesarea te thakise. Herod Mora

Aru Herod to Tyre aru Sidon laga manu khan uporte bisi khong thakise. Etu karone taikhan joma hoi kene eke logote taike lok kori bole ahise. Taikhan Blastus koi kene Raja laga kaam kora ekjon ke kotha korise aru taikhan ke modot kori bole phuslai loise. Titia taikhan shanti thaki bole nimite mangise, kelemane taikhan laga desh te kha luwa kiman jai, sob etu raja laga desh pora he jai thakise.
Kotha kori kene rakha dinte, Herod raja laga kapra lagai kene tai nijorke taiyar korise. Tai laga singhason te bohi kene taikhan ke kotha korise.
Kintu manu khan hala kori koise, “Etu Isor laga awaj ase, manu laga nohoi!”
Titia etu homoi te Probhu laga sorgodoth joldi taike mari dise, kelemane tai Isor ke Acts 12:24 lii Acts 13:6 mohima diya nai; aru puka pora taike khai kene morai dise.
Aru Isor laga kotha bisi-bisi hoi jaise.
Aru jitia Barnabas aru Saul taikhan laga kaam pura kori loise, taikhan Jerusalem te jaise, aru John kunke Mark bhi mate taike bhi loi anise. 13 Barnabas Aru Saul Ke Pathai Diya
Aru Antioch girja te bhabobadi khan aru hikhok khan bhi thakise. Barnabas aru Simon -junke Niger koi-, aru Cyrene laga Lucius, - Herod tetrarch pora pala bhai- aru Saul.

Jitia taikhan Isor ke aradhana kori kene aru upwas kori thakise, Pobitro Atma pora koise, “Tumikhan Barnabas aru Saul ke Ami nimite alag rakhi dibi, Moi taikhan nimite ki kaam ase etu kori bole karone.”
Titia taikhan upwas rakhise aru duijon uporte hath dikena prathana kori dise, aru tai duijon ke pathai dise. Cyprus Te Barnabas Aru Saul
Barnabas aru Saul ke Pobitro Atma pora Seleucia te pathai dise; aru taikhan naw te uthi kene Cyprus majuli te jaise.
Aru jitia duijon Salamis sheher te ponchise, taikhan Yehudi khan laga mondoli te jai kene Isor laga kotha prochar korise. Aru duijon ke modot kori bole John Mark bhi thakise.
Aru jitia taikhan Paphos sheher laga sob jagate jaise, ta te ekjon jadu kora manu ke lok Acts 13:7 liii Acts 13:13 paise, Yehudi laga misa bhabobadi, tai laga naam Bar Jesus thakise.
Etu jadu kora manu to Proconsul Sergius Paulus logote thakise, tai gyaan thaka manu asele. Tai Barnabas aru Saul ke matise, kelemane tai Isor laga kotha huni bole mon thakise.
Kintu Elymas “Jadu kora manu” -taike eneka naam pora he mate- taikhan ke bhirodh korise; tai proconsul ke biswas pora hatai dibole kosis korise.
Titia Saul, junke Paul koi kene mate, taike Pobitro Atma pora bhorta hoise, aru taike bhal pora saise

aru koise, “Tumi saitan laga bacha, tumi sob biya kaam pora bhorta hoi ase aru tumi logote sob letera bhabona he ase. Tumi dharmikta laga sob kisim kaam laga dushman ase. Tumi Probhu laga sidha rasta to tera kori bole kitia bhi norokhibo, hoi na nohoi?

Etiya sabi, Probhu laga hath tumi uporte ase, aru tumi suku andha hoi jabo. Tumi olop din nimite suryo to nadikhibo.” Etu homoi te Elymas uporte andhera ahi jaise, aru tai manu khan ke tai laga hath dhurikena loi jabole modot mangise.
Jitia proconsul pora ki hoise etu dikhise, tai biswas korise, kelemane tai Isor laga kotha sikhai diya to asurit lagise. Pisidia Antioch Te Paul Aru Barnabas

Aru titia Paul aru tai laga sathi khan Paphos pora naw te uthi kene jaise aru Pamphylia jagate thaka Perga sheher te ahi Acts 13:14 liv Acts 13:22 jaise. Kintu John taikhan ke chari kene aru Jerusalem te wapas ahi jaise.
Kintu Paul aru tai laga sathi khan Perga te jaise aru Antioch laga Pisidia jagate ponchise. Taikhan Bisram laga dinte mondoli te jai kene bohise.
Bhabobadi aru niyom laga kotha porha pichete, mondoli laga cholawta khan pora koise, “Bhai khan, yate laga manu khan nimite kiba bhal kotha ase koile, kobi.”
Titia Paul khara korise aru hath pora dikhai kene koise, “Israel manu aru Isor ke bhoi kori kene thaka khan, huni bhi.
Israel manu laga Isor pora moi khan baba laga baba khan ke basi loise aru bisi kori dise jitia taikhan Egypt te thakise, aru Tai laga hath to uthaikene taikhan ke tai pora ulai loi anise.
Aru chalis saal tak Tai jongol te taikhan logote thakise.
Aru jitia Tai Cannan laga sat-ta desh ke khotom kori dise, Tai etu jaga amikhan laga manu khan ke dise.
Etu sob charsoh pachas saal upor hoise. Etu sob huwa pichete, Isor taikhan ke bisar dise jitia tak bhabobadi Samuel aha nai.
Titia taikhan raja mangise, aru Isor pora taikhan ke Kish laga chokra Saul dise, ekjon Benjamin laga jat pora, chalis saal tak raja hobole dise.

Kintu Isor pora Saul ke raja laga jaga pora hatai diya pichete, taikhan nimite David ke raja bonai dise. Aru David nimite bhi Isor pora koise, ‘Moi laga mon usorte te thaka ekjon Jesse Acts 13:23 lv Acts 13:31 laga chokra David ke paise, tai moi laga itcha kaam sob koribo.’
Etu manu laga khandan pora Isor Israel te bachai diya, Jisu ke pathaise, Tai Israel manu khan ke kosom diya nisena.
Etu sob to shuru hoise jitia, Jisu naha age te, John poila Israel manu khan ke baptizma dikene mon ghura bole koise.
Aru jitia John laga kaam khotom kori thakise, tai hudise, ‘Moike tumikhan kun ase bhabe? Moi etu nohoi. Kintu huni bhi, ekjon ahi ase, aru tai laga theng laga juta bandhi bole bhi moi layak nai.’
Hey bhai khan, Abraham khandan laga bacha khan, apuni khan majote kun Isor ke bhoi kore, amikhan nimite he etu notun jibon laga kotha to pathai dise.

Kunkhan Jerusalem te thaki ase, aru taikhan laga cholawta khan Taike chini bole para nai, aru bhabobadi khan kowa to pura kori dise, jun to ase, hodai Bisram dinte Taike hinsa aru bodnam kori kene puri thake.
Aru taikhan Taike morai dibole eku golti napai le bhi, taikhan Pilate ke Jisu morai dibole koise.
Jitia Tai nimite Shastro te ki likha ase etu sob pura hoise, taikhan Cross pora Taike namai ani kene kobor te rakhidise.
Kintu Isor Taike mora pora aru bhi jinda kori dise.
Aru Tai logote Galilee pora Jerusalem te kun manu khan ahise bisi din tak Taike dikhise. Aru etu manu khan Tai laga gawahi manu khan Acts 13:32 lvi Acts 13:40 ke koi kene berai.
Aru etu nimite amikhan etu kotha to koi kene prochar kore juntu Isor pora amikhan laga baba khan ke kosom disele.

Isor he sob kotha to amikhan nimite, taikhan laga bacha khan nimite pura kori dise, Jisu ke jinda kori diya pora. Bhajan Geet te likhi kene thaka nisena: ‘Tumi Moi laga chokra ase, aji pora Moi tumi laga Baba hoise.’
Taike mora pora jinda kori diya motlob ase Tai laga gaw to kitia bhi napuchibo, Isor to eneka koise: Moi tumike Pobitro aru hosa asirbad dibo juntu moi David ke kosom disele.’
Etu nimite tai dusra Psalms te aru koi kene ase, ‘Apuni kitia bhi Pobitro ekjon ke puchibole nadibo.’
Kelemane David tai laga homoi te Isor laga itcha pora Tai nijor manu ke sewa kori thakise aru mori jaise, aru tai baba khan logot moidam te dise, aru puchi jaise.
Kintu Jisu junke Isor jinda kori dise, Taike puchibole diya nai.
Kintu apuni khan jani lobi, manu khan, bhai khan, etu manu pora he apuni khan paap to maph pabo, aru sob biya pora ajadi pabo jun to Moses laga niyom pora bhi apnikhan ke dibole para nai.
Aru jun Taike biswas kore tai bachi jabo.
Etu karone hoshiar thakibi bhabobadi khan pora ki koise etu apuni khan logote nohobole nimite: Acts 13:41 lvii Acts 13:47

‘Sabi, hinsa kora khan, asurit hoi kene nijor harai jabi; Moi apuni khan laga homoi te kaam kori ase, Etu kaam juntu tumikhan kitia bhi biswas nakore, jodi bhi kunba apuni khan ke ahikena koi dile bhi.’ ”
Aru jitia Paul aru Barnabas jaise, manu khan taikhan ke anurodh korise etu kotha ahi kene aru Bisram dinte koi dibole.

Aru jitia mondoli laga sabha khotom hoise, Yehudi khan aru Yunani bhasa kotha koi thaka Yehudi khan Paul aru Barnabas pichete jaise, aru taikhan pora duijon ke Isor laga morom to koi thaki bole nimite koise,
Aru Bisram laga dusra dinte, pura sheher eke logote joma hoise Probhu laga kotha huni bole nimite.
Kintu jitia Yehudi khan pora dangor bhir dikhise, taikhan suku jolise aru Paul laga biya kotha koise aru taike sorom khilai dise.

Kintu Paul aru Barnabas mon dangor kori kene koise, “Isor kotha apuni khan logote poila kobole bisi dorkar thakise. Kintu Isor kotha to hatai diya dikhi kene tumikhan Tai laga rajyote jabole layak nai, sabi, amikhan Porjati khan logot jai ase.

Etu karone Probhu he moike hukum dise, aru koise, ‘Moi tumikhan ke biswas nathaka khan laga ekta puhor bonai dise, Etu pora tumikhan prithibi laga sob kona te jai kene anonto jibon laga kotha to koi dibo.’ ” Acts 13:48 lviii Acts 14:3
Jitia Porjati khan etu kotha hunise, taikhan khushi paise aru Probhu laga kotha ke dhanyavad dise. Aru jiman manu anonto jibon pabole ase eitu khan biswas kori loise.
Aru Probhu laga kotha sob usor-usor jagate prochar hoi jaise.

Kintu niyom luwa manu aru dorkar thaka maiki, aru sheher te manu majote naam thaka khan ke Yehudi khan pora Paul aru Barnabas ke digdar dibole korise, aru duijon ke taikhan laga desh pora bahar ulai dise.
Kintu Paul aru Barnabas taikhan usor pora theng laga dhula sapha korise. Aru ta te pora Iconium laga sheher te jaise.
Aru chela khan Pobitro Atma pora bhorta hoi kene khushi pora thakise. 14 Paul Aru Barnabas Iconium Te
Etiya Iconium te eneka hoise, Paul aru Barnabas pora Yehudi khan laga mondoli te jaise aru kineka tai duijon kotha koise, etu huni kene bisi Yehudi aru Porjati manu khan biswas korise.
Kintu kotha namana Yehudi khan pora manu khan laga bhabona biya kotha pora bhorta kori kene nijor bhai khan laga dushman kori dise.
Kintu taikhan ta te olop din thakise, aru Isor laga kotha mon dangor pora koise, aru Isor he Paul aru Barnabas laga hath pora Tai laga asurit kaam manu khan ke dikhai dise. Acts 14:4 lix Acts 14:13
Kintu sheher te thaka manu khan bhag hoi jaise; kunba Yehudi phale jaise, aru kunba apostle khan phale jaise.
Aru jitia biswas nakora khan aru Yehudi aru taikhan laga cholawta khan mili kene duijon ke hinsa kori kene pathor mari bole bisarise,
tai duijon etu jani loise aru ta te pora Lycaonia, Lystra aru Derbe aru etu usorte thaka sheher te polai jaise,
aru taikhan Isor laga kotha prochar kori thakise. Lystra Te Paul Aru Barnabas
Aru Lystra town te ekjon lengra manu bohise, tai laga theng te khara hobole olop bhi takot thaka nai, tai ama laga pet pora he lengra jonom hoise, tai kitia bhi bera nai.
Etu manu Paul kotha kowa hunise, titia Paul etu manu ke bhal hoi jabole mon kori thaka laga biswas dikhi kene taike bhal pora sai thakise.
Aru titia tai untcha awaj pora koise, “Uthi kene tumi laga theng te khara hobi.” Titia etu manu uthi kene bera bole shuru hoise.
Jitia manu khan Paul ki korise etu dikhise, taikhan laga awaj uthaise aru Lycaonia laga bhasa te koise, “Isor khan manu laga gaw loi kene amikhan majote ahise.”
Aru taikhan Barnabas ke “Zeus,” matise, aru Paul ke “Hermes,” kelemane tai he kotha bisi koi thakise.
Titia Zeus mondoli laga purohit jun to sheher usorte thakise, bail guru aru phul laga Acts 14:14 lx Acts 14:21 mala loi kene dorja usorte ahise; tai aru ta te laga manu khan boli dibole mon jaise.
Kintu jitia apostle Barnabas aru Paul etu hunise, taikhan laga kapra phatai kene manu khan laga majote jai kene jor pora kandise.

Aru koise, “Manu khan, tumikhan kele eneka kori ase? Amikhan bhi apuni khan nisena bhabona thaka manu he ase. Amikhan apuni khan ke Isor laga kotha prochar kori bole ahise, etu kotha huni kene Isor pora itcha nakora kaam khan chari bole, sorgo, prithibi aru samundar te jiman jinis ase sob Tai pora he bonaise.
Poila homoi te, manu khan ke nijor khushi pora berabo disele.
Kintu, Tai manu khan ke chari diya nai, Tai sorgo pora pani dise aru phul ulaikene khabole nimite bhal mohina dise aru sob bhal kaam kori dise.”
Etu kotha koi kene, Paul aru Barnabas taikhan ke boli dibole rukhaise. Lystra Te Paul Ke Pathor Mara

Titia Antioch aru Iconium pora kunba Yehudi khan ta te ahise aru manu khan laga monte biya kotha hali dise. Aru titia Paul ke pathor mari kene sheher laga bahar te tani ulai dise, taikhan bhabise Paul mori jaise.
Kintu chela khan tai usorte khara kori thakise, titia tai uthi kene sheher te jaise. Aru dusra dinte, Barnabas logote Derbe te jaise.
Aru jitia tai duijon Isor laga kotha koi kene bisi chela bonaise, taikhan Lystra te jaise, aru Iconium aru ta te pora Antioch te jaise. Acts 14:22 lxi Acts 15:1
Aru taikhan chela khan ke biswas te hodai mon dangor hoi kene thaki bole sikhaise, aru koise, “Amikhan Isor laga rajyote jabole bisi dukh kori bole lagibo.”

Aru sob girja te taikhan ke cholai loijabo nimite dangor manu basi dise, aru upwas rakhikena prathana korise, aru taikhan ke Isor hathte dise, junke taikhan biswas korise. Paul Aru Barnabas Syria Laga Antioch Te Wapas Ahise
Aru etu pichete duijon Pisidia jaga paar kori kene Pamphylia te ahi jaise.
Jitia taikhan Perga te Isor kotha koi dise, ta te pora taikhan Attalia sheher te jaise.
Ta te pora duijon naw te uthi kene Antioch te jaise, ta te taikhan Isor laga anugrah kaam kori bole pathai sele, aru duijon etu kaam pura kori dise.
Jitia taikhan Antioch te ahise aru girja manu khan ke joma korise, Isor pora ki korise, aru kineka Porjati khan nimite biswas laga dorja to khuli dise etu sob taikhan ke koi dise.
Aru duijon to chela khan logote bisi din tak ta te thakise. 15 Jerusalem Laga Sabha

Olop din pichete, kunba manu Judea jaga pora ahi kene Antioch te thaka bhai khan ke sikhai kene koise, “Jitia tak tumikhan Moses laga niyom te diya nisena sunnot nakore, tumikhan nabachibo.” Acts 15:2 lxii Acts 15:9

Etu kotha kowa nimite Paul aru Barnabas logote manu khan mon mila nai aru taikhan uporte khong uthise. Paul aru Barnabas aru ta te kunba khan ke Jerusalem te jabole basi loise aru jai kene apostle aru bura manu khan ke taikhan ki koise etu hudibole nimite pathaise.
Titia taikhan ke girja pora pathaise, aru Phoenicia aru Samaria laga jaga khan pora juwa homoi te Porjati khan mon ghura laga kotha koidi thakise. Sob bhai khan etu khobor paikena bisi khushi korise.
Jitia taikhan Jerusalem te ponchise, taikhan ke girja laga apostle aru bura khan pora ahibole dise, aru Isor pora taikhan majot ki kori dise etu sob manu khan ke koi dise.

Kintu kunba biswas kora manu, kunkhan Pharisee khan logote mili kene thakise, khara kori kene koise, “Taikhan karone to sunnot kori bole dorkar ase aru Moses laga niyom mani kene thaki bole nimite sikhai dibole lage.”
Titia apostle aru bura manu khan eke logote joma hoi kene etu kotha patise.

Jitia etu kotha bisi dangor hoi jaise, Peter khara kori kene taikhan ke koise, “Bhai khan, Isor poila te apuni khan majote te moike basi loise, moi laga mukh pora Porjati khan Isor laga kotha hunibo aru biswas koribo nimite.
Isor ,Tai manu laga mon jane, aru sob gawahi diye, Pobitro Atma pora bhorta kori diye, jineka Tai moi khan uporte bhi korise;
aru Isor dwara Porjati khan aru amikhan majote eku alag bhabona nai, aru taikhan laga mon biswas pora sapha kori dise. Acts 15:10 lxiii Acts 15:19
Etu nimite tumikhan kele Isor ke bisar kori ase, chela khan laga gola uporte amikhan aru amikhan laga baba khan pora kitia bhi uthabole napara bhar to kele hali bole bisari ase?
Kintu amikhan biswas kore Probhu Jisu laga anugrah aru morom pora poritran pabo, kineka taikhan paise amikhan bhi pabo.”
Aru ta te thaka sob manu khan chup hoi jaise jitia Paul aru Barnabas pora Porjati khan majote Isor pora ki asurit kaam kori dise etu taikhan ke koise.
Aru jitia taikhan kotha kori kene khotom hoise, James pora koise, “Bhai khan, moi laga kotha huni bhi.
Simon pora poila koise kineka Isor pora Porjati khan ke modot kori dise aru taikhan majot pora Tai laga naam ulabole nimite.
Aru bhabobadi khan etu kotha to manise, jineka etu Shastro te likha ase,
‘Etu pichete moi aru bhi ahibo, Aru moi David laga bhangi juwa tombu uporte ghor bonabo; Aru biya hoija khan sob wapas bhal kori kene khara kori dibo,
Kelemane manu khan Isor ke bisaribo, Aru sob Porjati khan moi laga naam matibo. Etu Probhu pora koi ase, jun he etu sob kaam to kori dise.
Etu sob kaam shuru pora manu khan ke jonai dise.
Etu karone, moi laga bhabona eneka ase, amikhan Porjati khan Isor phale aha to digdar nokorile lage. Acts 15:20 lxiv Acts 15:26
Kintu taikhan ke likhi kene taikhan murti puja kora aru mangso laga itcha kaam kora, aru janwar laga gola kati kene khun kha etu sob nakoribole koi dibo.

Moses laga kotha sob sheher te ase, poila khandan pora loi kene, aru jun manu tai laga naam loi kene mondoli khan te prochar kore, aru tai laga naam hodai Bisram dinte loi thake.” Porjati Biswasi Nimite Sabha Laga Chithi

Titia sob apostle khan, bura khan aru girja manu khan etu kotha khan bhal paise, aru basi luwa khan ke Paul aru Barnabas logote Antioch te pathai dibole taikhan sai loise. Titia Judas, kunke Barsabbas bhi mate, aru Silas taikhan biswasi bhai khan majote cholawta thakise, taike pathaise.
Aru taikhan hath pora chithi likhi dise: “Apostle aru bura khan pora, amikhan jun apuni khan laga bhai khan ase, jun khan Antioch, Syria, aru Cilicia te ase, aru Porjati khan ke salam di ase!
Amikhan hunise, kunba manu amikhan majot pora ulai jaise, aru amikhan ke eku huda nai, aru apuni khan ke ulta kotha sikhai kene Atma te dukh pabole dise.
Etu nimite, amikhan eke logote lok kori kene apnikhan ke pathabole bhal manu basi bo, jun khan logote amikhan bisi morom kora Barnabas aru Paul duijon bhi pathabole ase.
Etu manu khan nijor laga jibon dikene Probhu Jisu Khrista laga naam nimite dukh uthai thake. Acts 15:27 lxv Acts 15:36
Etu karone Judas aru Silas ke pathai ase, taikhan bhi etu kotha khan nijor mukh pora apnikhan ke koi dibo.
Kelemane Pobitro Atma pora amikhan nimite etu he bhal ase bhabise, apuni khan uporte eku kaam nathaka laga bhar pora dukh nadibo nimite:

murti puja ke boli diya pora apuni khan dur thakibo, aru khun para, aru gola kati kene morai diya pora, aru biya paap pora. Jodi apuni khan pora eitu khan sob pora dur thakise koile, apuni khan nijor nimite bhal ase. Bhal pora thakibi.”
Jitia taikhan ke jabole dise, taikhan Antioch te ahi punchise; aru sob manu khan ke joma kora pichete, chithi taikhan ke dise.
Aru jitia girja pora etu porhise, taikhan bisi mon dangor kori diya kotha dikhi kene taikhan bisi khushi korise.
Judas aru Silas, duijon bhi bhabobadi thakise, aru ta te thaka bhai khan ke nijor kotha pora manu khan laga biswas aru mon dangor kori dise.
Aru olop din ta te thaki kene, taikhan ke kun bhai khan pora pathaise, taikhan logot wapas shanti pora pathai dise.
Kintu Silas, ta te aru thaki bole mon thakise.
Aru Paul aru Barnabas to Antioch te thaki jaise, Isor laga kotha manu khan ke sikhai thakise- dusra khan bhi duijon logote thakise. Paul Aru Barnabas Alag Huwa

Olop din pichete, Paul pora Barnabas ke koise, “Ahibi amikhan poila jun sheher te jai Acts 15:37 lxvi Acts 16:3 kene Isor kotha prochar korise ta te laga bhai khan ke jai kene lok koribo, aru taikhan kineka ase etu sabo.”
Barnabas taikhan logote John kunke Mark bhi mate taike loi jabole mon thakise.
Kintu Mark ke loi juwa to thik nohoi eneka Paul pora bhabise, ta te pora John to Pamphylia te jaise aru taikhan ki kaam nimite jaise etu kaam te tai aru age naja hoise.
Etu nimite tai duijon majot kotha mila nai, aru ta te pora tai duijon alag hoi jaise, aru Barnabas pora Mark ke loi kene naw pora Cyprus te jai jaise.
Kintu Paul pora Silas ke basi loise aru ta te bhai khan pora duijon ke Isor laga anugraha te rakhi kene sob kaam di dise.
Aru tai Syria aru Cilicia te jaise, aru girja khan te jaikena biswasi khan laga mon dangor kori dise. 16 Paul Aru Silas Logot Timothy

Etu pichete tai Derbe aru Lystra sheher te jaise; aru sabi, ta te ekjon chela Timothy koi kene thakise, tai ekjon biswasi aru Yehudi mahila laga chokra asele; kintu tai laga baba to Yunani manu thakise.
Lystra aru Iconium te thaka biswasi bhai khan tai laga bhal kotha he koise.

Paul pora Timothy ke loi jabole mon thakise; aru taike sunnot kori dise kelemane etu jagate Yehudi khan thakise, aru ta te laga manu khan Acts 16:4 lxvii Acts 16:11 sob jani thakise tai laga baba Yunani manu ase koi kene.

Aru Paul, Silas aru Timothy khan sheher te ja-a homoi te, taikhan girja khan te manu khan ke Isor kotha mani bole sikhaise, juntu kotha Jerusalem te thaka apostle aru girja laga bura khan pora taikhan ke kobole faisla kori dise.
Etu pora girja khan biswas te takot hoi thakise, aru hodai din manu bhi bisi-bisi hoi jaise. Macedonia Khan Pora Mata
Paul aru tai laga sathi khan Phrygia aru Galatia laga jaga phale pora jaise, kelemane Pobitro Atma pora taikhan ke Asia te prochar kori bole mana korise.
Jitia taikhan Mysia sheher usorte ahise, taikhan Bithynia te jabole kosis korise, kintu Jisu laga Atma pora ta te jabole mana korise.
Etu karone taikhan Mysia paar kori kene Troas sheher te jaise.
Etu rati te Paul ekta darshan dikhise: ekjon manu Macedonia jagate khara kori thakise, aru taike mati kene koise, “Ahi kene amikhan ke Macedonia te modot koribi.”
Jitia Paul etu darshan dikhise, etu homoi te amikhan joldi Mecedonia te jaise, kelemane taikhan ke susamachar koi dibole Isor amikhan ke matise. Lydia Mon Ghurai Luwa
Aru amikhan Troas pora naw te uthi kene sidha Somothrace laga majuli te jaise, aru dusra din Neapolis sheher te ahi jaise. Acts 16:12 lxviii Acts 16:17
Aru ta te pora Mecedonia laga sob pora dangor sheher Philippi te punchise, Rome manu khan laga jaga, aru amikhan ta te olop din thakise.

Aru Bisram dinte amikhan sheher bahar te ulaikene nodi kinar phale, prathana kori bole jagah ase bhabi kene ta te jaise. Titia amikhan bohise aru ta te mahila khan joma hoi kene thaka khan logote kotha korise.

Ta te ekjon mahila Lydia koi kene asele, Thyatira te tai begoni rong kapra bikiri kori thake, tai Isor ke mohima kore, aru tai amikhan laga kotha hunise. Probhu he etu mahila laga mon khuli kene Paul laga kotha bhal pora huni bole dise.

Aru jitia tai aru tai laga ghor manu sob baptizma loise, tai amikhan ke hudi kene koise, “Jodi apuni khan moi Isor usorte biswasi ase koi kene bisar kore, ahi kene moi laga ghor te thaki bhi.” Aru amikhan tai laga ghor te rukhibole jaise. Paul Aru Silas Bondhi ghor Te

Etu homoi te, amikhan prathana kori bole ekta jagate jai thakise, titia amikhan ekjon jawan jyotishee kora mahila ke lok paise. Tai etu kaam kori kene tai laga malik khan ke bisi poisa kamaikena di thakise.

Etu mahila Paul aru amikhan laga pichete ahi kene hala korise, aru koise, “Etu manu khan sobse Mohan Isor laga noukar khan ase. Taikhan pora apnikhan logot prochar kora to poritran pabole rasta ase.” Acts 16:18 lxix Acts 16:26

Tai bisi din eneka koi thakise, kintu tai eneka kowa to Paul ke bhal panai, aru tai ghurai kene dusto atma ke koise, “Moi Jisu Khrista naam pora tumike hukum di ase tai pora ulai jabi,” aru etu homoi te atma ulai jaise.
Kintu jitia tai laga malik khan poisa aha rasta to bondh hoija dikhise, taikhan Paul aru Silas ke dhori kene bajar laga adhikari khan usorte loi anise.
Aru jitia taikhan ke bisar kora manu khan usorte anise, taikhan koise, “Etu manu khan amikhan laga sheher ke biya kori ase. Taikhan Yehudi manu ase.
Moi khan ki niyom manibo napare etu sikhai ase aru Rome laga niyom lobole koi ase.”
Titia manu khan Paul aru Silas uporte khong korise, aru bisar kora manu khan pora tai duijon laga kapra phatai kene pitabole hukum dise.
Aru tai duijon ke bisi marise, aru bondhi ghor te bondh kori dise aru bondhi ghor laga adhikari ke bhal pora duijon ke rukhibole hukum dise.
Jitia tai etu hukum paise, bondhi ghor laga adhikari pora tai duijon laga theng bandhi kene bondh kora bhitor kamra te rakhidise. Bondhi Ghor Adhikari Mon Ghurai Luwa
Aru adha rati te Paul aru Silas prathana kori kene Isor laga gana gayi thakise, aru bondhi ghor te thaka dusra koidi khan taikhan ke huni thakise.

Achanak pora dangor mati hili se, aru bondhi ghor laga khamba khan hili jaise; aru Acts 16:27 lxx Acts 16:36 etu homoi te dorja khan khuli jaise, aru manu khan ke bandhi rakha loha rusi sob khuli jaise.

Titia adhikari ghumai thaka pora uthijaise aru dorja khan sob khula dikhise; aru tai laga talwar ulaikene nijorke morai dibole korise, kelemane tai bhabise bondhi ghor te thaka manu khan sob polai jaise.
Kintu Paul jor pora hala kori kene koise, “Nijorke jokhom nadibi, kelemane amikhan sob yate ase.”
Titia bondhi ghor laga adhikari pora saaki mangi kene bhitor te polai ahise, aru bhoi pora kapi kene, Paul aru Silas laga theng te giri jaise,
aru tai duijon ke bahar te loi ani kene koise, “Sahab khan, poritran pabole moi ki koribo lage?”
Titia duijon Taike jawab dise, “Probhu Jisu ke biswas koribi, titia tumi aru tumi laga ghor manu sob bachi jabo.”
Titia duijon taike aru tai laga ghor manu sobke Probhu laga kotha hunai dise.
Titia bondhi ghor laga sipahi pora etu rati te duijon ke loi jaise, aru taikhan laga jokhom sapha kori dise, tai laga sob ghor manu aru tai etu homoi te baptizma loise.
Aru duijon ke tai laga ghor te loi anise aru kha luwa dise, aru tai Isor ke biswas korise koi kene tai laga sob ghor manu bisi khushi korise.
Aru jitia din hoise, titia sahab khan pora sipahi khan ke pathaise aru koise, “Taikhan ke jabole dibi.”
Titia sahab pora jai kene etu kotha Paul ke koise, “Bisar kora manu pora moike apuni khan Acts 16:37 lxxi Acts 17:3 ke chari dibole koise. Etu nimite bahar te ulabi, aru shanti pora jabi.”

Kintu Paul taikhan ke koise, “Amikhan Rome laga manu ase, hoilebi bisar laga niyom nacholai kene ami duijon ke marise, aru bondhi ghor te hali dise. Etiya to moi khan ke lukai kene pathai dibole mon ase? Eneka nohoi! Kintu, taikhan nijor ahi kene amikhan ke bahar te loi jabole dibi.”
Titia sipahi khan bisar kora manu khan ke jai kene etu kotha koise, aru jitia Paul aru Silas Roman manu ase koi kene janise, taikhan bhoi lagi jaise.
Titia bisar kora manu khan ahi kene taikhan ke maph mangise, aru duijon ke bahar te ulaikene anise, aru sheher pora jai jabole koise.

Titia duijon bondhi ghor pora ulaikene Lydia laga ghor te jaise. Aru jitia Paul aru Silas duijon bhai khan ke dikhise, taikhan laga mon dangor koridi kene sheher pora jai jaise. 17 Thessalonica Te Paul Aru Silas
Ek din paul aru silas duijon Amphipolis aru Apollonia laga sheher paar kori kene jaise, aru Thessalonica laga sheher te ahi ponchise, ta te Yehudi khan laga ekta mondoli thakise.
Aru Paul laga adat ekta thaka nisina, tai taikhan logote jaise, aru tin Bisram din tak taikhan logote Isor laga kotha koi thakise.

Aru tai Shastro khuli kene taikhan ke bujhai thakise ki Khrista dukh pabo aru mora pora Acts 17:4 lxxii Acts 17:10 jinda hoi jabo, aru etu eneka hobole dorkar thakise. Aru tai koise, “Etu Jisu kun laga kotha koi kene moi prochar kori ase Tai he Khrista ase.”
Ta te kunba Yehudi khan Paul aru Silas laga kotha huni kene tai duijon logote milai loise, aru taikhan logote kunba Yunani khan aru kunba maiki khan bhi mili jaise.

Kintu biswas nakora Yehudi khan mon julise, aru bajar pora biya manu ke joma kori loise, aru bisi manu lagai kene sheher te hala korise. Aru jitia Jason laga ghor bhangai dise, aru Paul aru Silas ke manu khan dhori kene loi anibole bisarise.

Kintu jitia taikhan duijon ke panai, taikhan Jason aru kunba biswasi bhai khan ke dhori kene sheher laga adhikari khan usorte loi jaise, aru hala kori kene koise, “Etu manu khan jun duniya ke ulta koridi ase, taikhan bhi yate ahikena ase.
Jason pora tai laga ghor te manu kunkhan rakhise kunkhan Caesar laga kotha mana nai, aru taikhan koi ase Jisu koi kene dusra raja ase.”
Aru etu kotha huni kene bisi manu khan aru sheher laga adhikari khan sob chinta hoise.
Kintu taikhan Jason aru tai laga saathi khan pora poisa loise, aru dusra biswasi khan ke jabole dise. Berea Te Paul Aru Silas
Titia biswasi bhai khan etu rati te Paul aru Silas ke Berea sheher te pathai dise. Aru jitia duijon ta te ponchise, tai duijon Yehudi khan laga mondoli te jaise. Acts 17:11 lxxiii Acts 17:17
