Aru Thessalonica te thaka manu khan to dusra jaga laga manu khan pora bhi bhal thakise, kelemane taikhan hodai din Isor laga kotha te ki likha ase etu saikene bhal mon pora grohon kori thakise.
Etu nimite bisi manu Jisu ke biswas kori loise, aru ta te laga Yunani niyom mani thaka mahila khan aru kunba mota manu khan bhi biswas korise.
Kintu jitia Thessalonica laga Yehudi khan Paul pora Berea te Isor laga kotha koi ase koi kene janise, taikhan jai kene manu khan laga monte biya kotha hali dise aru mon biya kori bole dise.
Etu homoi te, biswasi bhai khan joldi Paul ke samundar phale pora jabole dise, kintu Silas aru Timothy to Berea te thaki jaise.

Aru jun manu Paul ke loi jaise taikhan Athens sheher pora aru dur te taike loi jaise. Aru jitia taikhan Silas aru Timothy duijon ke Paul pora tai usorte te joldi ahibole dibi koi kene khobor paise, taikhan nijor laga ghor te jai jaise. Paul Athens Te
Jitia Paul Athens te Silas aru Timothy ke rukhi thakise, tai etu sheher te murti bhorta thaka dikhi kene tai laga atma pora bisi mon dukh hoise.

Titia tai mondoli te jai kene Yehudi aru hosa Isor ke aradhana kora manu khan logote kotha korise, aru hodai tai jitia bajar te jai ta te bhi manu lok paile etu laga kotha kori thakise. Acts 17:18 lxxiv Acts 17:24

Titia Epicurean aru Stoic khan laga pondit kunba ahi kene tai logot kotha lagi thakise, aru kunba koise, etu ke najana manu ki kobole mon kori ase? Dusra koise tai dusra jaga laga dhorom manu ase, kelemane tai Jisu laga kotha aru jee utha laga kotha prochar kori ase.
Taikhan Paul ke Aropagus laga usorte loi jaise aru koise, “Tumi ki koi ase aru sikhai ase etu amikhan bhi janibole paribo?
Kelemane amikhan laga kan pora kitia bhi nahuna kotha huni bole pai ase. Etu nimite, amikhan bhi janibole mon ase etu kotha laga ki motlob ase.”

-Etiya sob Athens laga manu aru dusra desh pora ahi kene thaka manu khan dusra eku kaam nakori kene kiba notun kotha hunile etu laga kotha koi kene bohi thake. Paul Pora Sabha Manu Khan Majot Te Prochar Kora
Titia Paul Areopagus majote khara hoi kene koise, “Tumi Athens laga manu khan, moi dikhi ase tumikhan sob kaam te bhal ase.

Jitia moi tumikhan laga puja kori thaka saman khan saikene paar kori thakise, tumikhan pathor pora bona bedi te eneka likhi kene rakha dikhise, “Ekjon najana Isor nimite.” Etu karone junke apnikhan najani kene puja kori thaki ase, etu laga kotha tumikhan ke moi kobo.
Isor jun he prithibi aru ta te thaka sob bonai dise, Tai sorgo aru prithibi laga Isor ase, manu pora bonai diya laga mondoli te nathake. Acts 17:25 lxxv Acts 17:32
Aru Tai manu laga hath laga sewa nalage, aru manu pora eku nibisare, kelemane Tai he sobke jibon aru saas diye aru manu ki lage Tai etu sob diye.

Aru Tai ekjon manu pora he ekta desh aru jiman manu etiya thaki ase etu sobke bonai dise, ki homoi te kineka dibole lage aru kun manu laga jat kote thaki bole lage etu sob Tai pora bonai kene rakhidise,
Eneka korile manu khan Taike bisaribo aru taikhan Isor phale mon dibo aru Tai usorte ahibo. Kintu Tai amikhan pora kitia bhi dur thaka nai.
Kelemane amikhan Tai logote jinda ase aru amikhan laga ki ase etu sob to Tai laga he ase, jineka apuni khan laga majote kitab likha ekjon pora koise, ‘Amikhan sob Tai laga bacha khan he ase.’
Etu karone, amikhan Isor laga bacha ase, amikhan eneka bhabona kori bole nalage ki tai laga sobhab to suna, chandi, aru pathor nisena ase- eitu khan jinis to manu laga bhabona pora bonai.
Etu nimite Isor poila te manu laga paap dhyan nakori kene chari dise, kintu etiya Tai sob manu ke paap pora mon ghura bole hukum dise.

Kelemane, ek dinte rakhi kene ase, juntu dinte, Tai pora basi luwa ekjon pora etu duniya ke dhormikta pora bisar koribo. Isor he Jisu ke mora pora jinda kori kene Tai hosa Isor ase koi kene dikhai dise.”

Aru jitia Athens laga manu khan mori kene Acts 17:33 lxxvi Acts 18:5 jinda huwa kotha hunise, kunba ta te thaka khan Paul ke hinsa korise; kintu kunba koise, “Amikhan etu kotha apuni pora aru hunibo.”
Etu pichete Paul taikhan laga majot pora ulai jaise.

Kintu kunba tai logote mili jaise aru tai ki kotha koise etu biswas korise, etu majote Dionysius jun Areopagus laga ekjon manu, aru Damaris koi kene ekjon mahila, aru dusra manu khan bhi taikhan logote thakise. 18 Paul Corinth Te
Etu pichete Paul Athens pora Corinth sheher te jaise.

Ta te tai ekjon Yehudi manu Aquila koi kene lok paise, tai Pontus laga manu thakise, aru tai olop din age te Italy pora tai laga maiki Priscilla ke loi kene ahise, kelemane Claudius pora Yehudi manu khan ke Rome pora jai jabole hukum dise. Paul taikhan usorte jaise,
aru kelemane taikhan ki kaam kore etu Paul bhi kora nimite, taikhan logote thaki kene kaam korise, kele koile taikhan sob tambu bona manu asele.
Aru Paul to mondoli te jai kene hodai Bisram dinte taikhan logote kotha kori thakise. Tai Yehudi aru Yunani manu khan ke Isor laga kotha mani kene thaki bole nimite koi thakise.
Jitia Silas aru Timothy duijon Macedonia pora ahise, Paul Isor laga kotha te pura mon dikene thakise, aru Yehudi manu khan ke Jisu Khrista laga gawahi koi thakise. Acts 18:6 lxxvii Acts 18:13

Kintu Yehudi manu khan tai laga kotha mana nai aru taike sorom khilai dise, Paul tai laga kapra jharikena taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan laga khun tumikhan nijor matha uporte ahibole dibi; moi eku golti kora nai. Etiya pora moi Isor najana manu usorte he jabo.”
Aru tai ta te pora ulaikene ekjon manu Titus Justus laga ghor te jaise, tai Isor ke mohima kora ekjon thakise. Tai laga ghor mondoli laga usorte thakise.

Crispus, mondoli laga ekjon cholawta, Probhu ke biswas kori loise, aru tai laga ghor manu sob bhi biswas korise; aru Corinth te kiman manu Isor laga kotha hunise taikhan bhi biswas kori kene baptizma loise.
Aru ek rati, Probhu he Paul ke sapna te koise, “Bhoi na koribi, kintu moi laga kotha koi thakibi aru kitia bhi chup nathakibi.
Kelemane moi tumi logote ase, aru kun bhi tumike ahi kene eku kori bole na paribo, aru tumike nuksan nakoribo, kelemane etu sheher te moi laga manu bisi ase.”
Aru Paul ta te ek saal aru choi mohina thakise, Isor laga kotha manu khan ke sikhai thakise.
Kintu jitia Gallio pora Achaia laga Governor hoise, sob Yehudi manu khan mili kene Paul laga bhirodh te khara hoise aru taike dhori kene bisar kora jagate loi anise;
taikhan koise, “Etu manu amikhan laga niyom bhirodh te jai kene Isor laga kotha sikhai ase aru mani bole koi ase.” Acts 18:14 lxxviii Acts 18:22
Aru jitia Paul pora kotha kobole mukh khuli se, Gallio pora Yehudi khan ke koise, “Tumi Yehudi khan, jodi etu kotha golti aru paap kaam kora laga ase koile, moi tumikhan nimite bisar koribo.
Kintu tai koi thaka kotha kunba laga naam nimite aru tumikhan laga niyom laga ase koile, tumikhan nijor hai sai lobi. Moi etu kotha khan nimite bisar kori bole mon nai.”
Titia Gallio bisar laga jaga pora taikhan ke jabole dise.
Aru taikhan sob Sosthenes usorte jaise, mondoli laga ekjon cholawta, aru taike bisar kora jagate jai kene marise. Kintu Gallio to eitu khan nimite eku chinta kora nai. Paul Antioch Te Wapas Aha

Aru Paul, bisi din ta te thaka pichete, ta te laga bhai khan ke chari kene Syria te jaise, Priscilla aru Aquila bhi tai logote thakise. Tai Cenchrea te tai nijor laga chuli kati dise kelemane tai kosom khaise.
Aru jitia taikhan Ephesus te ahise, Paul pora Priscilla aru Aquila ke ta te chari dise, kintu tai nijor jai kene Yehudi khan logote kotha kori thakise.
Jitia taikhan Paul ke ta te aru olop din thaki bole koise, tai mana nai.
Kintu tai anurodh kori kene taikhan ke koise, “Isor itcha hoile moi aru bhi ahibo.” Ta te pora tai naw te uthi kene Ephesus te jai jaise.
Aru jitia Paul Caesarea te namise, tai jai kene Jerusalem girja te manu khan ke salam dise aru ta te pora tai Antioch te jaise. Acts 18:23 lxxix Acts 18:28

Aru olop din ta te thaka pichete, Paul ta te pora ulai jai kene Galatia aru Phrygia laga desh te kiman biswasi manu khan ase taikhan laga mon dangor kori dise. Ephesus Te Apollos Pora Himot Korikena Kotha Kowa
Ta te Apollos koi kene ekjon manu thakise, tai jonom pora Alexandria laga manu thakise, kintu tai Ephesus te ahise. Tai to Isor laga kotha bhal pora jana aru kobo para ekjon gyaani manu thakise.

Apollos ke Probhu laga rasta te thik pora mani kene thaki bole koi dise. Atma te bhal kori kene thaki bole nimite, aru mon dikene Jisu laga kotha manu khan ke sikhai thake, kintu tai John pora diya baptizma he jane.

Etu nimite Apollos mondoli te jai kene mon dangor pora kotha koi thakise. Kintu jitia Priscilla aru Aquila tai laga kotha hunise, taike kinar te loijai kene Isor laga kotha aru bhi bhal pora bujhai dise.

Jitia tai Achaia jaga ke paar kori kene jabole itcha korise, titia biswasi bhai khan pora tai laga mon dangor kori dise aru taike bhal pora grohon koribi koi kene Achaia te thaka chela khan ke ekta chithi likhi dise. Jitia tai ta te punchise, tai Isor laga anugrah pora biswasi khan ke bisi modot dise.

Aru Apollos pora manu khan usorte mon dangor kori kene Yehudi khan ke kotha pora jitise aru Shastro te likhi kene thaka pora Jisu he Khrista ase koi kene dikhai dise. Acts 19:1 lxxx Acts 19:9 19 Ephesus Te Paul
Aru jitia Apollos Corinth te thakise, Paul to upor phale thaka desh paar kori kene Ephesus laga sheher te punchise, aru ta te kunba chela khan ke lok paise.
Aru Paul taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan biswas kora homoi te Pobitro Atma paise?” Kintu taikhan taike koise, “Nai, amikhan Pobitro Atma ase koi kene huna bhi nai.”
Titia Paul koise, “Tenehoile tumikhan ki pora baptizma loise?” Taikhan koise, “John laga baptizma pora.”
Titia Paul koise, “John pora mon ghura laga baptizma pora tumikhan ke baptizma dise. Tai manu khan ke koise tumikhan John laga pichete ekjon ahi ase Taike biswas koribi, Tai Jisu ase.”
Jitia manu khan etu kotha hunise, taikhan sob Probhu Jisu laga naam te baptizma loise.
Aru jitia Paul taikhan laga uporte hath rakhidise, Pobitro Atma taikhan laga uporte ahi jaise titia taikhan alag kotha pora bhabobani kobole shuru hoise.
Ta te taikhan sob milai kene baroh jon manu thakise.
Aru Paul mondoli te jai kene tin mohina tak Isor laga kotha mon dangor kori kene koise, manu khan ke Isor laga rajyo kotha bhujai kene biswas kori bole koi dise.

Kintu kunba Yehudi khan mon tan kori kene kotha mana nai, taikhan manu khan usorte biya kotha kobole shuru hoise. Titia Paul taikhan ke Acts 19:10 lxxxi Acts 19:17 chari kene chela khan ke loi jaise, aru hodai din Tyrannus hall te jai kene kotha koi thakise,
Aru eneka dui saal tak hoi thakise, etu karone Asia te kiman manu thakise taikhan sob Probhu laga kotha hunise, Yehudi aru Yunani manu khan bhi. Sceva Laga Putro Khan
Isor pora Paul laga hath pora kitia bhi nadikha asurit kaam khan korise,
etu karone manu khan rumal nohoile kapra loi kene tai gaw ke chui dibo, aru bemar bhal hoi thake, aru biya atma khan bhi gaw chari kene bahar ulai jai thakise.

Titia kunba Yehudi khan etu jaga phale beraikena jadu-tona, jhara-jhari kori thakise. Taikhan bhi jun manu logot dushto atma thakise utu khan ke Probhu Jisu laga naam lobole kosis kori kene eneka koise, “Moi tumike Paul pora prochar kori thaka Jisu laga naam pora bahar te ulai jabole hukum di ase.”
Aru Yehudi laga maha purohit kaam kora Sceva laga sat jon chokra khan tineka kaam kori thakise.
Aru dushto atma koise, “Moi Jisu ke jane aru Paul ke bhi jane, kintu tumi kun ase?”
Titia jun logot te dusto atma thakise, utu manu taikhan uporte uthi kene taikhan ke marise aru harai dise, aru manu khan sob utu ghor pora lengta hoi kene, bisi jokhom paikena polai jaise.
Aru utu kotha Ephesus te thaka Yehudi aru Yunani khan sob jani jaise, aru taikhan sob Acts 19:18 lxxxii Acts 19:25 bhoi lagi jaise, aru Probhu Jisu naam ke prosansa kori thakise.
Aru jun biswas kori loise utu khan pora bisi manu ahi kene nijor-nijor he taikhan ki biya kaam korise etu sob laga paap shikar korise.
Aru jadu-tona kori thaka khan nijor-nijor jadu laga kitab khan joma kori sob manu pora dikhikena jolai dise, aru jitia utu daam hisab kori saise, etu chandi poisa te pachas hajar toka nisena thakise.
Karone Probhu laga kotha pora jiti kene biswasi khan bisi hoi jaise. Ephesus Te Gondugol Huwa

Aru jitia Paul Ephesus te tai laga sewkai kaam khotom korise, tai Atma te bhabi loise jitia tai Jerusalem te jabo, titia tai Macedonia aru Achaia te bhi jabo; aru koise, “Ami ta te juwa pichete, aru Rome te bhi jai kene sabo lagibo.”
Etu karone tai sewa te thaka Timothy aru Erastus duijon ke Macedonia te pathai kene tai olop homoi karone Asia te thaki jaise.
Aru etu homoi te, Ephesus te Isor laga Rasta laga kotha nimite dangor gondugol hoise.
Demetrius koi kene chandi laga kaam kora ekjon thakise aru tai chandi pora Artemis laga mondoli te murtikhan bisi bonaise, aru etu pora kaam kora khan bisi labh hoi thakise.
Aru tai pora tai nisena kaam kori thaka khan sobke mati anikena koise, “Hey sahab khan, apnikhan bhi jani ase, amikhan etu kaam kora pora bisi poisa pai thake. Acts 19:26 lxxxiii Acts 19:34
Aru apnikhan bhi dikhi aru huni ase, khali Ephesus te he nohoi kintu pura Asia te eneka koi kene Paul pora bisi manu ke biswas kori loi ase, tai koi ase juntu hath pora bonaise utu Isor nohoi.
Etu karone khali ami laga kaam ke he nohoi, kintu Asia te, aru pura duniya te puja kori thaka maha devi Artemis laga mondoli ke bhi bodnam koridi ase, aru devi laga naam bhi harai jabole bhoi hoise.”
Jitia manu khan etu kotha hunise, taikhan bisi khong uthise, aru bisi jor pora hala kori koise, “Ephesus laga Artemis mohan ase.”

Eneka hoi kene pura sheher te hala hoi jaise; titia taikhan mili kene ahise aru Gaius aru Aristarchus jun Paul logote safar kori thaka manu khan asele, tai duijon ke dhori kene moncho ghor te loi anise.
Aru Paul to ta te jabole bisi mon korise, kintu chela khan pora taike jabo diya nai.
Titia kunba Asia te thaka adhikari khan pora taikhan laga sathi khan ke khobor pathai kene Paul ke moncho ghor te najabi koise.

Aru bhir te thaka kunba pora kiba kobo, aru dusra pora kiba kobo eneka hoi thakise, etu pora bhir te manu khan bisi matha ghurai thakise. Ta te bisi manu etu bhi jani kene thaka nai taikhan kele ta te joma thakise.
Aru Yehudi khan pora Alexander ke age te loi rakhidise, aru Alexander tai laga hath uthaikene manu khan ke bujhai dibole korise.
Kintu jitia tai Yehudi manu ase koi kene jani loise, sob mili kene dui ghanta tak, Acts 19:35 lxxxiv Acts 20:1 “Ephesus laga Artemis mohan ase” eneka hala kori thakise.

Aru titia sheher laga cholawta he sob manu ke chup kori kene koise, “Hey Ephesus manu khan, Ephesus laga sheher to maha devi laga mondoli rakhi thaka jaga ase koi kene, aru murti nisena sabole juntu akas pora ahise etu kun manu najane?
Karone utu jinis khan to nohoi kobo napare, titia hoile chup-chap hoi jabole lage, aru eku kori bole dorkar nai.
Kelemane etu duijon mondoli te chor dokaiti kora nohoi aru tumi laga devi laga uporte eku biya kotha kowa nohoi, hoilebi tumikhan pora taikhan ke dhori anise.
Karone Demetrius aru tai logote kaam kora khan he kunba logot kotha namila thakile, bisar kora jaga aru sabha to khula ase, taikhan ta te pora bisar koribo dibi.
Kintu jodi apnikhan etu te bhi aru kiba ase koile, thik homoi te sabha pora bisar kori lobo lage.
Kelemane aji gondugol kora nimite ami upor golti dibole bhoi ase, etu eku motlob nathaki kene gondugol kora etu laga jowab dibole na paribo.”
Aru tai etu kotha koi kene sabha ke chari dise. 20 Macedonia Aru Greece Te Paul
Jitia gondugol to khotom hoise, Paul chela khan ke mati anise aru taikhan ke samjai dise, Acts 20:2 lxxxv Acts 20:10 aru taikhan ke bhidai kori kene tai Macedonia te jai jaise.
Titia tai utu desh khan paar kori kene khotom huwa pichete, tai Greece te ahi jaise.
Aru tai ta te tin mohina thakise aru ta te pora Syria te jabole thakise, kintu Yehudi khan taike morai dibole thaka jani kene, Macedonia phale pora he wapas jabole bhabi loise.
Aru Berea manu Sopater laga chokra, aru Thessalonica pora Aristarchus aru Secundus aru Derbe pora Gaius aru Timothy aru Asia pora Tychicus aru Trophimus taikhan tai logote jaise.
Kintu eitu khan amikhan age te jai kene Troas te rukhi thakise.

Aru khomir nahala roti laga utsov din pichete amikhan Philippi pora naw te uthi kene pans din pichete Troas te taikhan logot ponchise, aru saat din tak ta te thakise. Eutychus Ke Mora Pora Jinda Uthai Diya
Titia hapta laga prothom din jitia biswasi chela khan eke loge mili kene roti bhangai sele. Paul dusra dinte jabole thakise, etu karone tai taikhan logot adha rati tak kotha kori thakise.
Upor kamra kot te amikhan joma thakisele ta te bisi saaki khan jolai rakhise.
Aru Eutychus koi kene jawan ekjon khirki te bohi thakise, aru Paul bisi deri kotha koi thaka pora, tai ghumai kene tin tola upor pora nichete girikena morise.
Kintu Paul niche jai kene tai usorte tai laga gaw ke lamba korise, aru taike dhurise. Aru tai koise, “Bhoi nokoribi, kelemane tai laga jibon etiya bhi tai logot he ase.” Acts 20:11 lxxxvi Acts 20:19
Titia tai aru upor jai kene roti bhangai khaise aru phojur tak kotha kori thakise, aru etu pichete jai jaise.
Aru taikhan utu chokra jinda pa karone ekdom shanti paise.
Titia amikhan naw pora Assos te jaise, aru ta te pora naw te Paul ke uthabole thakise, kelemane tai nije pora he tai berai kene jabo koise, aru tai he eneka kori bole amikhan ke koise.
Aru tai Assos te ahi amikhan ke lok paise, aru amikhan taike uthaikene Mitylene te ahi jaise.
Aru ta te pora naw te uthi kene dusra din Chios usorte ahi jaise, utu din amikhan Samos ponchise, aru Tragyllium te thaki kene dusra din Miletus te ahi Jaise.

Kelemane Paul Asia te homoi phelabo mon kora nai, tai naw pora Ephesus paar kori bole mon korise, kelemane parile Pentecost din tai Jerusalem te thakibo mon kori kene tara-tari kori thakisele. Ephesus Laga Bura Khan Logot Paul Pora Kotha Kowa
Tai Miletus pora khobor pathai kene Ephesus girja laga bura khan ke matise.
Aru jitia taikhan tai logot ahise, tai koise, “Moi juntu din pora Asia te ahise, utu prothom din pora kineka moi tumi logote thakise, apnikhan jani ase.”
Moi nomrota korise aru suku pani girikena aru Yehudi khan pora chalak kori kene moike Acts 20:20 lxxxvii Acts 20:28 dukh di thakile bhi moi Probhu laga sewa kori thakise.
Aru moi apnikhan ke sikha khan te, manu usorte nohoile ghor te hoilebi tumi bhal nimite kaam nakori kene chari diya nai.
Yehudi aru Yehudi hobi, moi taikhan ke mon ghurai kene Isor phale ahibole aru Jisu ke biswas kori bole sikhai ahise.
Aru sabi, etiya moi Atma laga kotha mani kene Jerusalem te jai ase hoilebi ta te moi logote ki hobo moi najane.
Juntu sheher te jaile bhi Pobitro Atma pora ami laga gawah koridi thakise, aru khali bandha aru dukh he moike rukhi ase koi kene.

Kintu moi nijor jibon karone eku chinta nathaki, kintu Probhu Jisu pora ji kaam moike kori bole dise, utu Isor anugrah laga susamachar ke khushi pora manu ke jonai dibole aru etu pura kori bole he bhabi thake.
Aru sabi, moi jani ase, moi Isor rajyo kotha loi kene sob jagate prochar koribo, aru apnikhan etiya pora ami laga chehera aru nadikhibo.
Etu moi aji apnikhan ke sakhi di ase, moi ekjon golti nathaka manu laga khun phale hoile golti nai.
Kelemane Isor laga itcha phale sob kotha moi apuni khan ke koi diya hoise.

Etu karone apnikhan nije bhi hoshiar thakibi aru Pobitro Atma pora apnikhan ke sabole mer khan dise. Hoshiar pora Isor laga girja ke roikhya koribi, jintu Isor Tai Nijor laga bacha khun pora kinise. Acts 20:29 lxxxviii Acts 20:38
Kelemane moi jani ase moi juwa pichete rong kutta khan tumi laga majote ahibo, aru tumikhan ke nacharibo jun khan etiya bisi ase.
Aru moi jani ase tumikhan nijor bhitor pora bhi misa kowa ulabo aru biswasi khan ke taikhan phale kori loi lobo.
Karone hoshiar koi kene thakibi, aru bhabona koribi, moi tin saal tak rati din suku pani girai kene sob manu ke sikhaise.
Aru bhai khan moi etiya apnikhan ke di ase, Isor aru tai anugrah laga kotha juntu pora tumikhan ke uthidibo pare aru sapha kori diya khan logote milaikena tai laga miras pabo thaka khan ase.
Moi kun laga suna, chandi, kapra khan lalos kora nohoi.
Apnikhan jani ase, moi nijor hath pora sewa kori kene nijor aru jun moi logot thakise, taikhan ke ki lage sob kori ahise.

Moi apnikhan ke sob rasta sikhai dise, kineka sewa kori kene dukhia khan ke modot koribo lage, aru Probhu Jisu kotha monte bhabona kori bole, juntu Tai nijor pora koise: “Lu-a pora to diya jon he bisi asishit ase.”
Aru jitia tai etu kotha koi diya hoise, tai athukari kene taikhan logote prathana kori loise.
Titia taikhan sob bisi kandise, aru Paul ke dhori kene taike chuma dise.

Taikhan bisi mon dukh huwa to Paul laga kotha karone hoise, aru kitia bhi tai laga chehera nadikhibo kowa karone, aru taikhan taike loijai kene jahaaj tak punchai dise. Acts 21:1 lxxxix Acts 21:8 21 Paul Jerusalem Te Juwa
Aru taikhan pora alag koi kene amikhan jahaaj te uthi kene sidha rasta jaise aru Cos te ponchise, aru dusra din Rhodes te, aru ta te pora Patara te ahi jaise.
Ta te pora ekta jahaaj Phoenicia te jabole thaka paise, etu pora amikhan bhi ta te uthi kene jaise.
Cyprus sheher ke dikhikena aru paar korise aru amikhan Syria phale jaise, aru Tyre te nami jaise, kelemane ta te jahaaj laga saman namabole thakise.
Aru ta te kunba biswasi chela khan lok paikene amikhan saat din ta te thakise. Aru taikhan Atma dwara Paul ke Jerusalem te najabole koise.

Jitia amikhan laga din pura hoi jaise titia taikhan pora alag hoi kene amikhan logote taikhan maiki khan aru bacha khan sob loi kene amikhan ke sheher bahar te loijai dise, amikhan sob ta te pora athukari kene prathana korise,
titia alag hoi kene amikhan jahaaj te uthijaise, aru taikhan nijor-nijor ghor te jai jaise.
Aru jitia amikhan Tyre pora safar khotom hoise, amikhan Ptolemais te ponchise. Aru bhai khan ke salam jonai kene taikhan logote ek din thakise.
Dusra din amikhan ta te pora ahi Caesarea te ponchise, aru prochar kora Phillip jun saat jon laga majote ekjon asele, tai ghor te ahi kene tai logot thakise. Acts 21:9 xc Acts 21:17
Etu manu laga shadi nakorikena thaka charjon swali thakise, aru utu khan sob bhabobani koi thakise.
Aru ta te bisi din thaki jaise, titia bhabobadi ekjon Agabus koi kene Judea pora ahise.

Jitia tai amikhan logot ahise tai Paul laga peti loi nijor hath theng ke bandi kene koise, “Jun manu etu komor bandha peti laga malik ase taike ‘Jerusalem te Yehudi khan pora taike eneka bandi kene Isor najana khan laga hathte dibo, eneka Pobitro Atma koi ase.’ ”
Etu kotha huni kene amikhan aru ta te thaka khan sob pora Paul ke Jerusalem te najabi koi kene rukhaise.
Kintu Paul koise, “Apuni khan ki kori ase, kandi-kandi kene ami laga mon dukhai ase? Moi to taiyar ase, khali bandibole nimite nohoi, hoilebi Probhu Jisu naam karone mori bole bhi taiyar ase.”
Jitia amikhan janise Paul to namanibo, titia amikhan chup thaki jaise aru titia moi khan koise, “Amikhan Isor laga itcha hobo dibi.”
Aru utu din pichete amikhan saman bandhi kene Jerusalem te jai jaise.
Caesarea te kunba chela khan amikhan logote ahise, aru taikhan Mnason koi kene Cyprus manu ekjon jun purana chela asele, taike amikhan logote thaki bole loi anise. Paul Pora James ke Lok Kora
Aru jitia amikhan Jerusalem te ponchise, biswasi bhai khan bisi khushi pora amikhan ke swekar korise. Acts 21:18 xci Acts 21:25
Aru dusra dinte Paul amikhan ke James laga ghor te loi jaise, ta te girja bura khan sob joma thakise.
Titia tai taikhan ke salam jonai kene Isor pora tai laga sewkai dwara ki kaam Porjati khan logote korise, eitu khan sob ekta-ekta kori kene sob koi dise.
Taikhan etu huni kene Isor ke mohima korise, aru tai koise, “Bhai khan etu sabi, Yehudi khan majote hajar manu bhi biswas kori loise, aru taikhan sob bhal pora niyom mani thake.

Taikhan ke manu khan pora apuni laga kotha koi dise, apuni Porjati khan laga jagah te thaka Yehudi khan ke Moses laga niyom ke namanibi koi kene hikai ase, aru bacha khan laga sunnot nakorile bhi hobo eneka sikhai ase hunise.
Tinehoile amikhan ki koribo? Taikhan apuni yate ahi ponchise koi kene jani thakibo pare.
Karone ekta kaam koribi amikhan logote kiba kori bole kosom luwa charjon ase.

Taikhan ke loi kene taikhan logote nijorke bhi pobitro kori lobi, aru taikhan matha chuli pura kati bole kharcha dibi. Titia sob manu jani lobo taikhan pora tumikhan laga ki kotha koi ase etu sob misa ase, kintu tumikhan to thik pora thaki ase aru niyom manikena thaki ase koi kene jani lobo.

Kintu Porjati khan ke jun biswas kori loise utu khan ke amikhan age pora likhi dise, murti ke boli diya laga bostu aru khun, aru gola mussri kene mangso kha-a aru bebichar kora, etu sob pora bachi thakibi koise.” Acts 21:26 xcii Acts 21:32

Titia Paul dusra din manu khan ke loi taikhan logote sapha kori loise, aru girja te jai kene ekjon-ekjon laga kiman din tak sapha koribo lage koi dise aru sob nimite daan korise. Mondoli Te Paul Ke Dhori Loise
Kintu jitia saat-din khotom hobole hoise, kunba Yehudi khan Asia pora ahikena taike mondoli te dikhise, aru manu khan ke chukli mari kene taike dhori loise.

Taikhan hala kori kene koise, “Hey Israel khan, amikhan ke modot dibi, etu manu pora sob jagah te manu khan ke manu khan, niyom khan aru etu jaga laga bhirodh kotha koi ase aru sikhai ase, aru tai Yunani manu khan ke bhi girja te anikena pobitro jaga ke letera kori dise.”
Age te Paul ekbar Trophimus koi kene Ephesus laga manu logote berai thaka dikhise, aru taikhan bhabise Paul he eitu ke loi girja te anise eneka bhabi thakise.
Titia etu sheher te gondugol hoise, sob polai ahi kene Paul ke dhuri loise, aru taike tani bahar te loi jaise, aru joldi mondoli laga dorja khan bondh kori dise.
Aru taikhan taike morai dibole thaka homoi te, pura Jerusalem te hungama hoi ase koi kene etu khobor mukhyo henedhikari logote ponchise.

Titia tai joldi sipahi khan aru henapoti khan loi kene niche phale polaikena taikhan logot punchise, aru jitia manu khan mukhyo henedhikari aru sipahi khan ke dikhise, taikhan Paul ke mari thaka pora rukhi jaise. Acts 21:33 xciii Acts 21:40
Titia mukhyo henedhikari usorte ahi kene taike dhori loise, aru duita luha rusi pora taike bandi lobole koi dise, aru hudise etu manu kun ase aru tai ki korise.
Aru bhir te kunba kiba-kibi koise, aru kunba dusra kiba koi thakise, aru bisi hala kora karone tai thik pora eku bujhi bo para nai, etu karone taike bondhi kora jagate loi jabole hukum dise.
Jitia tai siri te ponchise, manu khan bisi khong kora karone sipahi khan taike uthaikene loi jaise.
Kelemane bisi manu tai piche-piche hala kori thakise, “Taike morai dibi!” Paul Pora Manu Khan Logot Kotha Korise
Jitia taikhan Paul ke bondhi rakha jagate loi jabole thakise, tai mukhyo henedhikari ke koise, “Moi apuni ke kiba kotha kobo paribo?” Tai koise, “Tumi Yunani kotha kobo pare?
Olop din age te, ekjon Egypt manu, jun pora chukli mari kene gondugol kori dise, aru char-hajar ‘Hathiara manu khan ke’ jongol te loi jaise, utu manu to tumi nohoi?”

Kintu Paul koise, “Moi to Tarsus laga Yehudi ase Cilicia sheher te jonom huwa manu ase. Aru moi utu khas sheher laga ekjon manu ase. Etu nimite, apuni logote anurodh kori ase, moike manu khan logot kotha kori bole dibi.”

Jitia tai agya dise, Paul siri te khara hoi kene kotha kobole tai hath uthaise, aru manu khan chup hoi jaise, aru jitia taikhan chup hoise, titia tai Yehudi bhasa te kotha koise. Tai koise, Acts 22:1 xciv Acts 22:9 22
“Bhai khan, aru baba khan, moi etiya nijor laga safai te apnikhan usorte kotha kobole ase, etu ke huni bhi.”
Aru jitia tai Yehudi bhasa te koise, taikhan arubi ekdom chup thaki jaise. Titia tai aru koise,

“Moi Yehudi ase Cilicia laga Tarsus sheher te jonom luwa, etu sheher pora Gamaliel laga theng te bohi kene amikhan laga baba khan laga niyom thik pora sikhi loise, aru Isor phale jor dikena aji apnikhan jineka kori ase tineka kori ahisele.
Aru mota, maiki, hobi, etu dhorom Rasta te juwa khan ke bondhi ghor te dikene morai bhi di thakise,

etu kotha cholawta, bura khan aru sabha bhi sakhi dibo pare, moi taikhan pora ami laga bhai khan Damascus te thaka khan logote chithi likhi diya utu bhi loise, karone moi jai kene ta te kunba thakile dhori kene Jerusalem te ani taikhan ke sajai dibo bhabise.
Etu homoi moi Damascus punchibole usor hoi asele, titia din nisena homoi asele, aru sorgo pora achanak ekta dangor puhor ahi moi usorte thaki jaise.
Aru moi matite giri jaise, aru ekta awaj moike kowa hunise, ‘Saul, Saul, kele tumi Moike digdar kori ase?
Karone moi hudise, ‘Probhu Apuni kun ase?’ Aru Tai moike koise, ‘Moi Nazareth Jisu ase, junke tumi dukh digdar di ase.’
Aru jun manu moi logot ahise, taikhan bhi puhor to dikhise aru bhoi korise, kintu taikhan Acts 22:10 xcv Acts 22:20 moike kotha kowa laga awaj to huna nai.
Titia moi koise, ‘Moi ki koribo lage Probhu?’ Aru Probhu moike koise, ‘Uthi kene Damascus te jabi, aru ta te tumi ki-ki koribo lage etu sob tumike koi dibo.’
Aru utu puhor bisi huwa karone moi eku dikhibo para nai, titia moi laga sathi khan laga hath dhurikena he moi Damascus te ahise.
Titia Ananias koi kene ekjon asele, tai niyom mani thaka ekjon asele, aru ta te thaka Yehudi khan bisi sonman kori thaka manu ase.
Tai ami laga usorte ahikena koise, ‘Bhai Saul, apuni laga suku dikhi bhi.’ Aru etu homoi te moi dikhibole parise aru taike dikhise.
Titia tai koise, ami laga baba khan laga Isor he tumike basi loise, tumi he tai itcha ke janibole aru Dharmikta Jonke sabo paribole aru tai nijor mukh pora kowa awaj ke huni bole.
Kelemane tumi ki dikhise aru ki hunise etu sob manu ke koi dibole tai sakhi bonai dise.
Tinehoile apuni etiya bhi kele bohi ase? Uthi kene baptizma loi lobi, aru prathana kori kene tai naam pora tumi laga paap dhui dibi.’
Titia moi aru Jerusalem te ahi kene mondoli te prathana kori asele, titia moi Atma te bhorta hoi kene darshan dikhise.
Aru moi Probhu ke dikhise, Tai moike koise, ‘Joldi Jerusalem chari kene jabi, kelemane taikhan Ami laga kotha tumi gawahi diya ke namanibo.’
Karone moi koise, ‘Probhu, moi pora biswasi khan mondoli te dhurikena bondhi ghor te diya aru mari thaka taikhan jani ase.

Aru jitia Apuni nimite mori juwa Stephen Acts 22:21 xcvi Acts 22:27 ke khun giraikena morai di thakise, ta te moi bhi thakise, aru jun manu khan pora taike morai dise utu khan laga kapra ke moi rukhi thakise.’
Titia Tai moike koise, ‘Jabi, kelemane moi tumike yate pora dur Porjati khan logot pathai dibo.’ Paul Aru Mukhyo Henedhikari
Aru taikhan etu kotha kowa tak taike huni thakise. Etu pichete taikhan awaj uthaikene hala kori koise, “Eneka manu ke prithibi pora hatai dibi, kelemane tai jinda thaki bole thik nohoi.”
Titia taikhan hala kori kene taikhan laga kapra khan ulai phelaise, aru upor hawa te dhul urai thakise,
titia mukhyo henedhikari pora Paul ke bondh kora jagate loi jabole hukum dise, aru manu khan kele taike iman ghusa kori ase etu janibole taike chabuk pora mari kene bhal pora hudibole koise.
Aru taikhan jitia taike chabuk mari bole taiyar korise, Paul pora tai usorte khara thaka henapoti ke koise, “Rome manu ke eku golti nathaki kene bhi chabuk mari bole niyom te ase?”
Jitia henapoti etu kotha hunise tai mukhyo henedhikari logote jai kene koise, “Apuni eneka kele kori ase? Tai Rome laga nagrik ase.”
Titia henedhikari tai logot te ahikena koise, “Moike kobi, tumi Rome laga nagrik ase?” Paul koise “Hoi”. Acts 22:28 xcvii Acts 23:3
Etu huni kene mukhyo henedhikari pora koise, “Moi to Rome laga nagrik hobole bisi toka poisa pora kinise.” Kintu Paul koise, “Moi to jonom pora he Rome laga nagrik ase.”

Titia jun taike mari bole thakise, taikhan loge- loge tai usor pora joldi hati jaise. Aru kitia mukhyo henedhikari bhi Paul to Rome laga nagrik ase koi kene janise, tai bhi bhoi khaise kele koile tai pora Paul ke dhori kene bandh kora karone. Sabha Age Te Paul

Dusra din Yehudi khan pora ki nimite Paul ke doshi korise, etu janibole mukhyo henedhikari pora Paul ke khuli dise, aru mukhyo purohit khan aru sabhakhan ke joma kori bole hukum dise, aru Paul ke loi kene taikhan age te khara kori dise. 23
Titia Paul sabha laga adhikari khan phale dhyan pora saikene koise, “Bhai khan, moi aji tak ekjon bhal nagrik nisena thakise, ami sapha mon pora Isor usorte bhal pora ahise.”
Titia moha purohit Ananias pora jun khan Paul usorte khara ase taikhan pora Paul laga mukh te marikena bondh kori dibole hukum dise.

Titia Paul taike koise, “Isor pora apuni ke mari dibole ase, chuna pora boga kori rakha dewar khan. Isor apuni ke saja dibo, apuni niyom pora amike bisar kori bole bohi ase, aru kele niyom bhirodh te moike mari bole hukum di ase?” Acts 23:4 xcviii Acts 23:11
Kintu jun khan tai usorte khara asele taikhan koise, “Kile apuni Isor laga moha purohit ke ninda kori ase?”
Titia Paul koise, “Bhai khan, tai moha purohit ase koi kene moi jana nai. Kilekoile likha ase, Tumi pora tumi laga cholawta laga biya kotha nakobo.”

Kintu jitia Paul dikhise sabha laga ekta bhag Sadducee khan aru dusra bhag Pharisee khan ase, tai sabha te jor pora koise, “Bhai khan, moi Pharisee ase aru Pharisee khan laga chokra ase, aji moike bisar kora to morija-a khan jee uthibo laga asha laga kotha kowa nimite he ase.”
Aru jitia tai etu koi dise, Pharisee aru Sadducee khan laga majote kotha namila hoise, aru sabha to dui bhag hoi jaise.
Kelemane Sadducee khan punoruthan, sorgodoth aru atma khan te biswas nakore: kintu Pharisee khan to etu sob bhi hosa ase koi kene mani thake.

Titia bisi jor pora hala hoi jaise aru Pharisee khan jaga pora uthi kene apatti kori koise, “Amikhan etu manu laga eku dosh pa-a nai. Kintu jodi ekta atma pora, nohoile bhi, ekjon sorgodoth pora taike kotha koi kene ase koile?”

Titia taikhan bisi jhagara hoi jaise, aru henedhikari bhabise taikhan Paul ke tukra kori dibo, aru etu laga bhoi pora tai sipahi khan ke pathaise, aru joborjosti sabha pora taike bondh kora jagate loi jabole hukum dise.

Kintu utu rati te tai usorte Probhu ahi kene khara hoi kene koise, “Mon dangor hobi, kelemane tumi Jerusalem te Ami laga gawahi Acts 23:12 xcix Acts 23:19 dise, tineka tumi Rome te bhi Ami laga gawahi dibo lagibo.” Paul Ke Morai Dibole Buddhi Kora
Jitia din ulaise, kunba Yehudi khan mili kene, jitia tak Paul ke loi kene morai nadibo, titia tak eku bhi nakhabo koi kene kosom korise.
Jun khan kotha milai thakise eitu khan chalis-jon pora bhi bisi thakise.
Titia taikhan mukhyo purohit khan aru bura khan logote jai kene koise, “Amikhan jitia tak Paul ke morai nadibo titia tak eku bhi nakhabo koi kene kosom khaise.

Karone apnikhan aru sabhakhan mili kene mukhyo henedhikari logot khobor pathai dibi aru Paul ke bhal pora kotha hudibi kobi, aru eneka koi kene tai pora Paul apnikhan logot anibo. Aru amikhan to tai yate napuncha age te taike morai dibole taiyar ase.”
Kintu jitia Paul didi laga chokra pora taikhan Paul ke mari bole rukhi thaka janise, tai Paul ke bondh kora jagate ahikena taike etu kotha koi dise.
Titia Paul ekjon henapoti ke mati anikena koise, “Etu chokra ke mukhyo henadhikari logote loijabi, tai kiba kobole ase.”

Karone tai taike loi kene mukhyo henedhikari logot jaise aru koise, “Bondhi ghor te thaka Paul pora moike matise aru moike etu lora apuni logote loi ani dibi koi kene anurodh korise. Tai apuni logote kiba kobole ase koise.”
Titia mukhyo henedhikari pora tai hath dhurikena kinar te alag loijai kene hudise, “Tumi moike ki kobole ase?” Acts 23:20 c Acts 23:29
Aru tai koise, “Yehudi khan mili kene Paul laga kotha ke aru bhal pora hudibole kali sabha te taike loi anibole bhabona pora apuni logot anurodh kori bole ase.

Kintu taikhan laga kotha namanibi, kelemane taikhan chalis-jon pora bhi bisi manu taike morai nadiya tak ekubi kha luwa nakoribo koi kene kosom khai kene ase, aru taikhan apuni pora hukum pabole etiya bhi rukhi thaki ase.”
Titia mukhyo henedhikari pora lora ke koise, “Etu kotha tumi moike kowa khan kunke bhi nokobi.” Rajyopal Felix Usorte Paul Ke Pathaise
Aru tai henapoti duijon ke mati ani kene koise, “Aji rati nou-baji te duisoh sipahi aru sat-ta ghora chola sipahi aru duisoh jathi-dhora sena khan loi kene Caesarea te jabole taiyar kori dibi.
Aru Paul ke jabole nimite ghora taiyar koribi aru taike bachai kene Governor Felix logot loijabi.
Tai eneka chithi bhi likhi dise:
“Claudius Lysias pora Rajyopal Felix ke salam jonai ase.
Etu manu to Yehudi khan pora taike dhori kene morai dibole thaka te moi jani loise, tai Rome laga nagrik ase, moi joldi sipahi loijai kene taike bachai loise.
Aru taikhan kele taike golti lagai ase, etu janibole mon hoi kene moi taike sabha te loi jaise.
Aru moi jani paise taikhan nijor niyom kotha laga kotha namila pora taike golti kora he Acts 23:30 ci Acts 24:2 ase, aru taike morai dibole aru bandhi bole eneka eku bhi golti pa-a nai.

Aru jitia Yehudi khan taike morai dibole kotha milai thakise, etu kotha moike jonai dise, titia moi taike joldi apuni logote pathai dise, aru tai golti diya khan ke bhi taikhan laga kotha apuni laga usorte kobole koi dise.”
Titia sipahi khan taikhan ke kowa nisena rati te Paul ke Antipatris te loijai dise.
Dusra dinte sipahi bisi khan wapas jai jaise, kintu ghora chola sipahi khan ke Paul logot jabole dise.
Jitia sipahi khan Caesarea te ponchise, taikhan pora Governor ke chithi dise aru Paul ke bhi tai usorte khara kori dise.
Aru Governor pora chithi porhi kene hudise tai kun desh laga ase. Aru jitia tai jani loise tai Cilicia desh pora ase,
tai koise, “Jitia tumi laga golti diya khan ahibo, titia moi tumi laga kotha hunibo.” Aru taike Herod bisar kora jagah te rakhi dibi koi kene hukum dise. 24 Caesar Te Felix Age Te Paul
Pans-din pichete mukhyo purohit Ananias aru kunba bura khan aru ekjon ukil jun laga naam Tertullus asele, taikhan arubi ahikena Governor ke Paul bhirodh te kotha koise.

Aru jitia Paul ke Governor age te anise, Tertullus taike golti dikene eneka koise, “Apuni karone amikhan bisi shanti thaki ase, aru etu desh te apuni laga gyaan pora bodli korise; Acts 24:3 cii Acts 24:12
Amikhan laga sob jagah te aru hodai etu karone khushi pora apuni ke dhanyavad kori thake.
Hoilebi, apuni laga homoi aru bhi nolobole, ami apuni logot te anurodh ase, morom kori amikhan laga ekta kotha huni bhi.
Kelemane etu manu to mara-mari kore aru duniya te thaka Yehudi khan laga sob jagah te bhirodh aru gondugol kori thaka Nazareth manu ekjon cholawta ase, amikhan jani paise.
Tai mondoli ke bhi apobitro kori bole bisarisele, etu nimite amikhan taike dhuri loise, aru ami laga niyom pora taike bisar koribo thakise.
Kintu henapoti pora Lysias te ahi kene joborjosti amikhan laga hath pora taike dhori loi jaise.
Taike golti diya khan ke apuni usorte ahi kobole koise, kintu apuni nijor hudile jani jabo amikhan taike ki karone golti di ase.”
Aru Yehudi khan bhi mili kene taike etu sob kotha to hosa ase koi dise.

Titia Governor Paul ke kotha kobole nimite koise, titia Paul koise, “Ami bujhi ase apuni bisi saal pora etu jati khan laga bisar kori ahi thakise, etu karone moi khushi pora ami laga sob kotha apuni ke kobole ase.
Kelemane apuni nijor jani jabo moi jitia pora aradhana kori bole Jerusalem te ahise, baroh-din pora bisi huwa nai.
Aru taikhan moike mondoli aru mondoli aru sheher te kun logot te bhi kotha namila, nohoile gondugol lagi thaka pa-a nai. Acts 24:13 ciii Acts 24:21
Aru taikhan ki kotha loi moike bodnam lagai ase, etu kun bhi sakhi dibo na paribo.

Kintu moi apuni ke hosa kotha koi ase, taikhan juntu Rasta ke ekta dol mati ase, eneka laga rasta pora Isor ke sewa kori ahise. Ki niyom te ase aru ki bhabobadi khan pora likhise, etu sob te moi bhal pora mani kene ahise.
Aru ami Isor ke mon dangor laga etu asha ase, juntu etu manu khan nijor bhi rukhi ase, juntu to ase mori kene jinda hobole thaka, dharmik aru adharmik khan sob bhi.
Etu karone moi Isor phale bhi aru manu phale bhi sapha bhabona bhal thakibo karone kosis kori thakise.
Aru bisi saal pichete moi nijor jati khan ke poisa dibole anise, dukh thaka jati khan ke daan dibole anise.
Taikhan ami etu kori thaka dikhise, mondoli pora sapha kori loi kene, bhir nohoile gondugol bhi thaka nai.
Aru kunba Yehudi khan Asia pora ahise, taikhan ami laga bhirodh te thakile, taikhan apuni usorte ahi kene kobo lage.
Nohoile, yate etu manu thaka khan bhi jodi moi kiba golti kaam kora paise koile moi Yehudi sabha usorte khara thaka homoi te koi dibi,

khali ekta kotha karone ase, juntu moi sob manu usorte koisele, ‘Mora khan aru jee uthibo, etu kotha ke loi aji moike apuni usorte khara kori bisar kori ase.’ ” Senapoti Hathte Paul Ke Rakhise Acts 24:22 civ Acts 25:1

Jitia Felix etu kotha hunise, tai aru poritran Rasta ke bhal pora janibo mon hoi kene, taikhan ke rukhai dise. Tai koise, “Jitia sipahi laga senapoti Lysias Jerusalem pora ahibo, moi tumi laga bisar koribo.”
Aru tai henapoti ke koi kene Paul ke bondhi ghor te rakhise, hoilebi taike bhi bandi narakhikena khula chari dibole koise, aru tai sathi khan tai logote ahibole bhi mana na koribi koise.
Aru olop din pichete Felix tai laga Yehudi maiki Drusilla logote wapas ahise, jun Yehudini asele, aru tai Paul ke mati bole pathaise aru tai Paul dwara hunise Jisu Khrista ke biswas laga kotha.

Aru jitia Paul pora taike dhormikta aru nijorke rukhabo para aru aha dinte bisar hobole thaka kotha khan thik pora koi dise, Felix bisi bhoi koi kene koise, “Etu bar to jai jabi. Jitia moi homoi pabo titia tumike aru matibo.”
Tai Paul pora poisa bhi pabo bhabikena tai hodai Paul ke mati ani kotha kori thakisele.

Kintu dui saal pichete Porcius Festus he Felix jagah te Governor hoi jaise, kintu Felix to Yehudi khan ke khushi kori bole mon asele, aru tai Paul ke bondh kora jagate he aru bhi thaki bole dise. 25 Paul Pora Caesar Logot Anurodh Kora
Titia, Festus etu jagate ahise, aru tin din pichete, tai Caesarea pora Jerusalem te jaise. Acts 25:2 cv Acts 25:10
Titia mukhyo purohit khan aru Yehudi laga cholawta khan Festus logot Paul bhirodh te golti lagaise, aru anurodh korise.

Aru Paul laga bhirodh te ekta upkar Festus ke mangise - ki Festus pora Paul ke Jerusalem te matibo nimite- eneka hoile taike loija-a homoi te kunba khan rasta te rukhai kene taike morai dibole bhabona thakise.
Kintu Festus koise Paul to Caesarea te bondhi ase, aru tai nijor bhi joldi ta te jabole ase.
Tai koise, “Etu karone tumikhan majote kun cholawta ase taikhan moi logote jabole dibi. Jodi etu manu kiba biya kaam korise koile, taikhan taike golti dibole kobi.”
Aru tai dos din nisena taikhan logote thaki kene tai Caesarea te ahi jaise, aru dusra din bisar jagate bohi kene Paul ke loi anibole hukum dise.
Aru jitia Paul ahise, Jerusalem pora aha Yehudi khan ahi tai age piche khara hoi kene taike bisi biya golti lagaise jun to taikhan nijor bhi sakhi koribo napare.
Titia tai nijor kotha koise, “Moi Yehudi khan niyom laga bhirodh, nohoile girja ke bhirodh, nohoile Caesar laga bhirodh te eku bhi golti kora nohoi.”
Kintu Festus Yehudi khan ke khushi koribo itcha pora Paul ke koise, “Tumi Jerusalem te jai kene ami laga bisar jaga usorte etu kotha loi bisar korile tumi itcha hobo?”
Titia Paul koise, “Moi etiya bhi Caesar bisar jaga usorte khara ase, ami laga bisar yate hobo lage, apuni bhi jani ase, moi Yehudi khan logot Acts 25:11 cvi Acts 25:18 eku golti kora nohoi.

Jodi moi golti ase, aru etu nimite moike morai dibole layak ase koile moi morile bhi apatti nai. Kintu ki kotha loi kene moike doshi di ase, jodi ekta bhi hosa nohoi koile, kunbi moike taikhan hathte dibo na paribo, moi Caesar logot anurodh koribo.”
Titia Festus pora sabhakhan ke kotha kori kene koise, “Tumi Caesar logote kotha mila bole kori ase. Karone tumi Caesar logote jabo!” Agrippa Aru Bernice Age Te Paul
Aru olop din juwa pichete Raja Agrippa aru Bernica Caesarea te ahi Festus ke adar dise.
Aru duijon ta te bisi din thaka pichete, Festus Paul laga kotha raja ke koi dise. Tai koise, “Felix pora yate kunba ekjon ke bondh kora jagate rakhi ase.
Aru jitia moi Jerusalem te jaise, Yehudi khan laga mukhyo purohit khan aru bura khan tai bhirodh te golti kotha moike koise, bisar kori taike saja dibole.

Kintu moi taikhan ke koise, Rome laga niyom te to hoile, kunke golti lagai ase, taike bisar kora dinte taike golti lagai diya khan usor nijor sob kotha kobole homoi nadi kene taike saja diya niyom nai.
Karone jitia taikhan yate ahi kene joma hoise, moi deri nakori kene dusra din, bisar jagate bohi kene utu manu ke loi anibole hukum dise.
Jitia taike golti diya manu khan khara koi kene tai laga golti koise, taikhan eku biya golti Acts 25:19 cvii Acts 25:26 dibo para nai, jineka moi bhabise tineka huwa nai.
Kintu taikhan nijor dhorom kotha aru mori juwa Jisu koi kene ekjon asele, Paul koi utu jinda ase, etu kotha loi kotha namila he ase.
Aru etu laga motlob moi bhal pora bujhi bole para nai, karone moi taike hudise jodi tai etu kotha ke bisar kori bole Jerusalem te jabole mon kore na nai.
Kintu Paul koise tai Caesar logote anurodh koribo, etu karone moi taike Caesar logot pathai nadiya tak taike bondh kora jagate thaki bole hukum dise.”
Titia Agrippa pora Festus ke koise, “Moi nijor utu manu laga kotha hunibo itcha ase. Festus jawab dise, “Kali apuni tai kotha huni bole pabo.”

Karone dusra din Agrippa aru Bernica duijon dhum-dham pora bhal kapra lagai kene aru sheher laga daruga khan aru dusra cholawta logote sabha te ahise. Aru jitia Festus hukum dise, titia Paul ke loi anise.

Festus koise, “Raja Agrippa aru jun yate ahi bohi ase, apnikhan bhi etu manu ke dikhi ase, etu manu nimite yate thaka Yehudi khan sob aru Jerusalem te thaka sob moi logote binti korise tai jinda thaki bole nalage koise.
Kintu tai moribo lage eneka eku kaam kora moi pa-a nai, aru tai nijor moi Caesar logot anurodh koribo koise, to moi taike pathai dibole faisla kori loise.

Kintu tai laga kotha ami Caesar logot kineka likhibo thik napai-a karone, moi taike Acts 25:27 cviii Acts 26:7 apnikhan aru khaas pora Raja Agrippa apuni usorte loi anise, pichete kiba likhi bole pabo bhabona kori kene.
Kelemane ekjon manu ke ki nimite bondhi nisena pathai ase etu thik pora nalikhile, etu to moi hisab te thik nohobo.” 26 Agrippa Age te Paul Laga Kotha
Titia Agrippa pora Paul ke koise, “Tumi nijor laga kotha kobole homoi di ase.” Titia Paul tai hath uthaikene tai nijor laga safai diya kotha koise.
“Raja Agrippa, ji-ji kotha Yehudi khan moike bodnam lagai ase, aji apuni usorte utu laga sob jowab dibole homoi pa-a karone moi bisi khushi hoi ase;
kelemane Yehudi khan laga niyom te kotha namila kora sob apuni jani thaka karone, aru moike morom kori nomro pora moi laga kotha huni bole anurodh kori ase.
Jineka ami chokra thaka homoi te Jerusalem pora nijor jati khan logote ahise, etu sob Yehudi khan jane.
Taikhan jodi gawahi dibole mon thakile to shuru pora taikhan moike jani ase, moi Pharisee hoi kene taikhan laga dhorom te sob pora kara te choli ahise.
Aru etiya moi yate khara koi kene bisar huwa to Isor ami laga baba khan ke ki kosom dise utu asha kora karone ase.

Etu kosom ke pabo karone asha pora amikhan baroh-jati khan pura mon lagai kene Acts 26:8 cix Acts 26:16 raat-din Isor ke sewa kori ahise. Raja Agrippa, etu asha nimite he Yehudi khan moike golti lagai ase.
Jitia Isor mora manu ke jinda kore, kele apnikhan etu to biswas kori bole nohoi bhabe?
Hosa ase, moi bhi Nazareth Jisu naam bhirodh te bisi kaam koribo lage bhabi ahise.
Aru moi Jerusalem te eneka korise, mukhyo purohit khan pora hukum loi pobitro khan ke dhori bondhi ghor te haali kene morai diya te moi laga bhi itcha thakise.

Aru moi sob mondoli te taikhan ke dukh di-dikene joborjosti kori thakise, khali etu he nohoi kintu bisi gusa hoi kene bahar laga sheher te bhi jai kene taikhan ke dukh digdar di thakise. Paul Nijor Mon Bodli Huwa Laga
Jitia etu kori bole moi moha purohit khan pora hukum loi kene Damascus te jai thakise;
aru titia rasta he, O Raja, din laga homoi te akas pora moi dikhise suryo pora bhi bisi ujala, moi aru ami laga logote jai thaka khan usorte chamkise.
Aru jitia amikhan sob matite giri jaise, moi ekta awaj Ibrani bhasa te moike kowa hunise, ‘Saul, Saul tumi kele Moike digdar kori ase? Tumi dhar thaka te laat marile tumi karone bisi dukh hobo.’
Karone moi koise, ‘Probhu, Apuni kun ase?’ Aru Probhu pora koise, ‘Moi Jisu ase junke tumi digdar kori thake.’
Kintu uthibi aru tumi laga theng te khara hobi; kelemane Moi aji tumi ki dikhise etu Acts 26:17 cx Acts 26:24 manu ke kobole aru aha kali bhi dikha bole thaka khan ke gawahi dibole dikhai dise;
aru Moi tumike Yehudi aru Isor najana khan logote pathabo, aru taikhan hath pora tumike bachai thakibo,

tumi pora taikhan laga suku khuli dibo aru taikhan andhar pora ujala te ani dibole, aru Saitan laga takot pora Isor phale ghurai anibole, paap pora khyama pabole, aru biswas pora pobitro khan logote ki jaga ase utu pabole.’
Karone, Raja Agrippa, moi etu sorgo darshan laga kotha ke namani kene chari diya nohoi;

kintu poila moi Damascus te thaka khan ke koi dise, aru Jerusalem te thaka khan ke bhi, aru Judea sob te bhi, aru Isor najana khan ke bhi taikhan laga paap pora Isor phale ghuri ahibole, aru mon bodli huwa kaam khan kori bole koi dise.
Kelemane etu karone Yehudi khan mondoli pora moike dhori loise, aru morai dibole hoise le.
Kintu Isor laga modot pora aji tak yate khara hoi kene chutu, dangor sob usorte gawahi di aru Moses aru bhabobadi khan pora aha dinte ki hobole ase etu kotha kowa khan he nohoile dusra eku kowa nai-
etu kotha Khrista bisi dukh koribo aru mora pora tai he prothom jee uthibo, Tai Yehudi khan aru Porjati khan logote puhor laga prochar koribo.
Jitia Paul tai nijor kotha koi dise, Festus jor pora hala kori koise, “Paul, tumi pagla hoise; bisi sikha karone tumike pagla bonai dise.” Acts 26:25 cxi Acts 27:1
Kintu Paul koise, “O mohan Festus, moi pagla nohoi, kintu hosa aru buddhi laga kotha koi ase.
Raja bhi etu sob jani ase, moi eku bhoi nakori kene koi ase, aru etu kotha tai najana eneka ekta bhi kowa nai koi kene moi bhabi ase; etu ghatna to manu khan nathaka te kora nohoi.
Raja Agrippa, apuni bhabobadi khan ke biswas kore? Hoi, moi jane, apuni biswas kori ase.”
Titia Agrippa Paul ke koise, “Olop homoi te, tumi aram pora moike Khristan bonai dibole ase?”

Paul koise, “Isor logote moi anurodh kori ase, olop nohoile bisi homoi pichete hoilebi, aji apuni logote bohi ami laga kotha huni thaka sob bhi moi nisena hobole dibi, hoilebi jineka moike rusi pora bandhikena ase etu nisena nohoi.”
Jitia tai etu kotha koise, titia Raja aru Governor aru Bernice, aru taikhan logote bohi thaka sob khara hoi jaise;
aru taikhan alag jai kene nijor te kotha korise, aru koise, “Etu manu mori bole aru bandibole eneka eku biya kaam kora nohoi.”
Titia Agrippa pora Festus ke koise, “Jodi etu manu Caesar logot anurodh nakorile, taike chari dile bhi hobole asele.” 27 Paul Jahaaj Pora Rome Te Juwa

Aru jitia amikhan Italy te jabole faisla kori loise, taikhan Paul aru dusra bondh kora manu Acts 27:2 cxii Acts 27:10 khan ke Julius koi kene Augustus Regiment laga henapoti ekjon laga hathte di dise.

Titia amikhan Adramyttium pora ekta jahaaj Asia samundar phale jabole thaka te uthijaise. Aru amikhan safar korise. Thessalonica pora Macedonia laga ekjon Aristarchus koi kene bhi amikhan logote asele.
Aru dusra dinte amikhan Sidon sheher te ahise, aru Julius pora Paul ke bisi morom korise aru tai sathi logote berabo dise, aru tai ki lage sob taike di thakise.
Aru amikhan ta te pora jabole ulaise hoilebi hawa bisi jor pora mara karone jahaaj to Cyprus phale loi kene jaise.
Aru amikhan Cilicia aru Pamphylia samundar paar kori Lycia laga sheher Myra te ahi jaise.
Ta te henapoti he Alexandria laga ekta jahaaj Italy te jabole thaka paikene amikhan ke ta te uthai dise.

Amikhan bisi din aste-aste jai thakise, aru bisi digdar pora Cnidus ponchise, kintu hawa bisi mara pora amikhan age jabole para nai, etu pora jahaaj ke loi kene Crete phale loi jaise, juntu Salmone usorte ase.
Amikhan bisi digdar pora safar korise aru Lysea sheher usorte Bhal Jaga eneka te ponchise.
Etiya bisi homoi jaise, panite bera bole digdar hoise, aru etiya to Yehudi khan laga upwas din bhi paar hoise, karone Paul taikhan ke hoshiar kori bole,
koise, “Hey manu khan, amikhan etiya yate Acts 27:11 cxiii Acts 27:18 pora jaise koile digdar aru bisi nuksan bhi hobo pare, khali saman aru jahaaj he nohoi, kintu manu jibon bhi jabo pare.”
Hoilebi henapoti pora Paul laga kotha namani kene jahaaj laga malik khan laga kotha he manise.

Aru utu jaga to thanda dinte ta te thaki bole thik nohua karone bisi manu parile Phoenix te he thakile bhal hobo bhabise. Phoenix to Crete usorte ekta jaga ase, dakshin-paschim aru uttor-paschim phale bhi jabo para jagah ase. Samundar Te Tufan
Titia dakshin pora halka-halka hawa ahise, jahaaj chola khan bhabise taikhan ki lage etu sob taikhan logot ase. Etu pora taikhan Crete phale jabole jahaaj khuli dise.
Kintu bisi deri nohoi kene dangor hawa pani laga tufan ta te pora ahi taikhan ke lagise.
Jitia tufan pora jahaaj ke dhorise, taikhan aru age jabo napari kene hawa pora jahaaj ke kote loi jabole ase, loijabo dise.
Titia Cauda naam laga ekta majuli te bisi digdar pora punchise aru chutu naw ke dhori rakhibo parise.
Titia taikhan chutu naw ke uthai anise aru niche pora bandi loise. Syrtis laga balu matite lagi bole bhoi pora jahaaj kapra khan khuli dise, aru jahaaj ke hawa pora loijabo dise.
Kintu dusra din tak amikhan ke tufan pora bisi digdar di thakise, etu karone taikhan jahaaj pora saman khan samundar te phelai dise. Acts 27:19 cxiv Acts 27:28
Aru tin din pichete amikhan nijor hath pora jahaaj laga saman uthaikene samundar te phelai dise.
Aru jitia bisi din tak suryo aru tara khan ula nai aru tufan bhi bisi mari thakise, titia amikhan bachibole asha sob chari dise.

Titia bisi din pora kha-luwa nakora karone, Paul khara kori kene taikhan ke koise, “Sabi, apnikhan ami laga kotha mani kene Crete pora najaile bhal hobole asele, tinehoile amikhan eneka digdar aru nuksan nohobo asele.
Kintu etiya moi apnikhan ke mon dangor rakhibole koi ase, kelemane khali jahaaj ke he nohoile, kunke bhi digdar nohobo.
Kelemane moi jun laga ase, aru junke sewa kore, tai sorgodoth aji rati moi logote ahise.
Aru koise, ‘Paul, tumi bhoi na koribi. Tumi Caesar age te khara hobo lagibo, aru sabi Isor tumike morom kori kene tumi logote juwa manu khan sob etiya bhi tumi logote he ase.’
Karone manu khan mon dangor hobi! Kelemane moi Isor ke biswas kore, jineka Tai koise tineka hobo.
Hoilebi amikhan ekta majuli te loijai kene rakhibo pare.”
Titia choudah rati hoise, aru amikhan Adriatic Samundar majote loijai kene thaki jaise, aru adha rati te jahaaj chola khan bhabise taikhan to kunba mati usorte ahi punchise.
Aru taikhan pani laga galta ke naapi sai sele bisi lamba galta thakise, ekta hath to choi feet ase, aru olop jai kene aru sai sele, pondro hath paise. Acts 27:29 cxv Acts 27:39
Titia pathor te lagibo bhoi pora taikhan piche phale pora loha longor charta phelai dise, aru phojur hobole prathana kori thakise.
Aru jahaaj chola manu khan jahaaj charikena polabole bhabise, taikhan jahaaj pora longor phelai diya nisena bahana pora chutu naw ke niche samundar te girai dise.
Titia Paul pora henapoti aru sipahi khan ke koise, “Jodi eitu khan jahaaj te nathakile apnikhan kitia bhi bachibole na paribo.”
Titia sipahi khan jai kene chutu naw laga rusi khan kati girai dise.
Aru jitia phojur hobole hoise, Paul sob manu ke kiba khabole koise. Tai koise, “Aji choudah din hoise apnikhan eku nakhai kene bhukha thaki ase.
Karone moi apnikhan ke koi ase, kiba khai lobi, kelemane eneka korile bachibo paribo, tumi laga matha pora ekta chuli bhi na giribo.”
Aru jitia tai utu koi dise, tai roti loi kene Isor ke dhanyavad dise, aru taikhan khai loise.
Titia taikhan bhi sob mon dangor hoi kene kha luwa kori loise.
Aru amikhan jahaaj te thaka khan sob 276 jon asele.
Karone jitia taikhan kha luwa kora hoise, taikhan jahaaj ke halka kori bole gehu uthaikene samundar te phelai dise. Jahaaj Bhangi Jaise
Jitia din hoise, taikhan kuntu jagate ase janibole para nai, kintu ekta mati jagah dikhise, aru jahaaj ke ta te loijai kene rakhibole bhabise. Acts 27:40 cxvi Acts 28:4

Titia taikhan longor khan ke samundar te chari dise, aru jahaaj cholai thaka khuri bandi thaka ke khuli dise, aru jahaaj laga kapra khan age phale thaka ke uthaikene hawa pora kinar te loija bole dise,
Kintu jahaaj to jai kene samundar laga duita pani laga takot pora dhuri loise, aru jahaaj matite lagi kene thaki jaise, aru piche phale pani pora mari kene bhangai dise.
Aru koidi manu khan pani khilikena polai jabo bhoi pora sipahi khan taikhan ke morai dibole bhabise.
Kintu henapoti pora Paul ke bachai dibo mon asele, etu karone taikhan ke rukhai dise, aru jun pani khilibo jane, jap mari kene poila sukha matite jai jabole hukum dise.
Aru baki khan takhta pora aru kunba jahaaj bhanga tukra pora jabole hukum dise, aru sob bachi kene sukha matite punchise. 28 Paul Malta Te
Titia amikhan bachi kene ulai ahise, etu majuli laga naam Malta ase eneka jani loise.
Aru ta te laga manu khan bhi amikhan ke bisi morom korise, aru pani gira karone bisi thanda thakise, taikhan jui jolai amikhan ke jui thapibo dise.
Kintu jitia Paul khuri mutha uthaikene jui te haali se, ta te ekta saph gorom paikene khuri pora ulaise, aru tai hathte bandhi loise.

Titia ta te laga manu khan saph tai hathte bandi thaka dikhise aru taikhan majote kotha Acts 28:5 cxvii Acts 28:12 korise, “Ki hoilebi etu manu morai diya manu ase, tai samundar pora to bachi kene ahise, hoilebi niyom pora taike jinda thakibo nadibo.”
Kintu tai hath hilai kene saph ke jui te phelai dise, aru tai eku huwa nai.

Kintu taikhan bhabise tai gaw phuli jabo, nohoile giri kene mori jabo. Kintu bisi deri tak sai thaki bole taike eku huwa nai, titia, taikhan laga bhabona alag hoise, aru tai ekta Isor ase bhabona korise.

Etu jagah usorte Publius koi kene etu majuli laga prodhan cholawta asele, aru etu jaga laga mati bisi laga tai malik thakise, aru tai amikhan ke tai ghor te loijai kene tin-din bhal pora rakhi sewa korise.
Aru eneka hoise Publius laga baba bukhar aru pet-jai thakisele, Paul tai ghor te jai kene Isor ke prathana kori dise, aru tai uporte hath rakhi taike bhal kori dise.
Jitia eneka hoise, etu dikhi kene utu jaga laga manu khan jun bemar ase sob loi ani bhal hoi kene jaise.

Tai laga anugrah laga mohima juntu Tai amikhan ke ene pora dise Tai laga Sobse Morom Thaka Ekjon dwara,
Tai laga khun pora he amikhan udhar kori loise, aru Tai laga dangor anugrah te amikhan laga paap sob maph paise,
sob gyaan aru buddhi pora amikhan ke bhorta kori dise. Ephesians 1:9 ii Ephesians 1:17
Khrista dwara sorgote aru prithibi te thaka sob manu ke Isor laga asurit kotha koidibole Isor laga itcha korise,
Isor laga itcha to kineka thik homoi te pura hobo etu he tai laga bhabona ase, aru sorgo aru prithibi te ki jinis khan ase, sob eke logote mili kene Khrista laga age te anibo,
Khrista te he amikhan ke Isor laga manu hobole basi loise. Amikhan ke age pora jaga bonai kene rakhise juntu hisab te tai laga itcha pora amikhan ke Isor laga maksad karone basi loise,
etu nimite he amikhan, jun Khrista uporte poila pora asha rakhise, tai laga mohima hobo nimite aradhana koribo.
Apuni khan bhi Khrista ke biswas korise, aru jitia apnikhan laga poritran laga susamachar hunise, aru biswas korise, titia apuni ke Pobitro Atma laga kosom pora mohor lagai dise,
aru amikhan nimite pabole thaka to Pobitro Atma pora ji hoilebi rakhi diye, jitia tak amikhan etu pura pai naloi, Tai mohima karone. Dhanyavad Diya Prathana
Etu nimite, jitia apuni laga biswas Jisu Khrista te thaka aru apnikhan sob pobitro manu ke morom kora moi hunise,
Moi apnikhan nimite dhanyavad dibole rukhanai, moi laga prathana te hodai yaad kori thake,
ami laga Probhu Jisu Khrista laga Isor , mohima laga Baba, apnikhan ke Tai laga Ephesians 1:18 iii Ephesians 2:2 buddhi laga atma aru Tai laga gyaan apnikhan ke jonai dibo nimite,

aru apnikhan laga mon laga suku khuli kene ujala hobo nimite titia apuni janibo paribo kele tai apnikhan ke Tai laga asha te matise aru pobitro khan nimite tai kineka dhun aru mohima rakhi dikene ase etu janibo,
aru tulona kori bole napara Tai laga mohan hokti juntu biswas kora khan logot ase, juntu hisab te tai kaam kore,
juntu hokti Khrista bhitor te kaam korise, aru Jisu ke mora pora uthai dise aru sorgote Tai laga dyna hathte rakhise,
sob niyom, adhikar aru takot pora ki kotha koise khali etiya he nohoi, kintu ahibole yug nimite bhi.
Isor sob jinis to tai laga theng nichete rakhise aru sob hokti to taike dise aru sob girja uporte cholawta hobole dise*,
girja to Khrista laga gaw ase aru tai pora he bhorta kore, Tai sob saman ke pura kore aru thik kore. 2 Biswas Pora Anugraha Paise
Aru apnikhan poila to kotha namana aru paap te morikene asele,

utu somoite apuni khan etu prithibi laga niyom hisab te berai thakise, aru apnikhan hawa atma laga takot te berai thakise, juntu * 1:22 Col. 2:10; Psa. 8:6 Ephesians 2:3 iv Ephesians 2:11 atma etiya kotha namane laga manu khan logote kaam kori ase.
Amikhan bhi taikhan nisena he thakise, biya laga bhabona aru gaw mangso ke khushi koribo dise. Etu nimite, dusra khan nisena he, amikhan to Isor laga khong te julibole thaka bacha khan ase.
Kintu Isor to daya te bisi dhuni ase, aru tai laga dangor morom pora amikhan ke bisi morom korise.
Jitia amikhan tai laga kotha namana nimite mori thakise, Tai amikhan ke Khrista logote jinda kori dise- anugrah pora poritran anidise-
aru Tai logote amikhan bhi jinda uthai dise aru sorgo jaga sob te Jisu Khrista logot bohi bole dise,
etu nimite ahibole yug te etu jhuki bole napara dangor anugrah ki Tai daya kori kene Jisu Khrista te amikhan ke dikhai dise, etu sobke janai dibo karone ase.
Kile mane biswas dwara Isor laga anugrah pora apnikhan poritran paise, aru etu to apuni pora aha nohoi, kintu Isor laga bordan ase,
nijor laga kaam khan pora nohoi, kelemane kun bhi phutani nahobo nimite.
Kilekoile amikhan tai laga hath pora bona sristikhan ase, aru Khrista Jisu logote bhal kaam kori bole amikhan ke etu jibon dise. Khrista Te Sob Ekta Thaka

Etu karone monte rakhibi, ekta somoite apnikhan gaw mangso te Porjati thakise, aru apnikhan “sunnot kora khan” pora “sunnot Ephesians 2:12 v Ephesians 2:19 nakora khan” eneka mati thakise - juntu kaam to manu laga hath pora kora kaam ase*.

Kilekoile etu somoite apuni khan Khrista pora alag thakise, aru Israel samaj te luwa nai, aru kotha milai luwa laga kosom para apuni khan najana manu khan ase, aru eku asha aru Isor nathaka duniya thakise.
Kintu etiya Khrista Jisu te, apuni khan jun poila te tai pora bisi dur thakisele, Khrista laga khun pora usorte ani loise.
Kile mane Khrista nijor he amikhan laga shanti ase. Tai laga gaw pora duita thaka to ekta kori dise aru juntu diwar pora amikhan ke alag korise etu ke tai bhangai kene khotom kori dise†.
Tai laga kotha aru Yehudi niyom pora etu sob niyom khan khotom kori dise. Tai laga itcha to duita jat thaka to ekta hoi kene tai logote thaki bole, aru eneka pora he shanti banabo,
aru etu nimite Khrista laga Cross pora he taikhan majote dushmani thaka to khotom koribo paribo, aru Isor logot milai loi kene ki dushmani thakise etu khotom kori bole nimite.
Aru Khrista ahi kene jun dur te ase, aru jun usorte ase, duita jat ke shanti laga susamachar janai dise,
kelemane Tai pora he amikhan duijon‡ ke ekjon Atma bonai kene Baba Isor ke milai dise.

Etu karone apuni khan etiya dusra desh aru nachina manu nohua hoise. Hoile bhi, etiya * 2:11 Sunnot nakora Porjati † 2:14 Gal. 3:28; Eph. 2:15. ‡ 2:18 Yehudi aru porjati manu khan. Ephesians 2:20 vi Ephesians 3:6 apnikhan to pobitro manu khan logote Isor laga ghor te thaki thaka manu hoi jaise.
Apuni khan ke apostle aru bhabobadi khan laga mojbut kotha uporte bonaise, aru Jisu Khrista tai nijorke ekta bisi dorkar pathor dise§.
Jun he dangor ghor ke eke logote mojbut pora dhuri rakhise, aru Probhu te ekta pobitro mondoli hoi kene uthi thakibi,
aru Khrista te apnikhan ke milai kene bonai dise, juntu te Isor laga Atma thaki jabo. 3 Susamachar Laga Kotha
Etu nimite moi, Paul, apuni Porjati khan nimite, Khrista Jisu laga bondhi ase.
Jodi apuni Isor laga kripa kotha hunise juntu Isor pora moike dise apnikhan nimite,
juntu moike prokahit kori dise, utu lukai kene rakha kotha juntu moi age te olop likhi loise.
Jitia apuni etu kotha porhibo, apuni Khrista laga asurit aru bhitor kotha to bujhi bole paribo,
poila te etu kotha to dusra jamana khan ke janai diya nai, hoile bhi ekta sob kotha he Atma pora tai laga pobitro apostle aru bhabobadi khan pora janai dise--

aru Porjati khan bhi Jisu Khrista laga waris ase aru Tai laga gaw laga bhag ase aru susamachar laga kosom dwara taikhan bhi Isor diya kosom te bhag loise, § 2:20 Isa. 28:16; I Cor .12:28. Ephesians 3:7 vii Ephesians 3:16
etu nimite he moi Tai laga sewa korise, Isor laga anugrah pora kaam kori thaka aru asirbad morom moike dise.
Moi pobitro manu bhitor te sobse chutu ase, Khrista laga bisarikena khotom kori bole napara dhun kotha Porjati khan ke prochar koribo nimite etu anugrah moike dise,
aru sobke juntu tai laga asol maksad to ki ase etu dikhai dibo, ekta hosa kotha juntu Isor pora sob jinis bona homoi te lukai kene rakhidise-
etu hoile girja dwara he sob cholawta aru adhikari khan, jun sorgo jagate ase, taikhan Isor laga bisi kisim gyaan thaka to janibole pabo,
kitia bhi khotom nohobole bhabona juntu Isor pora amikhan laga Probhu Khrista Jisu logote korise,
amikhan Khrista logote biswas pora mon dangor kori kene tai usorte jabo.
Etu nimite moi anurodh kori ase apuni khan ke, mon chutu na koribi kelemane moi dukh pa to apnikhan laga labh hobole nimite ase. Atma Te Takot Hobole Prathana
Etu nimite moi Baba Isor usorte athukari kene ase,
jun pora sob dol laga ghor manu khan ke sorgo aru prithibi te naam dise,
titia Isor laga dhun aru morom laga asis pora apuni ke dibo aru apuni laga bhitor te thaka manu ke Atma pora takot koribo, Ephesians 3:17 viii Ephesians 4:5
etu hoile Khrista apuni laga mon bhitor te biswas dwara thakibo paribo, aru morom te thaki bole paribo,
titia apuni sob pobitro manu khan logote milikena bujhi bole paribo, kiman lamba aru kiman bhitor ,aru kiman untcha ase,
aru Khrista laga morom bujhi bo paribo, etu morom to gyaan pora bhi bisi dangor ase, etu sob to Isor laga bhal kaam pora amikhan uporte bhorta hoi jabo.
Isor usorte amikhan ki mangile bhi aru bhabona korile bhi sob to kori diye, aru juntu takot amikhan ke chulai ase etu laga itcha te he sob to pura hoi jabo,
Isor ke mohima hobi girja te aru Khrista Jisu dwara ahibole yug sob te, etiya pora hodai nimite. Amen. 4 Khrista Laga Sarir Te Milikena Thaka
Etu nimite ami Isor laga bondhi ghor te thaka manu, apnikhan ke utsah kori ase juntu kaam kori bole apnikhan ke matise utu thik pora kori kene berabi,
nomro aru norom hoi kene, dhorjo kori kene, ekjon-ekjon ke morom te thakibi,
shanti pora Atma bhitor te ekta hoi kene thaki bole kosis koribi.
Ekjon he gaw ase, aru ekjon Pobitro Atma ase, jineka apnikhan ke ekta bhabona kori kene mati sele,
ekjon Isor ,ekta biswas, ekta baptizma, Ephesians 4:6 ix Ephesians 4:15
Ekjon Isor aru sob laga Baba, jun sob laga uporte ase, aru sob pora ase, aru sob bhitor te ase.
Etiya amikhan sobke anugrah dikene ase Khrista laga inam laga ujon hisab te.
Etu nimite tai koise: “Jitia tai uporte uthise, Tai dhuri kene thaka khan ke dhuri kene loi jaise, Aru manu khan ke inam khan dise*.”
To etu laga motlob to ki ase “Khrista uthise,” hoilebi tai prithibi laga sob pora niche bhag te bhi jaise†?
Tai jun nichete jaise utu tai he ase jun sob sorgo khan pora bisi uporte bhi uthise, titia Tai sob jinis khan ke bhorta kori bole paribo.
Aru Khrista pora kunba ke apostle, kunba ke bhabobadi, kunba ke procharok, aru kunba ke palok aru hikhok kori bole dise‡,
pobitro manu khan ke thik kori bole nimite, mantri khan laga kaam khan aru Khrista laga gaw ke hikai dibole nimite,
Isor laga chokra laga gyaan te ekta biswas te napuncha tak, ekta pura aru thik manu hobo nimite, pura Khrista nisena,
titia amikhan aru bacha nisena nahobo, age piche nahilibo, niyom laga sob hawa te loi najabo, manu khan laga thoga baji te, aru chalak kaam khan te nagiribo.

Kintu morom pora hosa kotha kobo, aru sob jinis te uthibo, Tai logote jun matha ase, Khrista nijor , * 4:8 Psa. 68:18 † 4:9 Heb. 2:9; John 3:13. ‡ 4:11 2 Cor . 12:28-29. Ephesians 4:16 x Ephesians 4:24
Jun pora pura gaw thik pora mili kene ekta hoijai, aru bhag sob pora nijor kaam kori kene ekta bhag logote ekta bhag mili jai, etu pora gaw ke hikai, nijor pora morom te bonai uthibole. Notun Jibon
Etu nimite ami koi ase, aru Probhu naam te utsah di ase, etiya pora apnikhan Porjati khan misa-misi bhabona te thakikena bera nisena na koribi.
Bujhi bole para takot to andhar te rakhi kene ase, aru Isor laga jibon pora alag hoi kene ase, kele koile taikhan monte buddhi nai aru Isor ke taikhan laga mon tan hoi kene thaka nimite.
Jun khan nijor bhabona ke morai dise, aru nijorke bebichari kaam nimite cholai se, aru gaw mangso kaam te berai thakise.
Hoile bhi apnikhan eneka pora Khrista laga kotha hika nai,
eneka hoile apnikhan utu hobi juntu apnikhan tai laga hunise, aru Jisu pora jineka hikai se, juntu hosa to Jisu bhitor te ase.
Titia apnikhan utu purana manu laga poila kotha khan phelai dibi, juntu misa-misi ase thoga baji laga lalchi khan ase,
Aru apnikhan laga bhabona laga atma te notun hobi,
Aru ta te apuni khan utu notun manu hobi jun Isor laga protima ase- dharmikta aru pobitrota te§. § 4:24 Col. 3:10; 1 Cor .5:17. Ephesians 4:25 xi Ephesians 5:1
Etu nimite misa phelai dibi, sob manu dusra manu logote hosa kotha kobi kele koile amikhan ekjon-dusra-jon laga bhag ase*.
Apnikhan khong hobi, aru paap na koribi: apnikhan laga khong uporte din khotom hobole nadibi†.
Bhoot khan ke bhal homoi to nadibi.

Taikhan jun khan chor kore, taikhan chor nakori jabi. Ulta, tai kaam kori bole lage, tai laga hath khan pora utu kaam khan kori bole dibi juntu bhal ase hoile bhi, titia tai dusra ke dibole paribo junke dorkar ase.
Apnikhan laga mukh pora misa-misi kotha khan ulabole nadibi, hoile bhi juntu kotha dusra ke uthai dibole nimite bhal ase, eneka pora huni thaka khan anugrah pabo.
Aru Isor laga Pobitro Atma ke mon dukh kori bole nadibi, juntu pora apuni khan ke paap pora bachai diya laga dinte daag dise‡.
Sob tita khan, biya pa-a, khong, hala, aru gali diya khan apnikhan pora hatai dibi, sob biya laga bhabona khan.
Aru ekjon-ekjon ke morom koribi, norom mon rakhibi, maph koribi, jineka Isor pora Khrista dwara apnikhan ke maph korise. 5 Morom Te Thakibi

Etu karone, Isor pora morom kora bacha khan nisena, apnikhan bhi Isor laga niyom khan koribo lage, * 4:25 Col. 3:9; Rom. 12:5; Zec. 8:16. † 4:26 Psa. 4:4. ‡ 4:30 Eph. 1:13-14; Isa. 63:10. Ephesians 5:2 xii Ephesians 5:11
aru morom te bera bhi, jineka Khrista amikhan ke morom korise aru amikhan nimite tai laga jibon Isor ke ekta mitha sugandh thaka nisena bolidan dise*.
Kintu bebichari aru letera kaam khan aru lalchi huwa, etu kaam khan pora apnikhan uporte bodnam hobo nadibi kele koile apnikhan pobitro manu ase,
aru letera aru murkho kotha khan nohoile bhi biya kotha pora dhamali kora thik nai kintu dhanyavad diya laga kotha he kobi.
Etu bhal pora jani bhi, bebichari, nohoile letera, nohoile lalchi, aru murti puja kora- eitu khan sob Khrista aru Isor laga rajyote jaga napabo.
Kun manu pora bhi apnike eku motlob nathaka kotha pora thogabo nadibi, kele koile etu kotha namana bacha khan uporte Isor laga khong to ahibo.
Etu karone, eneka manu khan logote namili bhi,
kele koile poila apnikhan andhera te thakise, kintu etiya apnikhan Probhu logote ujala te ase. Ujala laga bacha nisena berabi†
-kele koile puhor laga phol to sob bhal niyom, dharmikta aru hosa khan ase-,
Hoshiar pora Probhu‡ laga itcha janikena thakibi.

Andhera te phol nadhura kaam kora manu khan logot namilibi, hoile bhi taikhan ke ujala te anibi. * 5:2 John 13:34; Gal. 2:20 † 5:8 Eph. 5:8 ‡ 5:10 Yate, Probhu to Isor hobo pare Ephesians 5:12 xiii Ephesians 5:21
Kilekoile taikhan lukai kene kora kaam khan kobole bhi sorom ase.
Kintu pohor te sob jinis khan dikhi jai, kelemane ki dikhi bole pare, etu sob pohor ase.
Etu nimite Isor kotha te eneka likha ase, “Uthi bhi, jun ghumai ase, Aru mora pora uthi jabi, Aru Khrista laga pohor apuni uporte ahibo§.”
Hoshiar pora sai thakibi, apuni kineka berai- murkho manu nisena nohoi kintu gyaani nisena,
homoi to para tak chola bhi kele koile din khan biya ase*.
Etu nimite, murkho nahobi, kintu Probhu laga ki itcha ase etu bujhi bole koribi.
Modhu pora nisa nohobi, kelemane etu pora apuni laga jibon sob khotom kori dibo. Kintu, Pobitro Atma pora bhorta hoi kene thakibi†,
ekjon-ekjon logote bhajan aru gana khan, aru pobitro gana khan, Probhu ke apuni laga mon bhitor pora gana kora khan aru sundur pora bajana koribi‡,
Sob homoi te Baba Isor aru amikhan laga Probhu Jisu Khrista laga naam te dhanyavad dibi,

Pura mon pora Khrista karone nijorke ekjon-ekjon logot mili kene thakibi. Shadi Kora Mota Aru Maiki Nimite Kotha § 5:14 Poila Khristan gana hobo pare * 5:16 Amos 5:13; Col. 4:5 † 5:18 Pro. 23:31-32; Gal. 5:21-25 ‡ 5:19 Col. 3:16; 1 Cor . 14:26 Ephesians 5:22 xiv Ephesians 5:31
Isor ke diya nisena, maiki khan nijor mota ke pura mon pora sabi§.
Kilekoile ekjon mota to maiki laga matha ase jineka Khrista ekta girja laga matha ase- tai nije he ekjon gaw laga tran-korta ase.
Etu nimite jineka girja to Khrista nichete ase, etu nisena maiki khan sob tai laga mota nimite ase.
Mota khan, apnikhan laga maiki khan ke morom koribi jineka Khrista tai laga girja ke korise aru etu nimite tai nije ke di dise,
Titia tai pora eitu khan ke pobitro kori dibo, taike Isor kotha loi kene pani pora dhulai sapha kori dibo,

titia Khrista nijor nimite ekta sonman laga girja ase koi kene dibo, eku bhi dagi nathaki kene nohoile bhi tera, nohoile bhi dusra eku bhi biya nathaka, kintu titia tai pobitro aru eku bhi galti nathaka hobo.
Etu nisena mota khan bhi nijor maiki ke nijor gaw nisena morom koribo lage. Jun mota nijor maiki ke morom kore tai nijorke morom kora nisena ase.
Kilekoile kunbi nijor gaw ke biya nalage, kintu tai bhal pora khilai aru sapha rakhe, jineka Khrista tai laga girja ke morom kore.
Kelemane amikhan tai laga gaw laga bhag khan ase.
“Etu karone ekjon mota tai nijor baba aru ama ke chari kene nijor maiki logote ekta gaw hoi kene thake*.” § 5:22 Col. 3:18; 1 Pet. 3:1; Gen. 3:16 * 5:31 Gen. 2:24 Ephesians 5:32 xv Ephesians 6:8
Etu ekta bisi dangor bujhi bo napara kotha ase, kintu ami Khrista aru girja laga kotha koi ase.
Kineka hoile bhi, apuni khan sobke koi ase, nijorke morom kora nisena nijor maiki ke morom koribi, aru maiki khan nijor mota ke sonman dibo lage. 6 Ama Baba Aru Bacha Khan
Bacha khan, Probhu dwara ama baba laga kotha mani bhi, kele koile etu he thik ase.
“Tumi laga baba aru ama ke sonman koribi” -juntu poila hukum ase kosom thaki kene-,
“Titia tumi nimite bhal hobo, aru tumi prithibi te lamba jibon thaki bole paribo*.”
Baba khan, apnikhan laga bacha khan ke khong hobole nadibi. Hoile bhi, taikhan ke Isor laga niyom te aru hisab te dangor koribi†.
Sewak khan, tumikhan laga mon sapha pora, malik logote kotha mani kene, bhoi pora aru kapi kene thaki bhi, jineka Khrista usorte thake,
khali suku usorte nohoi, jineka manu khan ke khushi kori bole nimite kore, hoile bhi Khrista laga noukar khan nisena, atma pora Isor laga monjur koribi,
bhal niyom pora sewa koribi Isor laga naam pora, manu laga naam pora nohoikena,

jani bhi jun manu bhal kaam koribo, etu manu Isor pora pabo, tai nokor hoile bhi nahoile ajad thaka hoile bhi. * 6:3 Exo. 20:12; Deu. 5:16 † 6:4 Deu. 6:7; Pro. 3:11-12; 22:6; Col. 3:2 Ephesians 6:9 xvi Ephesians 6:17

Malik khan, taikhan nimite bhi eneka he kori bhi. Gali kene bhoi nakhila bhi. Apnikhan jani ase, apnikhan aru taikhan laga Malik sorgote ase, aru Tai logot te eku bhagsak nai‡. Isor Laga Lorai Hathiar
Hekh te, Probhu logote thakibi aru tai laga takot te sakti pabi.
Isor laga sob hathiar khan lagai lobi, titia apnikhan bhoot laga chalak khan bhirodh te khara kori bole paribo.

Kilekoile amikhan gaw mangso aru khun logote lorai kora nohoi, hoile bhi biya niyom khan logote, biya takot khan logote, etu duniya laga andhar-laga-rajakhan laga biya khan logote, utcha jaga khan te thaka biya atma khan logote lorai kori ase.
Etu nimite apuni khan Isor laga hathiar khan loi lobi, titia apuni khan biya dinte khara hobole paribo, aru sob kori kene, khara hobo.
Khara hobi, apuni laga komor te hosa bandi lobi, aru chati te dharmikta bandi lobi§,
aru apuni laga theng khan te susamachar laga shanti nimite juta lagai kene taiyar koribi*.
Sob somoite, biswas laga dhal lobi, etu hoile biya jon† pora jui laga tir mari thaka to khotom kori bole paribo.

Aru poritran laga loha-laga-topi pindhi lobi, aru Atma laga dao, juntu Isor laga kotha ase‡. ‡ 6:9 Luke 6:31; Deu. 10:17; 2 Chr .19:7 § 6:14 Isa. 11:5; 59:17 * 6:15 Isa. 52:7; Nah. 1:15 † 6:16 Saitan ‡ 6:17 Isa. 49:2; Heb. 4:12; Isa. 59:17 Ephesians 6:18 xvii Ephesians 6:24

Aru ami nimite to, kotha kobole nimite sandesh dibi, tine hole ami bhoi nakori kene mukh khuli bo, susamachar laga lukai kene rakha janai dibole nimite.
-Juntu nimite moi noukar hoi kene ekjon janai diya manu ase-, titia moi bhoi nakori kene kobo, jineka moi kobo lage. Hekh Laga Salam Kotha
