Kintu kun to matite kata aru jongol ulai etu mati kaam nathake aru shrap paikena sob jongol khan jola bole nimite he hoijai*.
Kintu,morom te thaka khan, amikhan eneka koi thakile bhi, apuni khan nimite amikhan bhal bhabona koridi ase, juntu ase poritran laga kotha.

Kelemane Isor to anyai kora Isor nohoi, apuni kaam kora khan aru Tai laga naam ke morom kora, apuni Tai laga pobitro manu khan ke sewa kora aru etiya bhi taikhan ke sewa kori thaka to kitia bhi pahori najabo.
Amikhan laga etu he sob pora dangor itcha ase apuni ses tak eneka kori thakibo, etu pora apuni laga asha thik rakhibo nimite.

Eitu khan sob to apuni alchi nakoribole nimite ase, kintu atma te thaka khan laga biswas aru mon chutu kori kene thaka to saikene apuni bhi Isor pora ki kosom dise etu laga bhag hobo. Isor Laga Protigya Hosa Ase
Jitia Isor pora Abraham logote kosom disele, Tai nijor naam te kosom dise, kelemane Tai pora uporte thaka laga kosom khabole nimite aru kun bhi nai.
Tai koise, “Moi tumike asirbad koribo, aru Moi tumike bisi dangor bonai dibo†.” * 6:8 John 15:6. † 6:14 Gen. 22:17. Hebrews 6:15 xiv Hebrews 6:20
Aru etu nisena he, Abraham dhorjo kori kene rukha karone, Isor pora taike ki kosom dise etu tai paise.

Kelemane manu khan to kun taikhan nijor pora dangor ase, taikhan laga naam loi kene he kosom khai. Etu pora he taikhan majote mon namili kene thaka to khotom hoijai, kelemane kosom diya to ekjon uporte bharosa kori bole nimite kowa ase‡.
Jitia Isor pora Tai laga waris khan ke Tai laga kosom te eku bodla-bodli nai koi kene sapha pora dikhai dibole nimite korise, Tai etu kosom to ji hoile bhi pabo koi kene vachan dise.

Tai duita bodla-bodli kori bole napara laga kaam pora eneka korise- Isor to kitia bhi misa kotha nokoi- amikhan, kun luka bole nimite polai jaise, Tai pora amikhan ke ki asha dise, ta te mon dangor hoi kene thik pora dhuri rakhibo nimite§.
Amikhan etu asha thaka to amikhan laga atma ke nahila jagate rakhibole aru bharosa thaka jagate rakhibo nimite ase, kun to purdah laga bhitor jagate bhi ghusi bole pare,

kot te Jisu, amikhan age te Jisu ta te amikhan laga bodli jai kene Tai ekjon moha purohit hoi jaise, aru hodai nimite Melchizedek purohit laga niyom nisena kori ase. 7 Melchizedek Purohit Kaam Hisab Te ‡ 6:16 Exo. 22:11. § 6:18 Num. 23:19; Deu. 19:15; Mat. 18:16;
Tim. 2:13. Hebrews 7:1 xv Hebrews 7:8
Etu nimite Melchizedek, Salem* laga raja, aru Isor laga Moha Purohit, jitia Abraham pora raja khan ke khotom kori kene ahi thakise, titia taike lok paikena asirbad dise†.
Abraham bhi tai laga dos bhag sob to Melchizedek ke di dise. Tai laga poila naam laga motlob to hoile “dharmikta laga raja,” aru “Salem laga raja,” etu motlob thakise, “shanti laga raja.”

Tai laga baba aru ama bhi thaka nai, tai laga khandan nai, tai nimite tai jibon laga shuru aru jibon laga anth bhi nai. Kintu, Isor laga Putro nisena bonai dise, aru taike hodai nimite ekjon purohit thaki bole rakhise.
Kintu sabi etu manu Melchizedek to kiman dangor thakise, Abraham pora lorai kori kene ki jitise aru loi loise etu laga dos bhag taike di dise.

Aru Levi laga chokra khan ke purohit kaam kori bole nimite basi loise, aru niyom laga niyom hisab te jai kene Yehudi khan logot pora bhi daan aru dos bhag uthabole dise, taikhan bhi Abraham laga bacha khan hoilebi‡.

Kintu Melchizedek, taikhan pora bisari kene bhi tai laga khandan panai, kintu Abraham logot pora tai te dos bhag paise, aru kun logote kosom laga vachan thakise taike he Melchizedek pora asirbad dise.
Kintu eku jhagara nakori kene, ekjon chutu manu ke dangor manu pora asirbad dise.

Etu karone, jinda thaka manu dos bhag pai, kintu etu pora Melchizedek jinda thaki ase koi * 7:1 Jerusalem sheher laga purana niyom hobo pare. † 7:1 Gen. 14:17-20. ‡ 7:5 Num. 18:21. Hebrews 7:9 xvi Hebrews 7:17 kene gawahi diye.
Aru, kotha kori thaka nisena, Levi, kun bhi dos bhag paise, tai bhi Abraham dwara dos bhag daan di thakise,
kelemane etu homoi te Levi to tai laga khandan laga gaw pora thakise jitia Melchizedek aru Abraham lok paisele. Jisu Aru Melchizedek Duijon Ke Tulona Kora

Jodi Levi khandan laga purohit kaam pora he sob bhal aru thik hoise koile -juntu pora he manu khan niyom aru niyom paise-, titia Aaron laga niyom hisab te nohoikena kele Melchizedek laga niyom hisab te aru bhi kele dusra ekjon purohit ahibole nimite dorkar hoise?
Jitia ekjon purohit bodli hoijai, titia niyom aru niyom khan bhi bodli hoijai.
Etu kotha khan kun ekjon nimite koi ase tai dusra jat laga ase, kun manu bhi etu jat pora bedi te sewa kora nai.
Amikhan bhal pora jani ase Probhu to Judah laga khandan pora ahise, aru Moses pora bhi etu jat nimite eku kotha kora nai§.
Aru etu ke arubi bhal pora buji bole asele, jodi kunba aru ekjon purohit Melchizedek nisena ulai.
Tai ekjon purohit hoise, khandan saikene nohoi, kintu tai laga Tai laga namora jibon shakti saikene taike purohit bonaise.
Kelemane Isor laga kotha te bhi eneka gawahi di ase: § 7:14 Gen. 49:10; Isa. 11:1. Hebrews 7:18 xvii Hebrews 7:26 “Tumi hodai nimite purohit ase Melchizedek laga niyom hisab te.”
Purana niyom aru kaam khan komjur aru eku kaam nathaka hoija-a pora hatai dise,
-niyom aru niyom pora eku kaam to bhal bonai dibole napare-, aru bhal asha laga kotha to manu khan ke koi dise, etu pora amikhan Isor usorte ahe.
Aru etu kaam kosom nakhai kene kora nai! Kelemane dusra khan to kosom noloikene he purohit hoi jaise,
kintu Jisu to kosom khai kene purohit hoise, Isor pora Taike koise, “Probhu pora kosom khaise aru Tai mon bodli nokorile: ‘Tumi hodai nimite purohit ase.’ ”
Etu nisena he, Jisu pora amikhan bhal kaam kori bole nimite rasta khuli dise.
Prothom laga purohit khan bisi jon thakise, kintu mrityu hoija-a pora, taikhan kaam rukhi jaise.
Kintu Jisu hodai nimite jinda ase, Tai logot pora purohit laga kaam kitia bhi naharabo.
Etu karone, kun manu pora Tai dwara Isor ke bisari kene ahe, Tai pora eitu khan ke bacha bole pare, kelemane manu aru Isor majot te Tai hodai kotha koridi thake*.

Eneka moha purohit thaka to amikhan nimite bhal ase. Tai pobitro ase, eku golti nai, sapha, paapi manu khan pora alag, aru Tai sorgo pora bhi untcha hoi jaise. * 7:25 1 John2:1-2; 1 Tim. 2:5. Hebrews 7:27 xviii Hebrews 8:5

Tai ekjon moha purohit pora hodai kora nisena, poila tai nijor laga paap nimite, etu pichete manu laga paap nimite bolidan di thaki bole eku dorkar nai. Kintu Tai nijorke bolidan dikene, hodai nimite, ekbar te bolidan kori dise†.

Kelemane niyom to komjur thaka khan majot pora he moha purohit kori bole basi thake. Kintu kosom laga kotha, kun to niyom diya pichete ahise, etu pora Putro ke basi loise, kunke sob phale pora hodai nimite thik bonai dise. 8 Jisu He Sobse Bhal Moha Purohit
Etiya amikhan ki kobole mon ase etu laga motlob to hoile eneka ase: Amikhan logote moha purohit ase kun singhason laga dyna hathte sorgo laga mohan jagate bohi ase*.
Tai sob pora pobitro jagate sewa kore juntu Probhu pora bonaise, manu pora nohoi.
Kelemane sob moha purohit khan ke uphar aru bolidan dibole nimite basi loise. Etu nimite tai bhi kiba anikena boli dibole dorkar hoise.
Etiya jodi Khrista prithibi te ase koile, Tai ekjon purohit nohobole thakise, niyom laga niyom hisab te bolidan dibole nimite ta te manu khan thakise.

Taikhan sorgote thaka laga saya ki dikhi ase etu ke sewa kora he ase, jineka Moses ke Isor pora mana korise jitia tai aradhana kora laga † 7:27 Lev. 16:6; Heb. 10:10, 12, 14. * 8:1 Psa. 110:1; Heb. 10:12. Hebrews 8:6 xix Hebrews 8:10 jaga bona bole thakise. Kelemane, Isor he koise, “Sabi tumike pahar uporte loijai kene kineka dikhai dise etu nisena he bonabi†.”
Kintu etiya Jisu he bisi bhal porisorja to paise, jineka Tai manu aru Isor laga majote bhal vachan thaka laga kotha kori kene milai diya ekjon hoise.
Jodi prothom laga niyom te eku golti nai koile, titia dusra niyom dibole nimite eku dorkar thaka nai.
Jitia Isor manu khan uporte golti dikhise, Tai pora manu khan ke koise, “Sabi, eneka din ahi ase- Probhu pora koise- Jitia Moi ekta notun niyom bonai dibo Israel laga ghor aru Judah laga ghor logote.

Aru etu vachan to Taikhan laga baba khan logote niyom bonai diya nisena nohobo. Etu dinte jitia taikhan laga hath dhori kene Egypt pora ulaikene loi anise. Kintu taikhan Moi laga niyom to mani kene thaka nai, Aru Moi taikhan uporte khushi panai- Eneka Probhu pora koise.

Etu vachan ase Juntu Moi bonabo Israel laga ghor manu khan logote Etu din khan pichete - - Probhu koi ase. Moi laga niyom taikhan laga bhabona te rakhidibo, Aru taikhan laga monte likhi dibo. Moi taikhan laga Isor hobo, † 8:5 Exo. 25:40. Hebrews 8:11 xx Hebrews 9:4 Aru taikhan Moi laga manu hobo.
Taikhan kitia bhi nijor laga ghor usor thaka manu Aru kokai bhai khan ke nashikabo, aru kobo, ‘Probhu ke janibi.’ Kelemane taikhan Moike janibo, Sobse chutu pora loi kene sobse dangor tak.
Kelemane taikhan biya kaam kori kene thakise koile bhi Moi taikhan uporte morom thakibo, Aru taikhan laga paap Moi aru kitia bhi yaad nokorile.”
Etu niyom ke “notun” mata nisena, Tai pora prothom niyom to bodli kori dise, aru kun to purana aru eku kaam nathake hoise, etu joldi harai jabo‡. 9 Prithibi Laga Pobitro Jaga
Etu nisena prothom laga vachan te bhi prithibi te aradhana kora ghor bona bole niyom thakise.
Titia tombu ghor laga jaga taiyar korise. Poila kamra, kun jagate deevat, mez, aru Isor laga age te daan rakhi diya roti rakhe, etu kamra ke sob pora pobitro jaga matise*.
Dusra purdah laga pichete aru bhi dusra kamra thakise, aru etu ke pobitro pora bhi bisi pobitro jaga matise†.

Ta te dhuwa jolai kene aradhana kori bole laga suna pora bona pobitro bedi thakise. Etu ‡ 8:13 Jer . 31:31-34. * 9:2 Exo. 25:23-30; 26:1-30. † 9:3 Exo. 26:31-33. Hebrews 9:5 xxi Hebrews 9:10 laga bhitor te vachan laga sandook thakise kuntu suna pora pura lipai kene thakise. Etu laga bhitor te suna pora bona kolsi ekta te manna rakhi thakise, aru Aaron laga lathi pora notun pata ulaikene thakise, aru vachan likhi rakha pathor ,eitu khan sob halikena thakise‡.
Aru etu sandook laga uporte, mohima thaka Cherubim§ laga chaya pora sapha kori diya dhakna ke bondh kori kene thakise, kintu etiya etu kotha koi dibole homoi huwa nai*.
Jitia eitu khan sob taiyar kori kene rakhi loise, titia he purohit khan hodai tombu ghor laga bahar kamra te taikhan laga sewa kaam khan kori thakise†.
Kintu, khali moha purohit he, saal te ekbar , dusra kamra te ghusi kene, tai pora nijor nimite bolidan diya laga khun‡ aru manu khan najani kene paap kora laga daan loi kene jai.
Pobitro Atma pora sob pora pobitro jagate jabole nimite rasta to dikhai diya nai jitia tak prothom laga tambu ghor khara kori thakise.
Etiya laga homoi nimite etu ekta chihna ase, juntu te uphar aru bolidan duijon dilebi aradhana kori thaka jon laga mon ekdom sapha kori bole napare.

Taikhan khali kha luwa aru nijor gaw ke sapha rakhibole laga niyom khan, juntu poila pora thakise, eitu khan te he mon di thakise ‡ 9:4 Exo. 16:33; 25:10-16; 30:1-6; Num. 17:8-10; Deu. 10:3,5. § 9:5 Sabole manu nisina (kitia ba janwar nisina) jun khan laga pankh pora Vachan laga Sandook ke din-rati rukhi thake. * 9:5 Exo. 25: 18-22. † 9:6 Deu. 27: 21. ‡ 9:7 Bolidan kora janwar laga khun. Exo. 31:10; Lev. 16:2. Hebrews 9:11 xxii Hebrews 9:16 jitia tak notun niyom laga homoi aha nai. Khrista Laga Khun Pora Udhar Puwa
Kintu bhal kaam sob nimite Khrista ekjon moha purohit hoi jaise. Etiya Tai sewa kori thaka tombu ghor to dangor aru bhal ase, etu manu laga hath pora bona nohoi, aru shristi laga bhi nohoi.
Tai sob pora pobitro jagate hodai nimite jaise, saguli aru guru laga bacha khun boli kori kene nohoi, kintu Tai nijor laga khun loi kene amikhan karone anonto poritran anidise.
Kelemane, jodi saguli aru mota goru laga khun aru bacha napa goru laga khun pora paap te giri kene letera thaka khan uporte hali diya pora taikhan Isor usorte alag rakhi diye koile§,

titia Khrista laga khun, jun anonto Atma pora nijorke Isor usorte eku golti nathaki kene Tai laga jibon to bolidan kori dise, etu pora aru bhi kiman mora laga kaam pora apuni laga bhabona ke sapha kori dibo, jivit Isor ke sewa kori bole nimite?

Etu karone, Khrista to manu aru Isor majote notun niyom ase, etu pora kunke mati loise taikhan anonto jibon laga asirbad pabo, prothom laga niyom te paap pora maph pabole nimite ki niyom thakise etu hatai kene Tai manu khan ke paap pora bachai dibole nimite nijorke mori bole dise.
Kelemane, kitia manu itcha rakhe, tai mora pichete, etu itcha poila koi kene thaka to kaam ahe. § 9:13 Lev. 16:14-16; 16:3; Num. 19:9; 17-19. Hebrews 9:17 xxiii Hebrews 9:24
Kelemane mora manu laga itcha likhi thaka to, tai mora pichete he kaam kore, kele koile jitia tak itcha likha manu jinda ase, titia tak etu itcha kaam nadiye.
Etu nimite prothom niyom bhi khun noloikena sthapit kora nai.
Jitia Moses pora manu khan logote niyom laga hukum khan koi dise, tai saguli aru guru puwali laga khun, pani, lal suta aru hyssop logot loise aru kagos aru manu khan uporte chitai dise*.
Titia Moses pora manu khan ke koise, “Etu Isor laga vachaan mana laga khun ase aru etu apuni khan mani kene thaki bole nimite hukum di ase†.”
Etu nisena, tai tambu uporte khun hali dise aru ta te chola laga kiman saman thakise, sob laga uporte hali dise‡.
Niom laga hisab te sob to khun pora sapha kori dise, aru khun ulaikene nadiya tak paap pora maph napabo§.

Etu nimite eneka kori bole dorkar hoise aru sorgote bhi etu nisena kiman saman ase eitu khan ke bhi eneka pora he sapha kori bole lagise. Hoile bhi, sorgote thaka saman khan to etu pora bhi bhal bolidan pora sapha kori bole lagise.

Kelemane Khrista bhi hath pora bonai kene rakha sob pora pobitro jagate ghusa nai, etu hosa ekjon laga sabole eke thaka dikhai diya he thakise. Kintu Tai nijor pora he sorgote ghusi * 9:19 Lev. 14:4; Num. 19:6. † 9:20 Exo. 24:8. ‡ 9:21 Lev. 8:15, 19. § 9:22 Lev. 17:11. Hebrews 9:25 xxiv Hebrews 10:2 se, aru Isor laga usorte amikhan karone etiya jaga bona bole nimite jaise.
Khrista to ta te nijorke daan dibole nimite ghusa nai, moha purohit khan pora kora nisena, kun saal te ekbar sob pora pobitro jagate khun laga bolidan loi kene ekjon-ekjon nimite ghusi thakise.

Jodi eneka he ase koile, Tai prithibi laga shuru pora bar-bar jai kene nijorke dukh pabole nimite dibole thakise. Kintu Tai nijor pora ahi kene etu hekh yug te nijor jibon to manu khan nimite bolidan kori dise.
Jineka manu bhi ekbar mori bole lage, aru etu pichete bisar kora laga homoi ahibo*,

etu nisena, Khrista ke bhi manu laga paap bukhi bole nimite dise, aru ekbar ahibole ase kun manu Tai nimite pura mon pora rukhi ase, aru paap to bukhi bole nimite nohoi, kintu poritran dibole nimite ahibo†. 10 Khrista Laga Ekbar Bolidan To Hodai Nimite Hoise

Kelemane niyom khan to ki bhal ahibole ase eitu khan he laga saya he ase, aru utu khan asol te kineka ase, eitu khan to asol nohoi. Etu nimite, eke bolidan juntu purohit khan pora hodai saal-saal te diye, etu pora Isor logote ahise koile, taikhan kitia bhi thik hobo na paribo.

Nohoile, bolidan kora to rukhi jabole thaka nai nohoi? Kelemane ekbar bolidan diya pora * 9:27 2 Cor .5:10; Ecc. 12:14. † 9:28 1 Pet. 2:24; Tit. 2: 13. Hebrews 10:3 xxv Hebrews 10:11 he manu khan sapha hoise, aru paap laga bhabona eku bhi nathaka hoise.
Kintu saal-saal pichete utu bolidan khan di thaka to taikhan laga paap thaka to yaad kori diya he ase.
Kelemane saguli aru goru laga khun pora paap to sapha kori dibole napare.
Etu nimite jitia Khrista prithibi te ahise, Tai pora Isor ke koise, “Bolidan aru daan khan apuni itcha nakore, Kintu ekta gaw Moi nimite taiyar kori diya to he itcha kore;
Jolai kene daan kora aru paap laga daan diya pora apuni khushi napai.
Titia Moi koise*, ‘Sabi Moi yate ase- Moi nimite kitab te likha nisena- apuni laga kaam kori bole nimite, O Isor .’ ”
Khrista pora Isor ke koise, “Boli, aru daan, aru jolai kene diya daan, aru paap laga daan apuni itcha nakore. Aru manu pora eneka kori thakile bhi apuni khushi napai” -niyom hisab te daan di thaka-,
titia Tai koise, “Sabi, Moi yate apuni laga itcha kori bole nimite ase.” Tai shuru te ki niyom kori thakise etu hatai kene dusra notun niyom shuru kori dise.
Etu laga itcha pora, amikhan ke Jisu Khrista laga gaw daan diya karone paap pora hodai nimite sapha kori dise†.

Aru sob purohit khara kori kene hodai din Isor usorte tai laga niyom kori thake. Tai * 10:7 Khrista pora Isor ke koise. † 10:10 Heb. 10:14. Hebrews 10:12 xxvi Hebrews 10:21 bar-bar eke bolidan di thake - kintu etu bolidan kori thakile bhi paap to kitia bhi harai najai‡.
Kintu jitia Khrista pora sob paap laga boli ekbar pora di dise, Tai Isor laga dyna hathte bohise.
Etu homoi pora, kitia Tai laga dushman khan ke theng nichete girai dibo Tai etu rukhi ase§.
Ekta bolidan diya pora Tai sobke paap pora hodai nimite sapha kori dise.
Aru Pobitro Atma pora bhi amikhan ke etu gawahi diye. Tai pora poila etu koise,
“Etu laga niyom taikhan logote bonabo, Utu din pichete moi, Probhu pora koi ase. Moi laga niyom taikhan laga monte rakhibo, Aru taikhan laga bhabona te likhi dibo.”
Aru titia, “Taikhan laga paap aru biya kaam khan aru moi yaad nokorile*.”
Jun jagate eitu khan pora maph pabo, ta te aru paap laga bolidan dibole nimite dorkar nai. Biswas Pora Mon Dangor Huwa Kotha
Etu karone, bhai khan, Jisu laga khun dwara amikhan sob pora pobitro jagate jabole nimite pura asha ase.
Tai pora amikhan nimite purdah paar kori kene jabole Tai laga gaw dwara, ekta notun aru jinda thaka rasta khuli dise.
Kelemane Isor laga ghor te amikhan laga ekjon dangor purohit ase, ‡ 10:11 Exo. 29: 38-39. § 10:13 Psa. 110:1. * 10:17 Heb. 8:12; Jer .31:34. Hebrews 10:22 xxvii Hebrews 10:30
amikhan sapha mon aru pura biswas pora Tai logote ahibo, paap laga bhabona pora sapha koribo aru sapha pani pora nijor laga gaw dhulai lobo.
Amikhan asha pora paap shikar kori kene thaka to hili bole nadikena jor pora dhori lobo, kelemane Isor ,kun kosom dise, Tai hosa aru bhal ase.
Aru amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke bhal kaam kori kene morom pora thaki bole nimite mon dangor kori dibo.
Amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke lok kori thaki bole nimite bondh nokorile, kelemane kunba khan eneka kore. Hoile bhi, kineka din hekh hoi ase, amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke mon dangor koridi thakibo.
Jodi amikhan hosa kotha to jani kene pichete bhi paap kaam kori kene jai thakile, titia hoile paap nimite bolidan diya to hoile apuni nimite eku kaam nohobo.
Kintu, bisar laga dinte ki hobole ase etu laga olop bhoi ase, aru gorom jui pora Isor laga dushman khan ke julai dibo.
Kun manu Moses laga niyom namani kene thake, taikhan to daya napai kene duijon tinjon laga gawahi pora morai diye.

Kun manu Isor laga Putro ke theng nichete chipai dise, junke paap pora sapha kori dise, aru tai Isor laga pobitro khun pora bonai rakha vachan ke ninda korise aru anugraha Atma ke opman kori dise, taikhan laga saja to kiman bhi dangor hobo?

Kelemane amikhan jani ase etu kun pora Hebrews 10:31 xxviii Hebrews 10:38 koise, “Badla to Moi laga ase; Moi taikhan ki korise etu wapas dibo.” Aru bhi, “Probhu pora Tai laga manu khan ke bisar koribo.”
