Etiya, Baba etu duniya bona age te Moi Apuni logote mohima te thaka nisena, etiya Apuni logote mohima hobole dibi. John 17:6 lxxiv John 17:13
Moi Apuni laga naam taikhan ke dikhai dise, jun khan Apuni he duniya pora Moike dise. Taikhan Apuni laga asele aru Apuni he taikhan ke Moi logote dise aru taikhan Apuni laga kotha mani loise.
Etiya taikhan jani loise, sob to Apuni Moike dise, sob Apuni pora ahise koi kene,
kelemane ki kotha Apuni Moike dise, Moi taikhan ke koi dise. Aru taikhan etu grohon kori loise, aru Moi, Apuni pora aha jani loise, aru Apuni he Moike pathaise etu ke biswas kori loise.
Moi taikhan karone prathana kori ase. Moi etu duniya karone kora nai, kintu jun khan Apuni Moike dise, kelemane taikhan Apuni laga ase.
Aru Ami laga ki ase, sob Apuni laga ase aru ki Apuni laga ase, sob Ami laga ase, aru Moi etu pora mohima hoise.

Etiya Moi duniya te bisi din nathakibo, kintu eitu khan to duniya laga manu ase, aru Moi to Apuni logote ahi ase. Pobitro Baba, Apuni naam pora rakhi lobi jun khan Apuni Moike dise, taikhan ekta hobo dibi jineka Amikhan bhi ekta ase.

Jitia tak Moi taikhan logote ase, Moi Apuni laga naam pora, ki Apuni Moike dise eitu khan roikhya korise. Aru taikhan kunke bhi harai diya nai, khali khotom hobo thaka ke nohoile*, jineka Shastro te likha ase etu pura hobo karone.

Kintu etiya Moi Apuni logote ahi ase, aru * 17:12 Judas Iscariot ke koi ase, John 18:9. John 17:14 lxxv John 17:23 Ami laga khushi taikhan monte pura hobo karone Moi etu duniya te thaka somoite koi dise.
Moi Apuni laga kotha taikhan ke koi dise, aru duniya pora taikhan ke ghin korise, kelemane jineka Moi duniya laga nohoi tineka taikhan bhi duniya laga nohoi.
Moi taikhan ke etu duniya pora uthai loijabi koi kene Apuni ke prathana kora nohoi, kintu taikhan ke biya jon pora bachai rakhibi koi kene binti kori ase.
Taikhan duniya laga nohoi, jineka Moi duniya laga nohoi.

taikhan ke bhi ekta hobole dibi, jineka Apuni, Baba, Moi logote ase, aru Ami Apuni logote ase, eneka taikhan bhi Amikhan logote thaki bole, eneka pora duniya biswas koribo Apuni he Amike pathaise koi kene.
Aru mohima juntu Apuni Moike dise, Moi taikhan ke di dise, karone taikhan bhi ekta hobole nimite, jineka Amikhan ekta ase.

Moi taikhan logote aru Apuni Ami logote- taikhan ekta hobole, aru Apuni he Moike John 17:24 lxxvi John 18:5 pathaise koi kene prithibi he janibole, aru Apuni Moike morom kora nisena, taikhan ke bhi morom korise.

Baba, Ami laga itcha ase jun khan Apuni Moike dise, taikhan bhi kot te Moi thakibo ta te Moi logote thaki bole, tinehoile taikhan Moi laga mohima ke dikhibo, kele koile duniya bona age te Apuni Moike morom kori ahise.
Dharmik Baba, prithibi Apuni ke jana nai, kintu Moi Apuni ke jane; aru eitu khan to Apuni pora Moike pathaise koi kene jani loise.
Aru Moi Apuni naam taikhan ke koi dise, aru koi thakibo, juntu morom Apuni Moike dise, etu morom taikhan monte thaki bole, aru Moi taikhan logote thaki bole.” 18 Thogai Diya Aru Jisu Ke Dhura
Titia Jisu etu kotha koi diya pichete, Tai chela khan ke loi Kidron Bhoyam kinar pora jaise, ta te ekta bagan asele, juntu jagate Tai aru chela khan jaise.
Titia Judas, jun Taike thogai dibole ase, tai bhi etu jagah jani thakise, kelemane poila bhi Jisu Taikhan ke loi ta te jai thakisele.
Titia Judas, sipahi aru mukhyo purohit aru Pharisee aru adhikari khan sakhi, mashal, aru hathiar khan loi kene ahise.
Titia Jisu, etu sob jinis Tai upor ahibo thaka jani kene, Tai taikhan logote ahikena hudise, “Apnikhan kunke bisari ase?”

Taikhan Taike jowab dise, “Nazareth Jisu ke.” Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Moi ase.” Kintu John 18:6 lxxvii John 18:14 Judas, Taike thogai dibole aru dhoribo thaka manu bhi sipahi khan logote khara thakise.
Karone jitia Tai taikhan ke koise, “Moi ase,” taikhan pichete hati kene matite giri jaise.
Titia Tai aru taikhan ke aru hudise, “Kunke tumikhan bisari ase?” Aru taikhan koise, “Nazareth Jisu ke.”
Jisu jowab dise, “Moi tumikhan ke koise Moi ase. Jodi tumikhan Moike bisari ase koile, poila eitu khan ke jabo dibi.”
Etu pura kori bole karone hoise jun to kotha Tai age te koisele; “Apuni Moike diya khan, Moi ekjon ke bhi harai diya nai*.”
Titia Simon Peter logote talwar thakise, aru tai etu ke ulaikene moha purohit nokor laga dyna kaan kati dise. Etu nokor laga naam Malchus asele.
Karone Jisu Peter ke koise, “Tumi laga talwar nijor jagate rakhi dibi. Juntu kup Baba he Moike dise, Moi etu pora khabo nalage naki?” Moha Purohit Age Te Jisu
Titia Rome laga sipahi khan aru taikhan laga sahab aru Yehudi khan laga adhikari khan Jisu ke dhori loise aru Taike bandhi loise.

Titia moha purohit Jisu ke tai chela khan laga kotha aru tai laga updesh laga kotha hudise.

Kile tumikhan Moike hudi ase? Hudi bhi jun hunise Moi taikhan ke kowa kotha khan. Sabi, taikhan sob jani ase Moi ki koise.”
Jitia Jisu etu koise, ta te thaka ekjon adhikari khara kori thaka pora Jisu ke thapor John 18:23 lxxix John 18:30 mari koise, “Kile Apuni moha purohit ke eneka jowab dibo?†”

Peter aru nohoi koise aru etu kowa logote, ekta murga hala korise. Pilate Usorte Jisu

Titia taikhan Jisu ke Caiaphas logote prodhan sorkari kendra te loi jaise. Kintu etu somoi phojur asele, aru taikhan prodhan sorkari kendra te loi juwa nai kelemane Nistar khabole thaka karone taikhan letera hoi jabo bhabona laga bhoi pora‡.
Pilate taikhan logote ahikena koise, “Tumikhan etu manu ke ki golti lagai kene yate anise?”

Karone Pilate taikhan ke koise, “Loijabi tumikhan Taike, aru tumikhan laga niyom hisab pora Taike bisar koribi.” Yehudi khan taike koise, “Amikhan laga niyom te kunke bhi mora bole adhikar nai.”
Jisu Tai nijor kineka kori mori bole ase, Tai nijor koi diya ke pura hobo karone etu eneka hoise. Moi Laga Rajyo To etu Duniya Laga Nohoi
Titia Pilate prodhan sorkari kendra jagate ahi kene Jisu ke matise, aru Taike koise, “Apuni Yehudi laga Raja ase?”

Pilate jowab dise, “Moi Yehudi ase, na nohoi? Tumi laga jati aru mukhyo purohit khan he Apuni ke moi laga hathte dise. Apuni ki korise?”

Jisu jowab dise, “Moi laga rajyo etu duniya laga nohoi. Jodi etu duniya laga hoile, manu pora Moike dhori kene Yehudi khan ke nadibo karone, Ami laga nokorkhan lorai koribo asele. Kintu Moi laga rajyo to yate nohoi.”

Karone Pilate Taike koise, “Tinehoile, Apuni ekjon Raja ase?” Jisu jawan dise, “Apuni thik koise, Moi raja ase. Kelemane etu karone, Moi jonom loise aru ahise, hosa laga gawahi dibo nimite. Karone, jun manu hosa te thake Ami laga awaj huni thake§.”

Kintu tumikhan niyom te Nistar Purbb te moi pora ekjon ke tumikhan karone chari dibole ase, karone moi tumikhan Yehudi laga Raja ke chari dile tumi laga itcha hobo?”

Titia Pilate pora Jisu ke loijai kene chabuk maribo dise.

Jitia Annas aru Caiaphas, moha purohit thakise, titia Isor Zechariah laga chokra jongol te thaka homoi te, Isor laga kotha tai logote ahise.
Aru tai Jordan laga sob jagate jai kene prochar korise, baptizma pora mon ghura bole aru paap pora maph pabole nimite.
Aru Isaiah bhabobadi pora likha kotha kowa nisena, “Jongol pora ekta awaj mati ase, ‘Probhu nimite rasta taiyar koribi, aru Tai laga rasta to sidha koribi.
Sob bhoyam khan bhorta hoi jabo, Aru sob pahar khan ke niche anibo, Luke 3:6 xvi Luke 3:14 Aru biya rasta khan sob sidha hoi jabo, Aru tan rasta khan norom hoi jabo,
Aru sob manu jati Isor laga poritran dikhibo*.’ ”
Aru titia John pora baptizma lobole aha manu khan ke koise, “Saph laga khandan khan! Isor laga ahibole thaka khong pora polabole kun tumikhan ke polabole koise?

Etu karone, mon ghurai kene bhal phol ulabi, aru nijor logote koi nathakibi, ‘Moi khan logote baba Abraham ase,’ kelemane moi tumikhan ke koi ase, Isor to Abraham nimite etu pathorkhan pora bhi bacha khan uthabole pare.
Hoilebi etu kuthar to taiyar ase, ghas laga jor te laga bole nimite. Etu nimite, juntu ghas to phol nadhure etu kati kene jui te julai dibo.”
Titia manu khan taike hudibole shuru hoise, “Titia hoile amikhan ki kori bole laga?”
Aru taikhan ke koise, “Jun logote duita kapra ase ekta kapra to dusra ke dibi jun logote nai, aru jun logote kha luwa ase etu bhi eneka he koribi.”
Aru poisa utha manu khan bhi baptizma lobole ahise, aru taikhan pora koise, “Shika manu, amikhan ki kori bole lage?”
Titia taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan ke kiman poisa uthabole nimite koise etu pora aru bisi nauthabi.”

Aru ta te kunba sipahi thaka khan pora hudise, “Aru amikhan ki kori bole lage?” Tai taikhan ke koise. “Tumikhan joborjosti pora kun logote bhi poisa nolobi, aru misa pora * 3:6 Isa. 40:3-5 Luke 3:15 xvii Luke 3:22 manu ke naphasa bhi, aru ki pai etu logote he khushi thakibi.”
Etiya manu khan bisi rukhi thakise aru monte John to Khrista hoi na nohoi etu asurit hoi kene bhabona kori thakise.

John he sobke koise, “Moi tumikhan ke pani pora baptizma dise, kintu moi pora bhi dangor ekjon ahi ase, moi Tai laga juta laga rusi khuli bole bhi layak nohoi. Tai he Pobitro Atma aru jui pora sobke baptizma dibo.
Dhaan laga katha Tai laga hathte ase. Etu pora ekdom sapha kori kene dhaan to dhaan ghor te joma koribo. Kintu chamra to jui thaka jui te phelabo.”
Aru taikhan ke kisim kotha sob te mon dangor kori dise aru John eneka Isor kotha prochar kori dise.
Aru jitia John pora Herod raja ke tai laga kokai Philip laga maiki Herodias logote golti kaam kora nimite kotha koise, aru tai ki biya kaam khan korise eitu khan sob koi dise,
Tai etu biya kaam khan logote aru etu bhi milai dise: John ke bondhi ghor te rakhidise.
Etu homoi ahi jaise, jitia sob manu baptizma loise, Jisu bhi baptizma korise, aru prathana kora homoi te sorgo khan khuli jaise.

Aru Tai uporte kopu chiriya nisena Pobitro Atma ahise, aru sorgo ekta awaj kotha koise, “Tumi Moi laga Putro ase, junke moi morom kore, Moi Tumi laga uporte bisi khushi ase.” Jisu Khrista Laga Khandan Luke 3:23 xviii Luke 3:32

Aru Jisu, Pobitro Atma pora bhorta koi kene, Tai Jordan Nodi pora ghuri jaise, aru Pobitro Atma pora taike jongol te loi jaise.
Ta te Taike chalis din saitan pora porikha korise. Etu din khan te tai eku bhi khanai, aru porikha homoi khotom huwa pichete Tai bhuk lagise.
Saitan pora taike koise, “Tumi jodi Isor laga Putro hoi, titia etu pathor ke roti hobole hukum dibi.” Luke 4:4 xx Luke 4:13
Jisu taike koise, “Etu Isor kotha te likha ase, manu to khali bhaat pora jinda nathakibo*.”
Titia saitan pora Jisu ke uporte loi jaise aru ekbar te he Jisu ke duniya laga rajyo dikhai dise.
Aru saitan pora taike koise, “Moi tumike etu sob adhikar aru mohima dibo, kelemane etu sob moi loi loise aru moi junke itcha kore, moi taike dibo pare.
Jodi Tumi moike aradhana kore, etu sob Tumi laga hoi jabo.”
Kintu Jisu taike koise, “Isor kotha te likha ase, tumi khali Isor ke aradhana koribi, aru Tai laga kaam he koribi†.”
Pichete saitan pora aru Jisu ke Jerusalem te loi jaise, aru mondoli uporte taike loi jaise aru koise, “Jodi Tumi Isor laga Putro hoi, yate pora niche giri jabi.
Kile etu likha ase, tai sorgodoth ke hukum dibo, Tumike bachabo karone.’
Aru, taikhan Tumi laga hath pora uthai lobo, etu pora Tumi laga theng to pathor te nagiribo‡.’ ”
Jisu taike koise, “Etu Isor kotha te likha ase, ‘Tumi Isor ke porikha na koribi§.’ ”

Jitia saitan laga sob porikha khan khotom hoise, etu pichete saitan jai jaise, aru Taike gira bole bhal homoi rukhi thakise. Jisu Porisorja Kaam Shuru Kora * 4:4 Deu. 8:3. † 4:8 Deu. 6:13-14. ‡ 4:11 Psa. 91:11-12. § 4:12 Deu. 6:16. Luke 4:14 xxi Luke 4:22
Pichete, Jisu Galilee te wapas Pobitro Atma laga hokti loi kene ahise, aru sob jagate Tai laga khobor huni loise.
Tai mondoli khan te Isor laga kotha sikhabole shuru korise, aru manu khan pora tai sikhai diya kotha khan huni kene bisi bhal paise. Nazareth Te Jisu Ke Tyag Kora
Aru tai Nazareth te ahise, jun jagate Tai dangor hoise, aru Yehudi niyom te, tai Bisram dinte mondoli te ghumai se, aru awaj uthaikene jor pora poribole khara kori loise.
Aru Jisu ke Isaiah bhabobadi laga kagos poribole dise. Tai kagos Khuli Kena ki likha ase etu paise,

“Probhu laga Atma moi uporte ase, Tai moike tel hali dikene basi loise gorib khan ke susamachar prochar kori bole*, Tai moike pathaise bandhi rakha khan ke khulai diya laga prochar kori bole, Aru andha manu khan dikhi bole, Dukh te dabai rakha manu khan ke bacha bole,
Aru Probhu laga dinte sob manu khushi pabole.”
Aru Tai kagos bondh kori kene cholawta ke wapas di dise aru bohise. Aru mondoli te thaka manu khan Taike he sai thakise.
Titia Tai pora taikhan ke koise, “Aji Isor kotha to purah hoise aru tumikhan huni loise.”
Sob manu Tai laga bhal koise aru asurit hoise aru Tai laga mukh pora ula kotha khan * 4:18 Isa. 58:6; 61:1-2. Luke 4:23 xxii Luke 4:31 huni kene taikhan koise, “Etu Joseph laga chokra nohoi naki?†”

Titia Tai koise, “Hosa pora tumikhan Moi etu kotha kobo, ‘Bemar bhal kora manu, nijorke bhal koribi. Tumi Capernaum te ki korise amikhan etu sob huni loise, aru eneka kaam khan nijor desh te bhi koribi.’ ”
Kintu, “Moi hosa kotha kobo, bhabobadi ke nijor desh te kun bhi sonman nakore.
Moi hosa pora tumikhan ke koi ase bidhowa bisi jon Israel te Elijah laga dinte thakise, jitia akas to tin saal choi mohina bondh thakise, jitia dangor dukh din etu desh te ahise‡.
Kintu Elijah ke taikhan kun logote te bhi pathai diya nai, hoilebi Zarephath, Sidon te ekjon mota nathaka maiki logote he pathaise§.
Etu homoi te kusto-rugi laga bemar thaka manu Israel te bisi thakise. Elisha bhabobadi laga dinte, kintu kunbi bhal huwa nai, khali Syria desh laga Naaman ke chari kene.
Aru mondoli te thaka khan jitia etu kotha hunise, taikhan sob khong hoi jaise.
Taikhan khara hoise, aru Jisu ke tanikena nogor laga untcha pahar pora phelai dibole korise.
Kintu Taike manu khan majot pora loi juwa homoi te, Jisu alag rasta pora ulai jaise. Biya Atma Thaka Ekjon Jisu He Bhal Kora

Etu pichete Jisu Capernaum te namise, juntu Galilee laga ekta sheher asele aru ta te sob manu khan ke Sabbath dinte Isor kotha hikai se. † 4:22 Luke 2:42; Psa. 45:2 ‡ 4:25 1 Kin. 17:1; 18:1. § 4:26 1 Kin. 17:7-19. Luke 4:32 xxiii Luke 4:39
Tai laga kotha huni kene taikhan bisi asurit hoise, kele koile Tai adhikar thakikena Isor kotha koi thakise.
Etiya mondoli te ekjon manu bhoot atma pora dhora thakise, aru tai jor pora hala korise aru dangor awaj te koise,
“Ha! Apuni logote amikhan ki kaam ase, Nazareth laga Jisu? Moi khan ke borbad kori bole ahise? Moi jane Apuni kun ase- Isor laga Pobitro Ekjon Ase!”
Jisu pora bhoot ke hukum dikena koise, “Chup thakibi, aru tai pora bahar ulai jabi!” Aru bhoot pora manu ke taikhan majote girai dise, aru manu ke eku nuksan nakorikena ulai jaise.
Manu khan saikene asurit lagise, aru ekjon-ekjon logote kotha patikena koise, “Etu ki kotha ase, juntu laga adhikar aru hokti pora Tai dusto atma khan ke hukum kore aru taikhan ulai jai?”
Aru etu khobor sob jagate punchikena bisi manu huni loise. Jisu Pora Bisi Bemar Manu khan Ke Changai Kora
Pichete, Jisu mondoli chari kene Simon laga ghor te jaise. Etu homoi te Simon laga maiki laga ama bisi bemar thakise, etu nimite Taike ahikena anurodh korise.
Aru Jisu ta te jaise aru tai usorte khara hoi kene, bemar ke gali dise, aru bemar taike charise, aru tai uthikena taikhan ke sewa kori bole shuru hoise. Luke 4:40 xxiv Luke 5:2
Jitia suryo nami jaise, jiman manu alag-alag bemar thakise, Jisu usorte loi kene ahise, aru Jisu ke taikhan uporte hath rakhi kene bhal kori dise.

Bisi jon pora bhoot khan hala kori kene ulaise, aru koise, “Tumi Isor laga Putro ase!” Hoilebi Jisu hukum dikene bhoot khan ke kotha kobo diya nai, kele taikhan jani thakise Tai Khrista ase koi kene. Jisu Pora Mondoli Khan Te Prochar Kora
Aru jitia din hoise, Jisu ulaikene manu nathaka jagate jaise, kintu manu khan dangor bhir hoi kene Taike bisari ahise. Taikhan ke Jisu pora chari kene najabo nimite manu khan kosis korise.
Kintu Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Moi aru bhi dusra sheher khan te bhi Isor laga rajyo laga susamachar prochar koribo lage, etu karone Moike duniya te pathaise.”
Aru Tai Judea desh laga jaga sob te mondoli te jai kene prochar korise. 5 Jisu Pora Prothom Chela Khan Ke Mata
Etiya eneka hoise, bisi manu Jisu pora Isor kotha kowa huni bole Tai usorte ahi thakise, etu homoi te tai Gennesaret* laga pukhuri te rukhi thakise.
Aru Tai duita naw pukhuri kinar te ani thaka dikhise, kintu maas mara manu khan * 5:1 Galilee pukhri laga dusra naam Luke 5:3 xxv Luke 5:11 naw pora namikene taikhan laga jal dhulai thakise.
Aru Jisu ekta naw te uthise, etu Simon laga naw thakise, aru tai laga naw ke olop panite loi jabole koise. Aru Tai naw te bohi kene manu khan ke hikai se.
Jitia Jisu kotha koi kene khotom korise, Tai Simon ke koise, “Etu naw to pani bisi thaka phale loijabi aru tumi laga jal to ekbar panite phelabi.”
Simon koise, “Probhu, amikhan raat bhor jal marise aru eku bhi puwa nai, hoilebi apuni laga kotha te, moi jal phelabo.”
Aru jitia taikhan jal phelaise, taikhan bisi maas dhurise, aru taikhan laga jal phati jaise.
Dusra naw te thaka sathi khan ke modot mangise. Aru taikhan sob mili kene duita naw te maas khan bhorta korise, etu pora naw to panite dubi bole hoise.
Jitia Simon Peter etu dikhise, tai Jisu laga theng nichete girikena koise, “Ami usor pora jai jabi, kele moi ekjon paapi manu ase, Probhu.”
Etu kaam dikhikena Peter aru tai laga sathi khan,

aru etu nisena James aru John, Zebedee laga chokra khan, jun khan Simon laga sathi thakise taikhan sob kineka iman maas dhuri bo parise koi kene asurit hoise. Jisu pora Simon ke koise, “Bhoi nokoribi; tumikhan etiya pora manu khan dhora jal hobo.”
Jitia taikhan laga naw mati kinar te anise, taikhan sob chari kene Jisu laga piche korise. Jisu Pora Kusto-rugi Bemar Thaka Ekjon Ke Luke 5:12 xxvi Luke 5:18 Changai Kora

Tai jitia ekta sheher te jaise, ekjon manu kusto-rugi bemar pora bhorta koi kene thaka dikhise. Aru jitia Jisu ke dikhise, tai Jisu laga theng te giri kene mangise aru koise, “Probhu, jodi Apuni itcha kore, Apuni moike sapha koribo pare.”
Jisu taike chuikena koise, “Moi itcha ase, sapha hobi.” Etu homoi te kusto-rugi bemar taike charise.

Aru Jisu pora taike koise kunke bhi nokobi, kintu “Purohit logote jai kene dikha bhi. Aru ekta sapha huwa laga boli koribi, Moses pora niyom diya nisena†, etu pora he manu khan nimite ekta gawahi hobo.”
Kintu etu asurit kaam laga khobor to sob jagate punchise, aru bisi manu tai laga kotha huni bole aru bemar pora changai pabole ahise.
Kintu Tai manu nathaka jagate jai kene prathana kori thakise. Jisu Pora Jothor-rugi Ekjon Ke Changai Kora

Eneka he, ek dinte, jitia Tai hikai thakise, Pharisee khan aru niyom hikai diya khan Galilee jaga, Judea desh aru Jerusalem sheher laga usorte thaka alag-alag bosti pora ahise aru taikhan bohi thakise. Changai kori bole Isor laga hokti Jisu logote thakise.
Titia manu khan he ekjon jothor bemar manu ke chetai te bukhi kene anise, Jisu jun jagate bohi thakise etu jagate anibole kosis korise. † 5:14 Lev. 14:2-32 Luke 5:19 xxvii Luke 5:27
Jitia taikhan manu bisi thaka karone taike anibo para nai, taikhan ghor uporte uthise, aru ghor laga chaat khuli kene Jisu usorte namai dise.
Taikhan laga biswas dikhi kene, Jisu koise, “Manu, tumi laga paapkhan maph hoise.”
Titia niyom likha khan aru Pharisee khan hudibole shuru hoise, “Tai kun ase eneka misa kobole? Kun he paap maph kori bole pare, khali Isor he nohoile?”
Kintu Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan mon eneka kele bhabi ase?
Kuntu kobole asan ase, ‘Tumi paap to maph hoise’ na ‘Uthikena berabi?’

Kintu tumikhan janibole koi ase, Manu laga Putro logote prithibi laga paap ke maph dibole hokti ase” - aru Tai jothor thaka manu ke koise- “Moi koi ase, uthibi, tumi laga chatai uthabi, aru ghor te jabi.”
Aru etu loge-loge, etu manu khara hoi jaise, aru tai ghumai thaka chatai uthaise, aru Isor ke mohima dikena nijor ghor te jai jaise.
Sob manu khan asurit hoise, aru Isor ke mohima dise, aru manu khan bhoi hoise, aru koise, “Amikhan kitia bhi nadikha asurit kaam khan aji dikhise.” Jisu Pora Levi Ke Mata

Etu pichete, Jisu bahar te jaise. Aru Tai ekjon poisa utha manu, Levi koi kene naam thaka ke masul dikri laga tombu ghor te bohi thaka dikhise. Tai jai kene koise, “Moi laga pichete ahibi.” Luke 5:28 xxviii Luke 5:36
Aru tai uthise aru sob chari kene, Jisu laga pichete jaise.
Aru Levi pora tai laga ghor te jai kene, ekta dangor ekta khana rakhise, Jisu nimite, aru ta te poisa utha manu khan aru dusra khan bhi eke logote mez usorte bohi thakise.
Kintu Pharisee khan aru niyom likha khan chela khan logote hala kori kene koise, “Tumikhan kele poisa utha manu aru dusra paapi khan logote khai ase?”
Jisu pora taikhan ke jowab dise, “Jun manu bhal ase taike bemar bhal kora manu nalage, kintu bemar manu ke he lage.”
Moi dharmik manu ke mati bole aha nai, kintu paapi khan mon ghura bole nimite ahise.” Upwas Nimite Huda
Titia taikhan pora Taike koise, “John laga chela khan upwas aru prathana kore aru Pharisee khan laga chela bhi eneka he kore. Kintu Apuni chela khan, kha-luwa kore.”
Kintu Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Shadi te aha manu ke bhukha rakhibo pare naki, jitia tak taikhan logote shadi kori bole mota thaki ase?”
Kintu eneka din ahi ase, jitia shadi kora manu taikhan pora jai jabo, etu din pora taikhan upwas koribo.”

Aru Jisu taikhan ke ekta dristanto koise. “Kun bhi phata kapra logote notun kapra nasilai, jodi etu kore, notun kapra bhi phati jabo, aru notun kapra to purana kapra logote namilibo. Luke 5:37 xxix Luke 6:5
Kun bhi angur ros purana chamra jola te nadhale. Eneka korile, notun ros pora jola to biya kori dibo, aru etu borbad hoi jabo.
Kintu notun ros to notun chamra jola te halibo lage.
Jun manu bhi purana ros kha pichete notun ros khabole namange, kele tai koi, ‘Purana to he bhal ase.’ ” 6 Jisu He Bisram Din Laga Probhu Ase
Aru dusra Bisram dinte eneka hoise Jisu kheti majote jai thakise, aru chela khan dhaan guti ulaikene hath pora sapha kori kene khai thakise*.
Kintu Pharisee khan hudise, “Tumikhan eneka kele kori ase, Bisram dinte eneka kori bole niyom nai nohoi?”
Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan Isor laga kotha te pura nai naki David aru tai logote thaka manu khan bhuk laga homoi te taikhan ki korise?

Tai kineka Isor ghor bhitore jaise aru pobitro jagate bhaat rakha to loi kene khaise, aru tai logote thaka khan ke bhi dise, juntu niyom pora chubo aru khabo napare, khali purohitkhan he khabo pare.†”
Tai taikhan ke koise, “Manu laga Putro to Bisram Din laga bhi Probhu ase.” Hath Murjha Manu * 6:1 Deu. 23:25 † 6:4 Lev. 24:5-9; 1 Sam. 21:6 Luke 6:6 xxx Luke 6:15
Aru ekta Bisram dinte eneka hoise, Tai mondoli bhitor te jai kene sikhai thakise. Ta te ekjon manu tai laga dyna hath to murjha asele.
Aru Bisram dinte, Jisu pora kunba ke bhal kore na nai, etu pora golti dhori bole nimite, niyom likha manu kunba aru Pharisee khan Jisu ke sai thakise.
Kintu Jisu taikhan laga bhabona jani jaise, aru jun laga hath murjha asele etu ke koise, “Uthibi, amikhan majote khara hoi jabi.” Etu manu uthi kene taikhan majote khara hoi jaise.
Pichete Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Moi tumikhan ke hudibo, Bisram dinte bhal kaam koribo lage na manu ke nuksan koribo lage, atma ke bachabo lage na, biya koribo lage?
Aru Jisu sob phale saikene etu manu ke koise, “Tumi laga hath to sidha koribi.” Tai korise, aru tai laga hath to bhal hoise.
Kintu cholawta khan khong pora bhorta hoise aru Jisu ke kineka phasabo etu kotha korise. Baroh jon Apostle Khan
Aru eneka hoise dusra dinte Tai ulaikene tilla uporte prathana kori bole jaise, aru Tai pura rati Isor logote prathana kori thakise.
Aru jitia din hoise Jisu pora chela khan ke matise, aru baroh jonke basi loise, aru taikhan ke apostle naam dise.
Simon (junke Peter naam dise) aru tai laga bhai Andrew; James aru John; Philip aru Bartholomew;
Matthew aru Thomas; aru James Alphaeus laga chokra; aru Simon junke Zealot bhi mate; Luke 6:16 xxxi Luke 6:23
Aru James laga chokra Judas; aru Judas Iscariot, jun he Jisu ke pichete dhoka dise. Bisi Manu Majote Jisu Sikhai Diya

Jitia Tai tilla pora namikene taikhan logote ahise, aru bisi dangor bhir manu joma hoi thakise. Aru Judea desh, Jerusalem sheher ,aru samundar kinar Tyre aru Sidon sheher khan pora ahise bhi bisi manu ahise.
Taikhan Isor kotha huni bole aru bemar pora bhal hobole nimite ahise. Kunkhan dusto atma pora dhori thakise taikhan bhi bhal hoise.
Aru manu khan Jisu ke chubole kosis korise kelemane Tai pora changai laga hokti ulai thakise. Sorgo Laga Anondo Kotha
Titia Tai chela khan ke saise, aru koise, “Dhonyo ase dukhia manu khan, kelemane Isor laga rajyo to tumikhan nimite ase.
Dhonyo ase jun bhuk lagi ase, kele koile tumikhan bhorta hobo. Dhonyo ase kun etiya kandi ase, kele koile tumikhan hasibo‡.
Dhonyo ase jitia manu pora tumikhan ke ghin koribo, tumikhan ke chari dibo aru bodnam kori kene naam biya kori dibo, Manu laga Putro karone.

Etu din aha somoite khushi anondo pora nachibi, sabi, tumi laga inam to sorgote dangor ase. Kelemane taikhan baba laga baba khan bhi bhabobadi khan ke eneka he dukh dise. Jisu Pora Hai Khan Janai Dia ‡ 6:21 Mat. 5:4-5; Psa. 126:5-6 Luke 6:24 xxxii Luke 6:33
Kintu dhun thaka manu khan, hai ase, kele koile tumikhan aram pai loise.
Hai ase kun manu etiya pet bhorta ase, kele koile tumi bhuk lagibo. Hai ase tumi kun etiya hasi ase, kele koile tumi dukh koribo aru kandibo.
Hai ase jitia manu pora tumikhan ke bhal ase koi, kele koile taikhan baba laga baba khan bhi misa bhabobadi khan ke bhi eneka koi thakise. Dushman Ke Morom Koribi
Kintu kun huni ase, tumikhan ke Moi koi ase, tumi laga dushman khan ke morom koribi aru jun khan pora tumikhan ke ghin kore, taikhan ke bhal kaam dikhai dibi.
Jun manu tumikhan ke shrap diye aru tumike digdar kore, tai nimite prathana koribi.
Jun manu tumike ekta thapor mare, taike aru alag gaal phale bhi mari bole dibi, jun manu tumi laga kapra ekta loijai, dusra ula bhi taike lobole dibi.
Tumike ki mange, etu di thaki bhi, aru jun manu tumi laga saman loijai, itu aru wapas namangibi.
Manu ki korile tumi khushi pai, tumi bhi eneka taikhan logot koribi.
Jodi apuni pora jun manu tumike morom kore, tumi bhi etu manu ke he morom korile, apuni nimite ki labh ase? Paapi manu bhi eitu khan ke he morom kore jun manu taikhan ke morom diye.
Jun manu tumi karone bhal kaam kore, aru tumi bhi etu manu nimite he bhal kaam kore, Luke 6:34 xxxiii Luke 6:40 eneka hoile tumi nimite ki labh ase? Kile mane dusra paapi manu bhi eneka he kore.
Jun manu pora wapas pabole asha ase, taike he dile, tumi nimite ki labh ase? Dusra paapi manu pora bhi paapi manu ke dhar diye, taikhan bi etu sob pabole nimite.

Kintu dushman ke morom koribi aru bhal kaam to dikhai dibi, aru bodli te kiba pabo nimite bhabona nokoribi, eneka korile, tumi laga inam to dangor thakibo, aru tumi Sobse Mohan laga bacha khan hobo, kele koile paapi khan kun Isor ke dhanyavad nadiya, Tai pora eitu khan sobke morom kore§.
Dayalu thakibi, jineka tumi laga Baba bhi dayalu ase. Dusra Ke Bisar Kora
Bisar nokoribi, tumike bhi bisar nokorile. Bodnam na koribi, aru tumike bhi bodnam nakoribo, maph dibi, tumi bhi maph pabo.
Di thaki bhi, tumi bhi pai thakibo: bhal pora dabai kene aru bhorta hoi kene dibi, aru bisi hoi kene tumi laga theng uporte giri bo. Ki hisab pora tumikhan dibo etu hisab te tumikhan bhi pabo.”
Aru Tai taikhan ke ekta dristanto koise. “Ekjon andha manu pora aru ekjon andha manu ke rasta dikha bo pare naki? Taikhan jai kene nalah te nagiribo naki?
Ekjon chela to guru pora dangor nohoi, kintu jun manu bhal kori kene sikhi loi tai guru nisena hoijai. § 6:35 Lev. 25:35-36; Mat. 5:44-45 Luke 6:41 xxxiv Luke 6:48
Tumi bhai laga suku letera ke kele sai thake, kintu tumi nijor suku laga dangor letera to nadikhe?

Tumi laga bhai ke etu kineka kobo, ‘Bhai, tumi laga suku te ki letera ase etu ami sapha kori dibo’; aru tumi laga suku te dangor letera thaka to tumi dikha nai? Kopoti khan! Poila tumi suku te letera thaka to ulabi, titia he tumi sapha pora tumi bhai laga suku te letera thaka to ulabole paribo.
Kelemane bhal ghas te biya phol naulai aru etu nisena biya ghas te bhi bhal phol naulai.
Sob ghas to tai laga phol pora he jani jai. Manu khan kata ghas pora dimoru nakate, aru jongol ghas pora angur phol nakate.
Bhal manu laga mon pora bhal bostu ulai diye, aru paapi manu bhitor pora biya he ulai diye. Kelemane mon bhitor te ki ase, tai mukh pora koi. Pathor Uporte Ghor Bonabi
Tumikhan kele Moike ‘Probhu, Probhu,’ mate aru Moi ki koi etu nakore?*
Aru jun manu Moi logote ahe aru Moi laga kotha to huni kene kore, Moi tumikhan ke dikhai dibo tai kineka ase.

Tai ghor bonai thaka ekjon manu nisena ase aru bhal kori kene pathor uporte ghor bonaise aru jitia ban-pani ahise, ghor to pani pora bhorta hoi jaise, kintu ghor ke hila bo para nai, kele koile etu ghor to bhal kori kene bonaise. * 6:46 Mal. 1:6 Luke 6:49 xxxv Luke 7:6

Kintu kun manu huni kene kaam nakore, etu manu eneka ase, jun ghor bonaise hoilebi bhetimul to bhal diya nai. Aru jitia etu ghor te dangor hawa pani lagise, achanak pora etu ghor to purah bhangikena pura barbad hoi jaise.” 7 Jisu Pora Senapoti Laga Sewak Ke Changai Kora
Jitia Jisu sob kotha to koi dise aru manu khan ke hunai dise, Tai Capernaum town te jaise.
Aru Rome laga ekjon henapoti* laga noukar , junke tai bisi morom kore, tai bemar pora mori bole hoi thakise.
Aru jitia henapoti pora Jisu laga kotha hunise, tai Yehudi laga bura manu khan ke Jisu logote pathaise, Jisu pora jai kene tai laga noukar ke changai kori bole.
Aru jitia taikhan Jisu usorte ahise, taikhan Jisu ke eneka anurodh korise, “Tai ekjon bhal manu ase aru apuni eneka koridile bhal ase,
kelemane tai moi khan laga desh ke morom kore, aru tai moi khan nimite synagogue bhi bonai dise.”

Etu pora Jisu taikhan logote jaise. Kintu Tai jitia ghor te punchibole usor hoise, etu henapoti pora manu ke pathaise, aru Taike koise, “Probhu, Apuni dukh nauthabi, kelemane Moi laga ghor bhitor te Apuni ahibole moi layak nohoi. * 7:2 Henapoti, Luke 7:7 xxxvi Luke 7:14
Etu nimite moi nijor bhi Apuni laga usorte ahibole layak nohoi, kintu Apuni ekta kotha koi dibi aru moi laga noukar changai pai jabo.

Moi nijor bhi ekta hukum chola manu ase, moi nichete sipahi khan ase. Moi ekjon ke kobo ‘Jabi’ aru tai jai; aru dusra ke kobo, ‘Ahibi’ aru tai ahe; aru moi laga noukar ke, ‘etu koribi,’ aru tai kore.”

Aru jitia Jisu etu kotha hunise, Tai bisi asurit hoise aru jun manu khan tai laga piche kori thakise, taikhan ke saikene koise, “Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, Israel te Moi eneka biswas thaka manu dikha nai.”
Aru jitia etu manu khan ke ghor te pathai dise, taikhan noukar to bhal hoi kene thaka dikhise.
Aru dusra dinte eneka hoise jitia Jisu Nain sheher te jaise, aru Tai laga chela aru dangor manu laga bhir bhi tai logote jai thakise.

Aru jitia tai sheher laga dorjate ponchise, ekjon mora manu ke uthai loijai thaka Tai dikhise. Mora manu to tai laga bidhowa ama laga ekjon he thaka bacha asele-, aru sheher laga manu khan tai logote thakise.
Jitia Probhu taike dikhise, Tai etu ama ke bisi morom lagise aru taike koise, “Nakandibi.”

Titia Jisu uthikena mora manu bukhi thaka chatai† te chuise, aru mora manu ke bukhi thaka khan bhi ta te sidha khara hoi jaise. Titia Jisu koise, “Jawan manu, Moi tumike koi ase, uthi bhi.” † 7:14 Mat made of straw, bamboo or grass. Luke 7:15 xxxvii Luke 7:22
Aru titia mora manu to bohi kene kotha kobole shuru hoise, aru Jisu pora etu chokra ke tai laga ama logot di dise.
Aru etu dikhikene sob manu bhoi lagi jaise, aru Isor ke dhanyavad dibole shuru hoise, aru koise, “Ekjon dangor bhabobadi moi khan majote ahise” aru “Isor he manu uporte morom korise.”
Aru Jisu laga etu khobor to Judea desh aru usorte thaka bosti, nogor sob te bhi khobor to punchise. Baptizma Diya John Laga Khobor Bukha Manu
Aru John laga chela khan etu sob khobor to jai kene John ke koise. Titia John pora tai laga diuta chela khan ke matise,
aru taikhan ke Probhu ke hudibole pathaise, “Ahibole thaka Masiha to apuni ase naki, na amikhan to aru dusra ekjon ke rukhibo?”

Aru jitia taikhan Jisu usorte ahise, manu khan koise, “Baptizma Diya John pora amikhan ke etu hudibole nimite pathaise, ‘Ahibole thaka Masiha to apuni ase naki, na amikhan to aru dusra ekjon ke rukhibo?’ ”
Etu homoi te Tai bisi manu ke bemar pora changai korise, biya atma pora dhora manu aru suku andha manu khan ke bhi changai korise.

Titia Jisu pora taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan yate pora ja pichete, John ke jai kene tumikhan ki dikhise aru hunise etu kobi. Andha manu khan dikhi pai ase, lengra khan bera bole pari ase, korhi bemar thaka khan sapha hoi ase aru kaan benga khan huni ase, mora manu jinda Luke 7:23 xxxviii Luke 7:30 hoi ase, aru gorib manu khan susamachar laga kotha huni bole pai ase.
Dhonyo ase jun manu moi uporte biya napai.‡”
Aru jitia John laga khobor bukha manu khan jai jaise, Jisu pora manu khan ke John laga kotha kobole shuru hoise, “Tumikhan balu jagate ki sabole jaise? Ekta hawa pora hilai diya jongol ghas to?
Kintu tumikhan bahar te ki sabole jaise? Ekjon manu norom aru daam kapra lagai kene thaka to? Sabi, jun manu daam kapra lagai ase, aru aram pora thaki ase taikhan sob raja laga ghorkhan te pabo.
Kintu tumikhan bahar te ki sabole nimite jaise? Ekjon bhabobadi? Hoi, moi tumikhan ke koise, tai to bhabobadi pora bhi dangor ase.
Etu tai ase jun nimite etu Shastro te likha ase, ‘Sabi, Moi ekjon manu ke pathai ase, tumi laga chehera usorte te, Jun he rasta to taiyar koribo.§’
Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, jun manu ama pora jonom loise, kun bhi John nisena dangor nai, kintu jun Isor laga rajyote sobse chutu ase, tai pora bhi dangor ase.”
Aru jiman manu etu kotha hunise, poisa utha manu khan, aru John logote baptizma luwa khan sob Isor pora dharmik ase koi dise.
Kintu Pharisee khan aru niyom jana Yehudi khan Isor laga itcha namani kene baptizma ‡ 7:23 Isa. 35:5-6; 61:1 § 7:27 Mal. 3:1; Isa. 40:3 Luke 7:31 xxxix Luke 7:39 luwa nai.
“Tinehoile, Moi, etiya laga jamana khan ke ki logote tulona koribo, taikhan ki nisena ase?

Taikhan bajar te thaka bacha khan nisena ase, bohi kene ekjon-ekjon ke mati kene koi, ‘Ami tumikhan usorte shadi laga basuri bojaise, tumikhan nach kora nai; moi khan mon dukh laga gana korise, hoilebi tumikhan kandia nai.’
Baptizma Diya John to ahikena bhaat aru angur ros bhi khanai, aru tumikhan koi ase, ‘Tai logote bhoot ase.’
Kintu Manu laga Putro ahikena kha luwa korise, aru tumikhan koi, ‘Sabi, taike, ekjon khakuwa aru nisa-pani kora, poisa utha khan aru dusra paapi manu laga sathi!’
Gyaan pora sob bhal aru biya to jani loi.” Paapi Mahila Ekjon Ke Khyama Kori Diya
Ekjon Pharisee pora Jisu ke tai logote khabole matise. Tai Pharisee laga ghor te punchise, aru Tai khabole bohise.
Etiya sabi, etu sheher te ekjon paapi mahila thakise. Jitia tai Jisu to Pharisee laga ghor te khabole bohi thaka dikhise, tai bhal gundh thaka bisi daam laga tel anise,
aru khara hoi kene Jisu laga theng usorte kandi kene tai laga suku pani pora Jisu laga theng bhi jai dise aru chuli pora mussi kene tai laga theng ke chumai dise, aru bhal gundh tel lagai dise.
Etu dikhikene, Jisu ke mata Pharisee tai nije ke koise, “Jodi etu manu hosa bhi bhabobadi Luke 7:40 xl Luke 7:48 ase koile, Tai janibo thakise etu jun taike choi ase, etu kineka mahila ase.”
Aru Jisu taike koise, “Simon, Moi tumike kiba kobole itcha ase.” Aru tai koise, “Koi dibi, Probhu!”
“Duita manu poisa dhar loise. Ekjon pansho denari* aru dusra to pachas denari loi kene thakise.
Aru jitia taikhan logote wapas dibole poisa thaka nai, malik pora duijon ke maph kori dise. Etu nimite kun manu pora taike bisi morom koribo?
Simon koise, “Moi hisab te junke tai bisi dhar to maph korise.” Titia Tai taike koise, “Tumi thik bhabona korise.”

Aru titia Jisu etu mahila phale saikene Simon ke koise, “Tumi etu mahila ke dikhi ase. Moi tumi laga ghor te ahise. Tumi Moike theng dhula bole pani bhi diya nai, kintu tai laga suku pani pora moi laga theng bhi jai dise, aru tai laga chuli pora mussi dise.
Tumi Moike ekta chuma bhi diya nai, kintu Moi jitia pora yate ahise tai moi laga theng to chuma dibole chara nai.
Tumi Moi laga matha te tel dhala nai, kintu tai Moi laga theng te bhal gundh thaka tel pora mussi se.
Etu nimite Moi tumike koi ase, tai laga paap bisi thakise, etu sob maph kori dise- kelemane tai bisi morom korise, kintu jun manu olop he maph kore, tai olop he morom kore.”
Titia Jisu pora mahila ke koise, “Tumi laga * 7:41 Ek denarius poisa to ek din laga hajara poisa thakisele. Luke 7:49 xli Luke 8:5 paap sob khyama koridi ase.”
Jun manu khan ta te bohi thakise taikhan majote kobole shuru hoise, “Etu kun ase, jun paap bhi maph kori bole pare?”
Titia Jisu mahila ke koise, “Tumi laga biswas he tumike bachai loise. Shanti pora jabi.” 8 Jisu Logot Safar Kora Khan
Aru eneka hoise, Jisu alag-alag sheher aru bosti te Isor laga rajyo laga kotha prochar kori kene jai thakise, aru Tai logote baroh jon chela khan bhi thakise,
aru kunba mahila khan bhi thakise jun khan dusto atma pora changai paise aru bemar pora bhal hoise. Mary, kunke Magdalene mate, jun laga gaw pora sat-ta bhoot khedaise;
aru Joanna, Chuza laga maiki, Herod raja laga imandar ,aruSusanna; aru dusra manu khan kun Isor laga kaam nimite taikhan logote ki ase etu di thakise. Bijon Hissi Diya Laga Dristanto
Aru jitia bisi dangor manu laga bhir joma hoi thakise aru manu khan alag-alag nogor pora ahise, Jisu dristanto pora taikhan ke koise:
“Ekjon kheti kora manu bijon hissi bole jaise. Aru jitia tai bijon halise, kunba rasta te girise, aru theng pora chipai dise, aru akas te chiriya thaka khan pora khai dise. Luke 8:6 xlii Luke 8:14
Aru kunba bijon pathor uporte girise, aru jitia dangor hoise, etu sukhi jaise, kelemane pathor uporte bisi patla mati thakise.
Aru kunba bijon to kata majote girise, aru dangor bhi hoise, hoilebi kata pora dabai dise.

Kintu kunba bijon to bhal matite girise, aru jitia etu dangor hoise, bisi dhan dhurise. “Etu kowa pichete, Tai awaj uthaikene koise, “Kun manu logot huni bole khan ase, tai huni lobi.” Dristanto Laga Motlob
Titia chela khan Taike hudise, “Etu dristanto laga ki motlob ase?”
Tai koise, “Tumikhan ke Isor he sorgo laga rajyo janibole dise, kintu dusra manu ke Moi dristanto pora koi, utu karone taikhan sai thakile bhi nadikha aru hunile bhi bujhi bole napare*.’
Etiya dristanto laga motlob eneka ase: bijon to Isor laga kotha ase.
Rasta te gira bijon laga motlob kunba khan kotha hunise, kintu bhoot ahi kene mon pora bijon ke chingi loijai, etu pora taikhan biswas nokorile aru roikhya napabo.
Aru pathor uporte bijon gira to kunba Isor laga kotha khushi pora hunise. Kintu tai laga jor to bhitor te jabo napare, aru olop homoi nimite biswas kore, aru porikha aha homoi te giri jai.

Aru kata bhitor te gira bijon ase jun khan kotha hune, kintu duniya pora tani loi, dhun sampoti, rong tamash aru lalaj pora bandhi jai aru uthibole napare. * 8:10 Mat. 4:11; Isa. 6:9-10. Luke 8:15 xliii Luke 8:23
Kintu bhal matite gira bijon khan taikhan ase kunkhan mon dikena Isor kotha ke hunise aru monte rakhise, aru thik pora dhuri rakhise aru pichete bhal guti dhore. Tukri Bhitor te Saaki
Kun manu bhi saaki jolai kene bisna nichete narakhe. Kintu etu ke uporte rakhe, aru sob manu etu laga puhor dikhi bole pai.
Eku bostu lukai kene rakhibo na paribo, kele koile puhor pora sob bostu dikhai dibo.
Etu karone ki hune ase, jun manu logot bisi ase, tai arubi bisi pabo, aru kun manu logot komti ase, tai logote ki ase etu bhi loijabo.” Jisu Laga Ama Aru Bhai Khan
Pichete Jisu laga ama aru bhai khan Jisu usorte ahise, kintu taikhan Jisu thaka usorte jabo para nai kelemane manu laga bhir dangor thakise.
Jisu ke manu khan khobor dise, “Apuni laga ama aru bhai khan bahar te rukhi ase, Apnike lok kori bole rukhi ase.”
Kintu Jisu Khrista taikhan ke jowab dise, “Ami laga ama aru bhai eitu khan ase jun manu Isor kotha hune aru kore.” Jisu Pora Andhi Rukhai Diya
Etu ek din eneka hoise, Tai chela khan logote ekta naw te uthise, aru taikhan ke koise, “Ahibi amikhan nodi laga dusra phale jabo.” Aru taikhan bohi kene jaise.
Naw te jai thaka homoi te Tai ghumai jaise. Etu homoi te dangor andhi ahise. Taikhan laga Luke 8:24 xliv Luke 8:31 naw panite gushi bole shuru hoise aru taikhan moribo bhabi thakise.
Taikhan Jisu ke uthaise aru koise, “Probhu! Probhu! Moi khan sob mori bole ase!” Kintu Tai uthikena hawa pani ke hukum korise, aru bisi shanti hoi jaise.
Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan laga biswas to kot te ase?” Aru taikhan bhoi pora asurit hoi kene majote ke koise, “Etu kun ase, Tai hawa aru pani ke hukum dise, aru taikhan manise?”
Pichete taikhan nodi paar kori kene Gerasenes, Galilee nodi usorte jaise.

Aru jitia Jisu matite namise, ekjon manu bisi bhoot pora dhora sheher pora ahi kene Jisu ke lok paise. Bisi din pora tai gaw te kapra nalagai kene, ghor te bhi thakibo napari kene, koboristan te he thaki asele.

Aru jitia tai Jisu ke dikhise, tai jor pora kandise, aru Tai age te girise aru jor pora hala kori kene koise, “Apuni moi logot ki kaam ase, Jisu, jinda Isor laga Putro? Moi anurodh kori ase, moike dukh nadibi.”

Jisu he dusto atma ke etu manu pora ulai jabole hukum dise. Bisi bar itu manu ke morai dibo nisena korise, loha laga rusi pora bandhi kene thakile bhi, manu khan pora bandhi rakhile bhi, sob rusi khan bhangai kene taike bhoot pora jongol te loijai thake.
Titia Jisu pora taike hudise, “Tumi laga naam ki ase?” Tai jowab dise, “Legion,” kelemane bisi bhoot khan tai bhitor te thakise.
Aru taikhan ke mora manu thaka jagate jabole hukum nadibi koi kene Taike anurodh Luke 8:32 xlv Luke 8:39 korise.
Aru etu usorte gahori khan tilla kinar te dana khai thakise, etu pora biya atma khan gahori bhitor te jabole nimite anurodh korise. Jisu pora eneka hobole dise.
Aru bhoot khan manu pora ulaikene gahori bhitor te ghumai jaise, aru gahori sob pahar nichete giri kene mori jaise.
Gahori pala manu khan etu dikhi kene sheher te polaikene khobor dise.

Aru manu khan ki hoise etu sabole ahise, aru jun laga gaw pora biya atma ulai jaise, taike Jisu laga theng usorte bohi thaka dikhise, sapha kapra lagase aru bhal hoise aru etu saikene manu khan bhoi lagise.
Aru jitia taikhan dikhise kineka bisi bhoot pora dhora manu to bhal hoise, taikhan pora jai kene itu laga khobor sobke dise.
Aru Gerasenes laga sob manu khan bhoi lagi kene Jisu ke etu jaga pora jai jabole koise. Etu pichete, Tai naw te bohi kene wapas jai jaise.
Jun manu pora biya atma khan ulaikene jaise, tai Jisu logote jabole anurodh korise, kintu Jisu pora taike wapas pathai kene koise,

“Tumi nijor ghor te jabi aru Isor ki kori dise etu jai kene koi dibi.” Tai pichete tai ghor te jaise, sob sheher te Jisu pora tai nimite ki kori dise etu prochar kori dise. Jisu Pora Mahila Ekjon Aru Jairus Laga Chukri ke Bhal Kori Diya Luke 8:40 xlvi Luke 8:50
Jitia Jisu ahise, sob manu khan taike salam korise, kelemane taikhan Taike rukhi thakise.
Aru ta te ekjon manu thakise tai laga naam Jairus asele, tai mondoli laga cholawta thakise. Tai Jisu laga theng te giri jaise, aru Jisu ke tai laga ghor te ahibole anurodh korise.
Tai laga ekjon baroh saal chukri mori bole asele aru jitia tai rasta te jai thakise, bisi manu khan tai logote joma hoi jaise.
Ekjon mahila baroh saal pora khun jai thakise, tai dawai diya manu logote sob taka poisa kharcha korise, kintu kun bhi taike bhal kori bole pora nai.
Tai piche pora jai kene manu majot pora Jisu laga kapra chuise, aru etu loge-loge te tai laga khun jai thaka rukhi jaise.
Titia Jisu koise, “Kun pora Moike chuise?” Jitia sob manu chup thakise, Peter koise, “Probhu, bisi manu khan ahi kene Apuni ke chui ase.”
Kintu Jisu he koise, “Kunba Moike chuise, Moi jani ase, Moi pora hokti ulai jaise.”
Jitia mahila to luka bole napara hoise, tai bhoi pora kapi kene Jisu usorte girise. Sob manu usorte tai koi dise ki nimite tai Jisu ke choise, aru kineka tai ekbar pora bhal hoise.
Jisu pora taike koise, “Swali, tumi laga biswas pora tumi bhal hoise. Shanti pora jabi.”
Aru Tai kotha koi thaka homoi te, synagogue laga kunba cholawta ghor pora ahise, aru koise, “Tumi laga swali to mori jaise. Sikhai diya manu ke aru dukh nadibi.”
Kintu jitia Jisu etu hunise, Tai eneka taike Luke 8:51 xlvii Luke 9:4 koise, “Bhoi na koribi; khali biswas koribi, aru tai changai hoi jabo.”
Aru jitia tai ghor te ahise, Tai kunke bhi bhitor te ahibole diya nai, khali Peter ,John aru James, aru bacha laga ama aru baba ke he ahibole dise.
Aru sob manu monte dukh kori kene tai nimite kandi thakise, “Nakandibi, tai mora nai, kintu ghumai ase.”
Kintu taikhan Taike hasi dise, swali to morise bhabikena.
Kintu Jisu, tai laga hath to dhorise aru matikena koise, “Bacha, uthibi!”
Titia tai laga atma wapas ahise aru tai uthikena kiba khabole mangise.
Tai laga ama aru baba asurit lagise, kintu Jisu pora taikhan ke ki hoise etu kunke bhi nakobi eneka koise. 9 Jisu Pora Apostle Khan ke Pathai Diya
Aru jitia Jisu baroh jon chela khan ke matise, Tai pora chela khan ke bhoot khan ke kheda bole aru bemar ke bhal kori bole laga hokti aru adhikar dise,
aru Tai taikhan ke pathaise, bemar manu ke changai kori bole aru Isor rajyo laga kotha kobole nimite.
Aru Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Eku loi najabi- tumi laga jola, lathi, poisa aru bhaat, duita kapra bhi loi najabi.
Juntu ghor te ghusi bo, ta te he thakibi, jitia tak etu jaga to nachare. Luke 9:5 xlviii Luke 9:12
Jun jagate tumikhan ke namate, etu sheher pora ula homoi te, tumi laga theng pora dhuli to hatai dibi, etu he taikhan bhirodh te ekta sakhi hobo.”
Aru taikhan alag hoi kene bosti khan phale jai jaise, Isor laga kotha prochar kori kene, sob jagate changai kori kene jaise. Herod Pora Jisu Ke Buja Nai
Jitia Herod raja pora etukhan sob hunise, tai bhoi hoi kene bhabona korise, kelemane kunba pora koise John to mora pora jinda hoise,
aru kunba koise Elijah he ahise, aru kunba pora koise, poila laga bhabobadi ekjon jinda hoise.
Kintu Herod koise, “Moi John laga matha alag kori dise, kintu etu kun ase jun laga moi iman kotha huni ase?” Aru tai Jisu ke sabole kosis kori thakise. Jisu Pora Pans Hajar Ke Kha Luwa Diya
Aru jitia apostle khan wapas ahise, taikhan ki korise etu sob Jisu ke koi dise. Titia Jisu pora taikhan ke loi jaise, aru ekdom chup-chap pora Bethsaida sheher te taikhan sob jai jaise.
Kintu jitia manu laga bhir khan etu hunise, taikhan bhi Jisu piche korise. Titia Tai sobke matise aru Isor laga rajyo kotha taikhan logote koise, aru jun manu changai lage, taikhan ke changai korise.

Etiya saam hobole homoi hoise, baroh jon chela khan Tai usorte ahikena koise, “Manu laga bhir khan ke pathai dibi, taikhan usor bosti Luke 9:13 xlix Luke 9:20 te jai kene ghuma bole aru khabole bisaribo, kelemane moi khan eku napai-a jagate ase.”

Kintu Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan manu khan ke kiba khabole dibi.” Kintu taikhan koise, “Moi khan logote pasta roti aru duita maas he ase- jodi moi khan jai kene sob manu nimite khana kina nai koile.”
-Ta te panch hajar manu thakise.- Titia Tai pora chela khan ke koise, “Taikhan ke ekta bhag te pachas manu kori kene bohibo dibi.”
Aru taikhan eneka korise aru sobke bohi bole dise.
Pasta roti aru duita maas to hathte loi kene, Tai sorgo phale saise, dhonyabad dise aru bhangaikena chela khan ke dibole dise.
Taikhan sob khai kene bhorta hoise, aru bachi juwa sob uthaise- aru baroh ta tukri te uthaise. Peter Pora Jisu he Khrista Ase Koikena Shikar Kora
Aru ek din eneka hoise jitia Jisu Tai ekla pora prathana kori thakise, aru chela khan bhi Tai logote thakise, aru Tai taikhan ke hudise, “Manu khan pora Moi kun ase koi?”
Taikhan koise, “Baptizma Diya John Aru kunba koi Elijah, aru dusra khan pora koi purana homoi pora jinda huwa bhabobadi ekjon.”
Titia Tai taikhan ke koise, “Kintu tumikhan Moi kun ase koi?” Titia Peter he koise, “Isor laga Khrista.” Jisu Pora Tai Mora Laga Age Te Kowa Luke 9:21 l Luke 9:28
Kintu Tai pora taikhan ke etu kotha kunke bhi nokobole koise.

Tai koise, “Manu laga Putro bisi dukh pabo aru cholawta khan Taike swekar nakoribo, mukhyo purohit khan aru niyom likha khan pora bhi golti dhoribo aru Taike morai dibo, kintu Tai tin dinte arubi jinda hobo.” Tumi laga Cross Uthaikene Moi Piche Ahibi
Aru Tai sobke koise, “Kunba manu Moi pichete ahibole itcha thakile, tai nijorke pahoribo lage aru hodai cross uthaikene moi pichete ahibo lage.
Jun manu tai laga jibon to bacha bole kaam koribo tai harai dibo; kintu jun manu moi nimite jibon dibo, tai jibon pabo.
Jibon te ki labh ase, sob duniya to paile bhi, nijor jibon to nuksan korile?

Kun manu moi laga kotha aru moi nimite sorom kore, jitia Manu laga Putro Tai nijor laga mohima aru Baba laga mohima aru pobitro sorgodoth khan laga mohima pora wapas ahibo, etu homoi te etu manu nimite moi bhi sorom hobo.
Kintu moi hosa kotha koi ase, kunba manu khan yate rukhi ase, taikhan Isor laga rajyo nadikha tak namoribo.” Chehera Aru Kapra Bodli Huwa
Etu kotha khan kowa ath din pichete, Tai tilla uporte prathana kori bole jaise, Peter ,John aru James khan ke loi kene. Luke 9:29 li Luke 9:37
Jitia Tai prathana kori thakise, Tai laga chehera bodli hoise, aru Tai laga kapra to asurit laga boga hoise.
Aru sabi, duijon manu Tai logote kotha koi thakise, Moses aru Elijah thakise,
Mohima pora taikhan ahise, tai jabo laga kotha to patise, juntu Jerusalem te pura hoi jabo.
Jitia Peter aru sathi khan ghumai thakise, aru uthise, taikhan Tai laga mohima dikhise, aru duijon manu Tai logote khara hoi thaka dikhise.

Pichete eneka hoise, jitia duijon manu Jisu usor pora jai thakise, Peter Taike koise, “Probhu, amikhan yate tinta khamba bonabo, ekta apuni nimite, ekta Moses karone, aru ekta Elijah karone.” -Tai ki koi thakise tai najane.-
Kintu jitia tai etu koise, ekta badal ahikena taikhan ke lukai dise, aru taikhan bhoi lagise.
Aru akas pora ekta awaj ahise, “Etu Ami laga Putro ase, junke Moi basi loise; Tai laga kotha huni bhi*.”
Jitia etu kotha khotom hoise, taikhan Jisu ekla thaka dikhise. Taikhan chup thakise aru ki dikhise kunke bhi kowa nai. Dusto Atma Pora Dhori Thaka Putro Ekjon Ke Changai Kora
Aru ek dinte eneka hoise, jitia taikhan pahar upor pora nichete ahise, dangor bhir ke lok paise. * 9:35 Isa. 42:1; 2 Pet. 1:17-18 Luke 9:38 lii Luke 9:45
Aru sabi, ekjon manu majot pora hala kori, koise, “Sikhai diya manu, moi anurodh korise, ami laga bacha ke sabi, tai moi laga ekjon bacha he ase.
Sabi, ekjon atma achanak pora dhori kene tai laga mukh pora letera thuk ulaise. Aru taike jokhom kori kene ulai jaise.
Moi Apuni laga chela khan ke atma kheda bole anurodh korise, kintu taikhan kheda bole para nai.”
Titia Jisu taikhan ke jowab dise, “Biswas nathaka aru biya rasta te jai thaka manu khan, Moi tumikhan logote kiman din thakibo? Tumi laga chokra ke yate anibi.”
Jitia chokra ke ani thakise, atma pora taike matite girai kene bisi hilai dise. Kintu Jisu pora dusto atma ke gali dise, aru chokra ke bhal kori dise, aru tai baba logot di dise.
Taikhan Isor laga asurit kaam to dikhise. Kintu jitia manu khan ki hoise etu dikhise taikhan asurit lagise, Jisu tai laga chela khan ke koise, Jisu Pora Arubi Tai Mori bole Laga Janai Diya
“Etu kotha tumikhan mon bhitor te jabole dibi: kele koile Manu laga Putro ke manu laga hathte thogai pora di dibole ase.”

Kintu taikhan etu kotha bujhi bole para nai. Etu kotha taikhan pora lukai kene thakise, etu karone taikhan bujhi bole para nai, aru taikhan Jisu ke etu kotha hudibole bhoi lagise. Sob Pora Dangor Kun Hobo Luke 9:46 liii Luke 9:54
Pichete chela khan majote kun he sob pora dangor hobo itu laga kotha ulaise.
Kintu Jisu taikhan laga monte ki bhabona kori ase etu jani loise, aru ekjon chutu bacha ke Tai usorte uthai loise,

aru taikhan ke koise, “Jun manu etu bacha ke Moi laga naam pora grohon kore, tai Moike grohon kore; aru jun manu Moike grohon kore, jun Moike pathaise Taike bhi grohon kore. Kun manu nijorke chutu koribo, tai he dangor hobo.” Kun Amikhan Laga Birodh Te Nohoi Amikhan Logot Ase
John koise, “Probhu, amikhan dikhise kunba manu Apuni laga naam pora bhoot khedai se aru amikhan taike rukhai dise, kele koile tai moi khan logot nohoi.”
Kintu Jisu pora taikhan ke koise, “Taikhan ke narukhabi, jun manu tumikhan bhirodh te nai, tai tumikhan logote ase.” Jisu ke Samaria Te Ninda Kora
Etiya, Taike sorgote uthai loi jabole laga din to usorte hoise, Tai Jerusalem te jabole bisi mon hoise.
Tai poila ekjon chela ke pathaise, aru taikhan Samaria bosti bhitor te punchi kene sob kaam taiyar korise.
Kintu ta te thaka manu khan Taike grohon kora nai, kelemane tai Jerusalem te jabole he mon thakise.
Aru jitia chela khan James aru John ke dikhise, taikhan koise, “Probhu, amikhan sorgo Luke 9:55 liv Luke 10:1 pora jui ahi kene taikhan ke khotom kori bole kobo naki?†”
Kintu Tai ghuri kene taikhan ke gali dise,
aru taikhan ta te pora alag bosti te jaise. Jisu ke Piche Kora Laga Daam
Taikhan rasta te jai thaka homoi te, kunba ekjon Jisu ke koise, “Apuni kun jagate jabo moi bhi apuni logote jabo.”
Jisu taike koise, “Siyal khan laga bhi gath ase aru akas te chiriya khan laga bhi ghor ase, hoile bhi Manu laga Putro laga matha rakhibole eku bhi jaga nai.”
Titia Jisu aru ekjon ke koise, “Moi laga piche ahibi.” Kintu tai koise, “Probhu, poila moi jai kene moi laga baba ke kobor dikene ahibo.”
Kintu Tai koise, “Mora khan pora mora khan ke kobor dibo. Kintu tumi, jai kene Isor laga rajyo prochar koribi.”
Aru ekjon koise, “Moi bhi Apuni laga piche ahibo, Probhu, kintu moi poila jai kene sob ghor manu ke jai ase kobo‡.”
Kintu Jisu koise, “Jun manu kheti te hal dhori kene pichete nasai, tai he Isor laga rajyo nimite thik ase.” 10 Jisu Pora Bahatar Jonke Pathai Diya

Aru jitia etu sob kaam pura hoise, Probhu pora aru bhi bahatar manu ke mati kene Isor kaam nimite asirbad korise, aru duijon-duijon † 9:54 2 Kin. 1:10 ‡ 9:61 1 Kin. 19:20 Luke 10:2 lv Luke 10:11 kori kene taikhan ke pathaise jun jagate Jisu nijor bhi jabo thakise.
Tai koise, “Kheti to bhorta hoise, kintu kaam kora manu olop he ase. Etu nimite kheti laga Probhu ke kobi, kaam kora manu pathai dibole nimite.
Nijor rasta te jai thakibi, sabi, Moi tumikhan ke ekta mer khan nisena rong kutta usorte pathai ase.
Poisa laga jola nolobi, rasta te jabole laga jola bhi nolobi, aru nijor chapal bhi nolobi, aru rasta te jai thaka homoi te kunke bhi salam nadibi*.
Jun to ghor te poila ghusi bo, poila kobi, ‘Shanti etu ghor te thakibi!’
Jodi shanti laga chokra ta te ase koile, titia tumi laga shanti tai uporte thakibo; jodi nohoi, etu shanti tumi logote wapas ahijabo.
Etiya etu ghor te he thakibi, ki kha luwa di ase etu khai kene thakibi, kelemane ki kaam kori ase, etu laga labh to pabole lage. Aru ekta ghor pora alag ghor te jai nathaki bhi.
Tumikhan juntu sheher te jabo, jodi taikhan tumike grohon kore, titia tumikhan ke ki khabole diye, etu he khabi.
Aru jun manu bemar ase taike changai koribi, aru taikhan ke kobi, ‘Isor laga rajyo tumikhan usorte ahise.’
Kintu jun sheher te tumikhan ke namate etu laga rasta te ulaikene kobi,
‘Juntu dhuli moi khan laga theng te lage etu bhi sapha kori ase tumikhan bhirodh te! Kintu * 10:4 Mat. 10:9; 2 Kin. 4:29 Luke 10:12 lvi Luke 10:19 etu jani lobi, Isor laga rajyo to usorte ahise.’
Moi tumikhan ke koi ase etu dinte tumikhan Sodom aru Gomorrah te dukh pa pora bhi bisi dukh pabo†. Mon Naghura Sheher Karone Hai

Hai ase tumi, Chorazin sheher! Hai ase tumi, Bethsaida sheher! Jintu dangor kaam tumikhan nimite kori dise, etu kaam Tyre aru Sidon sheher khan nimite korise koile, taikhan poila pora mon ghurai kene thakibo.
Kintu Tyre aru Sidon pora bhi bisi dukh tumikhan pabo, juntu dinte tumikhan logote Isor laga bisar hobo‡.
Aru tumi Capernaum town, tumike sorgote uthai loi najabo na, na uthai loijabo? Tumikhan ke ekdom niche, Hades te phelai dibo§.

Jun manu tumikhan laga kotha hune, taikhan Moike hune aru jun tumikhan ke ghin kore taikhan Moike ghin kore, aru jun Moike grohon nakore, tai kun pora Moike pathaise, Taike bhi grohon nakore.” Bahatar Jon Wapas Aha
Aru titia bahatar jon khushi pora jai kene koise, “Probhu, bhoot khan bhi Apuni laga naam te amikhan laga kotha mane.”
Titia Tai koise, “Moi sai thakise Saitan sorgo pora bhijili nisena girise*.

Sabi, Moi tumikhan ke saph aru bhichoo khan ke khotom kori bole nimite takot dise, aru † 10:12 Gen. 19:24-25 ‡ 10:14 Joel 3:4-8; Zec. 9:2-4 § 10:15 Isa. 14:13,15 * 10:18 Rev. 12:7-9; Isa. 14:12 Luke 10:20 lvii Luke 10:25 jiman dushman laga takot ase etu sob khan ke khotom kori bole nimite dise, aru eku pora bhi tumikhan ke jokhom kori bole napari bole dise.

Hoilebi tumikhan etu dusto atma khan pora tumikhan laga kotha mani ase koi kene he khushi na koribi, kintu khushi koribi ki karone tumikhan laga naam sorgote likha ase.” Jisu Pora Pobitro Atma Te Anondo Kora

Aru etu homoi te Jisu ke Pobitro Atma pora bisi khushi korise aru koise, “Moi Apuni ke dhanyavad di ase Baba, sorgo aru prithibi laga Probhu, kelemane Apuni etu sob kotha to gyaani aru bujhi bole pora manu khan logote lukai kene rakhise, aru etu sob kotha to chutu bacha khan ke janibole dise. Hoi Baba, etu sob Apuni usorte sabole bhal dikhe.”

Etu sob kaam aru kotha to Moi laga Baba pora Moike dise, aru kun bhi najane Putro to kun ase, khali Baba he jane, aru kun Baba ase etu khali Putro pora he jane, aru kunke Putro pora mati lobo taike he sob to dikhai dibo.”
Titia Tai chela khan ke ghuri kene saise aru aste pora koise, “Dhonyo ase etu sukukhan, manu nadikha tumikhan ke sabo dise.

Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, bisi bhabobadi aru raja khan tumikhan ki dikhise etu sabole nimite bisi itcha korise, kintu taikhan etu dikha nai, aru tumikhan ki hunise taikhan etu huni bole mon korise kintu taikhan huni bole panai.” Samaria Manu Laga Dristanto
Aru sabi, ekjon Yehudi laga niyom jana manu Jisu ke porikha kori bole nimite khara Luke 10:26 lviii Luke 10:34 hoise aru, koise, “Probhu moi anonto jibon pabole nimite ki kori bole lage?”
Titia Jisu he taike koise, “Niom hisab te ki likha ase? Tumi etu kineka porhe?”

Titia tai koise, “Tumi Probhu Isor ke pura mon pora morom koribi, aru tumi laga jibon pora, aru takot pora, aru tumi laga bhabona pora, aru tumi usorte thaka manu ke tumi nijorke kineka morom kore etu nisena morom koribi†.
Titia Jisu taike koise, “Tumi thik kotha koise. Eneka koribi, aru tumi jinda thakibo‡.”
Kintu tai nijorke thik dikha bole nimite, Jisu ke koise, “Moi laga usorte thaka manu to kun ase?”

Titia Jisu taike jowab dikene koise, “Ekjon manu Jerusalem pora Jericho phale jai thakise. Taike chor aru dokait khan pora dhuri kene marise aru tai laga kapra phatai khan phatai dise aru taike adha mora chari kene polai jaise.
Titia achanak pora ekjon purohit etu rasta pora jai thakise, aru jitia tai etu manu ke dikhise, tai dusra phale jai jaise.
Etu nisena, ekjon Levi, jitia tai etu jagate ahikena manu ke dikhise, tai bhi dusra phale jai jaise.
Kintu ekjon Samaria laga manu, tai safar kori thaka homoi te, etu manu usorte ahise aru jitia taike dikhise, tai bisi mon dukh hoise aru morom lagi jaise.

Aru jitia etu manu usorte punchise, tai laga † 10:27 Mat. 22:37-40; Deu. 6:5; 10:12; John 22:5 ‡ 10:28 Lev. 18:5 Luke 10:35 lix Luke 10:40 gaw te jokhom khan tel aru angur ros pora sapha kori kene bandi dise. Aru etu pichete, tai laga janwar uporte uthai dise, aru ekta ghor te loi jaise, aru taike bhal pora sai dise.
Aru dusra dinte tai duita denari§ ulaikene ta te thaka manu khan ke dise aru koise, “Taike bhal pora sabi, aru ki khorcha korile bhi, jitia moi aru wapas ahibo, etu homoi te moi sob di dibo.’
Tumi ki bhabe, taikhan tinjon bhitor te kun he tai laga asol usor thaka manu ase junke dokait aru chor khan pora mari kene chari dise?”
Titia tai koise, “Taike morom kora jon pora.” Titia Jisu taike koise, “Jabi aru tumi bhi eneka he koribi.” Martha Aru Mary
Aru taikhan jai thaka homoi te, Tai ekta bosti te ghusi se, aru ta te Martha koi kene ekjon mahila thakise, tai pora Jisu ke tai laga ghor te matise.
Tai laga ekjon bhoini Mary koi kene thakise, aru tai Jisu laga theng usorte bohi kene Tai ki kotha koi ase etu huni thakise.

Kintu Martha olop biya lagise kelemane tai sob kaam to ekla kori thakise, etu karone tai jai kene koise, “Probhu, Apuni eku chinta nakore naki moi laga bhoini moike kaam kori bole ekla chari dise? Etu nimite moike modot kori bole nimite taike kobi.” § 10:35 Ek denarius to ek din laga hajira asele. Luke 10:41 lx Luke 11:6
Titia Probhu pora Martha ke jowab dise, “Martha, Martha, tumi bisi alag kaam nimite chinta kori ase,
kintu khali ekta kaam he bisi dorkar ase. Aru Mary pora etu bhal kaam bisari loise, aru etu tai logot pora kitia bhi loi najabo.” 11 Probhu Laga Prathana
Aru ek din eneka hoise, Jisu ekta jagate prathana kori thakise, jitia khotom hoise, ekjon chela Taike hudise, “Probhu, amikhan ke prathana sikhai dibi jineka John tai laga chela khan ke sikhaise.”
Tai chela khan ke koise, “Jitia tumikhan prathana koribo eneka kobi, ‘Sorgote thaka amikhan laga Baba, Apuni laga naam honmanio hobole dibi, Apuni laga rajyo ahibole dibi.
Hodai laga kha luwa amikhan ke dibi.
Amikhan laga paap pora amikhan ke maph kori dibi, Amikhan bhi dusra laga paap maph diya nisena Jun khan amikhan ke baki ase. Amikhan ke porikha te giribole nadibi.’ ”
Aru Tai taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan logote kun sathi ase, aru tai logote rati te jai kene koi, “Sathi, moike tinta roti dhaar dibi,
kele koile moi laga ekjon sathi dusra jaga pora berai kene etiya ahise, moi taike dibole eku nai’? Luke 11:7 lxi Luke 11:15
Titia tai bhitor pora amike eneka kobo pare, ‘Moike etiya digdar nokoribi. Dorja to bondh hoise, aru moi aru bacha khan etiya ghumai ase. Moi etiya uthi kene tumike eku dibo na paribo.’
Moi tumike koi ase, jodi bhi tai uthi kene tai laga sathi ke dibole mon nai, hoilebi tai mangi thaka karone, tai ji hoilebi uthi kene taike jiman lage etu di dibo.
Moi aru bhi tumike koi ase, mangibi, aru tumi pabo; bisaribi, aru tumi pai jabo, dorjate khat-khata bhi, etu khuli jabo.
Jun manu mange tai pai; jun manu bisare tai pai; aru jun manu khatai, taike khuli diye.
Tumikhan majote kun baba eneka ase naki, jodi tai laga bacha pora maas mangile, taike saph dibo?
Aru jodi anda mangile, taike bhichoo dibo naki?
Etu karone, tumikhan biya manu hoilebi nijor bacha ke bhal saman he dibole jane, tenehoile sorgote thaka Baba Isor ke kun manu pora mange, taike Pobitro Atma nadibo naki?” Jisu Aru Beelzebul
Ek din, Jisu ekta gunga kori diya bhoot ke khedai thakise. Aru jitia bhoot to ulai jaise, etu manu kotha kobo parise, aru ta te thaka manu khan asurit hoise.
Kintu kunba manu khan koise, “Tai bhoot ke Beelzebul laga naam pora khedai ase jun he bhoot khan laga raja ase.” Luke 11:16 lxii Luke 11:24
Aru dusra manu khan, Jisu ke porikha kori kene koise, sorgo pora ekta asurit kaam dikha bole koise.
Kintu, taikhan laga bhabona jani kene Jisu pora koise, “Juntu rajyo alag-alag bhabona hoi kene ase, etu bhangi jabo, aru ekta ghor alag-alag bhabona hoile, etu ghor bhangi jabo.
Aru jodi Saitan bhi alag-alag hoijai, eneka hoile tai laga rajyo kineka khara hobo? Tumikhan koi ase Moi Beelzebul laga takot pora bhoot khan ke khedai.
Jodi Moi bhoot khan ke Beelzebul takot pora khedai ase koile, titia hoile tumikhan laga chela khan kun laga atma pora bhoot khan ke khedai? Etu karone, eitu khan he tumikhan ke bisar koribo.
Jodi Moi bhoot khan ke Isor laga anguli pora khedai, titia hoile Isor laga rajyo to tumikhan usorte ahise.
Jitia ekta takot thaka manu pora hathiar loi kene ghor to rukhi thake, tai laga ki ase etu naharai.
Kintu tai pora bhi bisi takot thaka manu taike hamla korile, taike harai dibo, tai laga hathiar bhi loi lobo, jun uporte tai bharosa kore, aru ji dhun sompoti tai laga ase, sob bhag hoi jabo.
Kun manu Moi logote nathake, Moi laga bhirodh te ase, aru kun manu Moi logote nathake, tai alag hoijai. Dusto Atma
Jitia ekta dusto atma ekjon manu pora ulai jai, tai sukha jagate aram pabole karone berai Luke 11:25 lxiii Luke 11:32 thake, aru koi, ‘Moi poila kot pora ulaise ta te aru bhi wapas jai jabo.’
Aru jitia tai ahe, tai sob sapha aru bhal kore kene rakhi thaka dikhe.
Tai jai kene tai pora bhi aru bisi biya sat-ta dusto atma loi kene etu manu bhitor te ghusi jai. Aru poila pora bhi etu manu laga jibon to bisi biya hoijai.” Hosa Laga Asis
Etiya eneka hoise, jitia Tai etu kotha koi thakise, ekjon mahila awaj uthaikene manu khan usorte Jisu ke koise, “Dhonyo ase etu ama jun Apuni ke jonom dise aru dudh khilai se.”
Kintu Tai koise, “Hoilebi, asishit hobo jun manu Isor kotha huni kene mani thake.”

Manu laga bhir jitia bisi hoise, Tai kobole shuru hoise, “Etu manu khan paap laga khandan ase. Taikhan kiba ekta sabole bisari thake, kintu, asurit kaam to taikhan ke nadikhabo, khali Jonah laga chihna he nohoile.
Jineka Jonah to Nineveh sheher laga manu khan nimite ekta chihna hoise, etu nisena Manu laga Putro bhi manu khan nimite eneka hobo.

Dakshin laga Rani bisar dinte uthi kene etiya laga manu khan ke bisar koribo, kele tai duniya laga kona pora Solomon raja laga gyaan kotha huni bole ahisele aru sabi Solomon pora bhi mohan ekjon yate ase*.

Nineveh sheher laga manu khan uthaikene etiya laga manu khan ke bisar koribo, kelemane taikhan mon ghuraise Jonah prochar kora * 11:31 I Kin. 10:1-10; 2 Chr .9:1. Luke 11:33 lxiv Luke 11:39 homoi te aru sabi, Jonah† pora bhi mohan ekjon yate ase. Tumi Laga Puhor
Kun bhi saaki to jolai kene lukai narakhe kintu saaki rakha jagate rakhe, aru kun manu ghor bhitor te ahe, puhor to dikhi pai.
Tumi suku to gaw laga diya ase. Jitia tumi laga suku bhal thake, tumi laga pura gaw to pohor pora bhorta hoi. Kintu jitia biya hoi jaise, tumi laga gaw bhi pura andhar hoijai.
Etu karone, bisi hoshiar hoi jabi etu pora tumi laga jibon to andhar nohobo nimite.

Jodi tumi laga gaw to ujala pora bhorta hoijai, aru kun jagate bhi andhar nai, titia etu puhor pora bhorta hoi jabo, jineka tumi uporte puhor to bhorta hoi thakibo.” Pharisee khan Aru Purohitkhan Karone Hai Kotha
Jitia Tai kotha kora khotom hoise ekjon Pharisee pora Taike khana khabole matise. Aru Jisu tai logote khabole bohise.
Aru Pharisee khan etu dikhi kene asurit hoise, kelemane Jisu to bhaat kha age te, Tai laga hath Yehudi niyom hisab de thaka nisina dhula nai.
Kintu Probhu taike koise, “Tumi Pharisee khan kup aru borton laga bahar to sapha kore, kintu tumikhan mon bhitor te biya aru lalchi pora bhorta thake. † 11:32 Jon. 3:5-10. Luke 11:40 lxv Luke 11:48
Murkho manu khan! Jun he tumi laga bahar to bonaise, tai he tumi laga bhitor bhi bonaise nohoi?
Kintu tumi bhitor laga morom to dikhai dibi, aru sabi, tumi laga jibon te sob to sapha hoi jabo.

Kintu Pharisee khan, tumikhan ke hai ase. Tumikhan kheti laga sobji aru bagan te thaka pata khan loi kene dos bhag diye, kintu Isor laga morom to namane. Kintu etu kori bole dorkar ase, aru dusra bhal kaam bhi nacharibo lage‡.
Pharisee khan, tumikhan ke hai ase. Tumikhan mondoli te sobse bhal jagate bohi bole mon kore aru bajar te manu bhoi pora salam diya to khushi pai.
Tumikhan ke hai ase, tumikhan nadikha laga kobor nisena ase, etu uporte manu khan najanikena berai thake.”
Titia ekjon niyom jana manu Jisu ke koise, “Probhu, etu koi kene, Apuni amikhan ke sorom khilai ase.”

Titia Jisu jowab dise, “Hai tumikhan, niyom laga hikhok khan! Tumikhan manu khan ke bhari bhar bukhi bole diye juntu taikhan bukhi bole napare, kintu tumikhan laga anguli pora nijor bhi etu bhar to bukhi bole mon nai.
Tumikhan ke hai ase, bhabobadi khan laga kobor to bonaise, hoilebi tumikhan baba laga baba khan pora he taikhan ke moraise.

Hosa koile, tumikhan baba laga baba khan pora ki korise etu laga tumikhan sakhi ase, ‡ 11:42 Mat. 23:23; Mic. 6:8; Lev. 27:30 Luke 11:49 lxvi Luke 12:1 taikhan pora morai dise aru tumikhan kobor khan bonaise.
Etu karone Isor laga gyaan pora sob koi dise, ‘Moi taikhan logot bhabobadi khan aru apostle khan ke pathabo, aru taikhan pora Moi patha khan ke dukh dibo aru kunba ke morai dibo.’
Etu karone, duniya shuru pora jiman bhabobadi khan laga khun giraise, sob laga bisar etiya laga jamana khan logote koribo.
Abel laga khun pora shuru kori kene Zechariah laga khun tak, junke pobitro jagate moraise. Hoi, Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, etu sob hisab to etiya laga jamana pora dibo lagibo§.

Kanun hikhok khan ke hai ase. Tumikhan Isor ke janibole gyaan laga chabi to loi kene rakhise; tumikhan nijor bhi etu bhitor te najai aru kun manu jabole mon kore, tumikhan pora taikhan ke bhi jabo nadiye.”
Jitia Jisu ta te pora ulai jaise, niyom likha khan aru Pharisee khan etu sob kotha to huni kene khong uthise aru Tai logote jhagara korise,
taikhan rukhi thakise, Jisu kiba ekta golti kotha koile, Taike phasabo koi kene. 12 Pharisee Khan Laga Khomir Nimite Hoshiar

Eneka homoi te, hajar-hajar manu eke logote joma hoise, eneka somoite hazar manu joma huwa karone manu khan ekjon-ekjon uporte girise, Tai chela khan ke poila koise, § 11:51 Gen. 4:8; 2 Chr .24:20-22. Luke 12:2 lxvii Luke 12:9 “Pharisee khan laga chalaki pora hoshiar hobi, kelemane taikhan chalak ase.
Eku kotha lukai rakhibole na paribo, kintu bhitor te thaka kotha to sob ulai jabo.
Etu karone ki kotha andhar te koise, ujala te sob hunibo aru tumi ghor bhitor te ki kotha khan ki koise etu kotha ghor uporte awaj uthaikene kobo. Bhoi Na koribi
Moi tumikhan ke koi ase moi laga sathi khan, bhoi nakori bhi jun manu tumi laga gaw to morai dibo, aru etu pichete taikhan eku koribo na paribo.

Kintu Moi tumikhan ke koi dibo Isor ke tumikhan bhoi kori bole lage. Morai diya pichete, norokte phela bole jun laga takot ase, taike bhoi koribi. Hosa Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, Isor ke he bhoi koribi.
Aru pansta ghor laga chiriya khan ke dui poisa pora bikiri nakore naki? Hoilebi eitu khan ke bhi Isor napahore.
Tumikhan matha laga chuli bhi ekta-ekta pora ginti kori kene ase. Bhoi nokoribi. Tumikhan to ghor te thaka chiriya pora bhi bisi daam laga ase. Manu Khan Age te Khrista Ke Shikar Kora
Moi aru bhi tumikhan ke kobo, jun manu Moike manu khan usorte paap shikar kore, Manu laga Putro bhi sorgodoth usorte taikhan ke shikar koribo,
kintu jun pora manu khan usorte Moike namatibo, Moi bhi sorgodoth usorte taike namatibo. Luke 12:10 lxviii Luke 12:18
Jun manu Moi laga bodnam koribo tai maph pabo, kintu kun manu Pobitro Atma ke bodnam koribo tai kitia bhi maph napabo.
Etu karone jitia taikhan tumikhan ke mondoli khan te, aru cholawta khan aru adhikari khan usorte loijabo, titia tumikhan laga safai te ki kobo lage etu karone chinta nokoribi,
tumikhan ki kobo lage Pobitro Atma pora etu homoi te sob sikhai dibo.” Murkho Dhuni Ekjon Laga Dristanto
Titia kunba ekjon manu majot pora Jisu ke koise, “Probhu, moi laga bhai ke kobi tai laga dhun sompoti bhag kori kene moike dibole.”
Kintu Jisu taike koise, “Manu, tumikhan uporte bhag aru bisar kori bole Moi kun koise?*”
Tai manu khan ke koise, “Lalchi aru biya itcha pora nijorke bachai kene rakhibi, sob thakile bhi manu laga jibon dhun sompoti bisi thaka para nohoi.”
Jisu taikhan ke ekta dristanto koise, “Ekjon dhuni manu laga mati ke bhal kheti ulaise,
etu manu monte bhabikena korise, moi ki koribo, kheti bisi bhal hoise aru rakhibole jaga nai?’
Kintu tai koise, ‘Moi eneka koribo: dhaan ghor to bhangai kene dangor ghor bonabo aru ta te moi laga dhaan aru sob bhal saman rakhibo. * 12:14 Exo. 2:14. Luke 12:19 lxix Luke 12:27
Aru moi laga mon ke kobo, “Oh mon, bisi saal nimite kha luwa joma kori kene rakhise. Kha luwa kori kene, khushi koribi.’ ”
Kintu Isor he taike koise, ‘Murkho manu, aji rati tumi laga atma uthai lobo, aru ki dhun sompoti tumi joma kori kene rakhise, etu kun laga hobo?’
Eneka he hobo utu manu logote jun nijor nimite dhun sompoti joma kore, kintu Isor phale dhuni nohoi.” Eku Chinta Na koribi
Titia Jisu tai laga chela khan ke koise, “Etu nimite Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, nijor laga jibon nimite chinta nokoribi, ki khabo aru ki pindhibo, nijor gaw nimite chinta nokoribi.
Kelemane jibon to kha luwa pora bhi dangor ase, aru tumi laga kapra pora bhi dangor to tumi laga gaw ase.

Sabi akas te uri thaka chiriya khan ke, taikhan kheti bhi nakate. Aru taikhan laga dhaan rakhibole jaga bhi nai, kintu Isor he taikhan ke khabole diye. Tinehoile tumikhan chiriya pora bhi daam laga ase†.
Kintu tumikhan majot te kun he chinta kori kene jibon to lamba kori bole paribo?
Aru jodi tumikhan etu chutu kaam bhi kori bole napare koile, tenehoile dusra kaam nimite kele chinta kori ase?

Sabi kheti te lili phul to kineka dangor hoi. Taikhan kheti bhi nakore aru joma bhi nakore. Hoilebi Moi tumike koi ase, Solomon ekta † 12:24 Psa. 147:9. Luke 12:28 lxx Luke 12:36 dangor raja hoilebi lili phul nisena sundur hobo para nai.

Kintu kheti laga ghas khan juntu aji ase aru kali to chulah te phelai dibo, hoilebi sabi, Isor pora eitu khan sundur pora bonaise, O biswas natakha manu khan, eitu khan pora bhi tumikhan ke sundur nabonabo naki!
Aru tumikhan ki kha luwa koribo etu nimite chinta nokoribi.
Etu prithibi manu kunkhan Isor najane, taikhan he eitu khan pichete berai thake, kintu etu tumi nimite dorkar ase koi kene Baba Isor he sob jane.
Poila Isor laga rajyo bisaribi, titia sob tumikhan ke hali dibo.
Komti manu khan, bhoi nokoribi, kelemane Baba pora tumikhan ke rajyo dibole khushi ase.
Tumikhan logote ki ase sob bikiri kori kene gorib khan ke de dibi. Jun jagate chor nahibo aru puka pora nakhabo, sorgote tumi laga dhun sompoti joma kora to kitia bhi naharabo.
Kilekoile jun jagate tumi laga dhun sompoti thake, etu jagate mon to hodai thake. Tumi Taiyar Thakibi
Tumi laga komor to bandhi lobi, aru saaki to jolai rakhibi‡,

aru eneka manu khan nisena hobi jun khan malik ke shadi pora wapas ahibole rukhi thake, aru jitia tai ahi kene dorwaja te mare, taikhan phot kori dorwaja to khuli bole pare. ‡ 12:35 Exo. 12:11; 2 Kin. 4:29; Eph. 6:14; Mat. 5:16. Luke 12:37 lxxi Luke 12:46

Asirbad ase etu noukar khan jun malik aha homoi te rukhi kene thake. Hosa pora moi tumikhan ke koi ase, Tai laga pet te kapra bandi kene taikhan ke khabole jagate bohai dibo, aru Tai ahikena nijor pora taikhan ke kha luwa khabole dibo.
Aru malik adha rati te, nohoile bisi phojurte ahile bhi, tai noukar khan pora rukhi thaka dikhile, etu noukar to asirbad ase.
Kintu etu jani lobi, jodi malik to tai laga ghor te chor kitia ahibo etu jani loi, titia tai kitia bhi ghor te chor hobole nadibo.
Tumikhan bhi taiyar kori thakibi, kelemane Manu laga Putro ki homoi te ahibo tumi kobo napare.”
Titia Peter koise, “Probhu, Apuni etu dristanto moi khan ke koi ase na, sobke bhi koi ase?”
Probhu koise, “Tinehoile kun taikhan majote gyaani imandar noukar ase junke malik pora basi lobo tai laga dusra nokorkhan ke sabole, taikhan laga kha luwa thik homoi te dibole?
Asirbad ase etu noukar jitia tai laga malik ahikena taike kaam kora dikhe.
Moi hosa koi ase tai etu noukar ke tai laga sob dhun sompoti to sabole di dibo.
Kintu jodi noukar tai laga monte bhabe, ‘Moi laga malik to ahibole bisi homoi loi ase,’ aru noukar khan ke mari bole shuru hoi, aru kha luwa kori kene, aru nisa te giri thake,

aru titia tai laga malik achanak pora ahijai, jun to homoi te tai bhabona kori thaka nai, titia Luke 12:47 lxxii Luke 12:53 malik pora taike kati phelai dibo aru tai laga bodli dusra bhal ke kaam to di dibo.
Aru jun noukar tai malik laga itcha to jane, kintu malik laga itcha nisena eku kori kene nathake, titia hoile taike marikena bisi dukh dibo.

Kintu jun manu eku najane, hoilebi mar kha laga kaam to kori thakise taikhan olop he mari khabo. Kintu jun manu ke bisi dikena ase, taikhan logote pora bisi pabo lage, aru jun manu ke kaam bisi dikena ase, tai logote pora etu sob kaam laga hisab mangibo. Shanti Nohoi Kintu Bhag Hobo
Moi etu duniya te jui phela bole ahise, aru Moi etu he itcha ase etu shuru hoijai kene thakibo nimite.
Moi baptizma pora baptizma kori bole ase§, aru Moi chinta te ase jitia tak etu pura nohoi!
Tumikhan bhabise naki Moi etu prithibi te shanti dibole ahise? Nohoi, Moi hosa koi ase, kintu sob bhag hoi jabo.
Etiya pora ghor te pans jon bhi bhag hoi jabo- tinjon bhitor te te duijon aru duijon bhitor te tinjon dushman hoi jabo.

Taikhan alag hoi jabo, baba pora bacha khan ke chari bo, aru bacha khan bhi baba ke chari bo; ama pora chukri ke chari bo aru chukri bhi ama laga dushman hobo, saas pora buari ke chari bo aru, buari bhi saas ke chari bo*.” § 12:50 Jisu dukh kori bole aru bukhibole laga baptisma. * 12:53 Mic. 7:6. Luke 12:54 lxxiii Luke 13:2 Homoi Anubad Kora
Etiya Jisu manu khan ke koise, “Tumikhan jitia paschim phale badal utha dikhe, ‘Borkhon ahise, aru etu ahijai.
Aru jitia dakshin laga hawa mare, tumikhan koi, ‘Bisi gorom ahibo, aru etu hoijai.
O Dhungi khan! Akas prithibi te ki dikhe etu kobole jane, kintu kele tumikhan aha dinte ki hobole ase etu kobo napare? Dushman Logot Faisla Kora
Aru tumikhan nijor bhi hosa to ki ase etu bisar nakore?

Tumi dushman logote bisar kori bole ja homoi te, rasta te he etu jhagara to faisla kori bole itcha koribi, nohoile tumike tanikena bisar ghor te loijabo, tumike daruga hathte di dibo, aru daruga pora tumike bondhi ghor te hali dibo.
Moi tumike koi ase, tumi poisa laga sob hisab kitab pura nakora tak tumi etu koidi ghor pora ulabole na paribo.” 13 Mon Ghura bhi Nahoile Harai Jabo
Titia kunba manu khan etu homoi te Jisu ke eneka khobor dise ki Pilate pora bolidan kora homoi te tai Galilee manu khan ke morai dikena taikhan laga khun bhi milai dise.
Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan bhabise naki etu Galilee manu khan dusra Galilee manu khan pora bhi bisi paapi khan ase kelemane taikhan eneka dukh paise? Luke 13:3 lxxiv Luke 13:11
Nohoi, Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo. Jodi tumikhan mon naghurai, tumikhan bhi eneka he khotom hoi jabo.
Aru atharo jon manu kunkhan uporte Siloam laga minar giri kene mari dise, tumikhan bhabise naki Jerusalem te thaka manu khan pora bhi taikhan he bisi paapi thakise?
Nohoi, Moi tumikhan ke koi ase. Jodi tumikhan mon naghuraile, taikhan nisena khotom hoi jabo.” Phol Nadhora Dimoru Gash Laga Dristanto
Titia Jisu ekta dristanto koise, “Ekjon manu tai laga bagan te dimoru ghas rupaisile, aru tai etu ghas te phol bisarikena jaise, kintu eku pa-a nai*.
Titia tai bagan sa-a manu ke koise, ‘Sabi, tin saal moi etu ghas te phol bisari kene ahise, kintu eku pa-a nai. Etu ke kati dibi. Etu mati to kele nuksan koribo?’
Titia noukar pora malik ke eneka jowab dise, ‘Probhu, etu saal nimite chari dibi, moi aru ekbar bhal pora etu ghas to mol dikene sabo.
Jodi etu ghas pora etu somoi nisena te phol diye, to bhal ase, kintu jodi etu pora bhal phol diya nai koile, apuni etu ghas to kati dibi!’ ” Mahila Ekjon ke Komjur Atma Thaka
Aru ek Bisram dinte Jisu mondoli khan te hikai thakise,

Aru ta te ekjon mahila atharo saal pora komjur laga atma thakise, tai laga komor to tera * 13:6 Mat. 21:18-20; Mark 11:12-14 Luke 13:12 lxxv Luke 13:19 thakise aru ekdom sidha koribo napari kene thakise.
Aru jitia Jisu taike dikhise, Tai usorte mati kene koise, “Mahila, tumi laga komjur pora tumi mukti paise.”
Titia Jisu tai laga hath etu mahila uporte rakhise, aru etu homoi te tai sida hoi jaise aru tai Isor ke dhanyavad dise.

Kintu mondoli te thaka cholawta khan bhal pa-a nai aru Jisu pora Bisram dinte changai kaam kora nimite manu khan ke koise, “Choi din tak kaam kori bole dorkar ase. Etu homoi te he bhal hobole ahibi, kintu Bisram dinte nahibi†.”
Kintu Probhu taikhan ke koise, “Dhongi khan! Tumikhan Bisram dinte tumikhan laga guru, saguli khan ke tai laga ghor pora ulaikene pani khabole loi najai naki?
Etu mahila, Abraham laga khandan pora ahise, junke Saitan para atharo saal tak bandhi kene rakhise, tenehoile taike Bisram dinte khuli nadibo lage naki?”

Jitia Tai etu kotha kori kene khotom hoise, jun Jisu ke ghusa kori thakise taikhan sorom lagi jaise, kintu sob manu khan khushi kori kene dhanyavad di thakise juntu kaam Tai kori kene dikhai diya karone. Sorso Bijon Aru Khomir
Titia Jisu koise, “Isor laga rajyo to kineka ase, aru Moi etu ke ki logote tulona koribo?

Etu ekta sorso dana nisena ase jineka ekjon manu pora loi kene tai laga kheti te phelaise, † 13:14 Exo. 20:9-10; Deu. 5:13-14. Luke 13:20 lxxvi Luke 13:28 aru etu dangor ghas hoi jaise, aru ta te chiriya khan bhi ahikena ghor bonaise‡.”
Aru Tai koise, “Isor laga rajyo to ki logote tulona koribo?
Ekjon mahila pora tin kilo atta te khomir hali dise, jitia tak etu phuli najai.” Huru Dhorjo
Aru Jisu nogor aru bosti khan te jai kene hikai thakise aru Jerusalem te jabo nimite taiyar kori thakise.
Etiya ekjon pora Taike hudise, “Probhu, jun poritran pai ase taikhan olop jon he ase naki?” Titia Tai taikhan ke koise,
