“Etu chutu rasta te jabole nimite dukh koribi, kelemane Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, bisi manu etu te ghusi bole kosis koribo, kintu ghusi bole na paribo.

Jitia ghor laga malik pora dorwaja to bondh kori dibo, titia tumi dorja to marikena kobo, ‘Probhu, moi khan nimite khuli bhi.’ Kintu tai tumikhan ke kobo, ‘Moi tumikhan ke najane, aru tumikhan kot pora ase.’
Titia tumi he kobo, ‘Amikhan Apuni logote bohi kene eke logote khai sele, aru Apuni amikhan laga jagate ahikena sikhai dise.’
Titia Tai kobo, ‘Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, Moi tumikhan kot pora ahise najane. Moi usor pora dur hoi jabi sob biya kaam kora khan!§’

Etu jagate, kanda he thakibo, aru dath chababo aru jitia Abraham, Isaac aru Jacob aru sob bhabobadi khan ke Isor laga rajyo to ‡ 13:19 Palestine te sorso to dangor ghas hoi. § 13:27 Psa. 6:8 Luke 13:29 lxxvii Luke 13:35 dikhibo, kintu etu pora tumikhan ke bahar te phelai dibo.
Taikhan purab, paschim, uttor aru dakshin pora ahikena Isor laga rajyote bohibo*.
Aru sabi, kun manu pichete thakise taikhan age te ase, aru kunba jun age te ase, taikhan pichete hoi jabo.” Jerusalem Karone Mon Dukh Hoi Kanda
Etu homoi te, kunba Pharisee khan Tai usorte ahikena koise, “Amikhan ke chari bhi aru yate pora jai jabi, kelemane Herod tumike morai dibole bisari ase.”
Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Jai kene utu siyal Herod ke kobi, ‘Sabi, Moi bhoot khan ke khedai dise aru bemar khan ke aji aru kali bhal korise, aru tin din pichete Moi laga lakshya punchi jabo.’
Jineka hoile bhi Moi kaam kori thakibo, aji, kali aru aha dinte bhi, kele koile Jerusalem te bhabobadi khan harai ja-a to bhal nai.

Oh Jerusalem, Jerusalem, kun he bhabobadi khan ke morai diye aru tumikhan usorte ahile pathor pora mari kene pathai diye. Moi kiman itcha korise tumikhan laga bacha khan ke eke logote rakhibole nimite jineka ekta murgi tai laga bacha khan ke pakhi nichete rakhe. Kintu tumikhan etu itcha nakore.

Sabi, tumikhan laga ghor to khali hoi jaise. Kile Moi kobo, tumikhan Moike aru nadikhibo etu homoi naha tak, jitia tumikhan kobo, * 13:29 Isa. 66:18; Rev. 7:9; Psa. 107:3; Mal. 1:11 Luke 14:1 lxxviii Luke 14:8 ‘Asirbad pabo jun Probhu laga naam te ahise.†’ ” 14 Bisram Dinte Ekjon Ke Changai Kora
Aru eneka hoise, Jisu ekjon Pharisee khan laga ghor te Bisram dinte bhaat khabole jaise, aru Jisu ki kori ase etu sob bhal pora taikhan sai thakise.
Aru ta te ekjon manu thakise jun gaw phula bemar pora dukh pai thakise.
Titia Jisu Pharisee khan aru Yehudi niyom jana manu khan ke hudi kene koise, “Bisram dinte changai kori bole pare na nai?”
Kintu taikhan eku kowa nai, titia Jisu taike dhorise aru changai kori dise, aru taike pathai dise.
Titia Tai pora taikhan ke hudise, “Tumikhan majote kunba tai laga bacha nahoile bhi tai laga janwar Bisram dinte panite giri le jai kene phot uthai nolobo naki?”
Taikhan etu kotha te eku jowab dibo para nai. Shadi Bhojan Laga Dristanto
Titia Tai arubi taikhan ke ekta dristanto koise, jun khan ke khabole mati sele, taikhan kineka kori kene bhal jagate bohi bole pabo, etu kosis kori thakise.

Jitia tumikhan ke shadi te khabole mate, tumikhan bhal jagate nabohibi, kele koile tumikhan pora bhi kunba bisi sonman thaka manu ke mati kene thakibo pare, † 13:35 Psa. 118:26; Jer .12:7 Luke 14:9 lxxix Luke 14:16
aru jitia tumi aru dusra manu junke khana te matise, tai tumikhan ke kobo, ‘Tumi laga jaga to taike dibi,’ aru titia sorom pora taike etu jaga to dikene tumi chutu jagate he bohi jai.

Jitia, tumike mate, jabi aru sobse chutu jagate he bohibi, jitia jun pora tumike matise tai ahibo, tai tumike kobo, ‘Sathi, uporte ahibi.’ Titia tumi laga sonman to dusra manu bohi thaka usorte bisi hoijai.
Jun manu nijorke dangor kori bole bisare tai chutu hoi jabo, aru jun manu tai nijorke chutu kore taike uthai dibo.”

Titia tai etu manu ke kobo jun he taike matise, “Jitia tumi kha luwa koribo, tumi laga bhal sathi khan, bhai khan aru dhuni manu ke namatibi, nohoile taikhan bhi tumike matibo, aru tumi taikhan nimite ki korise etu he apuni pabo.
Kintu jitia tumi kha luwa kore, gorib khan, bera bole napara, andha aru bemar manu khan ke mati bhi,
aru tumikhan asirbad pabo, kelemane taikhan tumike ghurai kene eku dibole na paribo. Kintu tumikhan ke Jisu Khrista wapas lobole aha homoi te biswasi khan logote sob kaam laga inam dibo.”
Jitia jun ekjon mez te bohi thakise aru eitu khan huni thakise, tai Jisu ke koise, “Dhonyo ase jun Isor laga rajyote roti khabo!”
Titia Jisu pora taikhan ke ekta dristanto koise, “Ekjon manu dangor kha luwa bonai kene manu khan ke matise. Luke 14:17 lxxx Luke 14:24
Aru jitia khabole homoi ahise, tai laga noukar khan ke pathai kene jun manu khan ke matise taikhan ke koise, ‘Ahibi, sob to taiyar hoi jaise.’
Kintu mata khan sob nijor bahana kori bole shuru hoise. Poila ekjon pora koise, ‘Moi ekta kheti kinise, aru moi ta te jai kene sabo lagibo. Morom pora biya napabi.’
Aru ekjon pora koise, moi pansta guru kinise, moi taikhan ke kheti te loijai kene ekbar sabo. Morom pora biya napabi.’
Aru dusra ekjon pora koise, ‘Moi ekjon maiki logote shadi korise, aru etu nimite moi ahibole na paribo.’

Titia noukar khan sob kotha to tai laga malik ke ahikena koise. Ghor laga malik khong uthi kene, noukar khan ke koise, ‘Bahar te joldi jabi aru bosti rasta pora gorib manu, bera bole napara, suku andha aru bemar manu ke loi anibi.’
Sewak pora etu kaam kori kene tai koise, ‘Probhu Apuni ki koise eneka kori dise, aru bhi alohi manu bisi karone jaga ase.’
Titia malik tai laga noukar khan ke koise, ‘Bahar te jabi aru rasta kinar aru jun jaga pora hoile taikhan ke mati kene loi anibi, Moi laga ghor to bhorta hobo lage.
Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, jun manu khan ke Moi poila mati sele taikhan Moi ki kha luwa bonaise etu khabole napabo.’ ” Chela Hobole Daam Ase Luke 14:25 lxxxi Luke 14:33
Aru bisi manu khan Jisu laga pichete jai thakise, aru Tai ghuri kene taikhan ke koise,
“Jun manu Moi logote ahibole itcha ase kintu tai nijor laga baba, ama, maiki, bacha, bhai, bhoini aru nijor jibon to ghin nakore, tai Moi laga chela hobole na paribo*.
Jun manu tai nijor laga Cross uthaikene Moi pichete nahe tai Moi laga chela hobole na paribo.
Jun manu ekta ghor bona bole itcha kore, poila tai bohi kene, tai logote thaka poisa pora ghor bona khotom koribo paribona nai koi kene ginti nakore naki?
Jitia, tai ghor laga bhetimul to uthai dibo, aru ghor to khotom kori bole naparile, sob manu saikene taike hasi dibo,
aru kobo, etu manu ghor to bona bole shuru korise kintu khotom kori bole para nai.’
Aru ekjon raja, dusra raja logote lorai kori bole ase, tai poila bohi kene nasabo naki, tai laga dos hajar manu pora dusra raja laga bis hajar logote lorai koribo paribona nai?
Kintu, tai dur te thaka homoi te, ekjon manu ke shanti pora kotha kori kene lorai to rukhai dibo.
Etu nisena, jun manu tai laga sob dhun sompoti chari kene nahile, tai Moi laga chela hobole na paribo. Swadh Nathaka Nimok * 14:26 Mat. 10:37; John12:25; Deu. 33:9 Luke 14:34 lxxxii Luke 15:7
Etu nimite nimok to bhal ase, kintu nimok laga swadh harai dile kineka etu ke aru swadisht bonabo?
Etu ke mati nimite bhi aru kheti te mol bona bole bhi kaam nathake. Taikhan etu ke phelai dibo. Jun manu logote huni bole kan ase, taikhan huni bhi.” 15 Harai Juwa Mer Laga Dristanto
Aru ek din poisa utha manu khan aru dusra paapi manu khan Jisu laga kotha huni bole nimite ahise.
Kintu Pharisee khan aru niyom likha khan ekjon-ekjon logote koi thakise, “Etu manu paapi khan ke mate, aru taikhan logote bohi kene khai.”
Titia Jisu he etu dristanto taikhan ke koise,
“Yate kun ase, jun logote eksoh mer ase kintu tai ekta haraise koile, tai ninyanve ke jongol te chari kene jun to haraise etu ke bisari bole najabo?*
Aru jitia tai etu mer to pai jai, tai laga pithite uthaikene khushi pora loi ane.
Jitia tai ghor te ahijai, tai sobke mate, tai laga sathi aru usorte thaka manu khan ke koi, ‘Moi logot khushi koribi, moi laga harai ja-a mer paise.’

Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, sorgote bhi eneka khushi koribo jitia ekjon paapi manu mon ghurai kene ahibo, etu ninyanve thaka pora bhi * 15:4 Eze, 34:11-12,16 Luke 15:8 lxxxiii Luke 15:15 bisi khushi hobo, kele koile taikhan to mon ghura bole eku nai. Harai Juwa Poisa Laga Dristanto
Aru kun mahila, jun logote dosta chandi poisa thakise, jodi ekta harai diye, titia tai saaki jolai kene ghor jharu marikena sob sapha kori bisaribo nohoi jitia tak etu poisa napai?
Aru jitia tai pai loi, tai laga sathi aru ghor usorte thaka manu khan ke matikena, koi ‘Moi logote khushi koribi, kelemane moi laga harai juwa poisa to moi paise.’
Etu nisena he, Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, aru Isor laga sorgodoth majote bhi khushi hoi jitia ekjon paapi manu mon ghurai kene ahe.”
Titia Jisu he koise, “Ekjon manu laga duita chokra thakise,
aru chutu chokra pora baba ke koise, ‘Baba, moi laga dhun sompoti te ki bhag ase etu moike dibi.’ Titia tai laga baba pora dui bhag kori kene duijon ke di dise.
Aru bisi din nohoi kene, chutu chokra tai laga ki ase etu sob joma kori kene dur jagate jai jaise, aru ta te tai laga sob dhun sompoti cholai kene khotom kori dise†.
Jitia tai logote ki thakise etu sob khotom hoi jaise, titia etu pura desh te dangor akaal ahi jaise, aru tai bisi dukh paise.
Titia tai kaam bisari kene ekta manu laga ghor te jaise, aru etu manu pora taike kheti te gahori ke dana khila bo nimite pathai dise. † 15:13 Pro, 29:3 Luke 15:16 lxxxiv Luke 15:25
Tai bisi bhuk laga pora gahori dana hoilebi khabo bhabi kene jaise, kintu tai khabole eku pa-a nai.

Jitia tai nijor laga halat dikhise, tai nijorke kotha korise, ‘Moi laga baba ghor te kiman jon hajira kora manu khan ase taikhan bhi pet bhorta kha-luwa khabo pai, kintu moi yate bhuk pora mori bole ase!
Moi tayar kene moi laga baba ghor te jabo, aru taike kobo, “Baba, moi sorgo aru apuni age te paap korise.
Moi apuni laga chokra kobole layak nai; moike bhi apuni laga ekjon hajira manu nisena he bonai kene rakhibi.’ ”
Titia tai uthi kene baba laga ghor te jaise. Jitia tai dur te he thakise, tai laga baba pora dikhise aru morom pora bhorta hoi jaise, aru polaikene taike dhurise aru chuma dise.
Titia chokra pora koise, ‘Baba, moi sorgote thaka Isor aru apuni usorte paap korise. Moi apuni laga chokra kobole layak nai.’
Kintu baba pora tai laga noukar khan ke koise, ‘Sobse bhal kapra joldi anibi, aru taike lagai dibi, aru tai laga anguli te anguthi lagai dibi, aru notun chapal bhi lagai dibi.
Aru sobse bhal guru laga bacha to ani kene maribi, aru moi khan sob kha luwa kori kene khushi koribo!
Kelemane moi laga chokra to mori jaisele, kintu etiya jinda hoise; tai harai jaise, kintu etiya pai loise.’ Titia taikhan sob khushi korise.
Etu homoi te tai laga dangor chokra kheti te thakise. Jitia tai ghor usorte ponchise, tai manu Luke 15:26 lxxxv Luke 16:1 khan gana kori kene nachi thaka awaj hunise.
Titia tai ekjon noukar ke matikena ki hoi ase etu hudise.
Titia noukar pora koise, ‘Tumi laga bhai wapas ahise aru tumi laga baba pora sobse bhal guru laga bacha katise. Kelemane baba pora tumi laga bhai ke bhal kori kene wapas pai loise.’
Kintu dangor chokra to khong uthise aru bhitor te jabole mon kora nai, etu karone tai laga baba bahar te ulaikene taike ahibole nimite matise.

Kintu dangor chokra pora tai laga baba ke koise, ‘Sabi, iman saal moi apuni nimite kaam korise, aru kitia bhi niyom bhanga nai, hoilebi apuni moike ekta chutu saguli bhi diya nai ami laga sathi khan logote jai kene khushi kori bole,
kintu jitia apuni laga etu chokra ahise, jun he apuni laga dhun sompoti sob to biya kaam kori kene phelai dise, tai nimite apuni sobse bhal guru laga bacha to katise.’
Titia baba taike koise, ‘Bacha, tumi hodai moi logote ase, aru etu sob to tumi laga he ase.
Kintu etu kha luwa kori kene khushi kori bole nimite dorkar thakise, kelemane tumi laga etu bhai jinda ase; tai harai jaisele, hoilebi etiya taike pai loise.’ ” 16 Adharmik Imandar Laga Dristanto

Titia Jisu chela khan ke koise, “Ekjon dhuni manu thakise aru tai laga ekjon imandar Luke 16:2 lxxxvi Luke 16:9 thakise, kintu tai malik laga poisa khorcha kori ase koi kene kunba pora malik ke koi dise.

Titia dhuni manu taike mati kene hudise, ‘Eneka kotha khan tumi laga moi kele huni ase? Tumi ki kaam korise etu sob hisab kitab moike dibi, kelemane tumi etiya pora moi nimite kaam kori bole na paribo.’
Titia etu imandar tai nijorke koise, ‘Moi etiya ki koribo, moi laga malik pora kaam to moi pora loi lobole ase? Moi iman takot nai mati khundikena kaam kori bole aru moi bhik mangi bole sorom lage.
Moi ki kori bole lage moi jane, jitia moike kaam pora ulai dibo, manu khan taikhan laga ghor te moike matibo.’
Titia noukar pora jiman manu malik pora dhar loi kene thakise sobke tai matise, aru poila ekjon ke hudise, ‘Tumi moi laga malik ke kiman dibole ase?’
Tai koise, ‘Moi eksoh botol oliv tel dibole ase.’* Titia tai koise, ‘Tumi laga hisab lobi aru joldi bohi kene yate pachas eneka likhibi.’
Aru baki luwa dusra ke hudise, ‘Aru tumi kiman dibole ase?’ Tai koise, ‘Eksoh jola chawal.’ Taike koise, ‘etu hisab lobi, aru joldi pora likhibi assi dhan bosta.’

Titia malik pora etu biya imandar jun chalaki pora kaam korise, taike bhal paise. Kilekoile, etu yug laga chokra khan to taikhan nijor yug laga chokra khan, jun khan jyoti laga ase, taikhan pora bhi bisi chalak ase.

Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, paap laga dhun * 16:6 Oliv tel laga 3,700 litres. Luke 16:10 lxxxvii Luke 16:16 sompoti pora sathikhan bonai, aru jitia etu pora eku kaam nadiye, taikhan pora tumikhan ke kitia bhi khotom nohua jagate grohon kori lobo.
Jun manu olop te bhi biswas hoi kene thake tai bisi te bhi eneka he thake, aru jun manu olop te bhi thoga baji kore tai bisi te bhi eneka he kore.
Jodi tumikhan etu sapha nathaka dhun to bhal pora cholai kene rakhibo napare, tenehoile etu hosa dhun to tumikhan ke kun pora dibo?
Aru tumikhan dusra manu laga dhun to bhal kori kene nacholaile, titia tumi nijor laga dhun to kineka chola bo?

Ekjon nokor pora duita malik laga kaam koribo na paribo, eneka korile tai ekjon ke ghin koribo aru ekjon ke morom koribo, aru nohoile ekjon ke chari kene dusra ke jai jabo. Tumikhan Isor aru dhun sompoti eke logote sewa kori bole na paribo. Kanun Aru Isor Laga Rajyo
Aru jitia poisa morom kora Pharisee khan etu kotha khan hunise, taikhan Jisu uporte biya paise.
Titia Jisu pora taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan manu usorte nijorke bhal dikhai, kintu Isor he tumikhan laga mon to jane. Jun manu usorte dangor hobole bisare tai Isor usorte komjur hoijai.

Bhabobadi khan aru niyom khan John laga homoi tak he thakise. Etu homoi para Isor laga rajyo laga susamachar prochar hoise, aru sob manu etu janibo nimite joborjosti jaise. Luke 16:17 lxxxviii Luke 16:24
Sorgo aru prithibi harabo nimite asan ase, kintu niyom te ki likhi kene ase, etu laga ekta chutu bhag bhi naharabo. Shadi Kora Khan Chara Chari Kora Aru Duibar Shadi Kora

Kun manu tai laga shadi maiki ke chari diye aru dusra maiki ke shadi kore, tai bebichari kaam korise, aru jun manu mota pora chari diya maiki logote shadi kore, tai bhi bebichari kaam kori ase. Dhuni Manu Aru Lazarus
Aru ekjon dhuni manu thakise, tai daam begoni rong kapra aru bhal mihin kapra lagai kene thakise, aru hodai din khushi aru moja pora thake.
Kintu ekjon gorib manu Lazarus koi kene tai laga mukhyo diwar te thakise aru tai laga gaw pura te biya ghaw pora bhorta koi kene thake,
aru etu dhuni manu laga thali pora ki gire eitu khan khabole nimite rukhi thake. Kintu kutta khan bhi ahikena tai laga ghaw to chati thake.
Etiya etu gorib manu to mori jaise, aru tai laga atma ke sorgodoth pora Abraham laga usorte loi jaise. Aru etu dhuni manu bhi mori jaise aru taike kobor te di dise,
aru mora manu laga desh pora tai laga suku to uthaikene Abraham ke dikhise aru tai laga usorte Lazarus ke bohi thaka dikhise.

Titia etu dhuni manu kandi kene koise, ‘Baba Abraham, moi uporte morom koribi aru Lazarus ke yate pathai dibi, tai laga anguli pora Luke 16:25 lxxxix Luke 16:31 hoilebi moike pani dikene jiba ke thanda kori dibole, kelemane moi etu jui te juli kene dukh pai ase.’
Kintu Abraham pora koise, ‘Bacha, yaad koribi tumi laga jibon te sob bhal saman he paise, aru Lazarus to sob biya he paise. Kintu etiya tai yate aram pora ase, aru tumi dukh te ase.
Etu sob to charikena, tumi aru amikhan majote ekta dangor khai ase, etu thaka pora manu yate pora tumi logote jabo na paribo aru taikhan bhi ta te pora yate ahibo na paribo.’
Titia dhuni manu koise, ‘Moi apnike anurodh kori ase, baba, apuni kunba ke moi laga baba ghor te pathai dibi-
kele koile moi laga pans jon bhai ase, taikhan ke hoshiar kori dibi, taikhan bhi etu dukh khotom nohua jagate nahibo nimite.’
Kintu Abraham koise, ‘Taikhan logote Moses pora likha aru dusra bhabobadi khan pora likha bhi ase; taikhan ke taikhan laga kotha hunibo dibi.’
Kintu dhuni manu pora koise, ‘Nohoi Baba Abraham, kintu kunba mora pora uthi kene jaile he, taikhan mon ghura bo.’

Kintu Abraham taike koise, ‘Jodi taikhan Moses pora likha aru dusra bhabobadi khan pora likha kotha mana nai koile, mora manu uthi jaile bhi taikhan mon naghurabo.’ ” 17 Paap Kori bole Porikha Luke 17:1 xc Luke 17:8
Aru ek din Jisu pora chela khan ke koise, “Paap koribi dibole porikha to ahibo, kintu jun manu eitu khan loi kene ahe, taike hai ase!
Eneka manu dusra ke dukh diya pora nijor gola te pathor bandhi kene pani nichete phelai dile he bhal hobo.
Nijorke bhal pora sai lobi. Jodi tumi laga bhai paap kori ase, tinehoile taike rukhai dibi; aru jodi tai mon ghurai loile, taike maph dibi.
Jodi bhi tai tumi logote sath bar paap kaam kore ek dinte, aru sath bar wapas ahi kene koi, ‘Moike maph dibi, titia tumi taike maph koribo lage!” Amikhan Laga Biswas Dangor Kori Diya
Apostle khan pora Probhu ke koise, “Moi khan laga biswas dangor kori dibi.”

Titia Probhu he koise, “Tumikhan laga biswas ekta sorso dana nisena thakile bhi, tumikhan etu mulberry ghas ke kobo, ‘Nijor laga niche shikor pora ulai jabi, aru jai kene samundar te ulabi,’ aru tumi laga kotha manibo.
Aru yate kun manu tai laga noukar kheti te kaam kori thaka homoi te, nohoile bhi saguli rukha homoi te taike kobo, ‘Joldi ahikena kha luwa koribi’?

Kintu, tai etu manu ke eneka nokobo naki, ‘Moi kiba khabole nimite taiyar koribi, aru tumi laga kapra ke peti bandi lobi jitia moike kha luwa di ase, aru etu pichete tumi kha luwa koribi’? Luke 17:9 xci Luke 17:17
Tai laga noukar ke ki hukum dise etu tai kori diya nimite malik pora taike dhanyavad dise naki?

Etu nisena tumikhan bhi, jitia tumikhan ke ki hukum diya sob kori loise, tumikhan eneka kobo lage, ‘Moi khan layak nathaka noukar ase. Moi khan ke ki koise etu he korise.’ ” Dos Jon Kusto-rugi Bemar Thaka Manu Khan ke Jisu Pora Changai Kora
Aru etu homoi te jitia Jisu Jerusalem sheher te jaise, Tai Samaria aru Galilee jaga khan phale pora jai thakise.
Jitia tai ekta bosti te ponchise, dos jon kusto-rugi bemar thaka khan ke lok paise. Taikhan durte khara kori thakise*.
Aru taikhan awaj uthaikene, koise, “Jisu, Probhu, amikhan uporte morom koribi.”
Jitia Tai taikhan ke dikhise, Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Jabi aru nijorke purohit khan ke dikhabi†.” Aru jitia taikhan jai thakise, taikhan sob sapha hoi jaise.
Titia ekjon taikhan majot pora, bhal howa dikhi kene ghuri kene saise aru jor awaj pora Isor ke mohima korise.
Tai Jisu laga theng nichete giri jaise, aru Taike dhanyavad dise. Tai Samaria laga manu thakise.
Titia Jisu taike hudise, “Dos jun manu bhal huwa nai naki? Nou jun to kot te ase? * 17:12 Lev. 14:36 † 17:14 Lev. 14:2-3 Luke 17:18 xcii Luke 17:27
Taikhan majote aru Isor ke dhanyavad dibole kun bhi wapas aha nai naki, khali etu manu he nohoile jun alag desh pora ase?”
Jitia Jisu he taike koise, “Uthibi aru jabi. Tumi laga biswas pora tumike bhal korise.” Rajyo Laga Kotha
Pharisee khan pora Jisu ke Isor laga rajyo kitia ahibo eneka hudise, Tai jawab dise, “Isor laga rajyo to koi kene nahe.
Aru eneka nokobo, ‘Sabi, yate ase!’ Nohoile ‘Ta te ase!’ Kintu sabi, Isor laga rajyo to tumikhan majote ase.”
Titia Jisu laga chela khan ke koise, “Eneka din ahibo, jitia tumikhan Manu laga Putro ke sabole itcha koribi, kintu tumikhan dikhi napabo.
Titia taikhan pora tumike kobo, ‘Sabi ta te!’ Nohoile ‘Sabi yate!’ Tumi taikhan laga pichete napola bhi,
jitia akas te bhijili mara homoi te ekta jaga pora dusra jagate ujala dikhe etu nisena Manu laga Putro bhi Tai wapas aha homoi te eneka hobo.
Kintu poila Tai bisi dukh pabo lagibo etu jamana manu khan hath pora.
Jineka Noah laga homoi te hoisele, eneka din Manu laga Putro laga homoi te bhi eneka hobo‡.

Taikhan kha luwa kori thakise, shadi kori thakise, aru jibon to duniya laga khushi pora moja kori thakise, utu din tak jitia Noah dangor ‡ 17:26 Heb. 4:7; Mat. 24:37-39; Gen. 6:5-12 Luke 17:28 xciii Luke 17:37 naw bhitor te ghusi jaise, aru dangor hawa pani ahi kene manu ke khotom kori dise.
Aru eneka din Lot laga homoi te bhi hoise- taikhan kha luwa nisa-panite moja kori thakise, ekjon-ekjon logote luwa-diya kori thakise, kunba ghor bonai thakise aru kunba kheti kori thakise:
kintu jitia Lot Sodom pora ulai ahise, akas pora jui ahi kene sob manu ke khotom kori dise§.
Aru eneka he din ahibo jitia Manu laga Putro wapas ahibo aru sob manu Taike dikhi pabo.

Aru etu dinte, jun manu ghor uporte ase aru tai laga saman khan ghor te ase, taike etu saman lobole nimite nichete jabo nadibi; aru jun manu kheti te kaam kori ase, etu ke ghuri kene pichete sabole nadibi.
Lot laga maiki ke yaad koribi*.
Jun manu tai laga jibon bacha bole bisare tai harai dibo, kintu jun manu nijor jibon to Isor nimite harai diye tai bachibo.
Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, etu rati te duijon ghumai thakibo. Ekjon ke uthai lobo, aru ekjon ke chari jabo.
Aru etu nisena duita mahila eke jagate dhaan khundi thakibo. Ekjon ke uthai loijabo aru ekjon ke chari jabo.

Karone swali jai kene tai laga ama ke hudise, “Moi ki mangibo?” Titia tai ama jowab dise, “Baptizma diya John laga matha mangibi”.
Tai joldi raja logote ahi koise, “Baptizma diya John laga matha ekta thali pora moike di dibi, etu he ami laga itcha ase.”
Titia raja laga mon bisi dukh hoise, kintu tai kosom diya karone aru Tai logote boha alohi manu khan karone tai swali ke nohobo kobo napara hoise.
Aru raja joldi ekjon sipahi ke John laga matha kati kene anibole hukum dise. Aru bondhi ghor te jai kene tai laga matha kati loise.
Aru ekta thali te rakhise aru etu swali ke dise, aru swali pora tai ama logot dise.
Jitia John laga chela khan etu hunise, taikhan ahi kene tai laga gaw uthai loijai kene ekta kobor te rakhidise. Mark 6:30 xxv Mark 6:38 Jisu Pora Pans Hajar Manu khan ke Khabole Diya
Titia apostle khan Jisu logote ahi joma hoise, aru ki kaam taikhan korise, aru sikhai dise, sob Taike koi dise.
Aru Tai taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan nijor alag sunsan jagah te jai kene olop somoi aram kori lobi.” Kelemane ta te bisi manu aha-juwa kori ase, karone taikhan khabole somoi bhi napa hoi jaise.
Aru taikhan naw pora ekta alag sunsan jagah te jai jaise.
Kintu bisi manu taikhan jai thaka dikhi kene sob nogor pora polai ahise aru Tai logote ahise.
Aru Jisu jitia bahar te ulaise, dangor bhir dikhikena taikhan ke morom lagise, kelemane taikhan to roikhya nathaka nisena thakise. Aru Tai bisi kotha taikhan ke sikhai dise.
Jitia saam hoi jaise, Jisu laga chela khan ahi kene Jisu ke koise, “Etu sunsan jagah ase, aru homoi to deri hoi jaise.
Taikhan ke pathai dibi, taikhan ephale-uphale usor bosti te jai kene nijor karone roti kinibo dibi, kelemane taikhan khabole eku nathaka hoise.”
Kintu Tai taikhan ke jowab di koise, “Tumikhan he taikhan ke kiba khabole dibi.” Aru taikhan Jisu ke hudise, “Amikhan jai kene dui-sou dinarii† laga roti kini ani kene taikhan ke khabole dibo?”

Kintu Tai taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan logote kiman roti ase? Jai kene sabi.” Aru jitia † 6:37 Ek denarius to ek din laga hajara kora laga poisa thakisele. Mark 6:39 xxvi Mark 6:48 taikhan saikene koise, “Pansta roti aru duita maas.”
Titia Tai sob manu ke ghas te joma hoi kene bohi bole koise.
Titia taikhan ke eksoh-eksoh aru pachas-pachas kori kene alag-alag jagate bohi bole koi dise.

Aru Tai pansta roti aru duita maas ke loi kene sorgo phale saise aru dhanyavad dikena roti bhangai se aru manu khan ke dibole chela khan ke koise. Aru Tai duita maas ke bhi taikhan sob logote bhag kori dise.
Titia Taikhan sob khai loise aru pet bhorta hoise.
Aru baroh ta tukri te bachi juwa roti tukra aru maas joma korise.
Ta te taikhan roti kha pans hajar manu thakise‡. Jisu Samundar Paani Uporte Bera
Titia Tai manu khan ke pathai dibo karone chela khan ke naw pora joldi Nodi laga dusra phale, Bethsaida te jabi koi dise.
Aru Tai prathana kori bole pahar te jai jaise.
Jitia saam ahise naw to nodi majote thakise, aru Tai ekla he matite asele.

Titia hawa taikhan ke ulta pora mari thaka karone, naw ke age te loi jabole bisi digdar huwa Tai dikhise. Aru choutha paher§ nisena Tai nodi te khujkari taikhan logote ahise, aru taikhan pora age ulai jabole bhabise. ‡ 6:44 Mahila aru bacha khan bhi khaishe, hoilebi taikhan ke ginti korate hala nai. § 6:48 Phojur tin aru choi baji bhitor te Mark 6:49 xxvii Mark 6:56
Kintu jitia Tai nodi te Tai khujkari aha dikhise, taikhan bhoot dikhise bhabi kene bisi hala korise.
Kelemane taikhan sob Taike dikhi kene bisi bhoi hoise, kintu Tai joldi taikhan logote kotha korise aru koise, “Mon dangor koribi, Moi he ase! Bhoi na koribi!”
Titia Tai taikhan logote naw te ahise, aru hawa rukhi jaise, aru taikhan bisi asurit hoise.
Kelemane taikhan etu roti laga motlob bhi buja nai. Kintu, taikhan laga mon tan hoi thakise. Gennesaret Jagate Jisu He Bemar Manu Ke Changai Kora
Jitia taikhan paar kori kene matite ahise taikhan Gennesaret jagate ahi kene naw ta te lagai rakhise.
Aru jitia taikhan naw pora ulai ahise, manu khan Taike joldi jani loise.
Aru usorte thaka bosti khan sob polai ahise aru bemari khan ke bisna pora loi anise, aru jun jagah te Tai ase koi kene janibo, ta te loi ani thakise.

Aru jun jagah hobi, bosti, nogor aru desh hobi, Tai kote jai, utu sob jagah te bemari khan ke bajar te bhi rakhi kene Tai laga kapra olop chubole binti kori thakise, aru jiman manu Taike chubo parise, taikhan sob bhal hoijai thake. 7 Niom Aru Hukum Khan Mark 7:1 xxviii Mark 7:10
Ek din, Jerusalem pora aha Pharisee aru kunba likha manu khan Tai logote joma hoise.
Aru taikhan Jisu laga chela khan kunba ke hath nadhulai kene* bhaat khai thaka dikhise.
-Kelemane Pharisee aru Yehudi khan purana niyom ke mani thakisele, taikhan hath nadhui kene eku bhi nakhai.
Jitia taikhan bajar jaga pora ahe, hath nadhui kene eku bhi nakhai, aru tineka bisi kotha ase: jun to taikhan mani thake, gilas, thali, tamba laga borton, dhua aru sapha kora.-
Titia Pharisee aru niyom likha manu khan Jisu ke hudise, “Kile Apuni laga chela khan poila laga niyom namani kene choli thake, aru hath nadholai kene roti khai thake?”
Jisu taikhan ke jowab dise, “Isaiah he tumi kopoti khan laga kotha bhabobani thik koise. Tai eneka likhise, ‘Eitu khan mukh pora to Moike sonman kore, Kintu taikhan mon to Moi pora dur thake.
Aru taikhan misa-misi te Moike aradhana kori thake, Kelemane manu para bona niyom loi sikhai thake.†’
Kelemane tumikhan Isor diya niyom chari kene manu bona niyom he mani thake.”
Tai taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan manu he bona niyom mani kene, Isor diya bhal niyom khan chari dise.

Kelemane Moses koisele, ‘Tumi laga baba aru ama ke Sonman koribi,’ aru, ‘Jun tai nijor baba, ama ke biya kobo, tai ji hoile bhi moribo.‡’ * 7:2 Yehudi niyom hisab te hath nadhula koi ase. † 7:7 Isa. 29:13. ‡ 7:10 Exo. 20:12; Due. 5:16. Mark 7:11 xxix Mark 7:21
Kintu tumikhan koi, ‘Jodi ekjon tai nijor baba, ama ke koi, “Moi pora tumi ki modot pabole ase, etu sob Isor pora Corban dise’ ” - motlob, ‘Isor ke di dise’.
Aru tumikhan etu manu ke tai baba aru ama ke eku bhi modot kori bole nadiye.
Aru tumikhan Isor laga kotha biya kori thake tumikhan niyom pora. Aru bisi mili thaka nisena kaam kori thake. Ki Pora Ekjon Ke Letera Kore
Aru titia Jisu pora manu khan ke Tai usorte mati anikena koise, “Ami laga kotha huni bhi, aru bujhi lobi.
Eneka jinis to nai, bahar pora manu bhithor te jai kene letera kori diya, kintu ji jinis bhitor pora ulai etu he taike letera kori diye.
Jodi kunba huni bole kan ase, taike hunibo dibi.
Jitia Tai bhir majot pora ulaikene ghor bhitor te ahise, taikhan Taike etu dristanto laga motlob hudise.
Aru Tai taikhan ke koise, “Kile tumikhan bhi eneka nabuja ase? Bahar pora manu laga bhitor te ki jai etu pora manu ke letera nakore.
Kelemane etu tai mon para nohoi, kintu mukh pora pet te jai kene aru latrine te ulai jai, kele koile sob kha luwa to sapha ase.”
Aru Jisu eneka koi thakise, “Ki mon pora ulai, etu he manu ke letera kore.
Kelemane manu laga mon pora biya bhabona, bebichari, chor kora aru morai diya, Mark 7:22 xxx Mark 7:30
lalos, biya kaam kora, thogai diya, biya niyom thaka, suku jola, hinsa kora, dimag napuncha kaam kora, aru phutani kora.
Etu sob biya bostu mon pora ahi manu ke letera kori diye.” Syrophoenicia Mahila Laga Biswas
Ta te pora Tai uthi kene Tyre aru Sidon laga desh phale jaise. Aru ekta ghor te jaise, aru kunke bhi janibo nadibo bhabisele, kintu Tai Iukabole para nai.
Kintu ta te ekjon mahila jun laga chutu swali ke dusto atma pora dhurikena thakise, etu mahila Jisu laga kotha hunise, aru ahi Tai laga theng te giri jaise.
Aru etu mahila Yunani aru Syrophoenicia jaga laga asele, aru tai swali pora bhoot ulai dibi koi kene Jisu ke binti korise.
Kintu Jisu taike koise, “Poila, bacha ke khabole dibi. Kelemane bacha laga roti loi kene kutta khan ke diya thik nohoi.”
Aru tai jowab dikene koise “Hoi, Probhu, kintu kutta bhi bacha khan laga roti tukra mez nichete giri thaka khabole pai.”
Titia Tai taike koise, “Etu kotha karone tumi, jabi, bhoot tumi laga swali pora ulai jaise.”
Aru tai jitia ghor te ahise, tai swali bisna te ghumai thaka aru bhoot ulai jai kene thaka pai loise. Kan Benga Ekjon Jisu Pora Changai Kora Mark 7:31 xxxi Mark 8:2
Titia Tai aru bhi Sidon laga desh pora ulai Decapolis laga desh te hoi Galilee nodi phale ahi jaise.
Titia kunba ekjon kaan benga aru kotha bhal pora kobo napara jon thakise, Tai laga hath tai uporte rakhi dibi koi kene binti korise.
Aru Tai taike bisi thaka manu pora alag loijai kene tai laga kan te anguli ghusai dise, aru thuk dikene tai jiba te chui dise.
Titia Tai sorgo phale saise aru jor pora awaj dikene koise, “Ephphatha!” -Motlob ase “Khuli jabi!”
Titia joldi tai kan khuli jaise, aru tai jiba bandi thaka bhi khuli jaise, aru tai sapha pora kotha kori bole parise.
Titia Tai taikhan ke etu kunke bhi nokobi koi mana kori dise kintu jiman taikhan ke mana kore, iman taikhan bisi kobole hoi jaise.

Aru taikhan bisi asurit hoi ekjon majot te koi thakise, “Tai jiman bhi korise sob thik korise. Tai kan nahuna ke bhi huni bole dise, aru kobo napara ke bhi kotha kobole takot dise.” 8 Jisu Pora Char Hajar Ke Khabole Diya
Dusra dinte arubi bisi manu joma hoi jaise, aru taikhan logote khabole eku thaka nai. Jisu pora Tai laga chela khan ke matise aru koise,
“Moi etu sob manu khan ke bisi morom lage, kelemane taikhan tin din pora Ami logote thaki ase, aru etiya taikhan logote khabole eku nai. Mark 8:3 xxxii Mark 8:13
Jodi Moi taikhan ke ghor te bhukha pathai dile, taikhan rasta te komjur pora giri jabo pare, kelemane kunba to dur pora ahise.”
Titia chela khan Taike jowab dise, “Kote pora kunba yate jongol pora roti ani kene eitu khan ke khila bo paribo?”
Tai taikhan ke hudise, “Tumikhan logote kiman ta roti ase?” Taikhan koise, “Sat-ta.”
Titia Tai taikhan ke matite bohi bole adesh dise, aru Tai sat-ta roti loi Isor ke dhanyavad dise, aru bhangai kene chela khan ke di dise, aru taikhan pora sobke dise.
Taikhan logote ekta huru maas thakise, Tai etu bhi loi dhanyavad dikene taikhan ke dibole koise.
Titia taikhan khai kene aram pai loise, aru bachi juwa khana to sat-ta tukri bhorta uthai loise.
Aru jun khaise, taikhan char hajar nisena asele, aru Tai taikhan ke jabo dise.
Aru Tai joldi nijor chela khan ke naw te uthi kene Dalmanutha laga desh phale jaise. Pharisee Khan Pora Ekta Chihna Mangise
Titia kunba Pharisee khan ahi Taike hudise aru porikha korise. Taike sorgo pora ekta chihna taikhan ke dikha bole koise.
Kintu Tai nijor Atma te dukh paa nisena lamba sans loi koise, “Kile etu yug khan chihna bisari thake? Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo, etu yug khan ke eku chihna nadibo.”
Aru Tai taikhan ke chari kene, naw te uthijaise, aru nodi paar kori kene dusra phale jai jaise. Mark 8:14 xxxiii Mark 8:23 Pharisee Khan Aru Herod Laga Khomir
Aru chela khan roti lobole pahorise, aru naw te taikhan logote ekta roti pora bisi thaka nai.
Titia Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Sai rukhi thaki bhi, Herod aru Pharisee laga khomir pora hoshiar thakibi.”
Taikhan apaste kotha korise, kelemane amikhan logote roti nathaka hoise.
Kintu Jisu etu jani kene taikhan ke hudise, “Tumikhan roti nathaka karone kele kotha kori ase? Kile etiya bhi najane? Tumi laga mon tan hoi thaki ase?
Suku thakile bhi, kele nadikhe? Kan thakile bhi, kele nahune? Aru tumikhan yaad nai?
Jitia Moi pans hajar karone pansta roti bhangai dise, aru tumikhan kiman tukri uthaise?” Taikhan jowab dise, “Baroh-ta tukri uthaise.”
“Aru jitia Moi char hajar karone sat-ta roti bhangai sele, titia tumikhan kiman ta tukri bhorta kori uthaise?” Taikhan koise, “Sat-ta tukhri uthaise.”
Titia Tai hudise, “Kile, tumikhan etiya bhi nabuje?” Suku Andha Ekjon Bethsaida Te Jisu Bhal Kora
Titia Jisu aru chela khan Bethsaida te ahi jaise, aru taikhan suku nadikha manu ekjon Jisu logote loi anise, aru taike chubole binti korise.

Etu karone Tai suku nadikha manu laga hath dhorise aru bosti bahar te loi jaise, aru tai laga suku te thuki kene, Tai hath pora taike chuise aru taike hudise, “Tumi kiba dikhi ase?” Mark 8:24 xxxiv Mark 8:33
Aru tai uporte sai koise, “Moi ghas nisena manu jai thaka dikhi ase.”
Titia Tai arubi ekbar hath tai laga suku te chuise, aru tai bhal pora sabo parise aru sapha pora sob dikhibo parise.
Titia Jisu taike ghor te pathai dise aru koise, “Town te etiya-etiya nimite najabi.” Peter Pora Jisu Khrista Ase Koikena Shikar Kora
Titia Jisu aru Tai chela khan Caesarea Philippi laga usorte thaka bosti khan te jai jaise. Tai rasta te ja somoite, chela khan hudise, “Manu khan Moike kun ase koi?”
Titia taikhan taike koise, “Baptizma diya John,’ aru kunba koi, ‘Elijah,’ aru kunba koi, ‘Ekjon bhabobadi.’ ”
Tai taikhan ke koise, “Kintu tumikhan Moike ki koi ase?” Peter jowab di koise, “Apuni Khrista ase.”
Titia Tai kun ase etu kunke bhi nokobi koise. Tai Mora Aru Punoruthan Laga Age Te Jisu Kowa

Aru Jisu taikhan ke sikhabole shuru korise, Manu laga Putro bisi dukh koribo lagibo, bura khan aru prodhan purohit aru likha manu khan Taike namanibo aru morai dibo, aru Tai tin din pichete jee uthijabo.
Tai taikhan ke etu kotha sapha pora koi dise, aru Peter Taike alag loijai kene Taike hala korise.

Kintu Jisu ghurikena chela khan ke saise aru Tai Peter ke galise aru koise, “Saitan! Ami laga usor pora dur hobi, kelemane tumi Isor Mark 8:34 xxxv Mark 9:3 laga kotha te nohoi, kintu manu laga bhabona te he thake.”

Titia Tai bhir te thaka manu khan aru chela khan ke matise, aru Tai usorte ani kene koise, “Jodi kunba Ami laga piche koribo mon hoile, tai nijorke tyag koribo lage aru nijor Cross uthai loi Ami laga pichete ahibi.
Kelemane jun nijor jibon bacha bole mon koribo, tai jibon harabo, kintu jun Moi karone, aru susamachar karone nijor jibon harabo, tai bachibo.
Karone kunba manu sob prithibi pai loi kene tai nijor jibon haraile, tai ki labh ase?
Karone manu to nijor jibon laga bodli te ki dibo paribo?

Judi biswas nathaka aru paapi yug pora Ami laga kotha ke aru Moi nimite sorom kore, Manu laga Putro bhi jitia Tai laga pobitro duth khan aru Baba laga mohima te ahibo, Tai bhi tai nimite kotha kobole sorom koribo.” 9

Aru Jisu taikhan ke koi thakise, “Hosa pora Moi tumikhan ke kobo, yate khara thaka kunba khan namoribo jitia tak Isor rajyo laga takot loi kene aha ke nadikhe bo.” Jisu Laga Chehera Aru Kapra Bodli Huwa
Titia choi din pichete Jisu pora Peter ,James aru John ke loi kene ekta untcha pahar te jaise. Titia taikhan usorte, Tai laga gaw bodli hoi jaise.
Tai kapra borop nisena bisi boga hoi jaise, etu prithibi te kun dhobi bhi tineka boga kori bole na pora nisena. Mark 9:4 xxxvi Mark 9:13
Titia Moses aru Elijah aha dikhai dise, aru taikhan Jisu logote kotha kori thakise.
Titia Peter pora Jisu ke koise, “Rabbi*, amikhan yate thakile bhal hobo, amikhan ke tinta thaki bole jaga bonabo dibi, ekta Apuni nimite, ekta Moses nimite, aru ekta Elijah nimite.”
Aru tinjon chela khan bisi bhoi laga karone Jisu taikhan ke ki kobo lage etu najana hoise.
Titia ekta badal ahikena taikhan ke dhaki loise, aru badal pora ekta awaj pora koise, “Etu Ami laga morom thaka Putro ase. Taike huni bhi.†”
Titia tinjon chela khan achanak ephale-uphale saise aru Jisu he taikhan logote thaka paise, aru kunke bhi dikha nai.
Jitia taikhan pahar pora niche ahi thakise, Jisu taikhan ke hukum dikene koise jitia tak Manu laga Putro mora pora jee uthi najai, titia tak taikhan ki dikhise etu kunke bhi nakobo.
Taikhan etu kotha lukai rakhidise aru “Mora pora jee uthi naja tak” ki motlob ase koi kene kotha kori thakise.
Aru taikhan Taike hudise, “Kile, likha khan Elijah he poila ahibo lage koi?‡”

Tai taikhan ke jowab dikena koise, “Elijah he poila ahibo lage, aru sob thik tak kori dibo, etu hosa ase. Kintu Manu laga Putro laga kotha te Tai bisi dukh koribo aru Taike ghin hobo etu kele Isor kotha te likhi rakhise?

Kintu Moi tumikhan ke koi dibo Elijah ahi jaise, aru taikhan taike ki kori bole mon thakise * 9:5 Shika manu. † 9:7 I Pet. 1:17; Psa. 2:7. ‡ 9:11 Mal. 4:5-6. Mark 9:14 xxxvii Mark 9:22 etu kori dise, jineka Tai nimite bhi kotha likhi rakhi kene ase.” Dusto Atma Pora Dhora Ekjon Ke Changai Kora
Aru jitia Tai chela khan logote ahise, bisi manu taikhan laga age pichete thakise, aru niyom likha khan taikhan logote kotha te lagi thakise.
Aru jitia manu khan Taike dikhise, taikhan asurit hoi kene Jisu logot polai ahise aru Taike salam dise.
Aru Tai pora chela khan ke hudise, “Tumikhan taikhan logote ki kotha te lagi ase?”
Ekjon bisi manu thaka jaga pora Taike jowab di koise, “Shika manu, moi laga chokra ke Apuni logot loi anise, tai logot gunga atma ase.

Aru kot te taike dhure, ta te taike phelai diye aru tai laga mukh pora phen ulai, aru daat kamuri kene tai laga bodon to tan hoi thake. Aru moi Apuni laga chela ke etu khedai dibole koise, kintu taikhan para nai.”
Jisu taike jowab dise, “Tumi biswas nakora yug khan, Moi kitia tak tumikhan logote thakibo? Kitia tak Moi tumikhan ke sai thakibo? Taike Moi logote loi anibi.”
Aru taikhan chokra ke Tai logote anise. Aru jitia etu gunga atma pora Jisu ke dikhise, joldi tai chokra ke dukh dise, aru matite girai dise, aru tai laga mukh pora phen ulaise.
Etu karone Jisu tai laga baba ke hudise, “Tai kitia pora bemar ase?” Aru tai koise, “Bacha homoi pora ase.
Aru bar-bar taike khotom kori bole kitia ba jui te aru kitia ba panite girai di thake, kintu Mark 9:23 xxxviii Mark 9:31 Apuni he kiba koribo parile, morom pora amikhan ke modot koribi.”
Aru Jisu taike koise, “ ‘Jodi Apuni pare koile koi ase?’ Biswas manu khan karone to sob koribo paribo.”
Joldi chokra laga baba kandi kene koise, “Hey Probhu, moi biswas ase, moi laga biswas laga upai kori dibi!”

Jitia bhir khan polai ahi thaka Jisu dikhise, titia Tai dusto atma ke galise, aru koise, “Tumi nahuna aru gunga atma, Moi tumike hukum di ase, tai pora ulai jabi, aru kitia bhi tai bhitor te aru najabi.”
Titia gunga atma taike bisi dukh dise aru jor pora hala kori kene ulai jaise, aru chokra to mora nisena hoise, etu dikhikena bisi manu eneka koise, “Tai mori jaise.”
Kintu Jisu etu chokra laga hath dhori kene taike uthai dise aru tai khara hoi jaise.
Pichete, jitia Jisu ghor bhitor te ahise, Tai laga chela khan alag pora Taike hudise, “Amikhan kele etu ke khedabo para nai?
Etu karone Tai taikhan ke koise, “Etu sob prathana aru upwas pora he koribo paribo.” Mora Aru Punoruthan Laga Aru bhi Age Te Jisu Koi Dise
Titia Jisu aru chela khan ta te pora ulaikene Galilee paar kori jai asele, kintu Tai kun manu ke bhi janibo dibole itcha kora nai.

Kelemane Tai nijor chela khan ke sikhai thakise aru koise, “Manu laga Putro ke manu hathte dhori dibo, aru taikhan Taike morai dibo; aru tin din pichete arubi Tai jee uthijabo.” Mark 9:32 xxxix Mark 9:39
Kintu taikhan etu kotha laga motlob bujhi bo pora nai, aru Taike hudibole bhi bhoi lagi thakise. Sob Pora Dangor Kun Ase
Titia Tai Capernaum te ahise, aru jitia Tai ghor bhitor te ahise, Tai taikhan ke hudise, “Tumikhan rasta te ki kotha loi huda-hudi kori asele?”
Kintu taikhan eku bhi kowa nai. Kelemane taikhan rasta te ekjon-ekjon logote kun he dangor hobo etu kotha kori thakise.
Aru bohi kene, Tai laga baroh jon chela ke mati kene koise, “Jodi kunba prothom hobole mon korile tai sob pora piche hobi, aru sob laga noukar hobi.”
Titia Tai ekta huru bacha loi taikhan majote rakhise aru bacha ke Tai laga hathte loi kene taikhan ke koise.

“Jun Ami laga naam te eitu khan nisena bacha ke grohon koribo, tai Moike grohon kori loise, aru jun Moike grohon koribo, tai Moike he nohoi kintu Moike Jun pathaise, Taike bhi grohon kori loise.” Amikhan Ke Birodh Nakora Khan Amikhan Logot Ase
John Taike koise “Shika manu, kunba ejkon pora Apuni laga naam te bhoot khedai thaka paisele, aru amikhan taike mana kori dise, kelemane tai amikhan logote nathaka manu huwa karone.”
Kintu Jisu koise, “Taike mana na koribi, kelemane eneka kun bhi nai, jun Ami laga Mark 9:40 xl Mark 9:47 naam te asurit kaam koribo, aru pichete Moike biya nokobo.
Kelemane jun bhi Amikhan ke hinsa nakore, tai Ami phale ase.
Kelemane jun bhi tumikhan ke Khrista laga koi kene Ami naam pora ekta gilas pani bhi khilai le, Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo, tai pabo thaka naharabo. Paap Kori bole Porikha Ahibo
Kintu jun bhi, Moike biswas kora chutu ekjon ke bhi biya kori dile, tai karone dhan pisi thaka dangor pathor to tai gola te bandi kene samundar te phelai diya he bhal hobo.
Jodi tumi laga hath pora tumike paap koribo di thake, etu hath kati phelai dibi, duita hath loi norokte kitia bhi khotom nohua jui te juwa pora tumi hath nathakile bhi jibon te juwa he bhal hobo.
Ta te taikhan laga puka namora aru jui bhi kitia bhi nabhutibo.

Aru jodi tumi laga theng pora tumike paap koribo di thake, etu ke kati phelai dibi. Duita theng loi norokte kitia bhi bhuti bo napara jui te juwa pora tumi lengra hoile bhi jibon te juwa he bhal hobo.
Ta te taikhan ke kamura puka namore aru jui kitia bhi nabhute.

Aru jodi tumi laga suku karone tumike paap koribo di thake koile, suku ulaikena phelai dibi. Duita suku loi kene norokte juwa pora to ekta suku loi kene Isor laga rajyote juwa he bhal hobo. Mark 9:48 xli Mark 10:8
Ta te taikhan ke kamura puka namore aru jui bhi kitia bhi nabhute§.
Karone sob jui pora nimokia kori dibo.

Nimok to bhal ase, kintu nimok bhi tai laga swadh harai jaile tumi ki pora etu ke aru swad koribo? Tumi nijorke nimok nisena rakhibi, aru shanti pora ek-dusra logote thakibi.” 10 Shadi Pora Chari-Chari Laga Sikha
Titia Jisu Capernaum chari kene Jordan Nodi paar korise aru Judea desh phale ahi jaise, aru bisi manu Tai logote joma hoise, aru hodai nisena Tai taikhan ke sikhai di thakise.
Kunba Pharisee khan Taike porikha kori bole kiba hudise, “Ki karone mota tai maiki ke chari dibole niyom ase?”
Aru Tai taikhan ke jowab dikene koise, “Moses tumikhan ke ki hukum disele?”
Taikhan koise, “Moses koise chari bole laga kagos likhi kene taike chari dibole pare.*”
Aru Jisu taikhan ke koise, tumikhan laga mon tan huwa karone tai tumikhan ke etu hukum dise.
Kintu sristi laga shuru pora ‘Isor he mota aru maiki bonai dise.†’
‘Karone mota to nijor ama aru baba chari kene tai nijor maiki logote mili jabo.

Aru tai duijon eke sharir hoi jabo.’ Karone taikhan duijon nohoi kintu ekta sharir hoi jabo‡. § 9:48 Isa. 66:24. * 10:4 Due. 24:1-3 † 10:6 Gen. 1:27; Gen. 5:2 ‡ 10:8 Gen. 2:24 Mark 10:9 xlii Mark 10:18
Karone ki Isor pora milai dise, etu ke manu pora alag nokoribi.”
Jitia taikhan ghor te thakise Tai chela khan Taike aru etu kotha hudise.
Karone Tai taikhan ke koise, “Jun bhi tai maiki ke chari dikene aru dusra ke shadi korile tai maiki laga bhirodh te bebichar kori ase.
Aru jodi maiki bhi nijor mota chari kene dusra logote shadi korile tai bhi bebichar kori ase.” Bacha Khan Moi Usorte Ahibole Dibi
Ek din kunba manu khan pora taikhan laga bacha khan ke Tai usorte loi anise, taikhan laga matha te Tai laga hath rakhi kene asirbad dibole nimite, kintu chela khan pora taikhan ke rukhai dise.
Kintu Jisu etu dikhikena koise, “Bacha khan ke Moi logote ahibo dibi taikhan ke narukha bhi, kelemane Isor laga rajyo to eneka khan laga he ase.
Moi hosa pora tumikhan ke koi ase, jun pora nije ke ekta chutu bacha nisena kori kene Isor laga rajyo ke swekar nakore, tai ji hoile bhi ta te gusibo na paribo.”
Aru Tai hath taikhan uporte rakhi kene asirbad dise. Dhuni Jawan Putro Ekjon
Aru jitia Jisu rasta te jai asele, ekjon polai ahise, aru Tai samne te athukari kene Taike hudise, “Bhal Shika manu, anonto jibon pabole moi ki koribo lage?”
Titia Jisu taike koise, “Tumi Moike kele bhal koi ase? Isor he nohoile kun bhi bhal nohoi. Mark 10:19 xliii Mark 10:27
Tumi niyom khan jani ase: ‘Manu namora bhi, bebichar na koribi! Chor na koribi, misa gawahi nadibo, manu ke nothogabi, tumi baba ama ke sonman koribi.§’ ”
Aru tai jowab di Taike koise, “Shika manu, moi etu sob jawan thaka somoi pora mani ahise.”

Titia Jisu taike morom pora saikene taike koise, “Tumi ekta kaam he puncha nai, jabi aru tumi laga ki ase, sob bikiri kori kene dukhia khan ke di dibi, aru tumi sorgote dhun pai jabo, aru ahikena Ami laga piche koribi.”
Kintu tai etu kotha huni kene dukh hoise, aru mon biya hoi kene jai jaise, kelemane tai bisi dhuni asele.
Titia Jisu Tai age piche saikene chela khan ke koise, “Dhuni manu Isor laga rajyote gushi bole bisi digdar hobo!”
Aru chela khan Tai kotha pora asurit hoise. Kintu Jisu taikhan ke aru koise, “Bacha khan, Isor laga rajyote gushi bole kiman bhi digdar ase!
Isor laga rajyote dhuni manu gushi bole para to ekta uth pora bhiji laga suku paar ulai juwa he bisi sosta hobo.”
Aru taikhan ekdom asurit hoi kene ekjon-ekjon logote kotha korise, “Tinehoile kun poritran pabo?”

Kintu Jisu taikhan ke saikene koise, “Manu pora hoile etu na paribo, kintu Isor he paribo*. Kelemane Isor nimite sob para ase.” § 10:19 Exo. 20:12-16; Rom. 13:9 * 10:27 Job 42:2; Luke 1:37 Mark 10:28 xliv Mark 10:35
Titia Peter Taike koise, “Sabi amikhan to sob chari kene Apuni laga piche korise.
Titia Jisu koise, “Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo, kun bhi Moi karone aru susamachar karone Tai ghor nohoile bhai-bhoini, ama-baba, nijor bacha, aru kheti mati bari chari dile;
taikhan sob ek-sou guna pora bhi bisi pabo: ghor ,aru bhai, bhoini, ama aru bacha aru kheti baari khan, aru aha yug te anonto jibon pabo.
Kintu bisi manu jun khan age ase, taikhan piche hoi jabo, aru jun piche ase taikhan age hoi jabo.” Jisu Tai Nijor Mora Laga Kotha Age Pora Koi Diya

Kitia Jisu aru chela khan Jerusalem te jai thakise, Jisu taikhan sob laga age hoi kene jai thakise. Taikhan asurit hoise, aru Tai laga piche kori thaka khan bhoi lagi thakise. Titia Tai ekbar aru baroh jonke kinar te loijai kene Tai uporte ki ahibole ase etu taikhan ke koise.

“Sabi, Amikhan Jerusalem te jai ase, aru Manu laga Putro ke dhorikena mukhyo purohit aru niyom likha khan laga hathte di dibo, aru taikhan Taike golti dibo aru Taike morai dibo. Taike biswas nakora khan laga hathte dikena morai dibo.
Aru taikhan Taike ninda kori kene maribo, kintu tin din pichete Tai jee uthibo.” James Aru John Pora Manga
Titia Zebedee laga Putro James aru John duijon Tai logote ahikena koise, “Shika manu, ami duijon kiba mangibo, etu kori dibi.” Mark 10:36 xlv Mark 10:44
Tai duijon ke koise, “Moi tumikhan karone ki kori dibo?”

Tai duijon pora Jisu ke koise, “Kitia Apuni singhason te bohibi, Apuni laga mohima pora bhorta thaka rajyote, titia, duijon nimite, ekjon Apuni laga dyna hath aru dusra Apuni laga baya hathte bohibo dibi.”
Kintu Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tumi duijon ki mangi ase, etu najani kene mangi ase, duijon Moi khabole thaka kup pora khabo paribo, aru Moi ki baptizma pora baptizma lobole ase etu paribo?
Duijon Taike koise, “Amikhan paribo.” Titia Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Duijon Ami khabole thaka kup pora khabole to hosa ase, aru Moi ki baptizma pora baptizma kori bole ase, etu bhi hobo.
Kintu Ami laga dyna aru baya phale bohi bole to Moi dibo napare, kintu etu to kun nimite rakhikena ase, tai he pabo.”
Aru jitia dos jon chela khan etu kotha hunise, taikhan James aru John duijon ke bisi khong hoise.

Kintu Jisu taikhan ke mati anikena koise, “Tumikhan jani ase na, Porjati khan kun taikhan laga adhikari khan ase koi kene mane, eitu khan pora he taikhan uporte raj kore aru taikhan laga daruga khan pora taikhan uporte adhikar cholai thake.
Kintu tumi majot to eneka nahobi, kintu jun dangor hobole mon kore tai tumi laga nokor hobo dibi.
Aru jun age hobole mon kore taike sob laga Mark 10:45 xlvi Mark 10:52 ses te thakibo dibi.
Kelemane Manu laga Putro bhi sewa lobole aha nohoi, kintu sewa kori bole aru bisi manu ke bacha bole nijor jibon dibole ahise.” Jisu Pora Andha Bartimaeus Ke Changai Kora

Titia taikhan Jericho sheher te ahise. Aru ta te pora Tai aru chela khan aru taikhan logot bisi manu Jericho pora ulai jai thakise, titia Timaeus laga chokra Bartimaeus koi kene andha ekjon rasta kinar te bohi kene bhikh mangi thakise.
Aru jitia tai etu Nazareth Jisu ase koi kene janise, tai hala kori kene koise, “Jisu, David laga Putro, moike daya koribi!”
Titia bisi manu taike gali dikena chup thaki bole koise. Kintu tai arubi jor pora hala kori kene koise, “David laga Putro, moike daya koribi!”
Titia Jisu rukhise aru taike mati bole koise. Etu nimite taikhan pora andha manu ke koise, “Mon dangor koribi! Uthibi! Tai tumike mati ase.”
Aru tai uthikena tai bahar te lagai thaka kapra ke ulaikene phelai dise aru Jisu logote ahise.
Aru Jisu taike koise, “Moi tumi karone ki kori dibo?” Andha manu Taike jowab dise, “Rabbi, moike dikhi pabo dibi.”
Titia Jisu taike koise, “Jai jabi. Tumi laga biswas he tumike bhal kori dise.” Aru etu loge-logote tai dikhibow parise, aru Jisu laga piche korise. Mark 11:1 xlvii Mark 11:10 11 Jitikena Juwa
Aru jitia Jisu aru chela khan Jerusalem te, aru Oliv Pahar kinar Bethphage aru Bethany nogorkhan te ahise, aru taikhan age jabole Jisu pora duijon chela ke pathaise.
Aru Tai taikhan ke koise, “Jabi usor thaka bosti te, aru tumi ta te puncha loge-loge gadha puwali juntu uporte kun manu bhi boha nai, etu bandhi thaka pabo. Etu ke Khuli Kena loi anibi.
Aru jodi kunba tumike kunba eneka hude, ‘Kile eneka kori ase?’ Titia taike kobi, ‘Probhu ke etu lagi ase, titia tai joldi pathai dibo.’ ”
Karone taikhan jaise aru etu gadha puwali ke dorja bahar rasta te bandha paise, aru taikhan khuli loi anise.
Kintu kunba manu ta te khara khan pora hudise, “Etu ki kori ase, gadha puwali ke kele khuli ase?”
Aru Jisu pora kowa nisena taikhan etu manu ke koise, etu pichete taikhan ke jabole dise.
Titia taikhan gadha puwali loi anise, aru taikhan nijor kapra etu uporte bichai dise, aru Tai etu uporte bohi jaise.
Aru bisi manu nijor kapra rasta te bichai dise, aru dusra khan ghas laga daal kati ani rasta te bichai dise.
Tai laga age ja-a khan aru piche kora khan sob hala kori kene koise, “Hosanna dhoinyo ase jun Probhu laga naam te ahise.
Probhu naam pora ami laga baba David laga rajyo loi aha ke dhoinyo! Mark 11:11 xlviii Mark 11:17 Hosanna Tai laga naam untcha koribi!*
Aru Jisu Jerusalem sheher te ahi kene mondoli te jaise, aru Tai ghuri kene sob saise, aru bisi deri huwa karone, Tai baroh jonke loi kene Bethany te jai jaise. Jisu Pora Dimoru Gash Ke Shrap Diya
Aru dusra din jitia taikhan Bethany pora ulai ahise, Tai bhuk lagise.
Aru dur pora ekta dimoru ghas te pata thaka dikhi kene ta te kiba pabo bhabi kene Tai etu usor jaise. Kintu Tai khali pata he thaka paise, kelemane etu somoi to dimoru guti dibole somoi nohoi,
Titia Jisu pora etu ghas ke koise, “Etiya pora kun bhi tumi laga phol aru nakhabo.” Aru Tai chela khan etu kotha kowa hunise.

Etu pichete taikhan Jerusalem sheher te ahise aru Jisu mondoli bhitor te jaise. Ta te bikiri kori thaka aru kini thaka khan ke bahar te ulai dise, aru taikhan laga mezkhan ultai dise aru kabotar bikiri kori thaka khan laga chowki bhi ultai dise.
Aru Tai kunke bhi eku jinis mondoli bhitor te loi aha-juwa kori bole diya nai.

Titia Tai sikhai dikene koise, “Isor kotha te eneka likha ase nohoi, ‘Ami laga ghor to sob jati khan karone prathana ghor hobo?†’ Kintu tumikhan etu ke chor dokait laga ghor bonai dise.” * 11:10 Mat. 23:39. † 11:17 Isa. 56:7; Jer .7:11; Luke 19:46. Mark 11:18 xlix Mark 11:26
Aru mukhyo purohit khan aru niyom likha khan etu hunise aru Taike khotom kori bole bisarise. Taikhan bhoi korise, kelemane sob manu Tai laga kotha huni kene asurit hoi thaka karone.
Aru jitia saam ahise, Tai sheher pora bahar te ulai jaise. Sukhi Juwa Dimoru Gash Pora Sikha
Aru dusra din phojur jitia taikhan jai asele, taikhan etu dimoru ghas to tai laga jor tak sukhi ja dikhise.
Aru Peter laga monte ahise, aru tai Jisu ke hudise, “Rabbi, sabi! Dimoru ghas junke Apuni shrap disele, etu sukhi jaise.”
Karone Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Isor ke biswas rakhibi.
Kelemane Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo, jun bhi etu ‘pahar ke yate pora ulai samundar te dubi jabi,’ eneka chinta nathakikena etu hoi jabo biswas thakile, etu bhi hoi jabo.
Karone Moi tumikhan ke kobo, tumikhan prathana te ki mangise, etu sob paise koi kene biswas korile etu pabo.
Aru jitia tumikhan prathana kori bole hoi, jodi tumi laga monte kunba ke biya pai thakile, taike maph kori dibi, eneka korise koile tumi laga sorgote thaka Baba bhi tumi laga golti maph kori dibo.
Kintu jodi tumikhan manu ke maph nadile tumi laga sorgo Baba bhi tumikhan laga golti maph nadibo.” Jisu Laga Adhikar Huda Mark 11:27 l Mark 12:1
Jitia Jisu aru chela khan aru Jerusalem sheher te ahise, aru Tai mondoli te berai thakise, titia mukhyo purohit khan, niyom likha khan aru bura khan tai logote ahise.
Aru taikhan hudise, “Apuni ki hokti pora etu sob kori ase Aru kun Tumike etu kori bole dise?”
Kintu Jisu taikhan ke jowab di koise, “Moi bhi tumikhan ke ekta kotha hudibo. Moike kobi, aru Moi bhi tumikhan ke kobo Moi ki takot pora eitu khan kori ase.
John pora baptizma diya to sorgo pora ahise, na manu pora ahise? Moike jowab dibi.”
Titia taikhan majote kotha patise, “Jodi amikhan sorgo pora ase koile, Tai kobo, ‘Tumikhan kele taike biswas kora nai?’
Kintu jodi amikhan ‘Manu pora’ koile .....” Bisi manu pora John ke bhabobadi mani thake nimite taikhan bhoi kori thakise.
Karone taikhan Jisu ke koise, “Amikhan najane.” Karone Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Moi bhi tumikhan ke Moi ki laga takot pora etu sob kaam kori ase nokobo.” 12 Kheti Kora Khan Dristanto

Titia Jisu dristanto pora manu khan ke koise, “Ekjon manu draikha baari ekta bonaise, aru char kona phale bera lagai dise, aru ros khunda jaga bonaise, aru machang bonai kene kunba kaam kora manu ke theka di dikena tai to safar te ulai jaise.* * 12:1 Isa. 5:1-2 Mark 12:2 li Mark 12:11
Jitia ros ulabole somoi ahise, malik pora nokor ke angur pabo pare bhabi kene draikha baari te kaam kora manu khan logote pathaise.
Kintu taikhan pora nokor ke dhori kene marise, aru taike khali hath pathai dise.
Titia tai aru dusra ekjon nokor ke pathaise, hoilebi taikhan etu nokor laga matha te pathor pora mari dikena jokhom kori dise aru sorom khilai se.
Aru tai dusra ekjon ke pathaise, aru etu bar to nokor ke morai dise. Tai bisi manu ke pathaise: kintu taikhan arubi kunba ke marise, aru dusra khan ke morai dise.
Tai logot pathabole ekjon he thaki jaise, tai laga ekjon morom thaka chokra. Tai eneka bhabona korise, ‘Taikhan bhi ami laga chokra ke to morom koribo.’
Kintu kaam kora manu taikhan bhithor te kotha korise, ‘etu to uttoradhikari ase, ahibi amikhan taike morai dibo, aru tai laga sob to amikhan laga hoi jabo.’
Aru taikhan taike loijai kene mari dise, aru taike draikha baari bahar te phelai dise.
Karone etiya draikha baari laga malik ki koribo? Tai ahi kene kaam kora manu khan ke khotom kori dibo, aru draikha baari to dusra ke di dibo.
Tumikhan Shastro te porha nai naki? ‘Pathor mistiri khan pora chari diya pathor kona te thakise, Aru etu he ghor khara kora laga asol pathor hoi jaise.
Etu Probhu pora he hoise, Mark 12:12 lii Mark 12:18 Ami laga suku pora sabole bisi asurit ase.†’ ”

Aru mukhyo purohit khan, niyom hika khan aru bura khan buji jaise Tai taikhan bhirodh te etu dristanto koise, aru taike dhori bole bhabisele, kintu manu ke bhoi pora chari dise aru jai jaise. Caesar Logot Khajana Diya
Titia Yehudi cholauta khan Jisu laga kotha pora Taike dhori bole kunba Pharisee aru Herod laga manu khan ke Tai logote pathaise.

Aru taikhan koise, “Shika manu, amikhan jane Apuni hosa ase, aru kunke bhi bhoi nakore, kelemane Apuni manu laga mukh saikene kotha nakore, kintu Isor laga hosa rasta he sikhai, karone Caesar‡ ke masul diya to thik ase na nai? Moi khan etu dibo lage na nai?”
Kintu Tai taikhan laga chalak jani kene koise, “Kile Moike porikha kori ase? Ekta chandi poisa anikena Moike dikhabi.”
Karone taikhan ekta anise, aru Tai koise, “Etu kun laga chehera aru naam ase?” Taikhan koise, “Caesar laga ase.”
Aru Jisu taikhan ke jowab dise, “Eneka hoile ki Caesar laga ase, Caesar ke di dibi, aru ki Isor laga ase, etu Isor ke dibi.” Aru taikhan Taike asurit hoise. Sadducee Khan Pora Punoruthan Laga Hudise

Titia Sadducee jun khan mora pora jee na uthibo koi, Tai logote ahise. Aru Taike hudise, † 12:11 Psa. 118:22-23; Mat. 21:42; Luke 20:17; Acts 4:11; 1 Pet. 2:7. ‡ 12:14 Rome raja laga naam. Mark 12:19 liii Mark 12:27

“Shika manu, Moses he amikhan ke etu niyom likhi disele, jodi kunba bhai bacha nathaki kene mori jai, aru tai laga maiki to thake, titia tai bhai he etu maiki ke lobo aru tai bhai laga naam age loi jabole koise.
Tinehoile age te sat-ta bhai asele, prothom bhai shadi kori kene bacha nathaki kene mori jaise.
Aru dusra bhai etu ke loise aru etu bhi bacha nohoi kene mori jaise, aru tisra bhai ke bhi thik eneka he hoise.
Aru sat-ta bhai sob taike loise aru bacha nathaki kene sob mori jaise, pichete etu maiki bhi mori jaise.
Karone jee utha pichete tai kun laga maiki hobo? Kelemane tai sat jon bhai laga maiki thakisele.”
Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan Shastro te likha kotha khan aru Isor laga hokti najana karone golti kori thake nohoi?
Kelemane jitia taikhan mora pora jee uthibo taikhan shadi nakoribo, kintu sorgote Isor laga duth nisena thaki jabo.

Kintu mora pora jee utha kotha khan nimite tumikhan Moses laga kitab te porha nai, joli thaka jhari te, kineka Isor he taike eneka koisele, ‘Moi Abraham laga Isor ,Isaac laga Isor , aru Jacob laga Isor ase?§’
Isor to mora khan laga Isor nohoi, kintu jinda khan laga Isor ase etu karone tumikhan bisi dangor golti kori thake.” Dangor Hukum § 12:26 Exo. 3:2-6. Mark 12:28 liv Mark 12:35
Titia ekjon niyom likha jon pora taikhan etu kotha kori thaka hunise. Aru Jisu pora etu laga thik jowab diya huni kene, tai Jisu ke hudise, “Sob pora prothom hukum to ki ase?”
Jisu taike koise, “Sobse poila, ‘Huni bhi Israel, sob pora prothom hukum to amikhan laga Probhu he Isor ase, aru ekjon he Probhu ase*.
Aru tumi pura mon, pura atma, pura dimag, aru pura takot pora Probhu Isor ke morom koribi.†’
Aru dusra hukum to etu kowa ase, ‘Tumi laga ghor usor manu khan ke nijor nisena morom koribi.‡’ Etu duita pora dusra dangor hukum aru nai.”
Karone likha manu Taike koise, “Bhal Shika manu! Apuni hosa pora koi dise, kelemane Isor ekjon he ase, aru Taike chari kene dusra nai.
Aru pura mon, pura dimag, pura atma, aru pura takot pora Isor ke morom kora, aru usor manu khan ke nijor nisena morom kora to daan kora aru bolidan diya pora bhi bisi dangor ase.§”
Jitia Jisu tai bhal jowab diya dikhise, Tai taike koise, “Tumi Isor laga rajyo pora dur nohoi.” Etu pichete, kun bhi Jisu ke aru kiba hudibole mon dangor kora nai. Khrista Kun Laga Putro Ase

Pichete, Jisu mondoli laga bahar jagate sikhai thakise, Tai hudise, “Kanun likha khan to * 12:29 Deu. 6:4. † 12:30 Deu. 6:5. ‡ 12:31 Lev. 19:18. § 12:33 Deu. 6:4-5; Lev. 19:18; Hos. 6:6. Mark 12:36 lv Mark 12:43 kineka Khrista to David laga chokra ase koi thake?”

Kelemane David to Pobitro Atma te bhorta hoi kene eneka koise, ‘Probhu he ami laga Probhu ke koise, “Ami laga dyna hath phale bohi thakibi, Jitia tak Moi pora tumi laga dushman khan ke tumi laga theng nichete nadibo, titia tak.*’ ”
David tai nijor Taike ‘Probhu’ koise, to David laga chokra tai kineka hobo? Aru bisi manu khan Tai kotha ke shanti pora huni asele. Kanun Likha Khan Pora Hoshiar Koribi
Titia Jisu sikhai thaka somoite taikhan ke koise, “Likha manu khan pora hoshiar thakibi, jun kapra lamba kori lagai berai thake, aru bajar te salam diya bhal pai,
mondoli te bhal jaga, aru kha luwa te bhal jaga bisara khan.
Taikhan bidhowa khan laga ghor hajam kori diye, aru bahana pora lamba prathana kori thake, eitu khan bisi dangor saja pabo.” Ekjon Bidhowa Laga Daan
Titia Jisu mondoli te daan diya daba usorte bohi kene sai thakise jun khan ahikena daba te poisa haali thakise. Aru dhuni khan bisi-bisi di thakise.
Titia gorib bidhowa ahikena duita paisa dise.
Titia Tai chela khan ke mati anikena koise, “Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo. Manu khan daba * 12:36 Psa. 110:1. Mark 12:44 lvi Mark 13:7 te daan diya te etu gorib bidhowa he sob pora bisi dise.

Kelemane sob manu taikhan nijor dhun bisi thaka pora dise. Kintu tai to bisi nathakilebi tai logote ki ase etu sob dise, motlob tai jinda thakibo laga sob di dise.” 13 Mondir Nosto Kotha Jisu He Age Te Kowa
Jitia Jisu mondoli pora ulaikene jai thakise, chela ekjon Taike koise, “Sikha manu, sabi, kineka bhal asurit pathor ase etu, aru kiman asurit ghor ase yate?
Aru Jisu jowab di taike koise, “Tumi etu dangor ghor dikhi ase? Yate ekta pathor bhi ekta uporte nathiki jabo, sob pathor ke girai dibo.” Yug Hekh Homoi Laga Chihna
Titia Tai mondoli samne te Oliv Pahar te bohi asele, titia Peter ,James, John aru Andrew taikhan lukaikene Taike hudise.
“Etu sob kotha kitia hobo, etu amikhan ke koi dibi, aru kitia etu sob kotha pura hobole hoi, etu laga chihna kineka hobo?”
Aru Jisu taikhan ke jowab di koise, “Hoshiar hobi, kun pora bhi tumikhan ke thogabo nadibi.
Kelemane bisi manu Ami laga naam loi ahikena kobo, ‘Moi he Tai ase,’ aru bisi manu ke thogai loijabo.
Kintu jitia tumikhan lorai aru mara-mari laga awaj hunibo, titia chinta nokoribi, kelemane eitu khan hobole dorkar ase, kintu etu bhi hekh somoi nohoi. Mark 13:8 lvii Mark 13:14

Kelemane ekta desh pora dusra desh ke bhirodh koribo, ekta rajyo pora dusra rajyo ke bhirodh koribo, aru jaga-jagate mati hili bo, aru titia khabole eku napabo. Etu sob to bacha jonom hobole shuru te bikha nisena ase.

Tumikhan nijor hoshiar thakibi. Ami nimite tumikhan ke dhori kene sabhakhan te aru mondoli khan te di dibo, tumikhan ke maribo, pitibo, aru tumikhan ke sorkar aru raja khan usorte loijabo, taikhan nimite gawahi hobole.
Kintu prothom te susamachar sob jati ke prochar kori dibo lagibo.

Jitia taikhan pora tumikhan ke dhori kene manu laga hathte di dibo, tumikhan ki kobo lage, etu nimite chinta na koribi, kintu tumikhan utu somoite ki kobo lage, etu he koi dibi, kelemane tumikhan pora nokobo, kintu Pobitro Atma pora he kobo.
Titia bhai pora bhai ke dhurikena morai dibo, aru baba pora bacha ke morai dibo, bacha khan pora nijor ama-baba laga bhirodh hoi kene taikhan ke morai dibo*.
Aru Ami karone sob tumikhan ke ghin koribo, kintu hekh tak jun dhorjo thakibo paribo tai he poritran pabo. Ghin Laga Letera Bostu

Kintu jitia paap laga ghin kaam khotom kora ke kuntu jagah te khara nathakibole lage ta te khara kora tumikhan dikhile- kun porhibo tai he bujhi bole dibi- titia jun Judea te ase, pahar te polai jabi†, * 13:12 Luke 21:16; Mic. 7:6 † 13:14 Dan. 11:31; 12:1 Mark 13:15 lviii Mark 13:25
Jun ghor uporte ase, taike niche najabole aru jai kene ghor bhitor pora kiba bahar te ulabole nadibi.
Aru jun kheti te ase, taike nijor kapra lobole ghuri ahibo nadibi.
Kintu etu dinte jun maiki khan pet te bacha bukhi se, aru jun bacha dudh khilai thakise, taikhan nimite hai ase.
Etu sob thanda dinte nohobo nimite prathana kori thakibi.
Kelemane etu din eneka dukh din hobo, jitia shuru pora Isor sristi bona homoi pora aji tak eneka dukh aha nai, aru kitia bhi nohobo.
Aru jodi Probhu he etu din to khata kori nadile kunbi bachibole nohoi, kintu basi luwa khan karone Tai etu din khan khata kori dise.
Aru jodi kunba tumikhan ke kobo, ‘Sabi, Khrista yate ase nohoile, ‘Sabi Tai ta te ase,’ etu biswas na koribi.
Kelemane misa khrista aru misa bhabobadi ahibo, aru chihna aru asurit dikha bo, aru jodi parile basi luwa khan ke bhi thogai loijabo.
Kintu hoshiar thakibi, sabi Moi age pora tumikhan ke koi ase. Manu Laga Putro Aha
Kintu etu dukh din laga pichete Suryo andhera hoi jabo, Aru chand bhi ujala nadibo‡.
Titia akas laga tara bhi giri jabo, Aru akas laga hokti hili jabo§ ‡ 13:24 Isa. 13:10. § 13:25 Isa. 34:4. Mark 13:26 lix Mark 13:34
Titia Manu laga Putro dangor hokti aru mohima hoi badal pora aha taikhan dikhibo*.
Titia Tai duth khan ke pathai kene prithibi laga kona pora akas laga kona tak, char phale hawa pora Tai basi luwa sobke joma kori lobo†. Dimoru Gash Laga Dristanto
Titia dimoru ghas pora dristanto sikhi lobi, jitia ghas laga daal komoliya hoi, aru pata ulabole hoi, gorom din usor hoise koi kene tumikhan jani jai.
Etu karone jitia etu sob hoi thaka dikhile jani lobi Jisu‡ dorja usorte ahi jaise.
Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo, jitia tak etu sob kotha pura nohobo, titia tak etu yug laga manu khan harai najabo.
Akas aru prithibi harai jabo, kintu Ami laga kotha khan kitia bhi naharabo§. Din Aru Homoi Kunbi Najane
Kintu etu din aru etu somoi kun bhi najane, sorgodoth khan bhi, aru Putro bhi najane, kintu khali Baba he jane.
Hoshiar pora sai thakibi, uthi kene prathana kori thakibi kelemane tumikhan najane etu somoi kitia ahibo.

Etu to ekjon manu pora tai laga nokorkhan ke adhikar dikene, taikhan sobke nijor kaam dikene aru chokidar ke bhal pora sob sai thaki bole hukum dikene dusra jagate jai ja nisena ase. * 13:26 Dan. 7:13; Rev. 1:17. † 13:27 Due. 30:4; Matt. 24:31 ‡ 13:29 Manu laga Putro. § 13:31 Isa. 40:8; Luke 21:33. Mark 13:35 lx Mark 14:5
Karone hoshiar thakibi, kelemane tumikhan najane, malik kitia ghor te ahibo, saam te hobo na adha rati te hobo, na murga hala kora homoi te hobo, nohoile phojurte hobo.
Tai achanak ahikena tumikhan ghumai thaka pai jabo pare.
Etu pora Moi tumikhan ke ki koise, Moi sobke koi ase; Hoshiar hoi thakibi!” 14 Jisu Ke Morabo Nimite Buddhi Kora
Dui din pichete Khomir Nathaka Roti laga Purbb hobole asele. Aru prodhan purohit khan aru niyom likha khan kineka kori Taike thogai dikene morai dibole bisari asele.
Kintu taikhan apaste eneka koi thakise, “Purbb dinte eneka nohobo lage, kelemane manu majote gondugol kori biya hoi jabo.” Bethany Te Jisu Ke Abhishek Kora

Jitia Jisu Bethany te Simon junke korhi bemar thakise, tai laga ghor te kha luwa kori bole bohi asele, ekjon mahila ekta alabaster daba te bisi daam laga abhishek kora shudh tel loi anise. Aru tai etu khuli kene Jisu laga matha te hali dise.
Kintu kunba biya paikene ekjon-ekjon ke koise, “Kile etu abhishek tel borbad kori ase?
Kilekoile etu tel bikiri korile tin-sou dinar pora bhi bisi pabo, aru loi kene dukhiya khan ke dibo pare.” Eneka hoi kene taikhan tai bhirodh te kotha korise. Mark 14:6 lxi Mark 14:13
Kintu Jisu pora taikhan ke koise, “Taike chari- dibi, tumikhan kele taike digdar kori ase? Tai Moi karone bhal kaam korise.
Dukhiya khan hodai tumikhan logote thakibo, aru jitia itcha hoi, taikhan ke bhal kaam koribo pare, kintu Moi hodai tumikhan logote nathakibo*.
Tai ki koribo pare, etu tai kori dise. Moike matite moidam diya age te tai tel loi kene Moi laga gaw te haali kene abhishek kori dise.
Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo, pura prithibi te susamachar prochar kori juwa te etu mahila kori diya laga kotha bhi taike yaad thakibo karone kobo.” Judas Pora Jisu ke Thogai Diya
Titia Iscariot Judas baroh jon majot te ekjon asele, Jisu ke dhori dibole prodhan purohit khan logote jaise.
Aru etu huni kene taikhan bisi khushi hoi kene taike poisa dibole koi dise, karone tai etu somoi pora Taike dhori dibole bhal somoi sai thakise. Chela Khan Logot Nistar Purbb

Khomir nathaka Roti Purbb laga prothom din, jitia taikhan Nistar laga mer bacha ke bolidan di thakise, Tai chela khan Taike hudise, “Kun jagah te amikhan Nistar purbb nimite taiyar kori bole Apuni laga itcha ase?†”
Aru Tai duijon chela ke pathai kene koise, “Sheher te jabi, aru ekjon ekta kolsi te pani loi juwa pai jabo, tai piche-piche jabi. * 14:7 Due. 15:11. † 14:12 Exo. 12:6, 15. Mark 14:14 lxii Mark 14:22
Aru kot te tai jabo ta te tumi bhi jabi, aru jai kene ghor malik ke kobi, ‘Shika manu koise, “Alohi khan karone jagah kot te ase? Ami laga chela khan logote kot te Nistar khabo?’ ”
Titia tai sapha kori rakhi thaka uporte ekta kamra dikhai dibo, ta te amikhan karone taiyar kori kene rakhibi.”
Titia tai laga duijon chela sheher te ahise, aru jineka Tai taikhan ke koise thik tineka paise aru taikhan Nistar nimite taiyar kori rakhise.
Jitia saam hoise, Jisu aru chela baroh jon ahise.
Jitia taikhan khai asele titia Jisu koise, “Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo, tumikhan majote ekjon jun Moi logote kha luwa kori ase tai Moike thogai dibo.‡”
Aru taikhan bisi mon dukh hoise, aru Taikhan ekjon-ekjon kori sob Taike hudise, “Etu moi ase?”
Tai taikhan ke jowab di koise, “Etu baroh jon te ekjon ase, jun Moi logote eke thali te bhi jai kene khai ase.

Kelemane Manu laga Putro nimite jineka Isor laga kotha te likhi rakhise, tineka hoi ase. Kintu jun pora Manu laga Putro ke thogai di dise, taike hai ase! Tai to jonom nohoile he tai nimite bhal hobo asele.” Probhu Bhoj Shuru Kora

Aru jitia taikhan khai thakise, titia Jisu roti loise aru dhonyabad diya pichete bhangai se, aru taikhan ke eneka koi kene dise, “Lobi aru khabi. Etu Ami laga gaw ase.” ‡ 14:18 Psa. 41:9. Mark 14:23 lxiii Mark 14:31
Titia Tai kup loi kene Isor ke dhanyavad dise aru taikhan ke dise. Aru taikhan sob etu pora pi loise.
Aru Tai taikhan ke koise, “Etu khun to bisi manu karone Moi bahai diya khun laga vachan ase§.
Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo, Isor laga rajyote notun angur phol laga ros napiya tak Moi aru etu napibo.” Peter Pora Jisu Ke Ashikar Kori bole Thaka Jisu Koi Diya
Aru titia taikhan gana kori loise, taikhan Oliv Pahar te jai jaise.
Titia Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan sob Moike charikena jai jabo, etu Isor kotha te likha ase, ‘Moi roikhya ke maribo Aru mer khan ephale-uphale hoi jabo.’
Kintu Moi jee utha pichete tumi pora age Galilee te jai jabo.”
Kintu Peter Taike koise, “Jodi sob manu giri le bhi, moi to nohobo.”
Jisu taike koise, “Moi tumike hosa kobo, aji rati murga duibar hala nakora age te tumi tin bar Moike najana kobo.”

Kintu tai aru jor pora koise, “Jodi Apuni logote moribo koile bhi, moi Apuni ke kitia bhi najana nokobo.” Aru sob chela khan bhi tineka koise. Gethsemane Te Jisu Prathana Kora § 14:24 Exo. 24:8; Zec. 9:11. Mark 14:32 lxiv Mark 14:41
Titia taikhan Gethsemane naam ekta jagate ahise, aru Jisu Tai chela khan ke koise, “Moi prathana kori thaka somoite yate bohibi.”
Aru Tai Peter ,James aru John ke loi kene tai logote jaise, aru Tai bisi dukh aru chinta bhabona hoise.
Tai koise, “Ami laga atma bisi dukh hoise, mori bole nisena. Na ghumai kene yate rukhi thakibi.*”
Titia olop dur jai kene, Jisu niche giri prathana korise, jodi parile etu somoi ke Tai pora dur kori dibole.
Aru Tai koise, “Abba, Baba Apuni to sob koribo pare. Moi pora etu kup hatai dibi. Hoile bhi Ami laga itcha nohoi kintu jineka Apuni laga itcha ase, eneka koribi.”
Titia Tai ahikena tinjon to ghumai thaka paise aru Peter ke koise, “Hey Peter ,tumi ghumai jaise? Tumi ek-ghanta bhi rukhibo napare?
Tumikhan porikha te nagiribo karone na ghumai kene prathana kori thakibi, Atma to taiyar ase kintu gaw to komjur ase.”
Aru Tai jai kene age te kowa nisena koi kene prathana korise.
Aru jitia Tai wapas ahise, arubi tinjon ke ghumai thaka paise kelemane taikhan laga suku nindh pora bhorta asele. Aru Taike ki jowab dibo najana hoi thakise.

Titia tin-bar ahi kene taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan etiya bhi aram pora ghumai ase? Hoise! Somoi ponchise. Sabi! Manu laga Putro * 14:34 Psa. 42:5. Mark 14:42 lxv Mark 14:51 ke dhori kene paapi khan laga hathte di dibole hoise.
Uthibi, amikhan jai jabo, sabi, Moike thoga manu usor ase.” Jisu Ke Thogai Kena Dhori Luwa
Aru tai etu kotha koi thaka somoite, Judas baroh jon te ekjon to, prodhan purohit, likha manu aru bura khan pora pathai diya talwar , lathi aru bisi manu loi ahise.
Taike thogai diya manu taikhan ke ekta chihna disele, “Junke moi chuma dibo, etu ase, Taike dhori lobi, aru dhuri kene loijabi.”
Aru jitia Judas ahise, tai joldi ahi kene Jisu ke koise, “Rabbi,” aru Taike chuma dise.
Titia taikhan ahi kene hath pora Taike dhori loise.
Aru ta te usorte khara thaka ekjon talwar ulaikene moha purohit laga nokor uporte cholai dise, aru tai laga kan kati dise.
Titia Jisu taikhan ke jowab dise, “Tumikhan Moike daku bhabi kene Moike dhori bole talwar aru lathi loi ahise?
Moi hodai din mondoli te tumikhan logote bohi prochar kori thakise, aru tumikhan Moike dhora nai, kintu Shastro te likha pura hobo karone eneka hoise.”
Titia Jisu laga chela khan sob Taike chari kene polai jaise†. Jawan Putro Ekjon Pola

Aru ekjon jawan chokra kapra napindi kene bodon te ekta mihin kapra lagai kene Jisu † 14:50 Psa. 88:18. Mark 14:52 lxvi Mark 14:61 laga piche kori ahi thakise. Aru kunba manu khan pora taike dhori loise,
kintu tai pindhi thaka mihin kapra chari dise aru eku kapra napindhi kene polai jaise. Sabha Age Te Jisu Ke Khara Kora
Aru taikhan Jisu ke loi kene moha purohit logote jaise, aru ta te prodhan purohit khan, niyom likha khan aru bura khan sob joma hoise.
Kintu Peter dur hoi kene Tai piche-piche ahi moha purohit laga veranda te nokorkhan logote jui thapi thakise.
Titia prodhan purohit aru sob maha sabha Taike morai dibole Jisu laga bhirodh misa kotha bisarise kintu eku pa-a nai.
Kelemane bisi manu Tai bhirodh te misa kotha koi dise, kintu taikhan laga kotha thik mila nai.
Titia kunba khara hoi kene Tai bhirodh te misa kotha di koise.
“Tai eneka kowa amikhan hunise, ‘Moi manu hath pora bonai rakha etu mondoli ke bhangai dikene, aru tin dinte dusra juntu hath pora bona nohoi, etu ke bonai dibo.”
Kintu titia bhi taikhan laga kotha thik milabo para nai.
Aru moha purohit taikhan majote uthi kene Jisu ke hudise, “Apuni eku bhi nokobo? Manu khan Apuni bhirodh te ki koi ase?”
Kintu Tai ekdom chup thakise. Aru eku jowab diya nai. Aru moha purohit Taike hudi koise. “Apuni Dhoinyo Jon laga Putro Khrista ase?” Mark 14:62 lxvii Mark 14:70
Jisu koise, “Moi ase; Aru tumikhan dikhibo Manu laga Putro ke dikhibo Jitia Tai hokti laga dyna hath phale bohibo Aru akas laga badal pora ahi thaka dikhibo‡.”
Titia moha purohit bisi ghusa hoi kene tai laga kapra phatai kene koise, “Etiya amikhan ki gawah dibo lage?
Apuni khan bhi Isor laga ninda kowa hunise. Apuni khan ki bhabi ase?” Aru taikhan sob taike morai dibo lage koise§.
Titia kunba Tai uporte thuki se, aru tai laga mukh dhakai dise, aru Taike marikena koise, “Bhabobani kobi!” Aru daruga khan bhi Taike loi jaise aru thapor marise. Peter He Jisu Ke Ashikar Kora
Etu homoi te Peter nichete bohi asele aru moha purohit laga nokorni ta te ahise.
Aru taike koise, “Tumi bhi Nazareth Jisu logote asele nohoi?”
Kintu tai nohoi koise, “Moi najane, tumi ki koi ase moi bujhi panai.” Aru tai bahar ulai jaise.
Aru etu nokorni taike aru dikhi kene usor thaka khan ke koise, “Etu manu bhi taikhan logot ekjon ase!”

Kintu tai nohoi koi dise, aru olop, pichete ta te khara thaka ekjon pora Peter ke koise, “Hosa ase, tumi bhi taikhan majote ekjon ase, kelemane tumi bhi Galilee manu ase.” ‡ 14:62 Dan. 7:13; Psa. 110:1. § 14:64 Lev. 24:16. Mark 14:71 lxviii Mark 15:8
Titia Tai shrap di kosom khai koise, “Apuni jun laga kotha koi ase moi etu manu ke najane.”

Aru titia dusra bar murga hala korise. Titia Peter Jisu kowa kotha ke bhabona korise, “Murga duibar hala kora age te tumi Moike tin-bar najane kobo,” aru titia tai etu kotha bhabi kene kandise. 15 Jisu Ke Pilate Logot Te Dise
Dusra din phojur huwa loge-loge mukhyo purohit khan pora niyom likha khan, bura khan aru pura sabha manu khan kotha milai kene Jisu ke bandi Pilate laga hathte di dise.
Pilate pora Jisu ke hudise, “Tumi Yehudi laga raja ase?” Tai jowab di taike koise, “Apuni kowa to ase.”
Aru purohit khan Taike bisi kotha te bodnam lagaise.
Titia Pilate Taike koise, “Apuni eku jowab nadibo? Sabi taikhan Tumi laga bhirodh te ki bodnam lagai ase?”
Kintu Jisu eku kowa nai, karone Pilate bisi asurit hoise.
Aru etu purbb somoi ekta manu bondhi te thaka ke chari dibole niyom thake, kunke taikhan chari dibole itcha kore.
Aru ta te Barabbas naam ekjon manu morai diya taikhan logote bondhi te asele aru jun he bhirodh kori kene manu morai disele.
Titia bhir pora taike binti korise jineka niyom kori ahise tineka kori dibi koi kene jor pora hala korise. Mark 15:9 lxix Mark 15:19
Kintu Pilate taikhan ke jowab di koise, “Moi tumikhan nimite Yehudi laga Raja ke chari dibo naki?”
Kelemane tai jani asele mukhyo purohit khan he Taike suku joli kene dhori taike di dise.
Kintu mukhyo purohit khan pora Barabbas taikhan ke dibi koi kene manu khan ke chukuli kori dise.
Aru Pilate koise, “Tinehoile moi tumikhan Yehudi laga Raja Taike ki kori dibo?”
Etu karone taikhan aru hala kori koise, “Taike Cross te mari dibi!”
Titia Pilate taikhan ke koise, “Kile, Tai ki biya kaam korise?” Kintu taikhan aru bisi jor pora hala kori kene koise, “Taike ke Cross te mari dibi.”
Karone Pilate bisi manu ke khushi kori dibo itcha pora Barabbas ke taikhan nimite chari dise, aru Jisu ke chabuk mari kene Taike Cross te mari bole di dise. Jisu Ke Ninda Kora
Titia sipahi khan Taike raja laga darbar -kuntu ke Praetorium koi- ta te loi jaise aru pura platon joma kori loise.
Aru taikhan begoni rong kapra Taike pindhai dise, aru katta thaka laga mukut bonai kene Tai laga matha te rakhidise.
Aru Taike eneka koi thakise: “Salam, Yehudi laga Raja!”
Titia taikhan ekta lathi loi kene Tai matha te mari thakise, aru Tai upor thuk phelaise aru athukari kene taike sonman kora nisena kori thakise. Mark 15:20 lxx Mark 15:29
Jitia Taike dhamali kori loise, Taike age te begoni rong kapra pindhai diya to ulaikene Tai nijor kapra lagai dise, aru Taike Cross te mari dibole bahar te loi jaise. Cross Te Mora
Titia taikhan Cyrene desh laga Alexander aru Rufus laga baba Simon, jun desh pora ahi asele, taike joborjosti Jisu laga Cross ke loi jabole dhori loise*.
Aru taikhan Taike Golgotha- naam motlob ase, “Matha Hardi laga jaga”- ta te loi anise.
Taike tita pani draikha ros logot milai kene khabo dibole bisarise, kintu Tai etu khanai.
Aru Taike Cross te mari dise, aru chithi kheli kene Tai laga kapra bhag kori loise kun ki pabo koi kene†.
Aru tin ghanta somoite taikhan Taike Cross te mari dise.
Aru Tai matha uporte Tai laga golti likhi dise, “Yehudi Khan Laga Raja” koi kene.
Aru Rome sipahi khan pora duita chor bhi Cross te mari dise, ejkon Tai dyna phale, aru dusra Tai laga baya phale.
Aru Taike golti thaka khan logote ginti kori loise koi kene Shastro te likhi diya kotha pura hoise‡.

Aru rasta te aha juwa kori thaka khan sob nijor laga matha hilai kene hinsa korise, “Ha! Tumi mondoli bhangai dikene, aru tin dinte bonai dibo kowa manu§. * 15:21 Cyrene to Uttor Africa te Cyrenaica jaga laga prodhan sheher ase. † 15:24 Psa. 22:18. ‡ 15:28 Isa. 53:12. § 15:29 Psa. 22:7; 109:25. Mark 15:30 lxxi Mark 15:39

Titia ekta dangor chihna sorgote ulaise: ekjon mahila suryo pora kapra lagai kene, aru chand tai laga theng nichete, aru baroh ta tara laga mukut tai laga matha te pindhise.
